<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de" data-theme="dark">

<head>

  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
  <title>Simon's Lab</title>
  <style>
    /* ==========================================================================
   NFL FOOTBALL LAB: UNIFIED DESIGN SYSTEM & SEMANTIC TOKENS
   Minimalist, High-Contrast, Timeless & Accessible Design System
   ========================================================================== */

    :root {
      color-scheme: dark;

      /* Surfaces & Backgrounds (Dark Mode: Deep Slate-Charcoal) */
      --bg: #0d1117;
      --bg-subtle: #13171f;
      --bg-card: #161b22;
      --bg-card-hover: #1c212a;
      --bg-elevated: #21262d;
      --bg-active: #28303b;

      /* Typography / Text Inks (Dark Mode) */
      --ink: #f0f6fc;
      --ink-secondary: #c9d1d9;
      --mut: #8b949e;
      --ink-inverse: #0d1117;

      /* Structural Borders & Dividers */
      --border: #30363d;
      --border-subtle: #21262d;
      --border-hover: #484f58;
      --border-focus: #58a6ff;

      /* Functional Football Brand Accents (Dark Mode) */
      --g: #238636;
      --g-light: #2ea043;
      --g-dark: #196c2e;
      --g-subtle: rgba(35, 134, 54, 0.15);

      --accent: #d29922;
      --accent-light: #e3b341;
      --accent-subtle: rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.15);
      --y: #d29922;
      --y-glow: transparent;

      /* Status Colors */
      --status-success: #238636;
      --status-success-subtle: rgba(35, 134, 54, 0.15);
      --status-warning: #d29922;
      --status-warning-subtle: rgba(210, 153, 34, 0.15);
      --status-danger: #f85149;
      --status-danger-subtle: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.15);
      --status-info: #58a6ff;
      --status-info-subtle: rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.15);

      /* Tactical Football Scheme Tokens (Preserved for Sports Diagrams) */
      --field-turf-1: #154524;
      --field-turf-2: #194f2a;
      --field-endzone: #0d361c;
      --field-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      --field-hash: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      --los-blue: #3b82f6;
      --fd-yellow: #eab308;
      --hud-bg: var(--bg-card);

      /* Typography Scale */
      --font-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Monaco, "Cascadia Code", "Roboto Mono", Consolas, monospace;

      /* Disciplined Border Radius Scale */
      --radius-xs: 3px;
      --radius-sm: 5px;
      --radius-md: 7px;
      --radius-lg: 10px;
      --radius-xl: 12px;

      /* Soft, Natural Elevation Shadows (Zero Neon Glow) */
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
      --shadow-md: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);

      /* Spacing Scale */
      --sp-1: 4px;
      --sp-2: 8px;
      --sp-3: 12px;
      --sp-4: 16px;
      --sp-5: 20px;
      --sp-6: 24px;
      --sp-8: 32px;

      box-sizing: border-box;
      padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
      padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
    }

    :root[data-theme="light"] {
      color-scheme: light;

      /* Surfaces & Backgrounds (Light Mode: Clean Stone-Paper) */
      --bg: #f6f8fa;
      --bg-subtle: #f0f2f5;
      --bg-card: #ffffff;
      --bg-card-hover: #f3f5f8;
      --bg-elevated: #ffffff;
      --bg-active: #e6e9ee;

      /* Typography / Text Inks (Light Mode) */
      --ink: #1f2328;
      --ink-secondary: #3b434e;
      --mut: #57606a;
      --ink-inverse: #ffffff;

      /* Structural Borders & Dividers */
      --border: #d0d7de;
      --border-subtle: #e1e4e8;
      --border-hover: #afb8c1;
      --border-focus: #0969da;

      /* Functional Football Brand Accents (Light Mode) */
      --g: #1a7f37;
      --g-light: #2da44e;
      --g-dark: #116329;
      --g-subtle: rgba(26, 127, 55, 0.1);

      --accent: #9a6700;
      --accent-light: #b07d0a;
      --accent-subtle: rgba(154, 103, 0, 0.1);
      --y: #9a6700;
      --y-glow: transparent;

      /* Status Colors */
      --status-success: #1a7f37;
      --status-success-subtle: rgba(26, 127, 55, 0.1);
      --status-warning: #9a6700;
      --status-warning-subtle: rgba(154, 103, 0, 0.1);
      --status-danger: #cf222e;
      --status-danger-subtle: rgba(207, 34, 46, 0.1);
      --status-info: #0969da;
      --status-info-subtle: rgba(9, 105, 218, 0.1);

      /* Tactical Football Scheme Tokens */
      --field-turf-1: #1a562f;
      --field-turf-2: #1e5f35;
      --field-endzone: #134424;
      --field-line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      --field-hash: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      --hud-bg: var(--bg-card);

      /* Shadows (Soft, Crisp) */
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 3px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
      --shadow-lg: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
    }



    /* ==================== COMMAND CENTER HEADER ==================== */
    header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 0 1.25rem;
      height: 60px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--ink);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .brand-badge {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .brand-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .brand-title {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .brand-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .nav-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding: 0 0.25rem;
    }

    .nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      min-height: 36px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
    }

    .tab-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: var(--border-subtle);
    }

    .tab-btn.active {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: var(--border);
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .header-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .search-box {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .search-box input {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      width: 170px;
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      height: 34px;
    }

    .search-box input:focus {
      width: 220px;
      border-color: var(--border-focus);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--status-info-subtle);
    }

    .search-box input::placeholder {
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .btn-icon {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink);
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .btn-icon:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .theme-icon-dark,
    .theme-icon-light {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .theme-icon-light {
      display: none;
    }

    html[data-theme="dark"] .theme-icon-dark {
      display: block;
    }

    html[data-theme="light"] .theme-icon-dark {
      display: none;
    }

    html[data-theme="light"] .theme-icon-light {
      display: block;
    }

    .madden-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      height: 34px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .madden-toggle-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .madden-toggle-btn.active {
      background: var(--g-subtle);
      border-color: var(--g);
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .mastery-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      height: 34px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .mastery-pill:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
    }

    .mastery-dot {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 10px;
    }


    /* ==================== VIEW PANELS ==================== */
    .view-panel {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      flex: 1;
      animation: viewFadeIn 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .view-panel.active {
      display: block;
    }

    @keyframes viewFadeIn {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(5px);
      }

      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    /* ==================== 1. HOME DASHBOARD STYLES ==================== */
    .home-container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px 20px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .home-hero-status {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-card), #16291b);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero-text-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      max-width: 580px;
    }

    .hero-greeting {
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--g-light);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .hero-headline {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.25;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .hero-stats-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 24px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .stat-box {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .stat-val {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .progress-bar-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      height: 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 4px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .progress-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g), var(--y));
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: width 0.4s ease;
    }

    .continue-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-left: 5px solid var(--y);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: transform 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .continue-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--y);
    }

    .continue-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      max-width: 650px;
    }

    .continue-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .continue-title {
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .continue-desc {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .btn-continue {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--y), #d97706);
      color: #111;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 22px;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--y-glow);
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }

    .btn-continue:hover {
      filter: brightness(1.1);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .home-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .home-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .section-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .tool-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    .tool-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .tool-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .tool-icon {
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .tool-badge {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .tool-name {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .tool-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .home-side-hub {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .tip-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .recent-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .recent-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .recent-item:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    /* ==================== 2. LEARN (ORIGINAL WIKI) STYLES ==================== */
    .wrap {
      display: flex;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    nav.learn-nav {
      width: 270px;
      flex: none;
      padding: 16px 14px;
      position: sticky;
      top: 60px;
      align-self: flex-start;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 70px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      font-size: 14px;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .level-filter-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .filter-chip {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--mut);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .filter-chip.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    nav.learn-nav h4 {
      margin: 14px 0 5px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    nav.learn-nav a {
      display: block;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      text-decoration: none;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      margin: 2px 0;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    nav.learn-nav a:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    nav.learn-nav a.on {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-left-color: var(--y);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    nav.learn-nav a.done::after {
      content: " ✓";
      color: var(--g-light);
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    main {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 24px 36px;
      max-width: 880px;
      font: 16px/1.7 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: 28px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      margin: 0.3em 0 0.5em;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: 21px;
      margin: 1.5em 0 0.4em;
      color: var(--g-light);
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    h3 {
      font-size: 17px;
      margin: 1.2em 0 0.3em;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    p {
      margin: 0.8em 0;
    }

    .lv {
      display: inline-block;
      font: 700 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      background: var(--y);
      color: #111;
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    table {
      border-collapse: collapse;
      display: block;
      overflow-x: auto;
      max-width: 100%;
      font: 14px/1.5 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      margin: 16px 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    td,
    th {
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    th {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .co {
      border-left: 4px solid var(--y);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      margin: 16px 0;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      font-size: 14.5px;
    }

    .nfl {
      border-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .lab-jump-banner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.15), rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15));
      border: 1px solid rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      margin: 18px 0;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .lab-jump-btn {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border: 0;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .lab-jump-btn:hover {
      background: var(--g-light);
    }

    details {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      margin: 10px 0;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    a.w {
      color: var(--g-light);
      border-bottom: 1px dotted;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    a.w:hover {
      color: var(--y);
    }

    ul,
    ol {
      padding-left: 24px;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }

    li {
      margin: 4px 0;
    }

    .sim {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px;
      margin: 18px 0;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .sim select {
      padding: 8px 10px;
      max-width: 100%;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 8px 0;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .nx {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin: 32px 0 16px;
      padding-top: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .nx button {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 9px 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.15s;
    }

    .nx button:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .q button {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      margin: 6px 0;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 14px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .q button:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
    }

    .ok {
      background: #2e8b57 !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }

    .no {
      background: #b3402f !important;
      color: #fff !important;
    }

    /* ==================== 3. FOOTBALL LAB ADVANCED STYLES ==================== */
    .lab-container {
      max-width: 1360px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .lab-toolbar {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .toolbar-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .toolbar-label {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .lab-select {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 6px 11px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }

    .lab-select:focus {
      border-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .toggles-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .toggle-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .toggle-item input {
      accent-color: var(--g);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* Main Lab Split View: Field + Telemetry Inspector */
    .lab-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 350px;
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .lab-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .field-wrapper {
      background: #091a0f;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      position: relative;
    }

    .field-svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* Playback State & Controls Bar */
    .field-controls-bar {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding: 12px 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .phase-indicator-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .playback-cluster {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .btn-play {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-play:hover {
      background: var(--g-light);
    }

    .btn-subtle {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--ink);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .btn-subtle:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
    }

    .btn-subtle:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .timeline-slider {
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 280px;
      accent-color: var(--y);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .time-counter {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-family: monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mut);
      min-width: 75px;
      text-align: right;
    }

    /* Inspector Panel */
    .inspector-panel {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .panel-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-bottom: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .panel-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .player-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .player-badge.offense {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #d97706, #b45309);
      border: 2px solid #fef08a;
    }

    .player-badge.defense {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e11d48, #9f1239);
      border: 2px solid #fecdd3;
    }

    .telemetry-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--g-light);
    }

    .telemetry-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .telemetry-val {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .tactical-hint-box {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 11px 13px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* Interactive Field SVG Elements */
    .field-player-node {
      transition: transform 0.05s ease-out;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .field-player-node circle {
      transition: stroke 0.15s, stroke-width 0.15s, filter 0.15s;
    }

    .field-player-node:hover circle {
      stroke: #ffffff !important;
      stroke-width: 3.5px !important;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--y));
    }

    .route-vector-path {
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
      transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.1s linear;
    }

    /* ==================== 4. FILM ROOM STYLES ==================== */
    .film-container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px 20px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .film-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .film-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(360px, 1fr));
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .film-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .film-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .film-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      align-self: flex-start;
    }

    .film-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .film-body {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .film-focus-box {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .film-focus-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    /* ==================== 5. PLAYBOOK STYLES ==================== */
    .playbook-container {
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px 20px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .play-filter-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .play-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .play-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }

    .play-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .play-card-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .play-scheme-pill {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    /* ==================== 6. CHALLENGES STYLES ==================== */
    .challenges-container {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 20px 16px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .challenge-subtabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 4px;
      width: fit-content;
    }

    .subtab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--mut);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .subtab-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .trainer-hud {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .trainer-stats {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .stat-pill {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .stat-name {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .stat-score {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .question-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .scenario-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .scenario-prompt {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.4;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .clues-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .clue-box {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
    }

    .clue-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .clue-val {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .choices-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 650px) {
      .choices-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .choice-btn {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      text-align: left;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .choice-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .choice-btn.correct {
      background: rgba(46, 139, 87, 0.25) !important;
      border-color: #2e8b57 !important;
    }

    .choice-btn.incorrect {
      background: rgba(179, 64, 47, 0.25) !important;
      border-color: #b3402f !important;
    }

    .choice-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .choice-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .debrief-box {
      display: none;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 18px;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      animation: viewFadeIn 0.3s ease;
    }

    .debrief-box.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* Situation Coach HUD */
    .scoreboard-hud {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #101c13, #15271b);
      border: 1px solid var(--g);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 22px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .score-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .score-team {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .team-code {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .team-pts {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .game-clock-readout {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .clock-digits {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-family: monospace;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .situation-call-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .call-options-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .call-option-btn {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .call-option-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
    }

    .call-primary {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .call-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .call-rationale {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .call-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      text-align: right;
    }

    .epa-pill {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .epa-pos {
      background: rgba(46, 139, 87, 0.2);
      color: #5fbf8a;
      border: 1px solid rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.3);
    }

    .epa-neg {
      background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2);
      color: #fb7185;
      border: 1px solid rgba(251, 113, 133, 0.3);
    }

    /* ==================== 7. PROGRESS DASHBOARD STYLES ==================== */
    .progress-container {
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px 20px 48px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .ladder-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .ladder-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .ladder-step-box {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .ladder-step-box.current {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);
    }

    .ladder-num {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .ladder-name {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .ladder-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 10px 14px;
      }

      .nav-tabs {
        order: 2;
        overflow-x: auto;
        width: 100%;
      }

      .header-actions {
        order: 3;
        max-width: 100%;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      .wrap {
        display: block;
      }

      nav.learn-nav {
        position: static;
        width: auto;
        max-height: 220px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
        border-right: 0;
      }

      main {
        padding: 18px 14px;
      }
    }

    /* ==================== PLAYBOOK & PLAY SIMULATOR STYLES ==================== */
    .playbook-container {
      padding: 16px 24px 60px 24px;
      max-width: 1440px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .playbook-top-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      padding-bottom: 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .playbook-mode-tabs {
      display: flex;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .pb-mode-btn {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-mode-btn:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .pb-mode-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
    }

    .playbook-filter-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .pb-chips-scroll {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .pb-search-box {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 260px;
    }

    .pb-search-input {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--ink);
      padding: 8px 12px 8px 34px;
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .pb-search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.2);
    }

    .pb-search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 10px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 14px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* 2-Column Layout */
    .playbook-workspace {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 390px 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .playbook-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Catalog Column */
    .playbook-catalog-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .catalog-header-count {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
    }

    .playbook-cards-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 240px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 6px;
    }

    .playbook-item-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .playbook-item-card:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--ln-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .playbook-item-card.active {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.05);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .playbook-card-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .pb-category-pill {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 900;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .pb-category-pill.run {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.2);
      color: var(--g-light);
      border: 1px solid rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.pass {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.play_action {
      background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-purple);
      border: 1px solid rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.rpo {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
      color: var(--y);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.screen {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.qb_run {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.2);
      color: #facc15;
      border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.man_coverage {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.zone_coverage {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.blitz {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
      color: #f87171;
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.sim_pressure {
      background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-purple);
      border: 1px solid rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.4);
    }

    .pb-category-pill.run_defense {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.2);
      color: var(--g-light);
      border: 1px solid rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
    }

    .playbook-item-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .playbook-item-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    /* Simulator Column */
    .playbook-simulator-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      position: sticky;
      top: 75px;
    }

    .simulator-header-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .sim-title-group h2 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .sim-badges-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .sim-btn-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .simulator-field-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .simulator-field-svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1000 / 600;
      display: block;
      background: #112c1a;
    }

    /* Tactical Dossier */
    .tactic-dossier-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .dossier-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .dossier-card.highlight {
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.03);
    }

    .dossier-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .dossier-text {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Compare View */
    .compare-view-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .compare-selectors-bar {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .compare-dropdown-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 240px;
    }

    .compare-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .compare-vs-badge {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--y);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
    }

    .compare-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 860px) {
      .compare-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .compare-col-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .matchup-analysis-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.15), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1));
      border: 1px solid var(--g);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .matchup-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--g-light);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .matchup-desc {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* ==================== 4. INTERACTIVE FILM ROOM STYLES ==================== */
    .film-room-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .film-room-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(20, 32, 23, 0.95), rgba(12, 20, 14, 0.98));
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .film-room-title-block h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .film-room-title-block p {
      margin: 4px 0 0 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .film-level-filters {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .film-filter-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .film-filter-btn:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .film-filter-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
    }

    /* Scenario Carousel / Quick Strip */
    .film-scenario-strip {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 4px 2px 8px 2px;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    .film-scenario-card {
      flex: 0 0 260px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .film-scenario-card:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .film-scenario-card.active {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(27, 44, 32, 0.95), rgba(20, 32, 23, 0.98));
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .film-card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .film-badge-level {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .film-badge-level.rookie {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .film-badge-level.pro {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      color: var(--y);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
    }

    .film-badge-level.all_pro {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
    }

    .film-card-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .film-card-situation {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-card-tags {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .film-tag {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 1px 5px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    /* Broadcast Telemetry HUD */
    .film-telemetry-hud {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      background: #090e0a;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    }

    .film-telemetry-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .film-hud-pill {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .film-hud-label {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .film-hud-value {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .film-hud-value.highlight-y {
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .film-hud-value.highlight-cyan {
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .film-hud-score {
      background: rgba(20, 32, 23, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    /* Main Split Stage */
    .film-stage-container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(500px, 1.4fr) minmax(360px, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .film-stage-container {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left Column: All-22 Field */
    .film-field-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .film-field-topbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .film-cam-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-cam-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent-cyan);
      animation: pulse-dot 1.5s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 1;
      }

      50% {
        transform: scale(1.4);
        opacity: 0.4;
      }

      100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    .film-svg-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      background: #08110a;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .film-svg-wrapper svg {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    /* Motion Tell Banner Overlay */
    .film-motion-banner {
      display: none;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.95), rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.95));
      color: #0b140d;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      margin-top: 6px;
      animation: slideDown 0.3s ease;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    @keyframes slideDown {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(-8px);
      }

      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    /* Field Control Toolbar */
    .film-field-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      padding-top: 4px;
    }

    .film-controls-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn.primary {
      background: var(--g);
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.35);
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn.primary:hover {
      background: var(--g-light);
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn.motion-btn {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn.motion-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25);
    }

    .film-ctrl-btn.active {
      background: var(--g-dark);
      border-color: var(--g);
    }

    /* Right Column: Coaching Desk */
    .film-desk-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      min-height: 520px;
    }

    .film-desk-phases {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .film-phase-tab {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 8px 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .film-phase-tab:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .film-phase-tab.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.35);
    }

    .film-phase-tab.disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .film-phase-content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    /* Situation Briefing Card */
    .film-briefing-box {
      background: rgba(15, 25, 17, 0.75);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .film-briefing-header {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    /* Questions & Interactive Options */
    .film-question-card {
      background: rgba(20, 32, 23, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .film-q-meta {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .film-q-num {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--y);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .film-q-cat {
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .film-q-prompt {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .film-options-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-option-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .film-option-item:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--ln-light);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .film-option-letter {
      flex: 0 0 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    .film-option-item.selected-correct {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.18);
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .film-option-item.selected-correct .film-option-letter {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .film-option-item.selected-wrong {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--accent-crimson);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .film-option-item.selected-wrong .film-option-letter {
      background: var(--accent-crimson);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* Didactic Feedback Box */
    .film-feedback-box {
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-top: 4px;
      animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-feedback-box.correct {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.22);
      border: 1px solid var(--g-light);
      color: #d1fae5;
    }

    .film-feedback-box.wrong {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.18);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent-crimson);
      color: #ffe4e6;
    }

    .film-feedback-title {
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .film-feedback-highlight-btn {
      align-self: flex-start;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      border: 1px solid currentColor;
      color: inherit;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .film-feedback-highlight-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }

    /* Phase Complete Transition Button */
    .film-phase-action-btn {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--g);
      border: 1px solid var(--g-light);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .film-phase-action-btn:hover {
      background: var(--g-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* Phase 3: Debrief & Performance Radar */
    .film-debrief-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .film-debrief-summary {
      background: rgba(16, 26, 18, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .film-rule-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15), rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08));
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      color: #fef3c7;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .film-rule-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--y);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    /* 4-Metric Coaching Radar Meter */
    .film-radar-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .film-radar-stat {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .film-radar-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .film-radar-value-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
    }

    .film-radar-pct {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .film-radar-grade {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
    }

    .film-radar-grade.a {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.2);
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .film-radar-grade.b {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .film-radar-grade.c {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
    }

    .film-radar-bar {
      width: 100%;
      height: 4px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 2px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .film-radar-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--g);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: width 0.4s ease;
    }

    .film-coach-advice-box {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-ring {
      0% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        stroke-width: 3px;
      }

      50% {
        opacity: 1;
        stroke-width: 5px;
      }

      100% {
        opacity: 0.7;
        stroke-width: 3px;
      }
    }

    .telestrator-ring {
      animation: pulse-ring 1.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    /* ==================== QB VISION & RECOGNITION TRAINING STYLES ==================== */
    .film-mode-switcher {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 5px;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .film-mode-btn {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .film-mode-btn:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .film-mode-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.45);
    }

    /* Vision Container */
    .film-vision-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease;
    }

    .vision-header-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 26, 18, 0.95), rgba(10, 16, 11, 0.98));
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .vision-title-block h2 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .vision-title-block p {
      margin: 4px 0 0 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    /* Vision Category Filters */
    .vision-filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .vision-pill-btn {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .vision-pill-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .vision-pill-btn.active {
      background: var(--g-dark);
      border-color: var(--g);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.3);
    }

    /* Vision Play Clock & Challenge HUD */
    .vision-hud-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      background: #090e0a;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    }

    .vision-clock-box {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .vision-clock-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }

    .vision-clock-timer {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-family: monospace;
      color: var(--y);
      padding: 2px 8px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      min-width: 58px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .vision-clock-timer.warning {
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
      animation: pulse-clock 0.8s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse-clock {
      0% {
        transform: scale(1);
      }

      50% {
        transform: scale(1.08);
      }

      100% {
        transform: scale(1);
      }
    }

    .vision-mode-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    /* Interactive Field in Vision Mode */
    .vision-field-interactive {
      cursor: crosshair;
    }

    .vision-field-interactive .field-player-node:hover circle {
      stroke: var(--y) !important;
      stroke-width: 3.5px !important;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--y));
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* Diagnostic Console on Right */
    .vision-console-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      min-height: 480px;
    }

    .vision-prompt-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .vision-target-click-hint {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
      border: 1px dashed var(--y);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #fef3c7;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* 5 Skill Areas Progress Panel */
    .vision-skill-radar-box {
      background: rgba(14, 23, 16, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .vision-radar-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .vision-radar-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--g-light);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .vision-iq-score {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
    }

    .vision-skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .vision-skill-card {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .vision-skill-name {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .vision-skill-val {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
    }

    /* ==================== WHAT WOULD YOU CALL? COACHING LAB ==================== */
    .call-header-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 26, 46, 0.95), rgba(12, 19, 36, 0.95));
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .call-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .call-main-badge {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);
    }

    .call-sub-badge {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .call-headline {
      margin: 0 0 8px 0;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }

    .call-intro {
      margin: 0 0 16px 0;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 900px;
    }

    /* Level Filter Bar */
    .call-level-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding-top: 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .call-lvl-btn {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .call-lvl-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.9);
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    }

    .call-lvl-btn.active {
      background: #3b82f6;
      border-color: #60a5fa;
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
    }

    /* Scenario Pills Carousel */
    .call-scenario-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding: 4px 2px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    .call-pill-item {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      min-width: 200px;
      max-width: 260px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
