      gap: 4px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .call-pill-item:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
      border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .call-pill-item.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.6), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9));
      border-color: #3b82f6;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
    }

    .call-pill-lvl {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #60a5fa;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .call-pill-title {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    /* Main Workspace Grid */
    .call-workspace-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .call-workspace-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left / Telemetry Panel */
    .call-telemetry-panel {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    /* Broadcast Telemetry Scoreboard HUD */
    .call-hud-scoreboard {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .call-hud-teams {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .call-hud-team {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .call-team-code {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 14px;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .call-team-score {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      min-width: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .call-vs {
      color: #64748b;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .call-hud-context {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .call-hud-clock-cluster,
    .call-hud-down-cluster {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .call-hud-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .call-hud-lbl {
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: #64748b;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .call-hud-val {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .call-hud-val.clock-digits {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .call-hud-val.warning-clock {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
      color: #f59e0b;
    }

    .call-hud-val.highlight-gold {
      color: #fbbf24;
      font-size: 17px;
    }

    .call-timeouts-pills {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Matchup & Personnel Banner */
    .call-matchup-meta {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .call-matchup-meta {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .call-matchup-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
    }

    .call-matchup-box.off-box {
      border-left: 3px solid #3b82f6;
    }

    .call-matchup-box.def-box {
      border-left: 3px solid #ef4444;
    }

    .call-box-title {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .call-matchup-box.off-box .call-box-title {
      color: #60a5fa;
    }

    .call-matchup-box.def-box .call-box-title {
      color: #f87171;
    }

    .call-box-row {
      margin-bottom: 3px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .call-box-row .k {
      color: #64748b;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-right: 4px;
    }

    .call-box-row .v {
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Dilemma Card */
    .call-dilemma-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
    }

    .call-dilemma-header {
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .call-dilemma-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .call-scenario-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .call-dilemma-text {
      margin: 8px 0 0;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* Options Section */
    .call-options-section {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .call-options-prompt {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 0 4px;
    }

    .call-options-hint {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .call-options-grid {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    /* Option Card Button */
    .call-option-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-align: left;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .call-option-card:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
      border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .call-option-card.selected {
      border-color: #3b82f6;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.4), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95));
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5), 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    }

    .call-opt-main {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .call-opt-concept {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--status-info);
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .call-opt-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .call-opt-badge-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .call-opt-badge {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    /* RIGHT DEBRIEF PANEL */
    .call-debrief-panel {
      background: rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.95);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      min-height: 520px;
    }

    /* Debrief Placeholder */
    .call-placeholder-debrief {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      height: 100%;
      min-height: 400px;
      text-align: center;
      color: #64748b;
      padding: 40px 20px;
    }

    .call-coach-avatar {
      font-size: 52px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .call-placeholder-debrief h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .call-placeholder-debrief p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      max-width: 440px;
    }

    /* Debrief Result Content */
    .call-analysis-result {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .call-result-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .call-result-title-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .call-result-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    }

    .call-chosen-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .call-result-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .call-grade-pill {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }

    .grade-optimal {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
      border-color: #10b981;
      color: #34d399;
    }

    .grade-viable {
      background: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
      border-color: #06b6d4;
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .grade-traditional {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
      border-color: #f59e0b;
      color: #fbbf24;
    }

    .grade-critical {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      border-color: #f43f5e;
      color: #fda4af;
    }

    .call-epa-pill {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
    }

    .epa-pos {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
      color: #34d399;
      border: 1px solid #10b981;
    }

    .epa-neg {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
      color: #fda4af;
      border: 1px solid #f43f5e;
    }

    .epa-neu {
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      border: 1px solid #64748b;
    }

    /* Rationale Box */
    .call-rationale-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-left: 3px solid #3b82f6;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
    }

    .call-section-heading {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #60a5fa;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .call-rationale-box p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    /* Pros & Risks Grid */
    .call-pros-risks-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .call-pros-risks-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .call-pros-card {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .call-risks-card {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    .call-card-badge {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .call-card-badge.pro-badge {
      color: #34d399;
    }

    .call-card-badge.risk-badge {
      color: #fda4af;
    }

    .call-pros-card p,
    .call-risks-card p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    /* Field Position & Clock Impact Grid */
    .call-impact-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .call-impact-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .call-impact-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .call-impact-icon {
      font-size: 18px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .call-impact-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .call-impact-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .call-impact-info p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* NFL Consensus Card */
    .call-consensus-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 16px;
    }

    .call-consensus-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .call-consensus-badge {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #60a5fa;
    }

    .call-consensus-sub {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .call-consensus-content {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .call-consensus-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .call-consensus-row .c-label {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .call-consensus-row .c-val {
      color: var(--ink);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .call-golden-rule {
      margin-top: 6px;
      background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.08);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.35);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .call-golden-rule .rule-icon {
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .call-golden-rule .rule-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .call-golden-rule .rule-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #fbbf24;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .call-golden-rule span:last-child {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #fef3c7;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* Action Bar */
    .call-action-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding-top: 10px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .call-inspect-other-btn {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .call-inspect-other-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.9);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .call-next-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8);
      border: 1px solid #60a5fa;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
    }

    .call-next-btn:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8, #1e40af);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);
    }

    /* ==================== FOOTBALL LAB MODE SWITCHER ==================== */
    .lab-mode-switcher {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      padding: 5px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .lab-mode-btn {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 10px 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .lab-mode-btn:hover:not(.active) {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .lab-mode-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.4);
    }

    /* ==================== CLOCK SIMULATOR WORKSPACE ==================== */
    .clock-simulator-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    /* Header Card */
    .clock-header-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .clock-header-top {
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .clock-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .clock-main-badge {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #0369a1);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.4);
    }

    .clock-sub-badge {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .clock-nfl-rule-badge {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.12);
      color: #facc15;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.25);
    }

    .clock-headline {
      margin: 0 0 8px 0;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
    }

    .clock-intro {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 14.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 960px;
    }

    /* Scenario Pills Strip */
    .clock-scenario-strip {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-top: 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .clock-scen-pills-label {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #64748b;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .clock-scen-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .clock-scen-pill {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .clock-scen-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.9);
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
    }

    .clock-scen-pill.active {
      background: #3b82f6;
      border-color: #60a5fa;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
    }

    /* ==================== STAGE GRID ==================== */
    .clock-stage-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.25fr 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .clock-stage-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .clock-telemetry-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* ==================== DUAL BROADCAST HUD ==================== */
    .clock-hud-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .clock-display-cluster {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.3fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .clock-display-cluster {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .clock-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .clock-box.game-clock-box {
      border-left: 4px solid #38bdf8;
    }

    .clock-box.play-clock-box {
      border-left: 4px solid #10b981;
    }

    .clock-box-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .clock-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .clock-status-pill {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .clock-status-pill.running {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
      color: #34d399;
      border: 1px solid #10b981;
      animation: pulseGlow 1.5s infinite alternate;
    }

    .clock-status-pill.stopped {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      color: #fda4af;
      border: 1px solid #f43f5e;
    }

    .clock-status-pill.refwind {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
      color: #fbbf24;
      border: 1px solid #f59e0b;
    }

    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0% {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }

      100% {
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      }
    }

    .clock-digits-display {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 42px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--status-info);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: 1px;
      margin: 4px 0;
    }

    .clock-digits-display.play-digits {
      color: #10b981;
    }

    .clock-digits-display.play-warning {
      color: #f59e0b;
    }

    .clock-digits-display.play-critical {
      color: #ef4444;
      animation: playFlash 0.6s infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes playFlash {
      0% {
        opacity: 0.7;
      }

      100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1.02);
      }
    }

    .clock-box-sub {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Telemetry Subgrid */
    .clock-telemetry-subgrid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .clock-telemetry-subgrid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    .clock-tel-item {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .tel-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    }

    .tel-score-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .team-tag {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 5px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .team-tag.off-tag {
      background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2);
      color: #60a5fa;
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
    }

    .team-tag.def-tag {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
      color: #f87171;
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }

    .score-val {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .score-sep {
      color: #64748b;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .tel-val-highlight {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .tel-val-gold {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fbbf24;
    }

    .tel-sub {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    /* Timeouts Dots */
    .timeout-team-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .to-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .to-dot {
      width: 11px;
      height: 11px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .to-dot.active {
      background: #fbbf24;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border-color: #f59e0b;
    }

    .to-dot.inactive {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      cursor: default;
    }

    .to-dot:hover.active {
      transform: scale(1.2);
    }

    /* Ticker Control Bar */
    .clock-ticker-control-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-top: 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .ticker-btn-group,
    .ticker-options-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .ticker-btn {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .ticker-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.95);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .ticker-btn.play-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #059669);
      border-color: #34d399;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    }

    .ticker-btn.play-btn.running {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #dc2626);
      border-color: #f87171;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
    }

    .ticker-btn.snap-btn {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb, #1d4ed8);
      border-color: #60a5fa;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
    }

    .speed-label {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mut);
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .speed-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .speed-btn.active {
      background: #3b82f6;
      border-color: #60a5fa;
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ==================== EVENT TRIGGER BOARD ==================== */
    .clock-events-board {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
    }

    .events-board-header {
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .events-board-header h3 {
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .events-hint {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .events-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .clock-event-card {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.65);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .clock-event-card:hover {
      background: rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.85);
      border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .clock-event-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .clock-event-icon {
      font-size: 18px;
    }

    .clock-event-name {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .clock-event-desc {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .clock-event-pill {
      align-self: flex-start;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .pill-stop {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.2);
      color: #fda4af;
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-run {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
      color: #34d399;
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-cond {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2);
      color: #fbbf24;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
    }

    /* ==================== RIGHT COLUMN: RATIONALE & SCENARIO ==================== */
    .clock-desk-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    /* Rationale Card */
    .clock-rationale-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 26, 46, 0.95), rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.95));
      border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rationale-card-head {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .rationale-tag {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--status-info);
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
    }

    .rationale-ref {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #facc15;
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.12);
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.25);
    }

    .rationale-title {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .rationale-body {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .rationale-metrics {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .rule-metric-box {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .metric-k {
      font-size: 10px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .metric-v {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    /* Guided Scenario Card */
    .clock-scenario-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 16px 18px;
    }

    .scenario-card-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .scen-badge {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .scen-active-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .scen-active-desc {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .scen-task-box {
      background: rgba(30, 58, 138, 0.25);
      border-left: 3px solid #3b82f6;
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    .task-title {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #60a5fa;
      margin-bottom: 3px;
    }

    .scen-task-box p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    /* History Log Card */
    .clock-log-card {
      background: rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      max-height: 240px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .log-card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      padding-bottom: 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .log-card-header h4 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .clock-log-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 4px;
    }

    .log-empty-state {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #64748b;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 16px 0;
    }

    .log-item {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .log-item-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .log-item-icon {
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .log-item-name {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .log-item-clocks {
      font-family: 'SF Mono', Consolas, monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* ==================== INTERACTIVE GLOSSARY & KNOWLEDGE GRAPH ==================== */
    .glossary-app-shell {
      max-width: 1440px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 20px 16px 60px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .glossary-header-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
    }

    .glossary-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    /* Toolbar & Search */
    .glossary-toolbar {
      margin-top: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .glossary-search-bar {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .glossary-search-bar .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 14px;
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .glossary-search-bar input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px 42px 12px 42px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 14px;
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .glossary-search-bar input:focus {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      background: var(--bg-card);
    }

    .glossary-search-bar .clear-btn {
      position: absolute;
      right: 12px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .glossary-search-bar .clear-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* Filter Rows */
    .glossary-filter-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .filter-group-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .filter-label {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      min-width: 75px;
    }

    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .gloss-pill {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .gloss-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }

    .gloss-pill.active {
      background: #2563eb;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-coverage.active {
      background: #0284c7;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-safety.active {
      background: #4f46e5;
      border-color: #818cf8;
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-pass.active {
      background: #ea580c;
      border-color: #fb923c;
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-run.active {
      background: #059669;
      border-color: #34d399;
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-formation.active {
      background: #9333ea;
      border-color: #c084fc;
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-pressure.active {
      background: #e11d48;
      border-color: #fb7185;
    }

    .gloss-pill.pill-rules.active {
      background: #d97706;
      border-color: #fbbf24;
    }

    .reset-filter-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-left: auto;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .reset-filter-btn:hover {
      border-color: #ef4444;
      color: #ef4444;
    }

    /* Workspace Layout */
    .glossary-workspace {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 370px 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .glossary-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Left Column: Browser */
    .glossary-browser-col {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .browser-meta-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 4px 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .result-counter {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .sort-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .sort-wrapper select {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .glossary-cards-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 280px);
      min-height: 480px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 4px;
    }

    .glossary-cards-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 6px;
    }

    .glossary-cards-list::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .glossary-cards-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .glossary-cards-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    }

    /* Term Card Item */
    .gloss-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .gloss-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }

    .gloss-card.active {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }

    .card-top-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .card-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .card-badges {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tag-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tag-basic {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      color: #34d399;
    }

    .tag-tactical {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.15);
      color: #facc15;
    }

    .tag-advanced {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      color: #c084fc;
    }

    .card-snippet {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.4;
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .card-footer-info {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      padding-top: 4px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .card-rel-count {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    /* Right Column: Detail & Graph */
    .glossary-detail-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    /* Knowledge Graph Card */
    .glossary-graph-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    }

    .graph-card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .graph-title-box {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .graph-icon {
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .graph-focus-indicator {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .graph-focus-indicator strong {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .graph-controls-cluster {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .graph-toggle-group {
      display: flex;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 2px;
    }

    .graph-toggle-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 5px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .graph-toggle-btn.active {
      background: #2563eb;
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .graph-zoom-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .graph-icon-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: #fff;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .graph-icon-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    /* SVG Viewport */
    .graph-viewport-box {
      position: relative;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.98) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      height: 340px;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    .graph-viewport-box:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    /* SVG Node and Link Styles */
    .graph-link-line {
      stroke: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      stroke-width: 1.5px;
      transition: stroke 0.2s ease, stroke-width 0.2s ease;
    }

    .graph-link-line.highlight {
      stroke: #38bdf8;
      stroke-width: 2.5px;
    }

    .graph-link-pill {
      fill: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      stroke-width: 1px;
    }

    .graph-link-text {
      font-size: 9px;
      fill: #94a3b8;
      text-anchor: middle;
      font-weight: 600;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .graph-node-group {
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .graph-node-group:hover circle.node-bg {
      stroke: #fff;
      stroke-width: 3px;
    }

    .node-center-halo {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #38bdf8;
      stroke-width: 2px;
      opacity: 0.7;
      animation: pulseHalo 2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }

    @keyframes pulseHalo {
      0% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      50% {
        transform: scale(1.25);
        opacity: 0.2;
      }

      100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }
    }

    .graph-node-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      fill: #ffffff;
      text-anchor: middle;
      pointer-events: none;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    }

    /* Node Tooltip */
    .graph-node-tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      max-width: 240px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      z-index: 50;
      backdrop-filter: none;
    }

    /* Legend */
    .graph-legend-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      padding-top: 4px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .legend-item {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .legend-dot {
      width: 9px;
      height: 9px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    /* Term Dossier Card */
    .glossary-dossier-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 24px 28px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    }

    .dossier-header-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      padding-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .dossier-main-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }

    .dossier-meta-chips {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .dossier-category-pill {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .dossier-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .dossier-action-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .dossier-action-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #fff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* Callout Definition */
    .dossier-callout {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
      border-left: 4px solid #38bdf8;
      border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0;
      padding: 14px 18px;
    }

    .dossier-callout-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .dossier-callout-text {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 0;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Sections */
    .dossier-section {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .dossier-sec-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .dossier-sec-content {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Related Terms Grid & Chips */
    .related-terms-grid {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .related-term-chip {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 3px;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .related-term-chip:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
    }

    .chip-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .chip-rel-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .chip-term-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .chip-desc {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .tags-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .tag-pill {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 2px 8px;
    }

    /* ==================== UPGRADED PROGRESS & MASTERY SYSTEM ==================== */
    .progress-hero-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 22px 26px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .prog-hero-main {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .prog-badge-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .prog-global-telemetry {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 14px 18px;
    }

    .prog-global-stat-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .prog-mini-metrics {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .prog-mini-metrics strong {
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* 1. Mastery Ladder */
    .ladder-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .ladder-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .ladder-steps {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .ladder-step-box {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ladder-step-box:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .ladder-step-box.current {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .ladder-step-box.completed-step {
      border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
    }

    .ladder-step-box.locked-step {
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .ladder-num {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
    }

    .ladder-name {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ladder-desc {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .ladder-prog-pill {
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      align-self: flex-start;
    }

    /* 2. Section Card */
    .prog-section-card {
      background: var(--card-bg, #1e293b);
      border: 1px solid var(--border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1));
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 20px 24px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .prog-section-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      padding-bottom: 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    /* Recommendations Grid */
    .prog-recommendations-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .prog-rec-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .prog-rec-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .rec-type-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rec-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 6px 0 4px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .rec-reason {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .rec-action-btn {
      background: #2563eb;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 8px 14px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      margin-top: 8px;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .rec-action-btn:hover {
      background: #1d4ed8;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* 3. Skill Profile Grid */
    .prog-skills-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .skill-card {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .skill-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .skill-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .skill-rating-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 1px 7px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .skill-bar-wrap {
      height: 8px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 4px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .skill-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: width 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* 4. Curriculum Filters & Grid */
    .prog-curriculum-filters {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .prog-curriculum-filters select {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      outline: none;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .prog-topics-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .prog-topic-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .prog-topic-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* Topic Status Borders */
    .prog-topic-card.status-mastered {
      border-color: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.6);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .prog-topic-card.status-completed {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
    }

    .prog-topic-card.status-in_progress {
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
    }

    .prog-topic-card.status-available {
      border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    }

    .prog-topic-card.status-locked {
      opacity: 0.55;
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
    }

    .topic-header-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .topic-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .topic-badges {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .topic-status-pill {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    }

    .pill-status-mastered {
      background: rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.18);
      color: #facc15;
      border: 1px solid rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-status-completed {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
      color: var(--status-info);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-status-in_progress {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18);
      color: #fbbf24;
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-status-available {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.18);
      color: #34d399;
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
    }

    .pill-status-locked {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      color: var(--mut);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .topic-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--mut, #94a3b8);
      line-height: 1.4;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .topic-progress-box {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .topic-action-bar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .topic-action-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 9px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .topic-action-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* ==================== 8. INTERACTIVE PLAY BUILDER & TACTICAL ARCHITECT STYLES ==================== */
    .playbuilder-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 18px 24px 48px;
      max-width: 1720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .pb-builder-top-bar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .pb-builder-title-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .pb-builder-headline {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.4px;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .pb-builder-subtitle {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .pb-builder-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .pb-action-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 7px 13px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pb-action-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-color: var(--mut);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--g), #185c37);
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.35);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.primary:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--g-light), var(--g));
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.5);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.accent-y {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.45);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.accent-y:hover {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.28);
      border-color: var(--y);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.accent-cyan {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.accent-cyan:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.danger {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
    }

    .pb-action-btn.danger:hover {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
      border-color: var(--accent-crimson);
    }

    /* 3-Column Main Workspace Grid */
    .pb-workspace-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 330px 1fr 370px;
      gap: 16px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1400px) {
      .pb-workspace-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 310px 1fr 340px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 1160px) {
      .pb-workspace-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Panels (Left, Center, Right) */
    .pb-panel {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .pb-panel-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .pb-panel-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Palette Tabs */
    .pb-tab-switch {
      display: flex;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 3px;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .pb-tab-switch-btn {
      flex: 1;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 6px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .pb-tab-switch-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    /* Selected Player Inspector Card */
    .pb-inspector-box {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .pb-inspector-top {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .pb-player-badge-lg {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .pb-jersey-circle {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .pb-jersey-circle.offense {
      background: #d97706;
      border: 2px solid #fef08a;
    }

    .pb-jersey-circle.defense {
      background: #e11d48;
      border: 2px solid #fecdd3;
    }

    .pb-player-details {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .pb-player-id-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .pb-player-coord {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-family: monospace;
    }

    /* Route Buttons Grid */
    .pb-routes-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-route-btn {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 7px 4px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      gap: 4px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .pb-route-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
      border-color: var(--y);
      color: var(--y);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .pb-route-btn.active {
      background: var(--y);
      border-color: #fef08a;
      color: #0c140e;
      font-weight: 900;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px var(--y-glow);
    }

    .pb-route-icon {
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    /* Run Concepts & Motion Clusters */
    .pb-concepts-cluster {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-concept-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 7px 10px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .pb-concept-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .pb-concept-btn.active {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.22);
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    /* Motion Buttons */
    .pb-motion-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .pb-motion-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--accent-purple);
      color: var(--accent-purple);
    }

    .pb-motion-btn.active {
      background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.25);
      border-color: var(--accent-purple);
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    /* Roster Mini List */
    .pb-roster-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      max-height: 220px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 4px;
    }

    .pb-roster-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      transition: all 0.12s;
    }

    .pb-roster-item:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border-color: var(--ln);
    }

    .pb-roster-item.active {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--y);
    }

    /* Center Column Field & Telemetry HUD */
    .pb-field-header-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .pb-play-name-input {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      outline: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
      max-width: 380px;
    }

    .pb-play-name-input:hover,
    .pb-play-name-input:focus {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-color: var(--ln-light);
    }

    .pb-tags-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .pb-tag-pill {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .pb-tag-pill.pass {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18);
      color: var(--y);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
    }

    .pb-tag-pill.run {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    .pb-tag-pill.personnel {
      background: rgba(141, 161, 145, 0.18);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .pb-tag-pill.formation {
      background: rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.22);
      color: var(--g-light);
      border: 1px solid rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.35);
    }

    /* SVG Field Stage */
    .pb-field-stage {
      position: relative;
      background: #0d1e12;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }

    .pb-field-svg {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1000 / 600;
      display: block;
      user-select: none;
      cursor: default;
    }

    .pb-field-svg.dragging {
      cursor: grabbing !important;
    }

    /* Playback Telemetry Bar */
    .pb-telemetry-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--hud-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .pb-playback-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 5px;
    }

    .pb-phase-hud {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 4px 9px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18);
      color: var(--y);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pb-slider-box {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 180px;
    }

    .pb-time-text {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-family: monospace;
      font-weight: 700;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .pb-toggle-flags {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 600;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .pb-toggle-flags label {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .pb-toggle-flags input[type="checkbox"] {
      accent-color: var(--g);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* Right Column: Tactical Analysis & Dossier */
    .pb-analysis-dossier {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .pb-metric-card {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-metric-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-metric-value {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .pb-metric-desc {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* Coverage Matchup Matrix */
    .pb-coverage-matrix {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-cov-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      padding: 5px 8px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .pb-cov-name {
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
      min-width: 65px;
    }

    .pb-cov-bar-track {
      flex: 1;
      height: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .pb-cov-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 3px;
      transition: width 0.3s ease;
    }

    .pb-cov-bar-fill.high {
      background: #22c55e;
    }

    .pb-cov-bar-fill.mid {
      background: #f59e0b;
    }

    .pb-cov-bar-fill.low {
      background: #ef4444;
    }

    .pb-cov-rating {
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 11px;
      min-width: 48px;
      text-align: right;
    }

    /* Callout Bullets (Strengths / Weaknesses / Risks) */
    .pb-callout-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-callout-item {
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .pb-callout-item.strength {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.09);
      border-left: 3px solid #22c55e;
      color: #bbf7d0;
    }

    .pb-callout-item.weakness {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.09);
      border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b;
      color: #fde68a;
    }

    .pb-callout-item.risk {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.09);
      border-left: 3px solid #ef4444;
      color: #fca5a5;
    }

    /* My Plays Library Drawer/Modal */
    .pb-myplays-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
      max-height: 520px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .pb-play-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s;
      position: relative;
    }

    .pb-play-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--y);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .pb-play-card.active {
      border-color: var(--y);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--y-glow);
    }

    .pb-play-card-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .pb-play-card-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .pb-play-card-desc {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .pb-play-card-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* Modals */
    .pb-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 1000;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .pb-modal-content {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 620px;
      max-height: 85vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .pb-modal-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .pb-modal-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .pb-modal-close {
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .pb-modal-close:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
    }


    /* ==================== 9. ADVANCED STATS LAB & FOOTBALL ANALYTICS STYLES ==================== */
    .statslab-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 18px 24px 60px;
      max-width: 1720px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .sl-top-bar {
      display: flex;
