      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .sl-title-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .sl-headline {
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.4px;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .sl-subtitle {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin: 0;
    }

    .sl-demo-disclaimer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #fde68a;
    }

    .sl-disclaimer-icon {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: var(--y);
    }

    /* Category Filter Bar */
    .sl-filter-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .sl-chips-group {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .sl-chip {
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      color: var(--mut);
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .sl-chip:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--mut);
    }

    .sl-chip.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--g-light);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.4);
    }

    /* 2-Column or 3-Column Layout */
    .sl-main-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 360px 1fr;
      gap: 18px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1180px) {
      .sl-main-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Metric Catalog List */
    .sl-catalog-panel {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      max-height: 840px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .sl-catalog-card {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .sl-catalog-card:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: var(--y);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .sl-catalog-card.active {
      border-color: var(--y);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--y-glow);
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.08);
    }

    .sl-card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .sl-metric-code {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.2px;
    }

    .sl-tag-pill {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    }

    .sl-tag-pill.epa {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.18);
      color: var(--y);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);
    }

    .sl-tag-pill.passing {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .sl-tag-pill.rush {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.18);
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4);
    }

    .sl-tag-pill.coverage {
      background: rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.18);
      color: var(--accent-purple);
      border: 1px solid rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.4);
    }

    .sl-tag-pill.overall {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.18);
      color: #4ade80;
      border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4);
    }

    .sl-card-desc {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    /* Detail Workspace */
    .sl-workspace {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    /* Hero Metric Header Box */
    .sl-hero-dossier {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .sl-hero-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .sl-hero-title {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      color: var(--ink);
      margin: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .sl-hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* Metric 5-Pillar Tabs / Grid */
    .sl-pillars-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .sl-pillars-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .sl-pillar-box {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .sl-pillar-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 7px;
    }

    .sl-pillar-title.measure {
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .sl-pillar-title.why {
      color: #4ade80;
    }

    .sl-pillar-title.calc {
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .sl-pillar-title.when {
      color: var(--accent-purple);
    }

    .sl-pillar-title.limits {
      color: var(--accent-crimson);
    }

    .sl-pillar-text {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Formula Box */
    .sl-formula-box {
      background: #080f0a;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-family: monospace;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #a7f3d0;
      margin-top: 4px;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    /* Benchmarks Tier Bar */
    .sl-benchmarks-box {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .sl-tiers-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 8px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .sl-tiers-row {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    .sl-tier-card {
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .sl-tier-card.elite {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.35);
    }

    .sl-tier-card.above {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
    }

    .sl-tier-card.average {
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.35);
    }

    .sl-tier-card.poor {
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35);
    }

    .sl-tier-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .sl-tier-val {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    /* Interactive Visualization & Comparison Section */
    .sl-interactive-section {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .sl-section-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .sl-section-title {
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Charts Stage */
    .sl-chart-stage {
      background: #09120b;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px;
      position: relative;
      min-height: 320px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .sl-chart-svg {
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 380px;
    }

    /* Situational Splits Interactive Controls */
    .sl-split-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .sl-split-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .sl-split-btn:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      border-color: var(--mut);
    }

    .sl-split-btn.active {
      background: var(--g);
      color: #fff;
      border-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    /* Comparison Table / Matrix */
    .sl-comp-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 12.5px;
    }

    .sl-comp-table th {
      text-align: left;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      font-size: 10.5px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .sl-comp-table td {
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln-light);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .sl-comp-table tr:hover td {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
    }

    .sl-bar-cell {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .sl-mini-bar-track {
      flex: 1;
      height: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .sl-mini-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    /* Tactical Bridge Callout Card */
    .sl-tactical-bridge {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(37, 131, 82, 0.15), rgba(15, 25, 17, 0.95));
      border: 1px solid rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .sl-bridge-title {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--g-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .sl-bridge-body {
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }



    /* ==================== OPTIONAL MADDEN LAYER STYLING ==================== */

    /* Header Toggle Button */
    .madden-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .madden-toggle-btn:hover {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    }

    .madden-toggle-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.3), rgba(2, 132, 199, 0.2));
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* Madden Badges */
    .madden-badge-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .madden-pill-badge {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .madden-pill-badge.real {
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
      color: #6ee7b7;
    }

    .madden-pill-badge.game {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
      color: #7dd3fc;
    }

    /* Playbook Madden Card */
    .madden-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85), rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.08));
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .madden-card-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      padding-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .madden-title {
      color: var(--status-info);
      !important;
      font-size: 14px !important;
      font-weight: 800 !important;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .madden-dossier-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .madden-subcard {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 12px;
    }

    .madden-subcard.warning {
      border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.3);
      background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.05);
    }

    .madden-subcard.diff {
      border-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25);
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.04);
    }

    .madden-subcard-title {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .madden-text {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.55;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .madden-controls-box {
      margin-top: 8px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: #bae6fd;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    /* Play Builder Madden Card */
    .madden-pb-card {
      margin-top: 10px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    /* Modal Guide */
    .madden-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .madden-modal-content {
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      max-width: 980px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .madden-guide-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .madden-guide-tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .madden-guide-tab-btn:hover {
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .madden-guide-tab-btn.active {
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .madden-guide-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .madden-guide-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .madden-guide-card-title {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--status-info);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .madden-guide-card-body {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .madden-diff-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .madden-diff-table th {
      text-align: left;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 700;
      border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .madden-diff-table td {
      padding: 8px 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      vertical-align: top;
    }



    /* ==================== AUDIT POLISH & COMMAND CENTER DESIGN SYSTEM ==================== */

    /* 1. Global Focus & Accessibility Standards */
    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan, #38bdf8) !important;
      outline-offset: 2px !important;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      !important;
    }

    button:focus-visible,
    input:focus-visible,
    select:focus-visible,
    a:focus-visible,
    [tabindex]:focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--accent-cyan, #38bdf8) !important;
      outline-offset: 2px !important;
    }

    /* 2. Interactive States & Micro-Transitions */
    button,
    .tab-btn,
    .subtab-btn,
    .tool-card,
    .sl-catalog-card,
    .playbook-item-card,
    .pb-callout-item,
    .chip-btn {
      transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1),
        background 0.2s ease,
        border-color 0.2s ease,
        box-shadow 0.2s ease,
        opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    button:active:not(:disabled),
    .tab-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
      transform: scale(0.97);
    }

    button:disabled,
    .tab-btn:disabled,
    [disabled] {
      opacity: 0.42 !important;
      cursor: not-allowed !important;
      pointer-events: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
    }

    /* 3. Empty States */
    .cmd-empty-state {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 36px 20px;
      text-align: center;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      margin: 14px 0;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .cmd-empty-icon {
      font-size: 32px;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .cmd-empty-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    .cmd-empty-desc {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      max-width: 420px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    /* 4. Loading States & Shimmer */
    .cmd-skeleton {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 25%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) 50%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 75%);
      background-size: 200% 100%;
      animation: cmdShimmer 1.8s infinite;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    @keyframes cmdShimmer {
      0% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
      }

      100% {
        background-position: -200% 0;
      }
    }

    /* 5. HUD Toast Notification System */
    #cmd-toast-container {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 24px;
      right: 24px;
      z-index: 999999;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .cmd-toast {
      pointer-events: auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 18px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 15px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
      max-width: 420px;
      animation: cmdToastSlideIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .cmd-toast.error {
      border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.5);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 15px rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.25);
    }

    .cmd-toast.success {
      border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.5);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 15px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.25);
    }

    @keyframes cmdToastSlideIn {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.95);
      }

      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
      }
    }

    /* 6. Progressive Disclosure in Stats Lab */
    .sl-disclosure-toggle-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      margin-top: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .sl-disclosure-label {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .sl-segmented-pills {
      display: flex;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      padding: 3px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .sl-seg-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 5px 11px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
    }

    .sl-seg-btn:hover {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .sl-seg-btn.active {
      background: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: #0b1120;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .sl-math-disclosure {
      margin-top: 6px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .sl-math-disclosure summary {
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #7dd3fc;
      user-select: none;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .sl-math-disclosure summary:hover {
      color: #fff;
    }

    .sl-math-disclosure[open] {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    }

    /* 7. Cross-Module Connection Cards */
    .sl-crosslink-card {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.15), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8));
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.35);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      margin-top: 14px;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .sl-crosslink-text {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .film-crosslink-bar {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* 8. Global Responsive Enhancements across Viewports */

    /* Laptops & Tablets (< 1200px) */
    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .nav-tabs {
        scrollbar-width: thin;
        scrollbar-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3) transparent;
      }

      .nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar {
        height: 4px;
      }

      .nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
        background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
        border-radius: 4px;
      }
    }

    /* Tablets (< 960px) */
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      header {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 8px;
        padding: 8px 12px;
      }

      .brand {
        align-self: flex-start;
      }

      .header-actions {
        justify-content: flex-start;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .nav-tabs {
        order: 3;
        width: 100%;
        margin-top: 2px;
      }

      .tab-btn {
        padding: 6px 9px;
        font-size: 12px;
      }

      .tools-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      }

      .simulator-field-box {
        min-height: auto;
      }

      .field-controls-bar {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;
      }
    }

    /* Mobile & Small Screens (< 640px) */
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      header {
        padding: 6px 10px;
      }

      .brand-title {
        font-size: 13px;
      }

      .brand-subtitle {
        display: none;
      }

      .search-box {
        max-width: 140px;
        min-width: 100px;
      }

      .madden-toggle-btn {
        padding: 5px 8px;
        font-size: 11px;
      }

      .tab-btn {
        padding: 5px 8px;
        font-size: 11px;
        gap: 4px;
      }

      .hero-stats-group {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 6px;
      }

      .tools-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .tactic-dossier-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .sl-tiers-row {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .madden-modal-content {
        padding: 16px;
      }

      .cmd-toast {
        right: 12px;
        bottom: 12px;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 24px);
        font-size: 12px;
      }
    }


    /* ==================== NFL COMMAND CENTER STYLES ==================== */
    /* ==================== HOME COMMAND CENTER CSS ==================== */

    /* Hub Navigation Switcher */
    .home-hub-switcher {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 6px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: thin;
    }

    .hub-tab-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      color: var(--mut);
      padding: 9px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .hub-tab-btn:hover:not(.active) {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
    }

    .hub-tab-btn.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(8, 145, 178, 0.25), rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15));
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* Hub Section Panes */
    .home-hub-pane {
      display: none;
      animation: cmdPaneFadeIn 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .home-hub-pane.active {
      display: block;
    }

    @keyframes cmdPaneFadeIn {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(6px);
      }

      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    /* Section Header Container */
    .cmd-section-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .cmd-section-title-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .cmd-section-title {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0;
      letter-spacing: 0.3px;
    }

    .cmd-section-subtitle {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Filter Bar Controls */
    .cmd-filter-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 8px 14px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .cmd-search-input {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 7px 12px 7px 32px;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 12.5px;
      outline: none;
      min-width: 200px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    .cmd-search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .cmd-filter-chips {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .cmd-chip {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s;
    }

    .cmd-chip:hover {
      color: var(--ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .cmd-chip.active {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* ==================== 1. 32 TEAMS GRID STYLING ==================== */
    .nfl-conferences-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .nfl-conferences-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .nfl-conf-column {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .nfl-conf-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .nfl-conf-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 900;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .nfl-conf-title.afc {
      color: #f43f5e;
    }

    .nfl-conf-title.nfc {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .nfl-division-block {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .nfl-division-title {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.6px;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .nfl-division-teams {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    /* Team Card */
    .nfl-team-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 10px 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .nfl-team-card:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .team-badge-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .team-card-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      min-width: 0;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .team-card-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .team-card-sub {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .team-card-scheme-pill {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      color: #7dd3fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      align-self: flex-start;
      margin-top: 3px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* ==================== 2. LEAGUE STATS OVERVIEW STYLING ==================== */
    .nfl-stats-container {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table-wrapper {
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
    }

    .nfl-stats-table {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      min-width: 820px;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table th {
      padding: 10px 12px;
      text-align: right;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 800;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ln);
      cursor: pointer;
      user-select: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table th:first-child,
    .nfl-stats-table th:nth-child(2) {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table th:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .nfl-stats-table th.sorted-asc::after {
      content: " ▲";
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table th.sorted-desc::after {
      content: " ▼";
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      font-size: 10px;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table td {
      padding: 9px 12px;
      text-align: right;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.1);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table td:first-child,
    .nfl-stats-table td:nth-child(2) {
      text-align: left;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table tbody tr:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.06);
    }

    .stat-cell-team {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .stat-mini-pill {
      width: 26px;
      height: 26px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .stat-bar-container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .stat-bar-mini {
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    /* ==================== 3. TIER LIST STYLING ==================== */
    .tierlist-wrapper {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .tierlist-header-actions {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .tierlist-canvas {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .tier-row {
      display: flex;
      min-height: 84px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.12);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }

    .tier-row.drag-over {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tier-label-box {
      width: 140px;
      min-width: 140px;
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 900;
      cursor: pointer;
      position: relative;
      user-select: none;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
    }

    .tier-label-box:hover {
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .tier-title-text {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    }

    .tier-count-sub {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      opacity: 0.8;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .tier-items-dropzone {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      align-items: center;
      align-content: center;
      min-height: 80px;
    }

    /* Tierlist Team Item Badge */
    .tier-team-item {
      width: 58px;
      height: 58px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      cursor: grab;
      user-select: none;
      position: relative;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .tier-team-item:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border-color: #fff;
    }

    .tier-team-item:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    .tier-team-item.dragging {
      opacity: 0.4;
      transform: scale(0.95);
    }

    .tier-team-abbr {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    }

    .tier-team-city {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      max-width: 50px;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Unranked Pool */
    .tier-unranked-pool {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px dashed var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .tier-unranked-title {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    /* Quick Move Dropdown Menu */
    .tier-quick-menu {
      position: absolute;
      top: 100%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 6px;
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      min-width: 120px;
    }

    .tier-quick-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .tier-quick-btn:hover {
      background: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: #0b1120;
    }

    /* ==================== 4. EXTERNAL RESOURCES STYLING ==================== */
    .resources-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .resource-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      position: relative;
    }

    .resource-card:hover {
      background: var(--bg-card-hover);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .resource-card-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .resource-icon-badge {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .resource-icon {
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .resource-title {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .resource-category {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .resource-badge {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: #7dd3fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .resource-desc {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .resource-footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      align-items: center;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      gap: 4px;
    }

    /* ==================== TEAM DETAIL MODAL ==================== */
    .team-modal-content {
      max-width: 680px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .team-modal-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      padding-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .team-modal-identity {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .team-modal-avatar {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .team-modal-name-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2px;
    }

    .team-modal-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      margin: 0;
    }

    .team-modal-division {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .team-modal-body-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .team-modal-body-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    .team-modal-info-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .team-modal-card-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .team-modal-card-val {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }


    /* Additional Interactive & Polish Elements */
    .team-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(3, 7, 18, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px;
    }

    .tier-team-chip-badge {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    }

    .tier-team-chip-name {
      font-size: 8.5px;
      opacity: 0.85;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      max-width: 50px;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .tier-chip-menu-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      right: 2px;
      width: 14px;
      height: 14px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      font-size: 8px;
      line-height: 1;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.15s;
    }

    .tier-team-item:hover .tier-chip-menu-btn {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .tier-chip-menu-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    }

    .tier-row-controls {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .tier-ctrl-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 4px 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .tier-ctrl-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      color: var(--ink-primary);
    }

    .tier-ctrl-btn.danger:hover {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
      color: #ef4444;
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }

    .tier-quick-popover {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      padding: 8px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 220px;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover-header {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover-item {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--ink-primary);
      text-align: left;
      padding: 6px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      transition: background 0.12s;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover-item:hover {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tier-quick-popover-item.danger {
      color: #f87171;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover-item.danger:hover {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
    }

    .resource-link-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .resource-link-btn:hover {
      background: #38bdf8;
      color: #0b1120;
    }


    .btn-tier-action {
      background: var(--brand-primary, #10b981);
      color: #0b1120;
      border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.4);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .btn-tier-action:hover {
      background: #059669;
      color: #fff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-tier-action.secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      color: var(--ink-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .btn-tier-action.secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-tier-action.danger:hover {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);
      color: #f87171;
    }


    /* ==================== REAL PLAYER TEAM BUILDER STYLES ==================== */
    /* ==========================================================================
   NFL REAL PLAYER TEAM BUILDER - STYLES
   ========================================================================== */

    .tb-container {
      max-width: 1380px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 24px 20px 80px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    /* 1. TEAM BUILDER HERO & IDENTITY BANNER */
    .tb-identity-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95) 0%, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2));
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px);
      padding: 22px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tb-identity-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 5px;
      height: 100%;
      background: var(--tb-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
      transition: background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .tb-identity-top {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .tb-title-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .tb-team-avatar {
      width: 56px;
      height: 56px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--tb-primary-color, #0ea5e9) 0%, var(--tb-secondary-color, #f59e0b) 100%);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    }

    .tb-name-input-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .tb-team-name-input {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px dashed transparent;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      max-width: 420px;
    }

    .tb-team-name-input:hover {
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .tb-team-name-input:focus {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-color: var(--tb-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
      outline: none;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.2);
    }

    .tb-team-subtitle {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      padding-left: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    /* Identity scheme tags */
    .tb-scheme-selectors {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tb-scheme-pill {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
    }

    .tb-scheme-pill select {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      outline: none;
    }

    .tb-scheme-pill select option {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* 2. STATS & METRICS ROW */
    .tb-metrics-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
      padding-top: 14px;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
    }

    .tb-metric-box {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .tb-metric-label {
      font-size: 10px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
    }

    .tb-metric-val {
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
    }

    .tb-metric-val.highlight {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tb-metric-sub {
      font-size: 9.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
    }

    /* 3. TOOLBAR & ACTIONS */
    .tb-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      background: var(--bg-card, #0f172a);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2));
      border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px);
      padding: 10px 16px;
    }

    .tb-actions-group {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-tb {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .btn-tb:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .btn-tb.primary {
      background: var(--tb-primary-color, #0ea5e9);
      color: #0b1120;
      border-color: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.4);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .btn-tb.primary:hover {
      background: #0284c7;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .btn-tb.danger:hover {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
      color: #f87171;
    }

    /* 4. MAIN BUILDER WORKSPACE (BOARD + DRAWER) */
    .tb-workspace {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .tb-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* 5. ROSTER BOARD (DEPTH CHART) */
    .tb-board {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .tb-phase-card {
      background: var(--bg-card, #0f172a);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2));
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .tb-phase-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      padding-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .tb-phase-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .tb-phase-title.offense {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tb-phase-title.defense {
      color: #f43f5e;
    }

    .tb-phase-title.special {
      color: #f59e0b;
    }

    .tb-phase-counter {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    /* Position Group Section */
    .tb-group-section {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .tb-group-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .tb-slots-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 10px;
    }

    /* 6. ROSTER SLOT CARDS */
    .tb-slot-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      position: relative;
      min-height: 84px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .tb-slot-card:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .tb-slot-card.active-target {
      border-style: solid;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
    }

    .tb-slot-card.filled {
      border-style: solid;
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      background: var(--bg-card);
    }

    .tb-slot-card.filled:hover {
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4);
    }

    .tb-slot-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .tb-slot-badge {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .tb-slot-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Empty slot call-to-action */
    .tb-slot-empty-content {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 6px;
      height: 44px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .tb-slot-empty-content:hover {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    /* Filled slot content */
    .tb-slot-player-content {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .tb-slot-player-avatar {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 900;
      color: #fff;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .tb-slot-player-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .tb-slot-player-name {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .tb-slot-player-sub {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
    }

    .tb-slot-player-rating {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #10b981;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .tb-slot-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      justify-content: flex-end;
    }

    .tb-slot-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      font-size: 11px;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 2px 4px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      transition: all 0.12s ease;
    }

    .tb-slot-btn:hover {
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .tb-slot-btn.danger:hover {
      color: #ef4444;
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
    }

    /* 7. PLAYER POOL DRAWER / BROWSER PANEL */
    .tb-pool-panel {
      background: var(--bg-card, #0f172a);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2));
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px);
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 14px;
      position: sticky;
      top: 80px;
      max-height: calc(100vh - 100px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .tb-pool-header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      padding-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .tb-pool-title {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
    }

    .tb-pool-active-slot-pill {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--status-info);
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      align-self: flex-start;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* Pool search & filter bar */
    .tb-pool-search-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .tb-pool-input {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 13px;
      outline: none;
      font-family: inherit;
    }

    .tb-pool-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
    }

    .tb-pool-pos-chips {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .tb-pool-pos-chips::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: 4px;
    }

    .tb-pool-pos-chips::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .tb-pos-chip {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .tb-pos-chip:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: #fff;
    }

    .tb-pos-chip.active {
      background: #38bdf8;
      color: #0b1120;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    /* Pool players list */
    .tb-pool-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      max-height: 520px;
      padding-right: 4px;
    }

    .tb-pool-list::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 5px;
    }

    .tb-pool-list::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .tb-pool-item {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 10px;
      transition: all 0.15s ease;
    }

    .tb-pool-item:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
    }

    .tb-pool-item.assigned-here {
      border-color: #10b981;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
    }

    .tb-pool-item-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tb-pool-avatar {
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tb-pool-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tb-pool-name {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .tb-pool-details {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
    }

    .tb-pool-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .btn-assign-player {
      background: #38bdf8;
      color: #0b1120;
      border: none;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.12s ease;
    }

    .btn-assign-player:hover {
      background: #0284c7;
      color: #fff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* 8. SAVED ROSTERS MODAL */
    .tb-saved-modal-content {
      max-width: 680px;
      background: var(--bg);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px);
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .tb-saved-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      max-height: 420px;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .tb-saved-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      transition: border 0.15s;
    }

    .tb-saved-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5);
    }

    .tb-saved-card.active {
      border-color: #10b981;
      background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08);
    }

    .tb-saved-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .tb-saved-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-primary, #f8fafc);
    }

    .tb-saved-meta {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--ink-secondary, #94a3b8);
    }

    .tb-saved-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }



    /* ==================== 3-PATH LEARNING SYSTEM STYLES ==================== */

    .learn-paths-header {
      padding: 16px 24px;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      position: relative;
      top: auto;
      z-index: 10;
    }

    .learn-paths-title-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }

    .learn-paths-main-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.3px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff 30%, var(--accent-cyan) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    .learn-paths-main-sub {
      margin: 4px 0 0;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--mut);
      max-width: 680px;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .learn-paths-global-stats {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 4px;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    }

    .learn-global-stat-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .learn-stat-val {
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--y);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
    }

    .learn-stat-lbl {
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .learn-global-stat-bar {
      width: 140px;
      height: 5px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 999px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .learn-global-stat-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--g), var(--y));
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: width 0.3s ease;
    }

    .learn-path-tabs {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 10px;
    }

    @media (max-width: 1100px) {
      .learn-path-tabs {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .learn-path-tabs {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    :root[data-theme="light"] .learn-path-tab {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border-color: var(--border);
    }

    :root[data-theme="light"] .learn-path-tab:hover {
      background: var(--bg-elevated);
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
    }

    :root[data-theme="light"] .learn-path-tab.active {
      background: #ffffff;
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    }

    .learn-path-tab {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      text-align: left;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .learn-path-tab:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .learn-path-tab.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95) 100%);
      border-color: var(--y);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .learn-path-tab[data-path="player"].active {
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .learn-path-tab[data-path="coach"].active {
      border-color: #a855f7;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .learn-path-tab-icon {
      font-size: 22px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }

    .learn-path-tab-info {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .learn-path-tab-title {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .learn-path-tab-desc {
      display: block;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--mut);
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .learn-path-tab-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--ink);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .learn-path-tab.active .learn-path-tab-badge {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.4);
      color: var(--y);
    }

    .learn-path-tab[data-path="player"].active .learn-path-tab-badge {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .learn-path-tab[data-path="coach"].active .learn-path-tab-badge {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
      color: #c084fc;
    }

    /* Module Header & Badges */
    .learn-module-header {
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .learn-module-meta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .learn-module-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    .player-pos-badge {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent-cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .coach-role-badge {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      color: #c084fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .learn-diff-badge {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .learn-read-time {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin-left: auto;
    }

    /* Objectives Box */
    .objectives-box {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.25);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--accent-cyan);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .objectives-title {
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .objectives-list {
      margin: 0;
      padding-left: 20px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .objectives-list li {
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    /* Pedagogical Cards (WAS, WARUM, WANN, WIE, FEHLER, LEVEL) */
    .pedagogical-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .pedagogical-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px 20px;
      transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
    }

    .pedagogical-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
    }

    .pc-header {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.8px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .card-was .pc-header {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .card-warum .pc-header {
      color: #facc15;
    }

    .card-wann .pc-header {
      color: #fb923c;
    }

    .card-wie .pc-header {
      color: #4ade80;
    }

    .card-fehler .pc-header {
      color: #f87171;
    }

    .card-level .pc-header {
      color: #c084fc;
    }

    .pc-content {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .pc-content b {
      color: #fff;
    }

    /* Drills Container */
    .pedagogical-section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 28px 0 16px;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln);
    }

    .pedagogical-section-header h3 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .drills-container {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .drill-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .drill-card-header {
      padding: 12px 18px;
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.08);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .drill-number {
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 800;
      background: var(--accent-cyan);
      color: #0f172a;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .drill-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .drill-difficulty-badge {
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .drill-body {
      padding: 16px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 13.5px;
      line-height: 1.55;
    }

    .drill-coaching {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.08);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--y);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
    }

    .drill-safety {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
      border-left: 3px solid #ef4444;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
    }

    .drill-criterion {
      background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.08);
      border-left: 3px solid #22c55e;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
    }

    /* Coach Case & Task Cards */
    .coach-case-card,
    .coach-task-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px 20px;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .coach-case-card {
      border-left: 4px solid #a855f7;
    }

    .coach-task-card {
      border-left: 4px solid var(--y);
    }

    .ccc-header,
    .ctc-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .ccc-header h4,
    .ctc-header h4 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .ccc-content,
    .ctc-content {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    /* Cross Perspectives Box */
    .cross-perspectives-box {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 18px 20px;
      margin: 28px 0;
    }

    .cp-title {
      font-size: 14.5px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    .cp-desc {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .cp-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .cp-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--ln);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 12px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.18s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .cp-card:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .cp-card-general:hover {
      border-color: var(--y);
    }

    .cp-card-player:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-cyan);
    }

    .cp-card-coach:hover {
      border-color: #a855f7;
    }

    .cp-badge {
      font-size: 10.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--mut);
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    .cp-card-label {
      font-size: 13.5px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .cp-link-arrow {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--g-light);
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* Responsive adjustments */
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .learn-path-tabs {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .learn-paths-title-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .learn-paths-global-stats {
        align-items: flex-start;
        width: 100%;
      }
    }
