    /* ==========================================================================
   MOBILE & RESPONSIVE DESIGN SYSTEM OVERHAUL
   Fluid Scaling, Touch Primitives, Safe Viewports & Mobile Navigation
   ========================================================================== */

    /* Universal Responsive Box Sizing & Root Overflow Protection */
    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html,
    body {
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow-x: clip;
      position: relative;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    }

    /* Base fluid container padding */
    .home-container,
    .lab-container,
    .film-room-wrapper,
    .pb-container,
    .tb-container,
    .sl-container,
    .challenges-container,
    .glossary-app-shell,
    .learn-paths-header,
    .wrap {
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 1380px !important;
      padding-left: clamp(12px, 3vw, 24px) !important;
      padding-right: clamp(12px, 3vw, 24px) !important;
    }

    /* Touch targets base rule */
    button,
    select,
    input,
    a,
    .tab-btn,
    .filter-chip,
    .gloss-pill,
    .film-filter-btn {
      touch-action: manipulation;
    }

    /* Safe viewport padding for mobile devices */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      body {
        padding-bottom: calc(68px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px)) !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   MOBILE NAVIGATION & HEADER SYSTEM (< 768px)
   ========================================================================== */
    .mobile-bottom-nav {
      display: none;
    }

    .mobile-more-drawer,
    .mobile-drawer-backdrop {
      display: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {

      /* Header adjustments on mobile */
      header {
        height: 54px !important;
        padding: 0 14px !important;
        position: sticky !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        z-index: 1000 !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        background: rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.95) !important;
        backdrop-filter: none;
        !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15) !important;
      }

      /* Hide desktop tabs row on mobile - replaced by Mobile Bottom Nav */
      header .nav-tabs {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .brand {
        gap: 8px !important;
      }

      .brand-badge {
        font-size: 20px !important;
      }

      .brand-title {
        font-size: 13.5px !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
      }

      .brand-subtitle {
        display: none !important;
      }

      .header-actions {
        gap: 8px !important;
      }

      .header-actions .search-box {
        max-width: 130px !important;
      }

      .header-actions .search-box input {
        font-size: 12px !important;
        padding: 5px 8px !important;
        height: 32px !important;
      }

      /* Hide non-essential header buttons on mobile header (accessible in Mehr drawer) */
      #btn-madden-toggle,
      #btn-madden-guide {
        display: none !important;
      }

      #mastery-badge {
        font-size: 11px !important;
        padding: 4px 8px !important;
        height: 30px !important;
      }

      #th {
        width: 32px !important;
        height: 32px !important;
        font-size: 14px !important;
      }

      /* Fixed Mobile Bottom App Bar */
      .mobile-bottom-nav {
        display: flex !important;
        position: fixed !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        right: 0 !important;
        height: calc(56px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
        padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) !important;
        background: rgba(10, 15, 29, 0.96) !important;
        backdrop-filter: none;
        !important;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important;
        z-index: 9995 !important;
        justify-content: space-around !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6) !important;
      }

      .mob-nav-btn {
        flex: 1 !important;
        height: 52px !important;
        background: transparent !important;
        border: none !important;
        color: var(--mut, #94a3b8) !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        gap: 3px !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
        padding: 4px 0 !important;
        font-family: inherit !important;
        transition: all 0.15s ease !important;
        position: relative !important;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
      }

      .mob-nav-btn:active {
        transform: scale(0.92);
      }

      .mob-nav-icon {
        font-size: 18px !important;
        line-height: 1 !important;
        transition: transform 0.2s ease !important;
      }

      .mob-nav-label {
        font-size: 10px !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.3px !important;
        text-transform: uppercase !important;
      }

      .mob-nav-btn.active {
        color: var(--status-info);
        !important;
      }

      .mob-nav-btn.active .mob-nav-icon {
        transform: scale(1.15);
        filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.6));
      }

      .mob-nav-btn.active::after {
        content: '' !important;
        position: absolute !important;
        top: 2px !important;
        width: 20px !important;
        height: 3px !important;
        background: #38bdf8 !important;
        border-radius: 2px !important;
        box-shadow: 0 0 8px #38bdf8 !important;
      }

      /* Mobile Drawer Backdrop */
      .mobile-drawer-backdrop {
        display: block !important;
        position: fixed !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        right: 0 !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
        backdrop-filter: none;
        !important;
        z-index: 9996 !important;
        opacity: 0 !important;
        pointer-events: none !important;
        transition: opacity 0.25s ease !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-backdrop.open {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
      }

      /* Mobile More Drawer Sheet */
      .mobile-more-drawer {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        position: fixed !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        right: 0 !important;
        bottom: 0 !important;
        max-height: 85vh !important;
        background: var(--bg-card);
        !important;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25) !important;
        border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0 !important;
        z-index: 9997 !important;
        padding: 12px 18px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px)) 18px !important;
        box-shadow: 0 -12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) !important;
        transform: translateY(105%) !important;
        transition: transform 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
        overflow-y: auto !important;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
        overscroll-behavior: contain !important;
      }

      .mobile-more-drawer.open {
        transform: translateY(0) !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-handle-bar {
        width: 100% !important;
        display: flex !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        padding: 4px 0 10px 0 !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-handle {
        width: 44px !important;
        height: 4.5px !important;
        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4) !important;
        border-radius: 4px !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-header {
        display: flex !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        padding-bottom: 12px !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15) !important;
        margin-bottom: 16px !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-title {
        font-size: 15px !important;
        font-weight: 800 !important;
        color: var(--ink);
        !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        text-transform: uppercase !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-close {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        !important;
        color: var(--mut);
        !important;
        width: 32px !important;
        height: 32px !important;
        border-radius: 50% !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        font-size: 14px !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-grid {
        display: grid !important;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr) !important;
        gap: 10px !important;
        margin-bottom: 16px !important;
      }

      .mob-drawer-item {
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.75) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important;
        border-radius: 12px !important;
        padding: 12px 10px !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: flex-start !important;
        gap: 4px !important;
        text-align: left !important;
        color: var(--ink);
        !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
        font-family: inherit !important;
        transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease !important;
        min-height: 72px !important;
      }

      .mob-drawer-item:active {
        background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18) !important;
        border-color: var(--status-info);
        !important;
        transform: scale(0.97) !important;
      }

      .mob-drawer-icon {
        font-size: 20px !important;
        line-height: 1 !important;
      }

      .mob-drawer-name {
        font-size: 13px !important;
        font-weight: 800 !important;
        color: var(--ink);
        !important;
      }

      .mob-drawer-desc {
        font-size: 10.5px !important;
        color: var(--mut);
        !important;
        line-height: 1.2 !important;
      }

      .mobile-drawer-quick-actions {
        display: flex !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        padding-top: 10px !important;
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15) !important;
      }

      .mob-quick-action-btn {
        flex: 1 !important;
        min-height: 44px !important;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        color: var(--ink-secondary);
        !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        gap: 6px !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
        padding: 8px 10px !important;
        font-family: inherit !important;
      }

      .mob-quick-action-btn:active {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   INTERACTIVE TACTICAL FOOTBALL FIELDS & FIELD LAB RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================================== */
    .field-wrapper,
    .film-svg-wrapper,
    .pb-field-wrapper {
      touch-action: none !important;
      overflow: hidden !important;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 12px) !important;
      position: relative !important;
    }

    #field-svg,
    #film-field-svg,
    #pb-field-svg,
    #vision-field-svg {
      display: block !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      height: auto !important;
      max-height: 75vh !important;
      user-select: none !important;
      -webkit-user-select: none !important;
      touch-action: none !important;
    }

    /* Field Controls Bar on Mobile */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {

      .field-controls-bar,
      .film-field-controls,
      .pb-playback-controls {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
        gap: 12px !important;
        padding: 12px !important;
      }

      .playback-cluster,
      .pb-transport-buttons {
        display: flex !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        width: 100% !important;
      }

      .playback-cluster button,
      .pb-transport-buttons button {
        min-height: 44px !important;
        min-width: 44px !important;
        font-size: 14px !important;
      }

      .timeline-slider,
      #field-scrubber,
      #film-timeline-slider,
      #pb-builder-scrubber {
        height: 36px !important;
        min-width: 140px !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
      }

      /* Range inputs touch target increase */
      input[type="range"] {
        touch-action: manipulation !important;
      }

      input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
        width: 26px !important;
        height: 26px !important;
      }

      input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
        width: 26px !important;
        height: 26px !important;
      }

      .lab-toolbar {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
        gap: 10px !important;
      }

      .toolbar-group {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
        gap: 4px !important;
      }

      .lab-select {
        min-height: 44px !important;
        font-size: 14px !important;
        width: 100% !important;
      }

      .toggles-group {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        gap: 8px 14px !important;
        padding-top: 6px !important;
      }

      .toggle-item {
        font-size: 13px !important;
        min-height: 36px !important;
        display: inline-flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        gap: 6px !important;
      }

      .toggle-item input[type="checkbox"] {
        width: 20px !important;
        height: 20px !important;
      }

      .lab-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 16px !important;
      }

      .inspector-panel {
        border-radius: var(--radius-md, 10px) !important;
        padding: 14px !important;
      }
    }

    /* Tactical Field Landscape Mode Optimization */
    @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) {
      header {
        height: 42px !important;
      }

      .lab-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }

      #field-svg,
      #film-field-svg,
      #pb-field-svg {
        max-height: calc(100vh - 120px) !important;
      }

      .field-controls-bar {
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   PLAY BUILDER: TOUCH-ALTERNATIVE & RESPONSIVE WORKSPACE
   ========================================================================== */
    .pb-touch-helper-banner {
      display: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .pb-layout {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 16px !important;
      }

      .pb-touch-helper-banner {
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: space-between !important;
        background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.4) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        padding: 8px 12px !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
        color: var(--status-info);
        !important;
        margin-bottom: 8px !important;
      }

      .pb-touch-nudge-pad {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
        background: var(--bg-card);
        !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
        padding: 10px !important;
        margin-top: 10px !important;
      }

      .pb-nudge-btn {
        min-height: 44px !important;
        min-width: 44px !important;
        background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3) !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        color: #fff !important;
        font-size: 16px !important;
        font-weight: 800 !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        justify-content: center !important;
        flex: 1 1 20% !important;
      }

      .pb-nudge-btn:active {
        background: #0ea5e9 !important;
      }

      .pb-topbar-actions {
        flex-wrap: wrap !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
      }

      .pb-btn-action {
        flex: 1 1 45% !important;
        min-height: 44px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   TIERLIST: TOUCH-FRIENDLY BOTTOM ACTION SHEET ALTERNATIVE
   ========================================================================== */
    .tier-quick-popover.mobile-sheet {
      position: fixed !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      right: 0 !important;
      bottom: 0 !important;
      top: auto !important;
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 100% !important;
      max-height: 80vh !important;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      !important;
      border-top: 2px solid #38bdf8 !important;
      border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 18px 18px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px)) 18px !important;
      box-shadow: 0 -12px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9) !important;
      z-index: 10005 !important;
      overflow-y: auto !important;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
      animation: slideUpTierSheet 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    }

    @keyframes slideUpTierSheet {
      from {
        transform: translateY(100%);
      }

      to {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .tier-quick-popover.mobile-sheet .tier-quick-popover-header {
      font-size: 15px !important;
      font-weight: 800 !important;
      padding-bottom: 12px !important;
      margin-bottom: 10px !important;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2) !important;
      color: #fff !important;
      display: flex !important;
      justify-content: space-between !important;
      align-items: center !important;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover.mobile-sheet .tier-quick-popover-item {
      width: 100% !important;
      min-height: 48px !important;
      font-size: 14px !important;
      font-weight: 700 !important;
      padding: 10px 14px !important;
      margin-bottom: 6px !important;
      border-radius: 10px !important;
      display: flex !important;
      align-items: center !important;
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.7) !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15) !important;
      color: var(--ink);
      !important;
    }

    .tier-quick-popover.mobile-sheet .tier-quick-popover-item:active {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2) !important;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      !important;
    }

    .tier-quick-backdrop {
      position: fixed !important;
      top: 0 !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      right: 0 !important;
      bottom: 0 !important;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75) !important;
      backdrop-filter: none;
      !important;
      z-index: 10004 !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .tier-row {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: stretch !important;
      }

      .tier-label-box {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 40px !important;
        min-width: 100% !important;
        border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0 !important;
      }

      .tier-teams-tray {
        border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px !important;
        min-height: 58px !important;
        padding: 8px !important;
      }

      .tier-team-item {
        min-height: 44px !important;
        padding: 6px 10px !important;
        cursor: pointer !important;
        -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   REAL-PLAYER TEAM BUILDER RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================================== */
    @media (max-width: 1080px) {
      .tb-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .tb-identity-top {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: flex-start !important;
      }

      .tb-team-name-input {
        font-size: 18px !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
      }

      .tb-slots-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(135px, 1fr)) !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
      }

      .tb-slot-card {
        padding: 10px 8px !important;
      }

      .tb-slot-actions button {
        min-height: 38px !important;
        font-size: 11px !important;
      }

      .tb-pool-filter-chips {
        overflow-x: auto !important;
        white-space: nowrap !important;
        padding-bottom: 6px !important;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
      }

      .tb-pos-chip {
        min-height: 40px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   RESPONSIVE TABLES (STATS LAB, HOME LEAGUE STATS, CURRICULUM TABLES)
   ========================================================================== */
    .nfl-stats-table-wrapper,
    .sl-table-wrapper,
    .table-responsive-wrapper,
    .learn-content table {
      width: 100% !important;
      max-width: 100% !important;
      overflow-x: auto !important;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
      position: relative !important;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px) !important;
      margin-bottom: 16px !important;
    }

    .nfl-stats-table,
    .sl-comp-table,
    .madden-diff-table,
    .learn-content table {
      width: 100% !important;
      min-width: 520px !important;
      border-collapse: collapse !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {

      /* Sticky First Column for tabular data */
      .nfl-stats-table th:first-child,
      .nfl-stats-table td:first-child,
      .sl-comp-table th:first-child,
      .sl-comp-table td:first-child {
        position: sticky !important;
        left: 0 !important;
        z-index: 3 !important;
        background: var(--bg-card);
        !important;
        box-shadow: 2px 0 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) !important;
      }

      .nfl-stats-table th,
      .nfl-stats-table td,
      .sl-comp-table th,
      .sl-comp-table td {
        padding: 10px 8px !important;
        font-size: 12.5px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   LEARNING SYSTEM & CURRICULUM RESPONSIVE (.wrap & .learn-nav)
   ========================================================================== */
    @media (max-width: 860px) {
      .wrap {
        flex-direction: column !important;
      }

      nav.learn-nav {
        width: 100% !important;
        position: relative !important;
        top: 0 !important;
        max-height: 320px !important;
        border-right: none !important;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ln) !important;
        margin-bottom: 16px !important;
      }

      .learn-paths-title-row {
        flex-direction: column !important;
        align-items: flex-start !important;
      }

      .learn-path-tabs {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
        gap: 8px !important;
      }

      .learn-path-tab {
        min-height: 48px !important;
      }

      .learn-content {
        padding: 12px 4px !important;
      }

      .learn-content h1 {
        font-size: 22px !important;
      }

      .learn-content h2 {
        font-size: 18px !important;
      }

      .learn-content p {
        font-size: 15px !important;
        line-height: 1.6 !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   GLOSSARY & KNOWLEDGE GRAPH RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================================== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .glossary-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }

      .glossary-browser-col {
        max-height: 480px !important;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .glossary-filter-container .filter-pills {
        overflow-x: auto !important;
        white-space: nowrap !important;
        display: flex !important;
        flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
        padding-bottom: 6px !important;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
      }

      .gloss-pill {
        min-height: 40px !important;
        padding: 6px 12px !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        flex-shrink: 0 !important;
      }

      #glossary-search-input {
        min-height: 44px !important;
        font-size: 14px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   MODALS: VIEWPORT CONSTRAINTS & STICKY CONTROLS
   ========================================================================== */
    .modal,
    .player-modal,
    .team-modal-content,
    .madden-modal-content,
    .pb-modal-content,
    .tb-saved-modal-content {
      max-width: min(94vw, 750px) !important;
      max-height: 88vh !important;
      overflow-y: auto !important;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch !important;
      margin: auto !important;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 14px) !important;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {

      .modal,
      .player-modal,
      .team-modal-content,
      .madden-modal-content,
      .pb-modal-content,
      .tb-saved-modal-content {
        width: 96vw !important;
        max-height: 90vh !important;
        padding: 16px !important;
      }
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   ACCESSIBILITY: REDUCED MOTION PREFERENCE
   ========================================================================== */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
      }
    }



    /* ==========================================================================
   NFL FOOTBALL LAB: TRAINING PLAN SYSTEM STYLES
   Command Center Aesthetic, Glassmorphism, Micro-Animations & Responsive Mobile
   ========================================================================== */

    #training-plan-container {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1400px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1.5rem 1rem 4rem 1rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* TOP PROFILE & PROGRESS HUD */
    .tp-hud-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.95) 0%, rgba(18, 30, 56, 0.85) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tp-hud-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00f0ff, #00ff88, #a855f7);
    }

    .tp-hud-profile-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-role-avatar {
      width: 72px;
      height: 72px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f2744, #1b3a60);
      border: 2px solid #00f0ff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tp-role-icon {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
    }

    .tp-role-meta {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 260px;
    }

    .tp-role-badge-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-role-group-tag {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
      color: var(--status-info);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tp-role-level-tag {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tp-role-level-tag.rookie {
      background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
      color: var(--g-light);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.35);
    }

    .tp-role-level-tag.varsity {
      background: rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .tp-role-level-tag.all-pro {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      color: #c084fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35);
    }

    .tp-role-budget-tag {
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-role-name {
      font-size: 1.55rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin: 0 0 0.3rem 0;
      color: #ffffff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .tp-badge-text {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--status-info);
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .tp-role-desc {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .tp-hud-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tp-btn-secondary {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .tp-btn-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .tp-btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-ghost:hover {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
      color: #f87171;
    }

    /* METRICS GRID */
    .tp-metrics-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      padding-top: 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .tp-metric-box {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .tp-metric-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .tp-metric-label {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #64748b;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tp-metric-val {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .tp-metric-muted {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #64748b;
    }

    .tp-progress-bar-bg {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0.4rem 0;
    }

    .tp-progress-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00f0ff, #00ff88);
      border-radius: 3px;
      transition: width 0.4s ease;
    }

    .tp-metric-sub {
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin-top: 0.2rem;
    }

    /* MULTI-WEEK PROGRESSION SELECTOR */
    .tp-week-nav-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-week-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .tp-week-tab {
      flex: 1;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 48px;
    }

    .tp-week-tab:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.8);
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-week-tab.active {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15), rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95));
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .tp-week-tab-num {
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .tp-week-tab-status {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      color: var(--status-info);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .tp-week-quick-nav {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .tp-btn-nav {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-nav:hover:not(:disabled) {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-btn-nav:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    .tp-btn-nav-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #0369a1);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-btn-nav-primary:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0369a1, #0284c7);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* THEMATIC BANNER */
    .tp-theme-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(14, 116, 144, 0.2) 0%, rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8) 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .tp-theme-icon {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .tp-theme-content {
      flex: 1;
    }

    .tp-theme-tag {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #22d3ee;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .tp-theme-title {
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-theme-focus {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .tp-theme-focus strong {
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-goals-badge {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
      color: var(--status-info);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* FILTER & DAY CONTROLS BAR */
    .tp-filter-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-day-pills {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .tp-day-pill {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      white-space: nowrap;
      min-height: 40px;
    }

    .tp-day-pill:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-day-pill.active {
      background: #00f0ff;
      color: #06101e;
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .tp-select-filter {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      min-height: 40px;
    }

    /* SESSIONS GRID */
    .tp-sessions-grid {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    }

    /* SESSION CARD */
    .tp-session-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.9) 0%, rgba(18, 30, 56, 0.75) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 1.4rem;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .tp-session-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--border-hover);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .tp-session-card.completed {
      border-color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(6, 36, 24, 0.85) 0%, rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.9) 100%);
    }

    .tp-session-card.skipped {
      opacity: 0.55;
      border-style: dashed;
    }

    .tp-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-card-badges {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-day-badge {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid #334155;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .tp-type-badge {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tp-type-badge.theorie {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.15);
      color: var(--status-info);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-type-badge.film {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.15);
      color: #c084fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-type-badge.technik {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.15);
      color: #facc15;
      border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-type-badge.quiz {
      background: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.15);
      color: #f472b6;
      border: 1px solid rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-type-badge.rest {
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3);
    }

    .tp-meta-pill {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    .tp-diff-pill {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: 5px;
    }

    .tp-diff-pill.rookie {
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tp-diff-pill.varsity {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .tp-diff-pill.all-pro {
      color: #c084fc;
    }

    .tp-card-status {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .tp-status-done {
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tp-status-skipped {
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .tp-status-pending {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tp-card-title {
      margin: 0 0 0.85rem 0;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    /* SAFETY ALERTS */
    .tp-safety-alert {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .tp-safety-alert.safe {
      background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.25);
      color: #a7f3d0;
    }

    .tp-safety-alert.info {
      background: rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(234, 179, 8, 0.25);
      color: #fef08a;
    }

    .tp-safety-alert.warning {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
      color: #fca5a5;
    }

    .tp-safety-icon {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 1px;
    }

    .tp-safety-alt {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: #fecaca;
    }

    /* THE 3 DIDACTICAL PILLARS BOXES */
    .tp-didactic-boxes {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
    }

    .tp-didactic-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.was {
      border-left-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.warum {
      border-left-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.erfolg {
      border-left-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tp-didactic-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
    }

    .tp-didactic-icon {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .tp-didactic-label {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.was .tp-didactic-label {
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.warum .tp-didactic-label {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .tp-didactic-box.erfolg .tp-didactic-label {
      color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tp-didactic-text {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    /* ACTIONABLE TASK CHECKLIST */
    .tp-task-checklist {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
    }

    .tp-tasks-title {
      margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--mut);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .tp-tasks-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .tp-task-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: background 0.15s ease;
    }

    .tp-task-item:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    .tp-task-item input[type="checkbox"] {
      appearance: none;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      border: 2px solid #64748b;
      border-radius: 4px;
      outline: none;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-top: 2px;
      position: relative;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .tp-task-item input[type="checkbox"]:checked {
      background: #00ff88;
      border-color: var(--g-light);
    }

    .tp-task-item input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after {
      content: '✓';
      position: absolute;
      top: -2px;
      left: 2px;
      color: #06101e;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .tp-task-label {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .tp-task-item.done .tp-task-label {
      text-decoration: line-through;
      color: #64748b;
    }

    /* TOOL LINK ROW */
    .tp-tool-link-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.85rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.1rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-btn-tool {
      background: #0284c7;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-tool:hover {
      background: #0369a1;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .tp-tool-hint {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    /* CARD CONTROLS & FOOTER */
    .tp-card-footer {
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      padding-top: 0.9rem;
    }

    .tp-card-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .tp-btn-toggle-done {
      background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.35);
      color: var(--g-light);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-toggle-done:hover {
      background: #00ff88;
      color: #06101e;
    }

    .tp-btn-toggle-done.active {
      background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15);
      border-color: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.35);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-select-day {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-skip {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.25);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-skip:hover {
      border-color: var(--ink-secondary);
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .tp-btn-note-toggle {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      margin-left: auto;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-note-toggle:hover {
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    /* NOTES DRAWER */
    .tp-notes-drawer {
      margin-top: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.75rem;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .tp-notes-label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--mut);
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .tp-notes-input-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .tp-notes-input {
      flex: 1;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      outline: none;
    }

    .tp-notes-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .tp-btn-save-note {
      background: #0284c7;
      border: none;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.55rem 1rem;
      border-radius: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* EMPTY STATE */
    .tp-empty-state {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
      border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 12px;
    }

    .tp-empty-icon {
      font-size: 2.8rem;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
    }

    .tp-empty-state h4 {
      margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .tp-empty-state p {
      margin: 0 0 1.2rem 0;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    /* FOOTER TOOLS */
    .tp-footer-tools {
      background: rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.7);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }

    .tp-footer-tools-title {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-footer-tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      gap: 0.85rem;
    }

    .tp-tool-card-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-align: left;
      min-height: 48px;
    }

    .tp-tool-card-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.1);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .tp-tool-icon {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .tp-tool-name {
      flex: 1;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .tp-tool-action {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    /* CONFIGURATION MODAL */
    .tp-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .tp-modal-container {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 820px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 30px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.2);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tp-modal-header {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .tp-modal-title {
      margin: 0 0 4px 0;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-modal-sub {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .tp-modal-close {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .tp-modal-close:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-modal-body {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .tp-modal-section {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.6rem;
    }

    .tp-form-label {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--status-info);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .tp-role-picker-groups {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.85rem;
    }

    .tp-role-group-col {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.8rem;
    }

    .tp-role-col-title {
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #64748b;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .tp-role-chips {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .tp-role-chip {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      min-height: 40px;
    }

    .tp-role-chip:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-role-chip.selected {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .tp-modal-row-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }

    .tp-toggle-buttons {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.45rem;
    }

    .tp-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.4rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      cursor: pointer;
      text-align: center;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 48px;
    }

    .tp-toggle-btn.active {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.15);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .tp-modal-select {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-goals-checklist {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.45rem;
    }

    .tp-goal-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .tp-goal-item:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
    }

    .tp-modal-footer {
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .tp-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #00f0ff);
      border: none;
      color: #06101e;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.4rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .tp-btn-primary:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* TOAST */
    .tp-toast {
      position: fixed;
      bottom: 2rem;
      right: 2rem;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid #00f0ff;
      color: #ffffff;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.3);
      z-index: 10001;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(20px);
      transition: all 0.25s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .tp-toast.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   RESPONSIVE DESIGN & MOBILE OVERHAUL COMPLIANCE
   ========================================================================== */

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .tp-metrics-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .tp-didactic-boxes {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .tp-modal-row-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      #training-plan-container {
        padding: 1rem 0.5rem 5rem 0.5rem;
      }

      .tp-hud-profile-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .tp-hud-actions {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: flex-start;
      }

      .tp-metrics-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .tp-week-tabs {
        width: 100%;
      }

      .tp-week-quick-nav {
        width: 100%;
        justify-content: space-between;
      }

      .tp-card-controls {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .tp-btn-note-toggle {
        margin-left: 0;
      }
    }



    /* ==========================================================================
   NFL FOOTBALL LAB: USER PROFILE & DATA MANAGEMENT STYLES
   Command Center Aesthetic, Glassmorphism, Micro-Animations & Responsive Mobile
   ========================================================================== */

    #view-profile {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    #view-profile.active {
      display: block;
    }

    .profile-container {
      max-width: 1350px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1.5rem 1rem 5rem 1rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    /* 1. HERO COMMAND DOSSIER */
    .prof-hero-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.95) 0%, rgba(18, 30, 56, 0.85) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .prof-hero-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 4px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00f0ff, #a855f7, #00ff88);
    }

    .prof-hero-profile-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-avatar-box {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f2744, #1e3a5f);
      border: 2px solid #00f0ff;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-avatar-icon {
      font-size: 2.5rem;
    }

    .prof-avatar-edit-btn {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      right: -4px;
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #0284c7;
      border: 2px solid #0d1527;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }

    .prof-avatar-edit-btn:hover {
      transform: scale(1.15);
    }

    .prof-hero-meta {
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .prof-tag-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-stage-badge {
      background: rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.18);
      color: var(--status-info);
      border: 1px solid rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .prof-role-badge {
      background: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.18);
      color: #c084fc;
      border: 1px solid rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.4);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }

    .prof-level-badge {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .prof-level-badge.rookie {
      background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
      color: var(--g-light);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.35);
    }

    .prof-level-badge.varsity {
      background: rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.15);
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .prof-level-badge.all-pro {
      background: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.15);
      color: #f472b6;
      border: 1px solid rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.35);
    }

    .prof-team-badge {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 9px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .prof-hero-name {
      font-size: 1.85rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .prof-hero-sub {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-hero-sub strong {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .prof-hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #0369a1);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.15rem;
      border-radius: 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-primary:hover {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0369a1, #0284c7);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .prof-btn-secondary {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-secondary:hover {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* TELEMETRY GRID */
    .prof-telemetry-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      padding-top: 1.25rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .prof-tele-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 11px;
      padding: 0.95rem 1.1rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .prof-tele-label {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #64748b;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .prof-tele-val-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .prof-tele-val {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-tele-sub {
      font-size: 0.76rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .prof-tele-bar {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 3px;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: 0.35rem;
    }

    .prof-tele-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00f0ff, #38bdf8);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .prof-tele-bar-fill.green {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00ff88, #10b981);
    }

    .prof-tele-bar-fill.purple {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #a855f7, #c084fc);
    }

    .prof-tele-bar-fill.amber {
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffb700, #f59e0b);
    }

    /* SECTION CARD */
    .prof-section-card {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(13, 21, 39, 0.9) 0%, rgba(18, 30, 56, 0.75) 100%);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
      backdrop-filter: none;
    }

    .prof-section-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      margin-bottom: 1.35rem;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-section-title {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-section-sub {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-btn-link {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .prof-btn-link:hover {
      color: var(--status-info);
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    /* PATHS GRID */
    .prof-paths-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .prof-path-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 13px;
      padding: 1.25rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .prof-path-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .prof-path-icon {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-path-name {
      margin: 0 0 0.25rem 0;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-path-meta {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      display: block;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .prof-path-stats {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .prof-path-num-row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: baseline;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
    }

    .prof-path-num-row .prof-num {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .prof-path-num-row .prof-num small {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: #64748b;
    }

    .prof-path-num-row .prof-pct {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--status-info);
    }

    .prof-btn-action {
      width: 100%;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--status-info);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      padding: 0.6rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-action:hover {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.12);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* SECONDARY TELEMETRY CARDS */
    .prof-secondary-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1.1rem;
    }

    .prof-sec-card {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1.15rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .prof-sec-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
    }

    .prof-sec-icon {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .prof-sec-header h4 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.96rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-sec-body {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .prof-sec-body strong {
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .prof-sec-btn {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.55rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      text-align: center;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-sec-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
    }

    /* 3. SETTINGS & FORM */
    .prof-form-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 1.75rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }

    .prof-form-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.15rem;
    }

    .prof-form-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.45rem;
    }

    .prof-form-label {
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--status-info);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .prof-input,
    .prof-select {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .prof-input:focus,
    .prof-select:focus {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .prof-toggle-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .prof-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.5rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .prof-toggle-btn:hover {
      background: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.9);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-toggle-btn.active {
      background: rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.18);
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .prof-goals-cloud {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
    }

    .prof-goal-pill {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
    }

    .prof-goal-rm {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .prof-goal-rm:hover {
      color: #f87171;
    }

    .prof-add-goal-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .prof-btn-small {
      background: #0284c7;
      border: none;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-form-footer {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding-top: 1rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .prof-btn-save {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0284c7, #00f0ff);
      border: none;
      color: #06101e;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.6rem;
      border-radius: 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-save:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* 4. DATA MANAGEMENT & RESETS */
    .prof-backup-card {
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.65);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 13px;
      padding: 1.35rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-backup-info {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .prof-backup-icon {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-backup-title {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-backup-desc {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.86rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-backup-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-btn-export {
      background: #0284c7;
      border: 1px solid var(--border-focus);
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.15rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-export:hover {
      background: #0369a1;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .prof-btn-import {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-import:hover {
      border-color: var(--status-info);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-sub-heading {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-sub-desc {
      margin: 0 0 1.1rem 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    /* GRANULAR RESETS GRID */
    .prof-granular-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
    }

    .prof-gran-box {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 1.15rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .prof-gran-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
    }

    .prof-gran-icon {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .prof-gran-header h4 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.94rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-gran-text {
      margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      color: var(--mut);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-btn-gran {
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.35);
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      padding: 0.55rem 0.85rem;
      border-radius: 7px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-gran:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 183, 0, 0.12);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* DANGER ZONE */
    .prof-danger-zone {
      background: var(--status-danger-subtle);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35);
      border-radius: 14px;
      padding: 1.4rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .prof-danger-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 1rem;
      flex: 1;
      min-width: 280px;
    }

    .prof-danger-icon {
      font-size: 2.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-danger-title {
      margin: 0 0 0.35rem 0;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fca5a5;
    }

    .prof-danger-desc {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-btn-danger-large {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid #ef4444;
      color: #fca5a5;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.35rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-danger-large:hover {
      background: #ef4444;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* MODAL OVERLAY & CONTAINER */
    .prof-modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: none;
      z-index: 10000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 1rem;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .prof-modal-container {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 640px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .prof-modal-container.danger {
      border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.5);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      ,
      0 0 30px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
    }

    .prof-modal-header {
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .prof-modal-header.danger {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08);
      border-bottom-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
    }

    .prof-modal-header-text {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .prof-modal-icon {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-modal-title {
      margin: 0 0 3px 0;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-modal-sub {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--mut);
    }

    .prof-modal-close {
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      color: var(--mut);
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .prof-modal-close:hover {
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-modal-body {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
    }

    .prof-danger-breakdown p {
      margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
      color: var(--ink);
      font-size: 0.88rem;
    }

    .prof-danger-list {
      margin: 0;
      padding-left: 1.2rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: var(--ink-secondary);
    }

    .prof-danger-list strong {
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .prof-danger-notice {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.35);
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 0.65rem;
    }

    .prof-notice-icon {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .prof-danger-notice p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      color: #fca5a5;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .prof-confirm-form {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      padding: 1rem;
