    }

    .prof-confirm-label {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    .prof-confirm-input {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 2px solid #ef4444;
      border-radius: 7px;
      padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      outline: none;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .prof-modal-footer {
      padding: 1.15rem 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    .prof-btn-danger {
      background: #ef4444;
      border: none;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      padding: 0.65rem 1.35rem;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      min-height: 44px;
    }

    .prof-btn-danger:disabled {
      opacity: 0.35;
      cursor: not-allowed;
      filter: grayscale(1);
    }

    .prof-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
   RESPONSIVE LAYOUT (< 1024px & < 768px)
   ========================================================================== */

    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .prof-telemetry-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .prof-paths-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .prof-secondary-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .prof-form-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .prof-granular-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .profile-container {
        padding: 1rem 0.5rem 5.5rem 0.5rem;
      }

      .prof-hero-profile-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .prof-hero-actions {
        width: 100%;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .prof-telemetry-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .prof-backup-card {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .prof-backup-btns {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }

      .prof-danger-zone {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: stretch;
      }
    }
  

/* ==========================================================================
   NFL FOOTBALL LAB: IMMERSIVE PORTAL ENTRY STYLES
   Minimalist, Atmospheric, Editorial, High-Contrast & Accessible
   ========================================================================== */

/* State when portal is active */
body.portal-active {
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

body.portal-active header,
body.portal-active .app-content-container,
body.portal-active .mobile-bottom-nav {
  display: none !important;
}

.portal-screen {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 99999;
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--ink);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: env(safe-area-inset-top, 1.25rem) env(safe-area-inset-right, 1.5rem) env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 1.25rem) env(safe-area-inset-left, 1.5rem);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
  transition: opacity 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.3s ease;
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.portal-screen.portal-leaving {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(1.02);
  filter: blur(2px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .portal-screen {
    transition: none !important;
  }
}

/* Whisper Gridiron Background Canvas */
.portal-gridiron-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.portal-field-svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  color: var(--ink);
  opacity: 0.045;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

:root[data-theme="light"] .portal-field-svg {
  opacity: 0.035;
}

.portal-vignette {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 40%, var(--bg) 95%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Portal Top Bar */
.portal-top-bar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.75rem 0;
}

.portal-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
}

.portal-brand-badge {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--accent);
}

.portal-brand-name {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.portal-top-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.portal-theme-btn {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--ink);
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.portal-theme-btn:hover {
  background: var(--bg-card-hover);
  border-color: var(--border-hover);
}

.portal-bypass-link {
  background: transparent;
  border: none;
  color: var(--mut);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
}

.portal-bypass-link:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
}

/* Central Stage */
.portal-stage {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex: 1;
  padding: 2.5rem 1rem;
}

.portal-stage-content {
  max-width: 760px;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}

.portal-eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.85rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.portal-status-dot {
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--g);
}

.portal-eyebrow-text {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--mut);
}

.portal-title {
  margin: 0 0 1.15rem 0;
  font-size: 3.1rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  line-height: 1.08;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.portal-lead {
  margin: 0 0 2.5rem 0;
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--ink-secondary);
  max-width: 640px;
}

/* Pillars Row */
.portal-pillars-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 2.75rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.portal-pillar-item {
  background: var(--bg-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.1rem 1.15rem;
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  align-items: flex-start;
  transition: border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.portal-pillar-item:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-hover);
}

.portal-pillar-num {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
  margin-top: 1px;
}

.portal-pillar-body {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.2rem;
}

.portal-pillar-title {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.portal-pillar-desc {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--mut);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Centerpiece Enter Button */
.portal-action-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  width: 100%;
}

.portal-enter-btn {
  background: var(--g);
  border: 1px solid var(--g-light);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  padding: 0.95rem 2.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  min-height: 52px;
  outline: none;
}

.portal-enter-btn:hover {
  background: var(--g-light);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.portal-enter-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(0) scale(0.99);
}

.portal-enter-btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.portal-btn-arrow {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  transition: transform 0.18s ease;
}

.portal-enter-btn:hover .portal-btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(3px);
}

.portal-sub-action {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--mut);
}

/* Bottom Bar */
.portal-bottom-bar {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.75rem 0;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--mut);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
}

/* Portal Shortcut Button in Navigation */
.portal-nav-shortcut {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--mut);
  padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.15s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.portal-nav-shortcut:hover {
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--border-hover);
  background: var(--bg-subtle);
}

/* Responsive adjustments */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .portal-title {
    font-size: 2.1rem;
  }
  .portal-lead {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
  }
  .portal-pillars-row {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.65rem;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
  }
  .portal-enter-btn {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 340px;
  }
  .portal-bottom-bar {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.35rem;
    text-align: center;
  }
}

</style>
</head>

<body>

  <!-- ==================== IMMERSIVE PORTAL ENTRY SCREEN ==================== -->
<div id="portal-entry-screen" class="portal-screen" role="region" aria-label="NFL Football Lab Portal">
  <!-- Minimalist Background Architectural Gridiron -->
  <div class="portal-gridiron-canvas" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg class="portal-field-svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 600" preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <defs>
        <pattern id="portal-yard-grid" width="60" height="600" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="600" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 6" opacity="0.3"/>
          <line x1="30" y1="180" x2="30" y2="200" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
          <line x1="30" y1="400" x2="30" y2="420" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5"/>
        </pattern>
      </defs>
      <!-- Yard Grid -->
      <rect x="100" y="0" width="1000" height="600" fill="url(#portal-yard-grid)"/>
      <!-- Endzones & Sidelines -->
      <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="100" y2="600" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
      <line x1="1100" y1="0" x2="1100" y2="600" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>
      <!-- 50 Yard Midfield Line -->
      <line x1="600" y1="0" x2="600" y2="600" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.8"/>
      <!-- Midfield Diamond Marker -->
      <circle cx="600" cy="300" r="45" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
      <circle cx="600" cy="300" r="4" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.8"/>
      <!-- Yard Numbers Outline -->
      <text x="590" y="80" font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.4" text-anchor="middle">5 0</text>
      <text x="590" y="550" font-family="ui-monospace, monospace" font-size="28" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.4" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(180 590 540)">5 0</text>
    </svg>
    <div class="portal-vignette"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- Top Bar -->
  <header class="portal-top-bar">
    <div class="portal-brand">
      <div class="portal-brand-badge" aria-hidden="true">
        <svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <ellipse cx="12" cy="12" rx="10" ry="6" transform="rotate(-45 12 12)"/>
          <line x1="8" y1="12" x2="16" y2="12" transform="rotate(-45 12 12)"/>
          <line x1="10" y1="10" x2="10" y2="14" transform="rotate(-45 12 12)"/>
          <line x1="12" y1="10" x2="12" y2="14" transform="rotate(-45 12 12)"/>
          <line x1="14" y1="10" x2="14" y2="14" transform="rotate(-45 12 12)"/>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <span class="portal-brand-name">NFL FOOTBALL LAB</span>
    </div>

    <div class="portal-top-actions">
      <button class="portal-theme-btn" onclick="toggleTheme()" title="Theme wechseln" aria-label="Theme wechseln">
        <svg class="theme-icon-dark" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path></svg>
        <svg class="theme-icon-light" width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"></circle><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"></line><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"></line><line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"></line><line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"></line><line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"></line><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"></line><line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"></line><line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"></line></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="portal-bypass-link" onclick="PortalEngine.enter(false)" title="Ohne Animation direkt zum Lab">
        Direkt zum Dashboard →
      </button>
    </div>
  </header>

  <!-- Central Stage -->
  <main class="portal-stage">
    <div class="portal-stage-content">
      <div class="portal-eyebrow">
        <span class="portal-status-dot"></span>
        <span class="portal-eyebrow-text">TACTICAL INTELLIGENCE & LEARNING SUITE</span>
      </div>

      <h1 class="portal-title">
        Das Spiel hinter dem Spiel.
      </h1>

      <p class="portal-lead">
        Vom ersten Down bis zum All-22 Film Room. Verstehe Taktik, Coverages, Playbook-Architektur und Strategie auf professionellem NFL-Niveau.
      </p>

      <!-- 3 Key Value Pillars (Clean, typographic, minimal) -->
      <div class="portal-pillars-row">
        <div class="portal-pillar-item">
          <span class="portal-pillar-num">01</span>
          <div class="portal-pillar-body">
            <span class="portal-pillar-title">Drei Lernpfade</span>
            <span class="portal-pillar-desc">Grundlagen • Spielertechnik • Coachausbildung</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        </button>

        </button>
      </div>

      <div id="lab-field-container">
        <div class="lab-container">

                  <button id="btn-reset" class="btn-subtle" title="Zurücksetzen" aria-label="Zurücksetzen">🔄</button>
                </div>

                    <option value="0.5">0.5x (Slow-Mo)</option>
                    <option value="1.0" selected>1.0x (Normal)</option>

            <div class="clock-badge-row">
              <span class="clock-main-badge">⏱️ NFL CLOCK COMMAND CENTER</span>
              <span class="clock-sub-badge">Game Clock & Play Clock Dual Engine</span>
              <span class="clock-nfl-rule-badge">Official NFL Rulebook Timing</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="clock-headline">Interaktiver NFL Game-Clock- & Play-Clock-Simulator</h2>
            <p class="clock-intro">
              Erlebe die feinen Unterschiede des echten NFL-Uhrenregelwerks in Echtzeit. Game Clock und Play Clock sind
              technisch getrennte Zustände.
              Löse typische Football-Events aus, teste das Verhalten bei Incompletions, Out-of-Bounds, 1st Downs,
              Timeouts und Spikes oder meistere geführte End-of-Game-Szenarien.
            </p>
          </div>

          <!-- Guided Scenarios Selector Carousel -->
          <div class="clock-scenario-strip">
            <div class="clock-scen-pills-label">Geführte Szenarien:</div>
            <div class="clock-scen-pills" id="clock-scen-pills-container">
              <!-- Populated by JS: Sandbox + 6 guided scenarios -->
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- MAIN CLOCK STAGE: HUD & CONTROLS -->
        <div class="clock-stage-grid">

          <!-- LEFT / TOP COLUMN: DUAL DIGITAL CLOCKS & TELEMETRY HUD -->
          <div class="clock-telemetry-column">

            <!-- Giant Dual Broadcast Scoreboard HUD -->
            <div class="clock-hud-card">

              <!-- Clocks Section: Game Clock & Play Clock -->
              <div class="clock-display-cluster">

                <!-- Game Clock Box -->
                <div class="clock-box game-clock-box" id="hud-game-clock-box">
                  <div class="clock-box-header">
                    <span class="clock-label">GAME CLOCK</span>
                    <span class="clock-status-pill stopped" id="hud-gc-status-pill">STOPPT (BIS SNAP)</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="clock-digits-display" id="hud-gc-digits">02:00.0</div>
                  <div class="clock-box-sub" id="hud-gc-restart-info">Startet beim nächsten Snap</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Play Clock Box -->
                <div class="clock-box play-clock-box" id="hud-play-clock-box">
                  <div class="clock-box-header">
                    <span class="clock-label">PLAY CLOCK</span>
                    <span class="clock-status-pill" id="hud-pc-status-pill">40 SEK</span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="clock-digits-display play-digits" id="hud-pc-digits">40</div>
                  <div class="clock-box-sub" id="hud-pc-type-info">Standard nach Tackle im Feld</div>
                </div>

              </div>

              <!-- Game Telemetry Grid (Score, Qtr, Down & Distance, Spot, Timeouts) -->
              <div class="clock-telemetry-subgrid">

                <!-- Score & Matchup -->
                <div class="clock-tel-item score-item">
                  <span class="tel-label">SPIELSTAND</span>
                  <div class="tel-score-row">
                    <span class="team-tag off-tag" id="hud-team-off">OFF (HOME)</span>
                    <span class="score-val" id="hud-score-off">21</span>
                    <span class="score-sep">:</span>
                    <span class="score-val" id="hud-score-def">24</span>
                    <span class="team-tag def-tag" id="hud-team-def">DEF (AWAY)</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Quarter & 2-Minute Warning -->
                <div class="clock-tel-item">
                  <span class="tel-label">QUARTER</span>
                  <div class="tel-val-highlight" id="hud-quarter-val">Q4</div>
                  <span class="tel-sub" id="hud-2min-flag">2-Minuten-Marke aktiv</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Down & Distance -->
                <div class="clock-tel-item">
                  <span class="tel-label">DOWN & DISTANCE</span>
                  <div class="tel-val-gold" id="hud-down-distance-val">2nd & 6</div>
                  <span class="tel-sub" id="hud-spot-val">Ball an OPP 35</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Interactive Timeouts -->
                <div class="clock-tel-item timeouts-item">
                  <div class="timeout-team-row">
                    <span class="to-team-name">Offense TO:</span>
                    <div class="to-dots" id="hud-to-dots-off">
                      <span class="to-dot active" onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('off')"></span>
                      <span class="to-dot active" onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('off')"></span>
                      <span class="to-dot inactive"></span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="timeout-team-row">
                    <span class="to-team-name">Defense TO:</span>
                    <div class="to-dots" id="hud-to-dots-def">
                      <span class="to-dot active" onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('def')"></span>
                      <span class="to-dot active" onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('def')"></span>
                      <span class="to-dot active" onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('def')"></span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>

              <!-- Ticker & Playback Control Bar -->
              <div class="clock-ticker-control-bar">
                <div class="ticker-btn-group">
                  <button class="ticker-btn play-btn" id="btn-clock-toggle-play" onclick="clockEngine.toggleRunning()">
                    ▶ Game Clock starten
                  </button>
                  <button class="ticker-btn snap-btn" id="btn-clock-snap" onclick="clockEngine.snapBall()"
                    title="Snappt den Ball und startet die Uhr bei Stopps">
                    ⚡ Ball Snappen (Snap)
                  </button>
                  <button class="ticker-btn step-btn" onclick="clockEngine.tickStep(1)"
                    title="+1 Sekunde Spielzeit ablaufen lassen">
                    ⏱ +1s
                  </button>
                  <button class="ticker-btn step-btn" onclick="clockEngine.tickStep(5)"
                    title="+5 Sekunden Spielzeit ablaufen lassen">
                    ⏱ +5s
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div class="ticker-options-group">
                  <span class="speed-label">Tempo:</span>
                  <button class="speed-btn active" id="btn-speed-1" onclick="clockEngine.setSpeed(1)">1x</button>
                  <button class="speed-btn" id="btn-speed-2" onclick="clockEngine.setSpeed(2)">2x</button>
                  <button class="speed-btn" id="btn-speed-5" onclick="clockEngine.setSpeed(5)">5x</button>
                  <button class="ticker-btn reset-btn" onclick="clockEngine.resetToDefaults()" title="Zurücksetzen">
                    ⏮ Reset
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <!-- EVENT TRIGGER BOARD (Typische Football-Events auslösen) -->
            <div class="clock-events-board">
              <div class="events-board-header">
                <h3>Football-Event auslösen & Clock-Auswirkung beobachten</h3>
                <span class="events-hint">Klicke ein Event, um die NFL-Timing-Regeln anzuwenden:</span>
              </div>

              <div class="events-grid" id="clock-events-grid">
                <!-- Populated by JS from NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS -->
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

          <!-- RIGHT / BOTTOM COLUMN: RULE RATIONALE & SCENARIO DESK -->
          <div class="clock-desk-column">

            <!-- Live NFL Rulebook Rationale Console -->
            <div class="clock-rationale-card" id="clock-rationale-card">
              <div class="rationale-card-head">

              </div>
              <h3 class="rationale-title" id="clock-rule-title">Wähle ein Event oder starte die Uhr...</h3>

              <div class="rationale-body" id="clock-rule-body">
                <p>Triff ein Ereignis auf der linken Seite (z. B. Incomplete Pass, Out of Bounds, Spike, First Down), um

              </div>

              <div class="rationale-metrics" id="clock-rule-metrics" style="display: none;">
                <div class="rule-metric-box">
                  <span class="metric-k">Game Clock Status:</span>
                  <span class="metric-v" id="clock-metric-gc">Läuft weiter</span>
                </div>
                <div class="rule-metric-box">
                  <span class="metric-k">Wiederaufnahme:</span>
                  <span class="metric-v" id="clock-metric-restart">Beim Snap</span>
                </div>
                <div class="rule-metric-box">
                  <span class="metric-k">Play Clock:</span>
                  <span class="metric-v" id="clock-metric-pc">40 Sekunden</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Active Scenario Card (If in Guided Mode) -->
            <div class="clock-scenario-card" id="clock-scenario-detail-card">
              <div class="scenario-card-head">
                <span class="scen-badge" id="scen-active-badge">Freier Modus (Sandbox)</span>
                <h4 class="scen-active-title" id="scen-active-title">Freie Uhren-Simulation</h4>
              </div>
              <p class="scen-active-desc" id="scen-active-desc">

              <div class="scen-task-box" id="scen-active-task-box" style="display: none;">
                <span class="task-title">🎯 Taktische Aufgabe:</span>
                <p id="scen-active-task">Aufgabe...</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Chronological Drive Event History Log -->
            <div class="clock-log-card">
              <div class="log-card-header">
                <h4>Ereignis- & Timing-Historie</h4>
                <button class="btn-subtle" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 8px;"
                  onclick="clockEngine.clearEventLog()">Log leeren</button>
              </div>
              <div class="clock-log-list" id="clock-event-log-list">
                <div class="log-empty-state">Noch keine Events im aktuellen Drive ausgelöst.</div>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>

                    <option value="empty_10">Empty 10 Spread (5 WR)</option>

                    <option value="custom_blank">Leeres Feld (Freie Aufstellung)</option>

                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="slant" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('slant')">

                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="out" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('out')">

                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="in" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('in')">

                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="dig" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('dig')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">📐</span> Dig (12y)
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="post" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('post')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">🏹</span> Post
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="corner" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('corner')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">🚩</span> Corner
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="curl" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('curl')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">↩️</span> Curl / Hitch
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="comeback" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('comeback')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">↪️</span> Comeback
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="flat" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('flat')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">⚡</span> Flat
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="seam" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('seam')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">🎯</span> Seam
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-route-btn" data-route="wheel" onclick="assignRouteToSelected('wheel')">
                      <span class="pb-route-icon">🔄</span> Wheel

                  <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px;"
                      onclick="removeRouteFromSelected()">
                      Route entfernen
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Run Concepts Selector (shown for Backfield or applicable players) -->
                <div id="pb-insp-run-section"

                  <span
                    style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--mut); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;">
                    Laufkonzept (Run Path)
                  </span>
                  <div class="pb-concepts-cluster">
                    <button class="pb-concept-btn" data-run="inside_run"
                      onclick="assignRunConceptToSelected('inside_run')">
                      <span>⚡ Inside Run (A/B-Gap Zone)</span>
                      <span style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7;">Dive / Duo</span>
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-concept-btn" data-run="outside_run"
                      onclick="assignRunConceptToSelected('outside_run')">
                      <span>🏃 Outside Run (Stretch / Sweep)</span>
                      <span style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7;">Perimeter</span>
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-concept-btn" data-run="cutback" onclick="assignRunConceptToSelected('cutback')">
                      <span>✂️ Zone Cutback</span>
                      <span style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7;">Backside Crease</span>
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-concept-btn" data-run="counter" onclick="assignRunConceptToSelected('counter')">
                      <span>🔄 Counter (Misdirection & Pull)</span>
                      <span style="font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.7;">GT Counter</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px;"

                    </button>

                <!-- Pre-Snap Motion Selector -->
                <div id="pb-insp-motion-section"

                  <span
                    style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--mut); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;">
                    Pre-Snap Motion
                  </span>
                  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px;">
                    <button class="pb-motion-btn" data-motion="jet" onclick="assignMotionToSelected('jet')">

                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-motion-btn" data-motion="orbit" onclick="assignMotionToSelected('orbit')">
                      🪐 Orbit Motion
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-motion-btn" data-motion="across" onclick="assignMotionToSelected('across')">

                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px;"

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Blocking Assignment Selector (for OL & Blockers) -->
                <div id="pb-insp-blocking-section"

                  <span
                    style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--mut); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;">

                  </span>
                  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 4px;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('pass_pro')">
                      🛡️ Pass Pro Drop
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('slide_left')">
                      ⬅️ Slide Left
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('slide_right')">
                      ➡️ Slide Right
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('drive_block')">
                      🚜 Drive Block
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('reach_block')">
                      📐 Reach Block
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('combo_climb')">
                      🪜 Combo Climb
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('kickout_pull')">
                      💥 Kickout Pull
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignBlockingToSelected('lead_pull')">
                      🏃 Lead Pull
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div style="margin-top: 6px; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px;"
                      onclick="removeBlockingFromSelected()">
                      Block entfernen
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

              </div>

              <!-- Roster Quick Picker -->
              <div style="margin-top: 10px;">
                <span

                </span>
                <div id="pb-offense-roster-list" class="pb-roster-list">
                  <!-- Dynamically populated -->
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <!-- TAB 2: DEFENSE PALETTE -->
            <div id="pb-palette-defense" class="pb-palette-content" style="display: none;">

              <!-- Defense Front Preset -->
              <div class="pb-inspector-box" style="margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <label style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--mut); text-transform: uppercase;">

                </label>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px;">
                  <select id="pb-sel-defense" class="lab-select" style="flex: 1; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 8px;">
                    <option value="cover_3">Cover 3 Sky (Single-High 3-Deep)</option>
                    <option value="cover_1">Cover 1 Man Free (Man Coverage)</option>
                    <option value="cover_2">Cover 2 Tampa (2-High Zone)</option>
                    <option value="cover_4">Cover 4 Quarters (4-Deep Zone)</option>
                    <option value="cover_6">Cover 6 Split Field (Quarter-Quarter-Half)</option>
                    <option value="cover_0">Cover 0 Blitz (All-Out Man)</option>
                    <option value="fire_zone_3">Fire Zone 3 (5-Man Blitz)</option>
                    <option value="none">Keine Defense (Nur Offense Chalkboard)</option>
                  </select>
                  <button id="pb-btn-apply-defense" class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 6px 10px;">

                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Selected Defender Inspector -->
              <div id="pb-defense-inspector" class="pb-inspector-box">
                <div class="pb-inspector-top">
                  <div class="pb-player-badge-lg">
                    <div class="pb-jersey-circle defense" id="pb-insp-def-jersey">FS</div>
                    <div class="pb-player-details">
                      <span class="pb-player-id-title" id="pb-insp-def-name">Free Safety</span>
                      <span class="pb-player-coord" id="pb-insp-def-coord">Position: x=520, y=300</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span id="pb-insp-def-role-badge" class="pb-tag-pill"
                    style="background: rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.2); color: #fda4af; border: 1px solid rgba(225, 29, 72, 0.4);">
                    ZONE DEEP
                  </span>
                </div>

                <!-- Defensive Assignment Buttons -->
                <div style="margin-top: 8px;">
                  <span
                    style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--mut); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;">

                  </span>
                  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 4px;">
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('deep_third')">
                      🌐 Deep 1/3
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('deep_half')">
                      🌐 Deep 1/2
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('deep_quarter')">
                      🌐 Deep 1/4
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('man')">
                      🔒 Man Coverage
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('curl_flat')">
                      ☁️ Curl / Flat
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('hook_curl')">
                      🪝 Hook / Curl
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('robber')">
                      🎯 Middle Robber
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('spy')">
                      👁️ QB Spy
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn danger" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('pass_rush')">
                      🔥 Pass Rush
                    </button>
                    <button class="pb-action-btn danger" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 6px;"
                      onclick="assignDefAssignmentToSelected('blitz')">

                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Defensive Roster List -->
              <div style="margin-top: 10px;">

                </span>
                <div id="pb-defense-roster-list" class="pb-roster-list">

                </div>
              </div>

            </div>

            <!-- TAB 3: MEINE PLAYS (LIBRARY) -->
            <div id="pb-palette-myplays" class="pb-palette-content" style="display: none;">
              <div style="display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 10px;">
                <input type="text" id="pb-myplays-search" class="pb-search-input" placeholder="Plays filtern..."
                  style="flex: 1; font-size: 12px; padding: 6px 10px;" oninput="filterMyPlays(this.value)">
              </div>
              <div id="pb-myplays-list"
                style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-height: 480px; overflow-y: auto;">
                <!-- Dynamically populated saved plays -->
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

          <!-- CENTER COLUMN: Interactive Football Field & Playback HUD -->
          <div class="pb-panel" style="gap: 12px;">

            <!-- Field Header Bar with Inline Editable Title & Badges -->
            <div class="pb-field-header-row">
              <input type="text" id="pb-play-title-input" class="pb-play-name-input" value="Custom Concept"
                placeholder="Play Name eingeben..." onchange="onPlayTitleChange(this.value)">

              <div class="pb-tags-row">
                <span id="pb-pill-type" class="pb-tag-pill pass">PASS PLAY</span>
                <span id="pb-pill-personnel" class="pb-tag-pill personnel">11 PERSONNEL</span>
                <span id="pb-pill-formation" class="pb-tag-pill formation">SHOTGUN 11</span>
                <span id="pb-pill-concept" class="pb-tag-pill"
                  style="background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: var(--y); border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4);">
                  DAGGER CONCEPT
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- The SVG Field Stage -->
            <div class="pb-field-stage" id="pb-field-stage-wrapper">
              <div class="pb-touch-helper-banner" id="pb-touch-helper-banner" style="display: none;"></div>
              <svg id="builder-field-svg" class="pb-field-svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 600"
                preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" style="touch-action: none;"></svg>
              <div class="pb-touch-nudge-pad" id="pb-touch-nudge-pad" role="group" aria-label="Touch Feinausrichtung">
                <button class="pb-nudge-btn" onclick="nudgeBuilderPlayer(0, -10)" title="1 Yard nach oben">⬆️
                  Hoch</button>
                <button class="pb-nudge-btn" onclick="nudgeBuilderPlayer(0, 10)" title="1 Yard nach unten">⬇️
                  Runter</button>
                <button class="pb-nudge-btn" onclick="nudgeBuilderPlayer(-10, 0)" title="1 Yard nach links">⬅️
                  Links</button>
                <button class="pb-nudge-btn" onclick="nudgeBuilderPlayer(10, 0)" title="1 Yard nach rechts">➡️
                  Rechts</button>
                <button class="pb-nudge-btn" onclick="nudgeBuilderPlayerToLos()" title="An Line of Scrimmage ausrichten"
                  style="font-size: 11.5px; flex: 1 1 30%;">📍 An LOS</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Playback Controls & Scrubber Telemetry HUD -->
            <div class="pb-telemetry-bar">
              <div class="pb-playback-controls">
                <span id="pb-builder-phase-badge" class="pb-phase-hud">🏈 PRE-SNAP</span>
                <button id="pbuilder-btn-play" class="pb-action-btn primary" style="padding: 6px 12px;">
                  ▶ Play
                </button>
                <button id="pbuilder-btn-pause" class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 6px 10px;">
                  ⏸
                </button>
                <button id="pbuilder-btn-step-back" class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 6px 9px;"
                  title="Schritt rückwärts (0.05s)">
                  ◀
                </button>
                <button id="pbuilder-btn-step-fwd" class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 6px 9px;"
                  title="Schritt vorwärts (0.05s)">
                  ▶
                </button>
                <button id="pbuilder-btn-reset" class="pb-action-btn" style="padding: 6px 10px;"
                  title="Auf Pre-Snap zurücksetzen">
                  ⏪ Reset
                </button>
              </div>

              <div class="pb-slider-box">
                <input type="range" id="pb-builder-scrubber" class="timeline-slider" min="0" max="100" value="0">
                <span class="pb-time-text" id="pb-builder-time-readout">0.0s / 3.2s</span>
              </div>

              <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;">
                <select id="pbuilder-sel-speed" class="lab-select" style="font-size: 11.5px; padding: 5px 8px;">
                  <option value="0.25">0.25x Speed</option>
                  <option value="0.5">0.5x Speed</option>
                  <option value="0.75">0.75x Speed</option>
                  <option value="1.0" selected>1.0x Realtime</option>
                  <option value="1.5">1.5x Fast</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Display Layer Toggles Bar -->
            <div class="pb-toggle-flags">
              <span style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase;">
                Ebenen:
              </span>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-routes" checked onchange="toggleBuilderLayer('routes', this.checked)">
                Routen (Gelb)
              </label>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-blocking" checked
                  onchange="toggleBuilderLayer('blocking', this.checked)">
                Blocking (Grün)
              </label>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-motion" checked onchange="toggleBuilderLayer('motion', this.checked)">
                Motion (Lila)
              </label>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-zones" checked onchange="toggleBuilderLayer('zones', this.checked)">
                Defense Zonen (Cyan)
              </label>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-rush" checked onchange="toggleBuilderLayer('rush', this.checked)">
                Pass Rush (Rot)
              </label>
              <label>
                <input type="checkbox" id="pb-chk-grid-snap" checked>
                Raster-Snap
              </label>
            </div>

          </div>

          <!-- RIGHT COLUMN: Tactical Analysis & Coaching Dossier -->
          <div class="pb-panel">

            <div class="pb-panel-header">
              <h2 class="pb-panel-title">
                <span>🧠</span> Taktische Analyse & Dossier
              </h2>
              <button class="pb-action-btn" style="font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 8px;"
                onclick="runPlayBuilderAnalysis()">
                🔄 Aktualisieren
              </button>
            </div>

            <div class="pb-analysis-dossier" id="pb-analysis-content">

              <!-- Metric Card: Formation & Personnel Breakdown -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title">
                  <span>📐</span> Formation & Personnel
                </div>
                <div class="pb-metric-value" id="pb-an-formation-name">
                  Shotgun 11 (Trips Right)
                </div>
                <div class="pb-metric-desc" id="pb-an-personnel-desc">
                  11 Personnel (1 Running Back, 1 Tight End, 3 Wide Receiver).
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Metric Card: Play Type & Primary Concept -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title">
                  <span>🎯</span> Spielzugtyp & Primärkonzept
                </div>
                <div class="pb-metric-value" id="pb-an-concept-name">
                  Dagger Concept
                </div>
                <div class="pb-metric-desc" id="pb-an-concept-desc">
                  Klassisches High-Low-Konzept: Vertikaler Seam-Clearout bindet den Free Safety, während der 15-Yard Dig
                  dahinter frei wird.
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Metric Card: Defensive Coverage Matchup Matrix -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title">
                  <span>🛡️</span> Coverage Matchup Matrix (Effektivität)
                </div>
                <div class="pb-coverage-matrix" id="pb-an-coverage-matrix">
                  <!-- Dynamically populated coverage bars -->
                </div>
              </div>

              <!-- Callout: Strengths -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title" style="color: #4ade80;">
                  <span>✅</span> Taktische Stärken (Strengths)
                </div>
                <ul class="pb-callout-list" id="pb-an-strengths-list">
                  <!-- Dynamically populated -->
                </ul>
              </div>

              <!-- Callout: Weaknesses & Protection Risks -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title" style="color: #f87171;">
                  <span>⚠️</span> Risiken & Schwachstellen (Risks)
                </div>
                <ul class="pb-callout-list" id="pb-an-weaknesses-list">
                  <!-- Dynamically populated -->
                </ul>
              </div>

              <!-- Metric Card: Coaching Points & QB Progression -->
              <div class="pb-metric-card">
                <div class="pb-metric-title">
                  <span>📋</span> Coaching Points & Progression
                </div>
                <div class="pb-metric-desc" id="pb-an-progression-desc" style="white-space: pre-line;">

                  3. Primary: Dig-Route hinter den abgesunkenen Linebackern.
                  4. Checkdown: RB Swing / Flat als sichere Not-Option.

                  </p>

                    style="font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mut); font-weight: 800;">Analytische

                    <marker id="arrow-link-active" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="24" refY="5" markerWidth="7"

                      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"></feGaussianBlur>
                      <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over"></feComposite>
                    </filter>

  <script>
    /* THEME-FLICKER-PREVENTION */
    (function () {
      try {
        let pref = 'system';
        const prof = localStorage.getItem('nfl_user_profile_v1');
        if (prof) {
          try {
            const p = JSON.parse(prof);
            if (p && p.themePreference) pref = p.themePreference;
          } catch (e) { }
        }
        if (pref === 'system') {
          const rawTheme = localStorage.getItem('nfl_theme');
          if (rawTheme === 'dark' || rawTheme === 'light') pref = rawTheme;
        }
        let theme = 'dark';
        if (pref === 'dark') {
          theme = 'dark';
        } else if (pref === 'light') {
          theme = 'light';
        } else {
          theme = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) ? 'dark' : 'light';
        }
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme;
          if (document.documentElement.style) document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = theme;
        }
      } catch (e) { }
    })();

    // Original Data Extracted
    const L = [{
      t: "Grundlagen & Downs", lv: 1, h: `<p>Ziel: mehr Punkte als der Gegner nach 4 Quartern à 15 Minuten. Die [[Offense]] hat eine <b>Possession</b> (Ballbesitz). Eine Folge von Plays heißt <b>Drive</b>.</p>
<h2>Das Down-System</h2><p>Die Offense hat <b>4 Versuche (Downs)</b>, um <b>10 Yards</b> zu überbrücken. Schafft sie das, gibt es ein <b>[[First Down]]</b> (neue Serie, wieder 1st & 10). "3rd & 2" = dritter Versuch, noch 2 Yards bis zum First Down.</p>
<table><tr><th>Situation</th><th>Folge</th></tr><tr><td>10 Yards geschafft</td><td>Neuer 1st & 10</td></tr><tr><td>Nach 4th Down nicht geschafft</td><td>Turnover on Downs: Gegner bekommt Ball dort</td></tr><tr><td>Punt</td><td>Ball wird weggekickt, Gegner übernimmt</td></tr><tr><td>Interception / Fumble verloren</td><td>[[Turnover]], Gegner sofort am Ball</td></tr><tr><td>Touchdown / Field Goal</td><td>Punkte, danach Kickoff</td></tr></table>
<h2>Spielstruktur</h2><ul><li>2 Hälften, je 2 Quarter. Nach Q2 Halbzeit (ca. 12–13 min), danach Anstoß-Wechsel.</li><li>Gleichstand: <b>Overtime</b>. <span class="nfl">NFL:</span> 10 Min (Playoffs 15); seit 2025 haben im Grundsatz beide Teams einen Ballbesitz, auch in der Regular Season. Prüfe aktuelles Rulebook.</li><li>College (NCAA): andere OT-Regeln (abwechselnde Drives ab der 25-Yard-Linie).</li></ul>
<div class="co nfl"><b>NFL vs. College:</b> NFL-Uhr läuft nach First Down weiter; College hält sie kurz an (nur im Ausnahmefall).</div>
<div class="q" data-q='[["Du hast 2nd & 7 und gewinnst 4 Yards. Was ist als Nächstes?","3rd & 3","3rd & 3 – 7 minus 4 = 3 Yards fehlen noch, nächster Versuch ist der dritte."]]'></div>`},
    {
      t: "Spielfeld", lv: 1, h: `<p>Das Feld ist 100 Yards lang plus zwei <b>End Zones</b> (je 10 Yards), 53⅓ Yards breit.</p><ul><li><b>Goal Line:</b> Ball darüber = Touchdown. <b>Sideline/End Line:</b> Seiten-/Rückbegrenzung.</li><li><b>Hash Marks:</b> Markierungen in der Feldmitte; jeder Play beginnt dort, wo der vorige endete, aber zwischen den Hashes. Ein Spielzug an der Seitenlinie lässt eine kurze Seite ("Short Side") und eine breite ("Field Side") entstehen.</li><li><b>Line of Scrimmage (LOS):</b> gedachte Linie auf Höhe des Balls. Zwischen den Teams liegt die <b>Neutral Zone</b> (Ballbreite).</li><li><b>Backfield:</b> Raum hinter der Offensive Line. <b>Box:</b> Bereich etwa zwischen den Tackles, 5 Yards tief, wo die Defense Läufe stoppt. <b>Pocket:</b> der geschützte Raum um den QB beim Pass.</li><li><b>[[Red Zone]]:</b> Raum zwischen gegnerischer 20-Yard-Linie und End Zone.</li></ul>
<p><b>Warum wichtig?</b> Je näher an der End Zone, desto weniger Raum hat die Offense für tiefe Pässe und desto enger wird die Defense.</p>`},
    {
      t: "Game Clock & Play Clock", lv: 1, h: `<p>Zwei Uhren, zwei Aufgaben. <b>[[Game Clock]]</b>: Spielzeit (15:00 pro Quarter). <b>[[Play Clock]]</b>: Zeit, in der die Offense den nächsten Play snappen muss, sonst <b>Delay of Game</b> (5 Yards).</p>
<h2>Game Clock</h2><ul><li><b>Läuft</b> bei Läufen/Pässen, die innerhalb des Feldes enden (Tackle, Sack, Run in-bounds, auch nach First Down).</li><li><b>Stoppt</b> bei: Incomplete Pass, Ball out of bounds, Timeout, Challenge, Penalty (meist), Verletzung, Score, Turnover (kurz), Spike, Two-Minute Warning, Quarter-Ende.</li><li><b>Restart</b>: entweder mit dem <b>Snap</b> oder wenn der Referee <b>"ready for play"</b> pfeift. <span class="nfl">NFL:</span> Nach Out of Bounds startet die Uhr in den letzten 2 Minuten jeder Halbzeit erst mit dem Snap; sonst nach "ready for play". Nach Incomplete Pass immer erst mit dem Snap.</li><li><b>Ready for play</b>: Referee signalisiert, dass Ball platziert ist und beide Teams bereit sein können.</li></ul>
<h2>Play Clock</h2><ul><li><b>40 Sekunden</b>: startet sofort nach Ende des Plays, wenn die Game Clock <i>läuft</i>.</li><li><b>25 Sekunden</b>: nach Unterbrechungen (Timeout, Incomplete, Penalty, Score, Out of Bounds); startet erst mit "ready for play".</li><li>Deshalb: Play Clock kann laufen, obwohl die Game Clock steht (Incomplete Pass). Und die Game Clock kann laufen, wenn die Play Clock gerade erst bei 40 steht (in-bounds Tackle).</li><li>QB wartet lange: Cadence, Pre-Snap-Reads, Uhr runterlaufen lassen, um Defense zu zwingen, Alignment zu zeigen. Sofort-Snap: Überraschung, Tempo, Uhr sparen.</li></ul>
<div class="sim"><b>Uhren-Simulator</b><br><select id="ck" aria-label="Ereignis"></select><div id="ckr"></div></div>
<h3>Beispiel</h3><div class="co">Game Clock 1:43 | Play Clock 18 | 3rd & 6 | Incomplete Pass<br>→ Game Clock stoppt bei 1:43. Down: 4th & 6. Play Clock: wird auf 25 zurückgesetzt, startet bei "ready for play". Game Clock läuft erst mit dem nächsten Snap wieder.</div>
<div class="co">Game Clock 2:30, Q4, 1st & 10, Run für 5 Yards in-bounds<br>→ Game Clock läuft weiter, Play Clock 40 startet sofort. Team muss in 40 Sek. snappen, dabei läuft die Game Clock. Hurry-Up: schnell snappen.</div>
<div class="q" data-q='[["Welche Play Clock gilt nach einem Timeout?","25 Sekunden","Nach Unterbrechung 25 s, ab ready for play."],["Wann läuft die Game Clock nach einem Incomplete Pass weiter?","Mit dem Snap","Incomplete Pass stoppt die Uhr; Restart immer am Snap."]]'></div>`},
    {
      t: "Scoring", lv: 1, h: `<table><tr><th>Art</th><th>Pkt</th><th>Details</th></tr><tr><td>Touchdown</td><td>6</td><td>Ball in End Zone tragen/fangen</td></tr><tr><td>Extra Point</td><td>1</td><td><span class="nfl">NFL:</span> Kick aus 33 Yards (15-Yard-Linie)</td></tr><tr><td>2-Point Conversion</td><td>2</td><td>Play von der 2-Yard-Linie</td></tr><tr><td>Field Goal</td><td>3</td><td>Kick durch die Torstangen</td></tr><tr><td>Safety</td><td>2</td><td>Offense wird in eigener End Zone gestoppt; Gegner kickt danach frei an</td></tr></table>
<p><b>Warum 6?</b> historisch: Touchdown war ursprünglich weniger wert, wurde als Haupt-Score hochgesetzt. Der XP ist nicht automatisch (~94% Quote). 2-Punkte-Versuche lohnen sich nach <b>Chart-Logik</b>, z. B. bei 8 Punkten Rückstand, Chart-Logik hängt vom Spielstand und von der Restzeit ab.</p>
<div class="q" data-q='[["Team liegt nach TD mit 14 Punkten zurück (Rückstand 8 nach dem TD, nein: 14 - 6 = 8). Warum jetzt 2-Punkte?","Auf 6 Punkte kommen, dann reicht TD+XP zum Ausgleich","Rückstand 8 → mit 2 Pkt nur noch 6 (= ein TD). Mit XP nur 7."]]'></div>`},
    {
      t: "Positionen", lv: 2, h: `<h2>Offense (11 Spieler)</h2><table><tr><th>Position</th><th>Aufgabe</th><th>Zuschauen auf</th></tr><tr><td>[[Quarterback]]</td><td>Spielmacher, wirft/übergibt</td><td>Blick vor Snap, Pocket-Präsenz</td></tr><tr><td>Running Back</td><td>Läufer, Passfänger, Blocker</td><td>Vision, Cuts, Pass Pro</td></tr><tr><td>Fullback</td><td>Lead Blocker</td><td>Block auf Linebacker</td></tr><tr><td>Wide Receiver</td><td>Passfänger außen; <b>Slot</b> = innen</td><td>Route, Separation</td></tr><tr><td>Tight End</td><td>Hybrid aus Blocker und Receiver</td><td>Aufstellung (eng/slot)</td></tr><tr><td>OL: LT, LG, C, RG, RT</td><td>5 Blocker; Center snappt, LT schützt oft die Blindside des QB</td><td>Pocket-Kollaps, Holding</td></tr></table>
<h2>Defense</h2><table><tr><th>Position</th><th>Aufgabe</th></tr><tr><td>DL: Nose Tackle, DT, DE</td><td>Linie, Läufe stoppen, Pass Rush; Nose zentral über Center</td></tr><tr><td>Edge Rusher</td><td>DE/OLB außen; Hauptaufgabe Sack</td></tr><tr><td>Linebacker (Mike = Zentrum/Kommandeur, Will = weak side, Sam = strong side)</td><td>Run Stop, Coverage, Blitz</td></tr><tr><td>Cornerback; Nickel = 3. CB (Slot); Dime = 4. CB</td><td>Receiver decken</td></tr><tr><td>Free Safety / Strong Safety</td><td>Tief absichern bzw. Box/Run unterstützen</td></tr></table>
<p>Namen variieren je Scheme (z. B. 3-4 vs 4-3), Rollen sind oft <b>Hybrid</b> (Safety spielt als Box-Spieler, Edge dropt in Coverage).</p>
<h2>Special Teams</h2><p>Kicker (FG/Kickoff), Punter, Long Snapper (langer Snap), Holder (hält Ball für FG), Returner (fangen Kick/Punt), Gunner (schnelle Außenspieler bei Punts).</p>`},
    {
      t: "Personnel & Formationen", lv: 3, h: `<h2>Personnel</h2><p>Zahlen = <b>RB+TE</b> (erste Ziffer RB, zweite TE); Rest sind WR. <b>11</b>: 1 RB, 1 TE, 3 WR · <b>12</b>: 1 RB, 2 TE, 2 WR · <b>13</b>: 1 RB, 3 TE · <b>21</b>: 2 RB (1 FB), 1 TE · <b>10</b>: 1 RB, 0 TE, 4 WR · <b>20</b>: 2 RB, 4 WR... (5 Skill-Spieler plus OL).</p><p>Defense reagiert mit passendem Personnel: 11 → <b>Nickel</b>, 12/13 → Base mit mehr LB.</p>
<h2>Formationen</h2><ul><li><b>Under Center:</b> QB direkt hinter Center; gut für Play Action, Läufe.</li><li><b>Shotgun:</b> QB ~5 Yards zurück; bessere Sicht, Passzeit; schwächer für Läufe mit Lead.</li><li><b>Pistol:</b> QB 3-4 Yards zurück, RB direkt dahinter; Mischung beider.</li><li><b>I-Formation:</b> FB und RB in Linie; Power Run.</li><li><b>Singleback:</b> 1 RB. <b>Empty:</b> kein RB, 5 Passfänger; Pass-Absicht, Pass Rush.</li><li><b>Bunch:</b> 3 Receiver eng zusammen (Picks gegen Man). <b>Trips:</b> 3 auf einer Seite. <b>Twins:</b> 2 auf einer Seite. <b>Stack:</b> Receiver hintereinander (Release gegen Press).</li></ul>`},
    {
      t: "Laufspiel", lv: 3, h: `<h2>Blocking-Philosophien</h2><ul><li><b>Zone Blocking:</b> OL blockt Räume gemeinsam und bewegt sich seitlich; RB liest und schneidet in die beste Lücke (<b>Cutback Lane</b>).</li><li><b>Gap/Man Blocking:</b> Jeder Blocker hat feste Lücke/Gegner; ein <b>Pulling Guard</b> läuft quer hinter der Linie und führt als <b>Lead Blocker</b>.</li><li><b>Double Team / Combo Block:</b> zwei Blocker nehmen einen DL, einer löst dann zum <b>Second Level</b> (Linebacker) ab.</li></ul>
<table><tr><th>Play</th><th>Idee</th></tr><tr><td>Inside Zone</td><td>Zone, Lauf zwischen den Tackles, Read nach Linebacker</td></tr><tr><td>Outside Zone</td><td>Horizontal Stretch, Defense streckt sich, Cutback</td></tr><tr><td>Split Zone</td><td>Inside Zone plus Block von TE/FB auf Backside</td></tr><tr><td>Duo</td><td>Doppelblocks, geradeaus</td></tr><tr><td>Power</td><td>Gap: Guard pullt, FB führt</td></tr><tr><td>Counter</td><td>Gegenläufige Fake-Bewegung, dann Pull</td></tr><tr><td>Trap</td><td>Ein Defender wird bewusst durchgelassen und von pullendem Guard geblockt</td></tr><tr><td>Draw</td><td>Fake-Pass, dann Lauf</td></tr><tr><td>Toss/Sweep</td><td>Außen laufen mit Blockerkette</td></tr><tr><td>QB Sneak</td><td>QB schiebt sich für 1 Yard (4th & 1)</td></tr></table>
<div class="co"><b>RB-Entscheidung:</b> "Press, Read, Cut": zur Hauptlücke (Press), Blick auf Reaktion der LBs (Read), dann <b>One Cut</b> in die offene Lane. Gewinnen = 4 Yards oder mehr.</div>`},
    {
      t: "Passspiel & Routes", lv: 3, h: `<h2>Konzepte</h2><ul><li><b>Quick Game:</b> kurze Pässe, schneller Release; gegen Pass Rush.</li><li><b>Dropback:</b> QB geht zurück; mehr Zeit, tiefere Routes. <b>Play Action:</b> Lauf-Fake, Linebacker kommen nach vorn, Raum hinter ihnen.</li><li><b>Screen:</b> Pass hinter Linie, Blocker formieren sich; bremst Pass Rush.</li><li><b>Hot Route:</b> Receiver ändert Route bei Blitz. <b>Checkdown:</b> sichere Kurz-Option.</li></ul>
<h2>Routes</h2><table><tr><th>Route</th><th>Beschreibung</th></tr><tr><td>Go / Fade</td><td>Gerade nach oben / zur Sideline</td></tr><tr><td>Post / Corner</td><td>Deep Cut zur Mitte / zur Ecke</td></tr><tr><td>Dig</td><td>Mittellange Cut quer (~12–15 Yds)</td></tr><tr><td>Curl / Hitch</td><td>Runterbremsen und umdrehen</td></tr><tr><td>Comeback / Out</td><td>Zurück zur Sideline / hinaus</td></tr><tr><td>Slant</td><td>Schräg nach innen, schnell</td></tr><tr><td>Seam / Wheel</td><td>Vertikal entlang Hash / Bogen außen entlang der Sideline</td></tr><tr><td>Swing / Flat</td><td>RB-Route zur Seite</td></tr></table>
<h2>Kombinationen</h2><ul><li><b>Mesh:</b> zwei Crosser kreuzen eng → gut gegen Man (Pick).</li><li><b>Levels:</b> zwei Digs auf unterschiedlichen Tiefen → Zone-Defender entscheiden.</li><li><b>Smash:</b> Corner über Hitch → gegen Cover 2 (Corner muss wählen).</li><li><b>Four Verticals:</b> 4 Gos → dehnt Safeties.</li><li><b>Stick:</b> TE sticht kurz, RB Flat → gegen Man/Zone.</li><li><b>Dagger:</b> Dig mit Vertikal-Clear → schlägt Cover 3.</li><li><b>Y-Cross:</b> TE Crosser, Deep Shots.</li></ul>`},
    {
      t: "QB Reads", lv: 4, h: `<h2>Pre-Snap</h2><ol><li><b>Safety Shell:</b> 1 tiefer Safety = <b>Single High</b> (Cover 1/3) → Läufe, Out-Routes; 2 tiefe = <b>Two High</b> (Cover 2/4/6) → mehr Platz für Lauf, aber Deep Middle weniger offen.</li><li><b>Box Count:</b> Anzahl Defender in der Box; 7 = Lauf okay, 8 = Passspiel/Play Action.</li><li><b>Man oder Zone:</b> Corner dicht an Receiver (Press), Defender folgen Motion → eher Man. Defender drehen sich zu Zone → Zone.</li><li><b>Blitz-Indikatoren:</b> LB nahe LOS, Safeties rücken ein, Corner extrem tief an der LOS.</li><li><b>Leverage:</b> Position relativ zum Receiver (innen/außen), bestimmt, wohin ein Route-Break funktioniert.</li><li>Antwort: <b>Audible</b>, Protection Call oder Hot.</li></ol>
<h2>Post-Snap</h2><p>Der QB bestätigt Coverage (Safeties drehen?), arbeitet <b>Progression</b> (1., 2., 3. Read), prüft Pocket und trifft Entscheidung in 2,5 Sekunden.</p>
<div class="q" data-q='[["3rd & 8, 1:32, Rückstand 4, zwei tiefe Safeties. Was bedeutet das?","Two-High → Cover 2/4; Underneath-Routes wie Dig, Curl, Checkdown","Two-High bietet Raum in der Mitte unter den Safeties (Dig, Levels, Mesh) und für Seam bei Cover 2. Ziel: First Down, Uhr stoppen (Sideline) und Field Goal Range."]]'></div>`},
    { t: "OL & Protection", lv: 4, h: `<ul><li><b>Pocket Integrity:</b> Pocket muss halten, sonst Pressure. <b>Slide Protection:</b> OL gleitet gemeinsam in eine Richtung (Half Slide / Full Slide), RB deckt Gegenseite.</li><li><b>Mike Point:</b> Center identifiziert den Mike (zentraler LB) und bestimmt die Protection. <b>Protection Call:</b> Lautes Ansagen, wer wen blockt.</li><li><b>Stunt/Twist:</b> DL-Tausch (ein Rusher kreuzt hinter anderem), OL muss <b>kommunizieren</b>. <b>Blitz Pickup:</b> RB/TE blockt unbesetzte Rusher.</li></ul>` },
    {
      t: "Defense Fronts & Coverages", lv: 3, h: `<h2>Fronts</h2><ul><li><b>4-3:</b> 4 DL, 3 LB. <b>3-4:</b> 3 DL, 4 LB (2 Edge LB). <b>Nickel:</b> 5 DB (3 CB). <b>Dime:</b> 6 DB.</li><li>Moderne NFL: Meist <b>Nickel</b> als Base, da 11 Personnel dominiert.</li></ul>
<h2>Coverages</h2><table><tr><th>Name</th><th>Struktur</th><th>Stärke/Schwäche</th></tr><tr><td>Cover 0</td><td>Man, kein tiefer Safety, meist Blitz</td><td>Sack/Hurry; Big Plays deep</td></tr><tr><td>Cover 1</td><td>Man + 1 tiefer Safety (Single High)</td><td>Press Man; Pick-Plays (Mesh)</td></tr><tr><td>Cover 2</td><td>2 tiefe Hälften, Corner Flat</td><td>Schutz vor Deep; Seam/Hole zwischen Corner und Safety</td></tr><tr><td>Cover 3</td><td>3 tiefe Drittel, 4 unter</td><td>Gegen Deep; schwach in Flats/Seams (Dagger, Smash)</td></tr><tr><td>Cover 4</td><td>4 tiefe Viertel</td><td>Gegen Deep Shots; Läufe, Underneath</td></tr><tr><td>Cover 6</td><td>Cover 4 auf einer, Cover 2 auf der anderen Seite</td><td>Mix, aber Seams</td></tr></table>
<p><b>Man oder Zone erkennen:</b> Press-Alignment, Defender folgen Motion → Man; Safeties rotieren erst nach dem Snap, Defender "schauen" in den QB → Zone. Begriffe: <b>Robber</b> (Safety jagt Crosser), <b>Spy</b> (beobachtet QB), <b>Rat</b>, <b>Hook</b> (Mitte unter Safety), <b>Curl/Flat</b> (Zone neben LOS).</p>`},
    {
      t: "Pass Rush & Blitz", lv: 4, h: `<p><b>Sack</b>: QB hinter LOS gebracht. <b>Pressure</b>: QB wird gestört, auch ohne Sack (Hurry, Hit). Ein Sack zählt für einen Spieler, Pressure ist Gruppenarbeit der Defense.</p>
<ul><li>Moves: <b>Bull Rush</b> (Power), <b>Speed Rush</b>, <b>Swim</b>, <b>Rip</b>, <b>Spin</b>, <b>Speed-to-Power</b>.</li><li><b>Blitz:</b> mehr als 4 Rusher. <b>Zone Blitz/Fire Zone:</b> Blitz, aber DL dropt in Zone. <b>Man Blitz:</b> Blitz plus Man. <b>Double A-Gap:</b> zwei LBs beide Seiten des Centers. <b>Creeper:</b> unerwarteter Rusher. <b>Simulated Pressure:</b> sieht nach Blitz aus, rusht aber 4.</li><li>Preis des Blitzes: weniger Defender in Coverage; Konter: Hot Route, Screen, Quick Game.</li></ul>`},
    {
      t: "Penalties", lv: 2, h: `<table><tr><th>Penalty</th><th>Yards</th><th>Bemerkung</th></tr><tr><td>False Start (O)</td><td>5</td><td>Bewegung vor Snap; Down wiederholt</td></tr><tr><td>Offside / Neutral Zone Infraction (D)</td><td>5</td><td>Im/über der Neutral Zone</td></tr><tr><td>Encroachment</td><td>5</td><td>Defense berührt Offense vor Snap</td></tr><tr><td>Offensive Holding</td><td>10</td><td>Down wiederholt</td></tr><tr><td>Defensive Holding</td><td>5</td><td>Automatisch First Down</td></tr><tr><td>Defensive Pass Interference</td><td>Spot of Foul</td><td>Automatisch First Down</td></tr><tr><td>Offensive Pass Interference</td><td>10</td><td>Down wiederholt</td></tr><tr><td>Delay of Game</td><td>5</td><td>Play Clock abgelaufen</td></tr><tr><td>Intentional Grounding</td><td>10 oder Spot, Loss of Down</td><td>Safety in End Zone möglich</td></tr><tr><td>Roughing the Passer</td><td>15</td><td>Automatisch First Down</td></tr><tr><td>Facemask / Horse-Collar / Unnecessary Roughness / Unsportsmanlike</td><td>15</td><td>Bei Defense automatisch First Down</td></tr></table>
<p><b>Decline:</b> Das gefoulte Team kann ablehnen, wenn das Ergebnis des Plays besser ist (z. B. 25-Yard-Pass trotz Holding).</p>`},
    { t: "4th Down, Red Zone, 2-Minute", lv: 4, h: `<ul><li><b>Punt:</b> Field Position. <b>Field Goal:</b> sichere 3 Punkte. <b>Go for it:</b> bei 4th & Short oft sinnvoll, weil Expected Points höher sind als ein Punt. Turnover on Downs gibt dem Gegner kurzen Weg. Fake Punt/FG als Überraschung.</li><li><b>Red Zone:</b> weniger Raum → Defense verdichtet, Routes wie Fade, Slant, Out; Field Goals werden relevanter, TD wird schwerer.</li><li><b>Two-Minute Drill:</b> No-Huddle, Spike (Uhr stoppt, kostet Down), Sideline-Pässe (Uhr stoppt), Timeouts. Ziel: Field-Goal-Range.</li><li><b>Victory Formation/Kneel Down:</b> QB kniet, Uhr läuft ab. <b>Intentional Safety:</b> Team gibt 2 Punkte, um mit Free Kick Raum zu gewinnen.</li><li><b>Challenges (NFL):</b> 2 Fehler = Verlust Timeout; ab 2 Min Booth Review durch Replay-Official.</li></ul>` },
    { t: "Special Teams", lv: 2, h: `<ul><li><b>Kickoff:</b> Anstoß nach Score; <span class="nfl">NFL (seit 2025):</span> Touchback = Ball an die 35-Yard-Linie.</li><li><b>Punt:</b> Weitsprung-Kick; <b>Fair Catch</b> = Returner signalisiert, wird nicht angegangen.</li><li><b>Onside Kick:</b> kurzer Kick zur Rückgewinnung. <b>Blocked Punt/FG:</b> Defense blockt, Ball verloren.</li><li>Field Position: je 10 Yards ≈ 0,5–0,7 Expected Points.</li></ul>` },
    { t: "Advanced Stats", lv: 5, h: `<table><tr><th>Stat</th><th>Misst</th><th>Sagt NICHT</th></tr><tr><td>Expected Points (EP) / EPA</td><td>Punktewert einer Situation / Änderung durch Play</td><td>Wer den Erfolg ausmacht (QB, OL, WR)</td></tr><tr><td>Success Rate</td><td>% der Plays mit positivem EP-Effekt</td><td>Explosivität</td></tr><tr><td>CPOE</td><td>Completion % über Erwartung</td><td>Schwierigkeit der Receiver</td></tr><tr><td>Air Yards / YAC</td><td>Distanz in der Luft / nach dem Catch</td><td>Spielqualität</td></tr><tr><td>YPA / ANY/A</td><td>Yards pro Versuch / adjustiert um Sacks, TDs, INTs</td><td>Kontext</td></tr><tr><td>Passer Rating / QBR</td><td>Formel aus Quoten / ESPN-Modell</td><td>Situation, Pressure</td></tr><tr><td>Pressure/Sack/Blitz Rate</td><td>Anteil der Dropbacks mit Pressure, Sack bzw. Blitz</td><td>Wer verantwortlich ist</td></tr><tr><td>DVOA</td><td>Effizienz, an Gegner und Situation angepasst</td><td>Einzelne Spieler</td></tr></table>` },
    { t: "Philosophien", lv: 5, h: `<ul><li><b>West Coast:</b> kurze Pässe als Laufersatz. <b>Air Raid:</b> viele Pässe, Spread. <b>Shanahan Outside Zone:</b> Zone-Lauf + Bootleg-Play Action. <b>Power Run:</b> Gap-Läufe, FB. <b>Vertical:</b> Deep Shots.</li><li>Defense: <b>Single High/Cover 3</b> (Seattle-Tradition), <b>Fangio-Style Two-High</b> (Deep Safeties, 5-6 DBs, wenig Big Plays), <b>Match Coverage</b> (Zone, die in Man übergeht), <b>Pressure Defense</b> (viele Blitze).</li></ul>` },
    { t: "Madden-Bezug", lv: 2, h: `<ul><li>Cover 2/3/4 sind echte Zonen: Coverage-Taste in Madden zeigt Zonen. <b>Zonen schließen Deep, öffnen Seams/Flats.</b> Man: Spieler decken Receiver; Hot Routes = Route per Stick ändern; Audible = Play am LOS wechseln.</li><li><b>QB Spy</b> = Defender, der den QB beobachtet (gegen Scrambler). <b>Contain</b> = Edge Rusher bleibt außen. <b>Usering</b> = Spieler steuert Defender.</li><li>Anfängerfehler: nur Blitz, keine Coverage-Erkennung, kein Pre-Snap-Read, immer Deep.</li></ul>` },
    { t: "Zuschau-Leitfaden", lv: 3, h: `<ol><li>Formation & Personnel</li><li>Safety Alignment, Box Count</li><li>Motion</li><li>Snap, Defensive Reaktion</li><li>Blocking, QB Read</li><li>Coverage erkennen, Ergebnis analysieren</li></ol><p>Fragen: "Warum diese Formation?", "Warum steht der Safety da?", "Was gewinnt die Offense, was gibt die Defense auf?"</p>` }];

      plays: {
        "inside_zone": {
          "id": "inside_zone",
          "name": "Inside Zone Run",
          "category": "run",
          "side": "O",
          "formation": "shotgun_11",
          "personnel": "11 Personnel (1 RB, 1 TE, 3 WR)",
          "summary": "Das Fundament des modernen Laufspiels. Die Offensive Line schiebt koordiniert im Zonen-Winkel nach rechts, während der Running Back den First-Level DT und den Mike LB liest.",
          "tacticalGoal": "Erzeugung von Double-Teams auf den Interior Defensive Tackles und Öffnung einer explosiven A/B-Gap Cutback Lane.",
          "reads": "1. Playside A-Gap (Frontside Entry) -> 2. Backside A/B-Gap (Cutback). Running Back liest die Helm-Ausrichtung des ersten Linebackers.",
          "strengths": "Universell einsetzbar gegen fast jede Front; bestraft über-aggressive Linebacker, die zu früh nach außen schießen.",
          "weaknesses": "Anfällig für gepenetrierende 3-Technique DTs und A-Gap-Blitze, die den RB vor dem Cutback im Backfield stoppen.",
          "counters": "Defensive Stunts (Slants ins B-Gap), Tite Front (404 Alignment) oder Double-A-Gap Mug Looks.",
          "targetWindow": {
            "x": 430,
            "y": 310,
            "rx": 35,
            "ry": 25
          },
          "routes": [
            {
              "id": "RB",
              "path": "M 285 340 L 350 315 L 450 280",
              "type": "Run Track",
              "label": "Press & Cutback"

        {
          "id": "cover_3",
          "term": "Cover 3",
          "category": "defense_coverage",
          "categoryLabel": "Defense & Coverages",
          "level": "basic",
          "levelLabel": "Grundlagen",
          "shortDef": "Zone Coverage mit 3 tiefen Zonenverteidigern (1 Deep Safety + 2 Outside CBs) und 4 Unterzonenverteidigern.",
          "longExpl": "Cover 3 ist die klassische Single-High Zone Defense der NFL. Vor dem Snap steht meist ein einzelner Free Safety tief in der Mitte (Deep Middle 1/3), während die beiden Outside Cornerbacks die tiefen Außen (Deep Outside 1/3) absichern. Die vier verbleibenden Defender (Linebacker, Strong Safety, Nickel) verteidigen die vier Underneath-Zonen: zwei Curl-Flat-Zonen an den Seiten und zwei Hook-Curl-Zonen in der Mitte.
