          all22Focus: "Achte auf den Eye-Discipline-Test des Backside Defensive Ends. Sobald er die Schultern dreht und dem RB hinterherrennt, ist der Bootleg-Pass über ihn hinweg garantiert offen.",
          preset: { form: "shotgun_11", play: "inside_zone", def: "cover_3" }
        },
        {
          title: "Vic Fangio: Two-High Shell Evolution & Match Quarters",
          category: "Defense Scheme",
          coach: "Vic Fangio (Dolphins / Broncos / Eagles)",
          philosophy: "Nimmt modernen Super-Pass-Offenses wie den Chiefs alle tiefen Big Plays. Zwei tiefe Safeties halten alles vor sich, während 4-5 Pass-Rusher ohne exzessiven Blitz für Druck sorgen.",
          all22Focus: "Pre-Snap stehen beide Safeties auf 14 Yards Tiefe. Nach dem Snap mutiert die Deckung basierend auf den Receiver-Releases in Match Coverage.",
          preset: { form: "shotgun_11", play: "smash", def: "cover_2" }
        },
        {
          title: "Steve Spagnuolo: Simulated Pressures & Creeper Blitzes",
          category: "Defense Scheme",
          coach: "Steve Spagnuolo (Chiefs DC)",
          philosophy: "Täuscht vor dem Snap einen 6-Mann-Blitz an, rusht aber nur 4 Spieler. Zwei Verteidiger droppen überraschend in die Pass-Lanes und verwirren die Protection Calls der O-Line.",
          all22Focus: "Der Center muss vor dem Snap entscheiden, zu welcher Seite die O-Line slidigt. Genau dorthin zieht sich der getäuschte Blitzer zurück!",
          preset: { form: "shotgun_11", play: "mesh", def: "cover_0" }
        },
        {
          title: "Lincoln Riley / Mike Leach: Air Raid Mesh Rubs",
          category: "Offense Scheme",
          coach: "Air Raid System",
          philosophy: "Zwei flache Receiver kreuzen auf 4-5 Yards Tiefe. Gegen Mann-Deckung kollidieren die Verteidiger legal miteinander (Natural Pick), wodurch der Crossing-Receiver freie Bahn hat.",
          all22Focus: "Achte auf den 'Mesh Point' in der Mitte. Der Over-Crosser muss so eng am Under-Crosser vorbeilaufen, dass kein Verteidiger dazwischenpasst.",
          preset: { form: "shotgun_11", play: "mesh", def: "cover_1" }
        }
      ],
      trainerScenarios: []
    };

    const NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS = NFL_DATA.clockEvents;
    const NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS = NFL_DATA.clockScenarios;
    const NFL_GLOSSARY_DATA = NFL_DATA.glossary;
    const G = NFL_DATA.glossary.map(t => [
      t.term,
      t.shortDef,
      t.gameContext,
      (t.relatedTerms || []).map(r => r.desc || r.id).join(', ')
    ]);


    /* ==================== THE CORE INTERACTIVE FOOTBALL FIELD ENGINE ==================== */
    class FootballFieldEngine {
      constructor(svgElementId, options = {}) {
        this.svg = document.getElementById(svgElementId);
        this.options = Object.assign({
          showRoutes: true,
          showZones: true,
          showRush: true,
          showLabels: true,
          showTarget: true,
          viewMode: 'tactical', // 'tactical' | 'fullfield'
          interactive: true,
          onPlayerSelect: null,
          onPhaseChange: null,
          onTimeUpdate: null
        }, options);

        this.formationKey = "shotgun_11";
        this.playKey = "mesh";
        this.defenseKey = "cover_3";

        this.formation = null;
        this.defense = null;
        this.play = null;

        this.progress = 0; // 0.0 to 1.0
        this.animating = false;
        this.animId = null;
        this.speed = 1.0;
        this.selectedPlayer = null;
        this.lastTimestamp = null;
        this.duration = 3200; // ms

        this.init();
      }

      init() {
        if (!this.svg) return;
        this.renderFieldBase();
      }

      setViewMode(mode) {
        this.options.viewMode = mode;
        this.renderFieldBase();
        this.render();
      }

      renderFieldBase() {
        const isFull = this.options.viewMode === 'fullfield';

        this.svg.innerHTML = `
      <defs>
        <pattern id="turf-stripe" width="${isFull ? 100 : 150}" height="600" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <rect x="0" y="0" width="${isFull ? 50 : 75}" height="600" fill="var(--field-turf-1)"/>
          <rect x="${isFull ? 50 : 75}" y="0" width="${isFull ? 50 : 75}" height="600" fill="var(--field-turf-2)"/>
        </pattern>
        <pattern id="endzone-stripes" width="30" height="30" patternTransform="rotate(45 0 0)" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="30" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.08)" stroke-width="4"/>
        </pattern>
        <marker id="arrow-route" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="7" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="var(--y)"/>
        </marker>
        <marker id="arrow-rush" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="7" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="var(--accent-crimson)"/>
        </marker>
        <marker id="block-tbar" viewBox="0 0 10 14" refX="5" refY="7" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="9" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <line x1="5" y1="0" x2="5" y2="14" stroke="#22c55e" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </marker>
        <marker id="arrow-motion" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="7" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#c084fc"/>
        </marker>
        <marker id="arrow-run" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="7" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
          <path d="M 0 1 L 10 5 L 0 9 z" fill="#38bdf8"/>
        </marker>
        <filter id="glow-los" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.5" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
        <filter id="glow-target" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
          <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
          <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
        </filter>
      </defs>

      <!-- Turf Base -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1000" height="600" fill="url(#turf-stripe)"/>

      <!-- Endzone (Right side in Tactical view: 820px to 980px) -->
      ${!isFull ? `
        <rect x="830" y="45" width="140" height="510" fill="var(--field-endzone)"/>
        <rect x="830" y="45" width="140" height="510" fill="url(#endzone-stripes)"/>
        <!-- Pylons -->
        <rect x="825" y="40" width="10" height="10" fill="#f97316"/>
        <rect x="825" y="550" width="10" height="10" fill="#f97316"/>
        <rect x="965" y="40" width="10" height="10" fill="#f97316"/>
        <rect x="965" y="550" width="10" height="10" fill="#f97316"/>
        <!-- Endzone Wordmark -->
        <g transform="translate(905, 300) rotate(90)" font-family="-apple-system, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="28" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" letter-spacing="8" text-anchor="middle">
          <text x="0" y="8">END ZONE</text>
        </g>
        <line x1="830" y1="45" x2="830" y2="555" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4.5"/>
      ` : `
        <!-- Full Field Left Endzone -->
        <rect x="30" y="45" width="80" height="510" fill="var(--field-endzone)"/>
        <g transform="translate(70, 300) rotate(-90)" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="20" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" letter-spacing="6" text-anchor="middle">
          <text x="0" y="6">END ZONE</text>
        </g>
        <line x1="110" y1="45" x2="110" y2="555" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4"/>
        
        <!-- Full Field Right Endzone -->
        <rect x="890" y="45" width="80" height="510" fill="var(--field-endzone)"/>
        <g transform="translate(930, 300) rotate(90)" font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="20" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.2)" letter-spacing="6" text-anchor="middle">
          <text x="0" y="6">END ZONE</text>
        </g>
        <line x1="890" y1="45" x2="890" y2="555" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4"/>
      `}

      <!-- Sidelines & Border -->
      <rect x="30" y="45" width="940" height="510" fill="none" stroke="var(--field-line)" stroke-width="3"/>

      <!-- Yard Lines & Numbers -->
      ${!isFull ? `
        <!-- Tactical View: 100px = 5 yds (350 is LOS, 470 is 1st Down) -->
        ${[110, 190, 270, 350, 430, 510, 590, 670, 750, 830].map((x, idx) => `
          <line x1="${x}" y1="45" x2="${x}" y2="555" stroke="var(--field-line)" stroke-width="${x === 350 ? 0 : (idx % 2 === 1 ? 2 : 1.2)}" stroke-opacity="${x === 830 ? 0 : 0.65}"/>
        `).join('')}

        <!-- Hash Marks (NFL spacing: 250px and 350px) -->
        ${Array.from({ length: 37 }).map((_, i) => {
          const x = 110 + i * 20;
          if (x > 830) return "";
          return `
            <line x1="${x}" y1="45" x2="${x}" y2="55" stroke="var(--field-hash)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
            <line x1="${x}" y1="245" x2="${x}" y2="255" stroke="var(--field-hash)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
            <line x1="${x}" y1="345" x2="${x}" y2="355" stroke="var(--field-hash)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
            <line x1="${x}" y1="545" x2="${x}" y2="555" stroke="var(--field-hash)" stroke-width="1.4"/>
          `;
        }).join('')}

        <!-- Yard Numbers -->
        <g font-family="-apple-system, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="16" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)" text-anchor="middle">
          <text x="190" y="80">2 5</text><text x="190" y="535">2 5</text>
          <text x="350" y="80">3 5 (LOS)</text><text x="350" y="535">3 5 (LOS)</text>
          <text x="510" y="80">4 5 (1st)</text><text x="510" y="535">4 5 (1st)</text>
          <text x="670" y="80">5 0</text><text x="670" y="535">5 0</text>
          <text x="830" y="80">GOAL</text><text x="830" y="535">GOAL</text>
        </g>

        <!-- Line of Scrimmage (LOS at x=350, Blue) -->
        <line x1="350" y1="45" x2="350" y2="555" stroke="var(--los-blue)" stroke-width="4" filter="url(#glow-los)"/>

        <!-- Line to Gain (1st Down at x=500, Yellow) -->
        <line x1="500" y1="45" x2="500" y2="555" stroke="var(--fd-yellow)" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-dasharray="10 5"/>
      ` : `
        <!-- Full Field Lines -->
        ${[110, 188, 266, 344, 422, 500, 578, 656, 734, 812, 890].map((x, i) => `
          <line x1="${x}" y1="45" x2="${x}" y2="555" stroke="var(--field-line)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-opacity="0.6"/>
        `).join('')}
        <g font-family="sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="14" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.4)" text-anchor="middle">
          <text x="188" y="75">10</text><text x="266" y="75">20</text><text x="344" y="75">30</text>
          <text x="422" y="75">40</text><text x="500" y="75">50</text><text x="578" y="75">40</text>
          <text x="656" y="75">30</text><text x="734" y="75">20</text><text x="812" y="75">10</text>
        </g>
        <line x1="380" y1="45" x2="380" y2="555" stroke="var(--los-blue)" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#glow-los)"/>
        <line x1="460" y1="45" x2="460" y2="555" stroke="var(--fd-yellow)" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6 3"/>
      `}

      <!-- Dynamic Layers -->
      <g id="layer-zones"></g>
      <g id="layer-target"></g>
      <g id="layer-blocking"></g>
      <g id="layer-motion"></g>
      <g id="layer-routes"></g>
      <g id="layer-rush"></g>
      <g id="layer-players"></g>
    `;

        this.layerZones = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-zones");
        this.layerTarget = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-target");
        this.layerBlocking = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-blocking");
        this.layerMotion = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-motion");
        this.layerRoutes = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-routes");
        this.layerRush = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-rush");
        this.layerPlayers = this.svg.querySelector("#layer-players");
      }

      loadSetup(formationKey, playKey, defenseKey) {
        this.formationKey = formationKey || "shotgun_11";
        this.playKey = playKey || "mesh";
        this.defenseKey = defenseKey || "cover_3";

        this.formation = (typeof formationKey === 'object' && formationKey !== null)
          ? formationKey
          : (NFL_DATA.formations[this.formationKey] || NFL_DATA.formations.shotgun_11);

        this.play = (typeof playKey === 'object' && playKey !== null)
          ? playKey
          : (NFL_DATA.plays[this.playKey] || NFL_DATA.plays.mesh);

        this.defense = (typeof defenseKey === 'object' && defenseKey !== null)
          ? defenseKey
          : (defenseKey === 'none' ? null : (NFL_DATA.defenses[this.defenseKey] || NFL_DATA.defenses.cover_3));

        this.reset();
      }

      render() {
        if (!this.layerPlayers) return;
        this.renderZones();
        this.renderTargetWindow();
        this.renderBlocking();
        this.renderMotions();
        this.renderRoutes();
        this.renderRush();
        this.renderPlayers();
      }

      renderBlocking() {
        if (!this.layerBlocking) return;
        this.layerBlocking.innerHTML = "";
        if (this.options.showBlocking === false || !this.play || !this.play.blocking) return;

        this.play.blocking.forEach(b => {
          const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
          path.setAttribute("d", b.path);
          path.setAttribute("fill", "none");
          path.setAttribute("stroke", "#22c55e");
          path.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3.2");
          path.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#block-tbar)");
          this.layerBlocking.appendChild(path);

          if (this.options.showLabels && b.label) {
            const pts = b.path.split(" ");
            const lx = pts[pts.length - 2];
            const ly = pts[pts.length - 1];
            const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
            txt.setAttribute("x", lx);
            txt.setAttribute("y", Number(ly) - 8);
            txt.setAttribute("font-size", "10");
            txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
            txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
            txt.setAttribute("fill", "#22c55e");
            txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
            txt.textContent = b.label;
            this.layerBlocking.appendChild(txt);
          }
        });
      }

      renderMotions() {
        if (!this.layerMotion) return;
        this.layerMotion.innerHTML = "";
        if (this.options.showMotion === false || !this.play) return;
        const m = this.play.motion;
        if (!m) return;

        const pts = m.path ? m.path : `M ${m.start.x} ${m.start.y} L ${m.end.x} ${m.end.y}`;
        const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
        path.setAttribute("d", pts);
        path.setAttribute("fill", "none");
        path.setAttribute("stroke", "#c084fc");
        path.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.8");
        path.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "6 4");
        path.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrow-motion)");
        this.layerMotion.appendChild(path);

        if (this.options.showLabels) {
          const startPt = m.start || { x: 300, y: 300 };
          const endPt = m.end || { x: 300, y: 300 };
          const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
          txt.setAttribute("x", (startPt.x + endPt.x) / 2);
          txt.setAttribute("y", (startPt.y + endPt.y) / 2 - 8);
          txt.setAttribute("font-size", "10.5");
          txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
          txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
          txt.setAttribute("fill", "#c084fc");
          txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          txt.textContent = `✈️ ${m.type ? m.type.toUpperCase() : 'MOTION'}`;
          this.layerMotion.appendChild(txt);
        }
      }

      renderZones() {
        if (!this.layerZones) return;
        this.layerZones.innerHTML = "";
        if (!this.options.showZones || !this.defense || !this.defense.zones) return;

        this.defense.zones.forEach(z => {
          const el = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "ellipse");
          el.setAttribute("cx", z.x);
          el.setAttribute("cy", z.y);
          el.setAttribute("rx", z.rx);
          el.setAttribute("ry", z.ry);
          el.setAttribute("fill", z.color || "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)");
          el.setAttribute("stroke", "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.45)");
          el.setAttribute("stroke-width", "1.2");
          this.layerZones.appendChild(el);

          if (this.options.showLabels) {
            const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
            txt.setAttribute("x", z.x);
            txt.setAttribute("y", z.y + 4);
            txt.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
            txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
            txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
            txt.setAttribute("fill", "#ffffff");
            txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
            txt.textContent = z.name;
            this.layerZones.appendChild(txt);
          }
        });
      }

      renderTargetWindow() {
        if (!this.layerTarget) return;
        this.layerTarget.innerHTML = "";
        if (!this.options.showTarget || !this.play || !this.play.targetWindow) return;

        const tw = this.play.targetWindow;
        const el = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "ellipse");
        el.setAttribute("cx", tw.x);
        el.setAttribute("cy", tw.y);
        el.setAttribute("rx", tw.rx);
        el.setAttribute("ry", tw.ry);
        el.setAttribute("fill", "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)");
        el.setAttribute("stroke", "var(--y)");
        el.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
        el.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "4 4");
        el.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow-target)");
        this.layerTarget.appendChild(el);

        if (this.options.showLabels) {
          const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
          txt.setAttribute("x", tw.x);
          txt.setAttribute("y", tw.y - tw.ry - 6);
          txt.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
          txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
          txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
          txt.setAttribute("fill", "var(--y)");
          txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          txt.textContent = "🎯 TARGET WINDOW";
          this.layerTarget.appendChild(txt);
        }
      }

      renderRoutes() {
        if (!this.layerRoutes) return;
        this.layerRoutes.innerHTML = "";
        if (!this.options.showRoutes || !this.play || !this.play.routes) return;

        if (this.play.runPath) {
          const rp = this.play.runPath;
          const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
          path.setAttribute("d", rp.path);
          path.setAttribute("fill", "none");
          path.setAttribute("stroke", "#38bdf8");
          path.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3.5");
          path.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrow-run)");
          this.layerRoutes.appendChild(path);

          if (this.options.showLabels && rp.label) {
            const pts = rp.path.split(" ");
            const lx = pts[pts.length - 2];
            const ly = pts[pts.length - 1];
            const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
            txt.setAttribute("x", lx);
            txt.setAttribute("y", Number(ly) - 8);
            txt.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
            txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
            txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
            txt.setAttribute("fill", "#38bdf8");
            txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
            txt.textContent = rp.label;
            this.layerRoutes.appendChild(txt);
          }
        }

        this.play.routes.forEach(r => {
          const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
          path.setAttribute("d", r.path);
          path.setAttribute("fill", "none");
          path.setAttribute("stroke", "var(--y)");
          path.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3");
          path.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrow-route)");
          path.setAttribute("class", "route-vector-path");
          this.layerRoutes.appendChild(path);

          if (this.options.showLabels && r.label) {
            const pts = r.path.split(" ");
            const lx = pts[pts.length - 2];
            const ly = pts[pts.length - 1];
            const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
            txt.setAttribute("x", lx);
            txt.setAttribute("y", Number(ly) - 8);
            txt.setAttribute("font-size", "11");
            txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "800");
            txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
            txt.setAttribute("fill", "var(--y)");
            txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
            txt.textContent = r.label;
            this.layerRoutes.appendChild(txt);
          }
        });
      }

      renderRush() {
        if (!this.layerRush) return;
        this.layerRush.innerHTML = "";
        if (!this.options.showRush || !this.defense) return;

        const rushers = this.defense.players.filter(p => p.role && (p.role.toLowerCase().includes("rush") || p.role.toLowerCase().includes("blitz")));
        rushers.forEach(p => {
          const line = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "line");
          line.setAttribute("x1", p.x);
          line.setAttribute("y1", p.y);
          line.setAttribute("x2", 285);
          line.setAttribute("y2", 300);
          line.setAttribute("stroke", "var(--accent-crimson)");
          line.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2");
          line.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "4 4");
          line.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrow-rush)");
          this.layerRush.appendChild(line);
        });
      }

      renderPlayers() {
        if (!this.layerPlayers) return;
        this.layerPlayers.innerHTML = "";

        // Offense
        if (this.formation && this.formation.players) {
          this.formation.players.forEach(p => {
            const pos = this.interpolatePosition(p, this.progress);
            const g = this.createPlayerNode(p, pos.x, pos.y, "O");
            this.layerPlayers.appendChild(g);
          });
        }

        // Defense
        if (this.defense && this.defense.players) {
          this.defense.players.forEach(p => {
            const pos = this.interpolateDefensePosition(p, this.progress);
            const g = this.createPlayerNode(p, pos.x, pos.y, "D");
            this.layerPlayers.appendChild(g);
          });
        }
      }

      createPlayerNode(player, x, y, side) {
        const g = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
        g.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${x}, ${y})`);
        g.setAttribute("class", "field-player-node");
        g.setAttribute("data-player-id", player.id);
        g.setAttribute("data-side", side);

        const circle = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
        circle.setAttribute("r", "13.5");
        circle.setAttribute("fill", side === "O" ? "#d97706" : "#e11d48");
        circle.setAttribute("stroke", side === "O" ? "#fef08a" : "#fecdd3");
        circle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.2");

        if (this.selectedPlayer && this.selectedPlayer.id === player.id) {
          circle.setAttribute("stroke", "#38bdf8");
          circle.setAttribute("stroke-width", "4");
          circle.setAttribute("filter", "url(#glow-los)");
        }

        const txt = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
        txt.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
        txt.setAttribute("dy", ".35em");
        txt.setAttribute("font-size", player.id.length > 2 ? "8.5" : "9.5");
        txt.setAttribute("font-weight", "900");
        txt.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
        txt.setAttribute("fill", "#ffffff");
        txt.textContent = player.id;

        g.appendChild(circle);
        g.appendChild(txt);

        // Click & Hover Interactivity
        if (this.options.interactive) {
          g.addEventListener("click", () => {
            this.selectPlayer(player.id);
          });
          g.addEventListener("mouseenter", (e) => {
            if (this.options.onPlayerHover) this.options.onPlayerHover(player, side, e);
          });
        }

        return g;
      }

      interpolatePosition(player, progress) {
        if (!this.play) return { x: player.x, y: player.y };

        // If play has discrete keyframe tracks for this player:
        if (this.play.tracks && this.play.tracks[player.id]) {
          const tr = this.play.tracks[player.id];
          return this.interpolateWaypoints(tr, progress);
        }

        // Fallback for players without specific tracks:
        if (progress === 0) return { x: player.x, y: player.y };

        // OL push
        if (player.id.startsWith("L") || player.id.startsWith("R") || player.id === "C") {
          return { x: player.x + progress * 10, y: player.y };
        }
        // QB drop
        if (player.id === "QB") {
          return { x: player.x - progress * 15, y: player.y };
        }

        return { x: player.x, y: player.y };
      }

      interpolateDefensePosition(player, progress) {
        if (this.defense && this.defense.tracks && this.defense.tracks[player.id]) {
          return this.interpolateWaypoints(this.defense.tracks[player.id], progress);
        }
        if (this.play && this.play.defenseTracks && this.play.defenseTracks[player.id]) {
          return this.interpolateWaypoints(this.play.defenseTracks[player.id], progress);
        }
        if (progress === 0) return { x: player.x, y: player.y };

        // Pass Rusher collapses to QB pocket (x=275, y=300)
        if (player.role && (player.role.toLowerCase().includes("rush") || player.role.toLowerCase().includes("blitz"))) {
          return {
            x: player.x + (275 - player.x) * (progress * 0.72),
            y: player.y + (300 - player.y) * (progress * 0.72)
          };
        }

        // Deep zone defenders sink into landmark
        if (player.role && (player.role.toLowerCase().includes("deep") || player.role.toLowerCase().includes("half") || player.role.toLowerCase().includes("post"))) {
          return {
            x: player.x + progress * 45,
            y: player.y
          };
        }

        // Underneath zone defenders react
        return {
          x: player.x + progress * 12,
          y: player.y
        };
      }

      interpolateWaypoints(waypoints, progress) {
        if (!waypoints || waypoints.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
        if (waypoints.length === 1 || progress <= waypoints[0].t) return { x: waypoints[0].x, y: waypoints[0].y };
        if (progress >= waypoints[waypoints.length - 1].t) {
          const last = waypoints[waypoints.length - 1];
          return { x: last.x, y: last.y };
        }

        // Find bounding pair
        for (let i = 0; i < waypoints.length - 1; i++) {
          const p0 = waypoints[i];
          const p1 = waypoints[i + 1];
          if (progress >= p0.t && progress <= p1.t) {
            const span = p1.t - p0.t;
            const localT = span > 0 ? (progress - p0.t) / span : 0;
            return {
              x: p0.x + (p1.x - p0.x) * localT,
              y: p0.y + (p1.y - p0.y) * localT
            };
          }
        }

        return { x: waypoints[0].x, y: waypoints[0].y };
      }

      getPhase(progress) {
        if (this.play && this.play.motion && progress <= 0.18) return "PRE-SNAP MOTION";
        if (progress <= 0.05) return "PRE-SNAP";
        if (progress < 0.25) return "SNAP & RELEASE";
        if (progress < 0.55) return "STEM & MESH";
        if (progress < 0.82) return "TARGET WINDOW";
        return "PLAY RESULT";
      }

      setTime(progress) {
        this.progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1.0, progress));
        this.render();

        const phase = this.getPhase(this.progress);
        if (this.options.onPhaseChange) this.options.onPhaseChange(phase, this.progress);
        if (this.options.onTimeUpdate) this.options.onTimeUpdate(this.progress, phase);
      }

      setSpeed(multiplier) {
        this.speed = parseFloat(multiplier) || 1.0;
      }

      get phase() {
        return this.getPhase(this.progress);
      }

      get currentTime() {
        return this.progress;
      }

      step(delta) {
        this.pause();
        this.setTime(this.progress + delta);
      }

      playSnap() {
        if (this.animating) return;
        this.animating = true;
        this.lastTimestamp = null;
        const effDuration = this.duration / this.speed;

        const frame = (timestamp) => {
          if (!this.lastTimestamp) this.lastTimestamp = timestamp;
          const dt = timestamp - this.lastTimestamp;
          this.lastTimestamp = timestamp;

          this.progress += dt / effDuration;

          if (this.progress >= 1.0) {
            this.progress = 1.0;
            this.setTime(1.0);
            this.animating = false;
            if (this.options.onComplete) this.options.onComplete();
            return;
          }

          this.setTime(this.progress);

          if (this.animating) {
            this.animId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          }
        };

        this.animId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      pause() {
        this.animating = false;
        if (this.animId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.animId);
      }

      reset() {
        this.pause();
        this.setTime(0);
      }

      selectPlayer(playerId) {
        let found = null;
        let unit = 'O';

        if (this.formation && this.formation.players) {
          found = this.formation.players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
        }
        if (!found && this.defense && this.defense.players) {
          found = this.defense.players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
          unit = 'D';
        }

        if (found) {
          this.selectedPlayer = found;
          this.renderPlayers();
          if (this.options.onPlayerSelect) {
            this.options.onPlayerSelect(found, unit, this.play, this.getPhase(this.progress));
          }
        }
      }
    }

// NFL FOOTBALL LAB: PORTAL ENGINE & SMART ROUTING
// Manages initial portal entry, transitions, deep links & navigation states
// ==========================================================================

const PortalEngine = {
  storageKey: 'nfl_portal_entered_v1',
  initialized: false,

  init() {
    this.initialized = true;

    // 1. Check if deep link is present (URL query or hash)
    const deepLinkTab = this.checkDeepLink();
    if (deepLinkTab) {
      this.enter(false, deepLinkTab);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Check session storage: has the user already entered during this browsing session?
    let sessionEntered = false;
    try {
      sessionEntered = typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined' && sessionStorage.getItem(this.storageKey) === 'true';
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Check explicit URL query "?portal=1" to force open portal
    let forcePortal = false;
    try {
      const search = (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location && window.location.search) || '';
      if (search.includes('portal=1') || search.includes('portal=true')) {
        forcePortal = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    if (sessionEntered && !forcePortal) {
      this.enter(false, 'home');
      return;
    }

    // Otherwise show portal view on fresh visit
    this.showPortal();
  },

  checkDeepLink() {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.location) return null;

      const validTabs = ['home', 'learn', 'lab', 'film', 'playbook', 'playbuilder', 'teambuilder', 'stats', 'challenges', 'glossary', 'progress', 'profile'];

      // Check search params (with regex fallback)
      const search = window.location.search || '';
      if (search) {
        let tabParam = null;
        if (typeof URLSearchParams !== 'undefined') {
          try {
            const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(search);
            tabParam = urlParams.get('tab');
          } catch(e) {}
        }
        if (!tabParam) {
          const match = search.match(/[?&]tab=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
          if (match) tabParam = match[1];
        }
        if (tabParam && validTabs.includes(tabParam)) {
          return tabParam;
        }
      }

      // Check hash
      const hash = (window.location.hash || '').replace('#', '').replace('view-', '').trim();
      if (hash && validTabs.includes(hash)) {
        return hash;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return null;
  },

  showPortal() {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    if (document.body && document.body.classList && typeof document.body.classList.add === 'function') {
      document.body.classList.add('portal-active');
    }
    const screen = document.getElementById('portal-entry-screen');
    if (screen) {
      if (screen.classList && typeof screen.classList.remove === 'function') {
        screen.classList.remove('portal-leaving');
      }
      screen.style.display = 'flex';
    }
  },

  enter(animated = true, targetTab = 'home') {
    try {
      if (typeof sessionStorage !== 'undefined') {
        sessionStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, 'true');
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const screen = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.getElementById('portal-entry-screen') : null;
    const prefersReducedMotion = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    const finalize = () => {
      if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.body && document.body.classList && typeof document.body.classList.remove === 'function') {
        document.body.classList.remove('portal-active');
      }
      if (screen) screen.style.display = 'none';
      if (typeof setView === 'function') {
        setView(targetTab);
      }
    };

    if (!animated || prefersReducedMotion || !screen) {
      finalize();
      return;
    }

    // Visual portal reveal exit animation
    if (screen.classList && typeof screen.classList.add === 'function') {
      screen.classList.add('portal-leaving');
    }

    let completed = false;
    const safeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!completed) {
        completed = true;
        finalize();
      }
    }, 280);

    // Also listen to transitionend if supported
    if (typeof screen.addEventListener === 'function') {
      screen.addEventListener('transitionend', function handler(e) {
        if (e.target === screen && !completed) {
          completed = true;
          clearTimeout(safeTimeout);
          screen.removeEventListener('transitionend', handler);
          finalize();
        }
      }, { once: true });
    }
  },

  reopenPortal() {
    this.showPortal();
  },

  isPortalActive() {
    return typeof document !== 'undefined' &&
      document.body &&
      document.body.classList &&
      typeof document.body.classList.contains === 'function' &&
      document.body.classList.contains('portal-active');
  }
};

window.PortalEngine = PortalEngine;




    function setView(tabName) {
      if (tabName === 'portal') {
        if (typeof PortalEngine !== 'undefined') {
          PortalEngine.showPortal();
        }
        return;

      // If portal is currently active and any standard view is requested, deactivate portal cleanly
      if (typeof PortalEngine !== 'undefined' && typeof PortalEngine.isPortalActive === 'function' && PortalEngine.isPortalActive()) {
        if (document.body && document.body.classList && typeof document.body.classList.remove === 'function') {
          document.body.classList.remove('portal-active');
        }
        const pScreen = document.getElementById('portal-entry-screen');
        if (pScreen) pScreen.style.display = 'none';
      }

      // Pause any active background playback/animation to preserve performance and prevent CPU/RAF leaks
      if (typeof playbookEngine !== 'undefined' && playbookEngine && playbookEngine.animating) playbookEngine.pause();

        "was": "Coverage Reading ist die geistige Fähigkeit des Quarterbacks, die gegnerische Verteidigung vor und nach dem Snap zu entschlüsseln. Der Ausgangspunkt ist die Ausrichtung der Safeties: Steht ein Safety tief in der Mitte, ist das Feld 'Closed' (Cover 1 oder Cover 3). Stehen zwei Safeties tief, ist das Feld 'Open' (Cover 2, Quarters oder Cover 6). Die Progression ist die geordnete Reihenfolge, in der der QB seine Receiver absucht.",
        "warum": "NFL-Defenses bewegen sich mit bis zu 35 km/h. Ein QB hat nach dem Snap im Schnitt nur 2.4 bis 2.7 Sekunden bis zum Ballabwurf. Wer erst nach dem Snap anfängt nachzudenken, wird gesackt. Ein präziser Pre-Snap Read eliminiert bereits vor dem Ballkontakt 50% der Routen und lenkt den Fokus auf das vorteilhafte 1-on-1-Duell oder den High-Low-Stresspunkt der Defense.",
        "wann": "Bei jedem Passspielzug. Pre-Snap Read beginnt beim Betreten der Line of Scrimmage (Play Clock 15 bis 0s); Post-Snap Confirm erfolgt im ersten Schritt des Dropbacks.",
        "wie": "<b>1. Pre-Snap Checkliste:</b><br>\n• 1. Safeties zählen: 1 Safety tief = MOFC (Cover 1 / Cover 3). 2 Safeties tief = MOFO (Cover 2 / Cover 4).<br>\n• 2. Cornerback-Alignment: Stehen sie 'Press' (an der Linie) mit den Augen auf dem WR (Man-to-Man)? Oder 'Off' (7 Yards tief) mit den Augen im Backfield (Zone)?<br>\n• 3. Box-Count & Blitz-Gefahr: Wie viele Verteidiger stehen in der Box? Zeigt ein Linebacker oder Nickel-DB 'Creeping' zur Line of Scrimmage?<br><br>\n<b>2. Post-Snap Confirm (Die ersten 0.5 Sekunden):</b><br>\n• Fällt der Single-High Safety zur Seite ab (Safety Rotation zu Cover 3 Cloud oder Cover 6)?<br>\n• Bleiben die Cornerbacks tief ('Bail') oder attackieren sie die Flat ('Hard Corner' in Cover 2)?<br><br>\n<b>3. Progression Execution:</b><br>\n• Read 1 (Alert/Shot): Wenn 1-on-1 vorteilhaft und Coverage passt -> Ball sofort raus auf den ersten Plant Foot.<br>\n• Read 2 (Primary Concept): Hook/Curl oder Out-Route am Break-Point attackieren.<br>\n• Read 3 (Checkdown): Running Back im Flat oder Crossing Over the Middle als sicherer Raumgewinn.",
        "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Staring down the receiver' (QB starrt nur auf seinen Lieblingsreceiver; Free Safety springt die Route ab); 'Ignoring the Post-Snap Rotation' (Pre-Snap sah es nach Cover 2 aus, nach dem Snap rotiert die Defense in Cover 3 und interceptet die Seam Route).<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Disguised Defenses fälschen 2-High vor und rollen in 1-High Blitz, um den QB unvorbereitet zu treffen.",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Extreme Disguise-Dichte (Fangio/Macdonald-Trees); Pre-Snap-Looks lügen zu 60%. QBs müssen 'Post-Snap Processor' sein.<br>• <i>College:</i> Oft 'Half-Field Reads' (nur linke oder rechte Seite lesen) oder pure RPO-Entscheidungen (Read an den End-Man auf der Line).<br>• <i>Jugend:</i> Einfache 2-Mann-Konzepte schulen (Smash = Corner/Hitch; Flood = Go/Out/Flat).         "warum": "Ein Running Back, der im Passblock versagt, gefährdet die Gesundheit seines Quarterbacks.         "wann": "Bei Passspielzügen aus Shotgun oder Pistol. Typisch bei 3rd & Long oder im 2-Minute Drill.",
        "wie": "<b>1. Scan & Blitz Pick-up:</b><br>\n• Pre-Snap-Identifikation des zugewiesenen Spielers (z.B. 'Mike Linebacker to Sam' je nach Protection Call).<br>\n• Bei Snap: 'Inside-Out'-Scan. Erst die A- und B-Gaps sichern, dann nach außen schauen.<br>\n• Nicht in den Schoß des QBs zurückweichen! 2 Schritte nach vorne machen und den Kontakt vor der Pocket suchen.<br><br>\n<b>2. Der Strike & Anchor:</b><br>\n• Athletic Base mit tiefem Schwerpunkt einnehmen.<br>\n• Schlag mit beiden Handflächen direkt in das Brustbein des Blitzers ('Punch inside the numbers').<br>\n• Füße weiter bewegen ('Keep feet churning') – niemals stehen bleiben oder nach hinten springen.<br><br>\n<b>3. Check-and-Release Route:</b><br>\n• Kommt kein Blitzer? Sofort in die Route entlassen ('Release').<br>\n• <i>Texas Angle Route:</i> 3 Schritte Richtung Flat antäuschen (LB folgt nach außen), scharfer 45-Grad-Cut nach innen in den verwaisten Raum hinter dem Tackle.",
        "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Ole-Blocking' (Versuch, den Blitzer mit der Schulter im Vorbeilaufen wegzustoßen); 'Eyes locked outside' (A-Gap-Blitzer übersehen); 'Dropping the ball' (vor dem Fang bereits downfield schauen).<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Defensive Coordinator schicken 'Green Dog Blitzes' (LB blitzt sofort, wenn der RB in Pass Pro blockiert).",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Pass Protection ist die Eintrittskarte für Spielzeit.         "warum": "Defenses agieren nach mathematischen Zonen- und Match-Regeln. Ein Zonen-Linebacker kann nur entweder den kurzen Checkdown decken ODER die tiefe Dig-Route verteidigen. Wenn das Spacing stimmt, MUSS er sich für einen entscheiden – und der QB wirft auf den anderen. Ist das Spacing unsauber (z.B. zwei Receiver laufen 2 Yards aneinander vorbei), kann ein einzelner Safety beide mit Leichtigkeit verteidigen.",
        "wann": "Bei der Offseason-Playbook-Entwicklung und gezielten Gameplan-Anpassung.",
        "wie": "<b>1. Die 3 großen Design-Prinzipien:</b><br>\n• <b>High-Low (Vertikaler Konflikt):</b> Z.B. Smash-Konzept (Hitch auf 5 Yards + Corner auf 12 Yards). Der Zonen-Cornerback kann nicht beides decken.<br>\n• <b>Horizontal Stretch:</b> Z.B. Flood- oder Sail-Konzept (3 Receiver auf verschiedenen Tiefen an einer Seitenlinie). Überlastet Zonen wie Cover 3.<br>\n• <b>Mesh / Man Beater:</b> Zwei sich kreuzende flache Drags ('Rub / Natural Pick') erzeugen Verwirrung gegen Man-to-Man.<br><br>\n<b>2. Protection Rules festlegen:</b><br>\n• <i>Half-Slide Protection:</i> Tackle und Guard blocken Mann-gegen-Mann auf der Play-Side; Center, Backside Guard und Backside Tackle sliden als 3-Mann-Zone zur anderen Seite.<br>\n• <i>Hot Reads / Sight Adjustments:</i> Wenn mehr Blitzer kommen als Blocker da sind ('Cover 0 Blitz'), muss der Receiver seine Route blitzschnell zu einem Slant oder Quick Hitch verkürzen.<br><br>\n<b>3. Answers for everything:</b><br>\n• Jeder gecallte Passspielzug muss eine Antwort gegen Single-High (Cover 1/3) UND eine Antwort gegen Two-High (Cover 2/4) enthalten.",
        "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Spacing Collisions' (zwei Receiver laufen in denselben Raum); Keine Absicherung gegen Blitzes (kein Hot Read für den QB eingeplant); Spielzüge entwerfen, die 3.5 Sekunden Zeit in der Pocket erfordern, obwohl die eigene O-Line nur 2.2 Sekunden halten kann.<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Disziplinierte Safeties springen bei schlechtem Spacing dazwischen und erzielen leichte Interceptions.",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Hochkomplexe Choice- und Option-Routen, bei denen WR und QB dieselbe Coverage post-snap lesen müssen.<br>• <i>College:</i> Enormes Tempo ('Tempo Spread') mit vereinfachten Half-Field-Reads.<br>• <i>Jugend & Amateure:</i> Klare, unverrückbare Routenregeln! 'Du brichst bei exakt 10 Yards nach außen ab, kein Zögern!' Option-Routen führen im Jugendfootball zu 80% zu Missverständnissen und Interceptions.",
        "praxisFall": "<b>Praxisfall: Zerstörung von Cover 3 mit dem 'Dagger'-Konzept</b><br>Die gegnerische Defense spielt stur Cover 3 mit einem tiefen Free Safety in der Mitte.<br><i>Play Design:</i> Außenreceiver läuft eine tiefe vertikale 'Seam / Clear-Out'-Route. Dies zwingt den Free Safety und den Cornerback dazu, mit ihm tief mitzulaufen. Der Slot Receiver läuft einen 15-Yard-Dig (In-Route) direkt in den verwaisten Raum hinter den Zonen-Linebackern. Perfektes Spacing, einfacher 18-Yard-Raumgewinn!",
        "playDesignOrFilmTask": "<b>Coaching-Aufgabe:</b> Baue im Play Builder das klassische 'Smash-Konzept' (Corner Route + Hitch Route) gegen Cover 2 auf. Prüfe, wie der Cornerback in den High-Low-Konflikt gerät.",

        "was": "Defensive Scheme Design ist das strategische Schachspiel zur Neutralisierung der Offense.         "warum": "Statische Coverages werden von modernen Quarterbacks mit Leichtigkeit seziert: Cover 3 ist anfällig gegen Four Verticals und Seams; Cover 2 hat ein riesiges Loch in der tiefen Mitte. Quarters zur starken Seite mit 3 Receivern und Cover 2 zur isolierten Seite), wodurch alle Schwachstellen eliminiert werden.",
        "wann": "Bei jedem Defensive Call gegen moderne 11- und 12-Personnel Spread Offenses.",
        "wie": "<b>1. Die Wahl der Front:</b><br>\n• <i>4-3 Over Front:</i> 3-Technique DT auf der Strong Side (außen am Guard) für maximale Penetration; gut gegen Inside Zone.<br>\n• <i>3-4 Tite / Mint Front:</i> 4i-Techniques auf beiden Innenschultern der Tackles. Macht B-Gaps dicht und zwingt Läufe nach außen in die Safeties.<br><br>\n<b>2. Pattern Matching Regeln (Cover 4 Match):</b><br>\n• <i>MEG (Man Everywhere he Goes):</i> Der Cornerback deckt Receiver #1 man-to-man, egal wohin er läuft.<br>\n• <i>MOD (Man Other than Down):</i> CB deckt #1 nur, wenn er tief läuft; bricht #1 flach nach innen ab, übergibt der CB ihn an den Linebacker und übernimmt die Route von Receiver #2.<br><br>\n<b>3. Simulated Pressures:</b><br>\n• Zeige vor dem Snap einen aggressiven 6-Mann-Blitz an der Line.<br>\n• Beim Snap rushen jedoch nur 4 Spieler (ein Linebacker blitzt, dafür lässt sich ein D-End in die Passzone fallen).<br>\n• Ergebnis: Maximaler Schutz (7 Spieler in Coverage) bei gleichzeitiger Verwirrung der gegnerischen O-Line-Protection.",
        "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Blowing Coverage durch Match-Fehler' (Verteidiger denkt es ist Zone, der andere denkt Man); Fehlende Disziplin in der Gap-Verantwortung bei Front-Stunts; Zu viele Blitzes gegen mobile Quarterbacks (öffnet Fluchtwege für QB-Scrambles).<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Offenses nutzen Motion, um Match-Regeln zu brechen und ungedeckte Receiver zu finden.",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Nahezu 80% aller Teams nutzen Two-High Split-Field Shells und komplexe Disguises.<br>• <i>College:</i> Hohe Dichte an Quarters Match (Nick Sabans System).<br>• <i>Jugend & Amateure:</i> Vorsicht vor Überkomplexität!         "praxisFall": "<b>Praxisfall: Neutralisierung von Trips mit Cover 6</b><br>Die Offense stellt 3 Wide Receiver auf die weite Feldseite (Trips Right) und einen isolierten X-Receiver nach links.<br><i>Defensive Call:</i> 'Cover 6 (Quarter-Quarter-Half)'. Auf der 3-Receiver-Seite spielen CB und Safety Cover 4 (Quarters Match), um die drei vertikalen Routen 3-gegen-3 abzusichern. Auf der isolierten Seite spielen CB und Safety Cover 2 mit Safety-Help über die Spitze gegen den X-Receiver. Keine Lücke für die Offense!",

        "was": "Gameplanning ist der akribische Prozess, einen spezifischen Schlachtplan für den nächsten Gegner zu entwickeln.         "warum": "Football ist geprägt von Gewohnheiten. Coaches und Spieler greifen unter Druck fast immer auf das zurück, was sie am besten kennen.         "wann": "Von Dienstag bis Freitag jeder Spielwoche.",
        "wie": "<b>1. Das Call Sheet aufbauen:</b><br>\n• Das Call Sheet enthält ca. 35 bis 50 Spielzüge, unterteilt in Boxen (z.B. 'Attack the Weak Link':</b><br>\n• Hat der gegnerische Right Tackle schwache Füße? Platziere deinen besten Pass Rusher über ihm.<br>\n• Spielt der gegnerische Backup-Cornerback? Attackiere ihn mit 5 vertikalen Pässen im ersten Quarter.",
        "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Analysis Paralysis' (Staff ertrinkt in 500 Statistiken und überfordert die eigenen Spieler mit einem 80-seitigen Gameplan); Den Self-Scout vergessen (der Gegner weiß genau, welche Plays man selbst am liebsten callt); Zu späte Fertigstellung des Gameplans (Spieler können ihn nicht mehr im Training verinnerlichen).<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Gute Gegner brechen gezielt mit ihren Tendenzen ('Tendency Breakers'), um spionierende Teams in Fallen zu locken.",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Ganze Abteilungen von Quality-Control-Coaches und Datenanalysten liefern automatisierte Berichte.<br>• <i>College:</i> Enormer Scouting-Aufwand bei gegnerischen Signalen und Tempi.<br>• <i>Jugend & Amateure:</i> 1 bis 2 Spiele analysieren reicht vollkommen!         "praxisFall": "<b>Praxisfall: Der 3rd-Down-Tendency-Schlag</b><br>Dein Scouting-Report zeigt: Der Gegner spielt bei 3rd & 7+ zu 88% Cover 2 Man Under mit tiefen Safeties.<br><i>Gameplan-Antwort:</i> Gegen Cover 2 Man callst du keinen tiefen Pass, sondern ein 'Mesh-Konzept' mit zwei kreuzenden Drag-Routen und schickst deinen Running Back auf eine Texas-Route über die Mitte.         "warum": "Unter dem Schock des Spielbeginns treffen menschliche Gehirne unüberlegte Entscheidungen. Ein Script nimmt dem Playcaller die Panik und zwingt ihn zur methodischen Diagnose. Erfolgreiches Playcalling baut aufeinander auf: Du läufst viermal denselben Inside Zone Run aus derselben Formation, bis der Safety auf den Run committet – und schlägst dann mit dem Play-Action-Deep-Pass über seinen Kopf zu ('Setting up the punch').",
        "wann": "Während des laufenden Spiels von Drive zu Drive.",
        "wie": "<b>1.         "fehler": "<b>Häufige Fehler:</b> 'Abandoning the Run too early' (nach zwei gestoppten Läufen sofort das Laufspiel komplett aufgeben; Defense kann blind Pass-Rush spielen); Emotionales Rache-Calling ('Wir müssen diesen Fehler sofort wiedergutmachen'); Das Headset überlasten mit zu langen Playcalls, die der QB in der Crowd nicht versteht.<br><b>Gegnerische Ausnutzung:</b> Clevere Defensiv-Koordinatoren täuschen im ersten Drive Schwächen vor, um den OC in eine Falle zu locken.",
        "levelDiff": "<b>Level-Unterschiede:</b><br>• <i>NFL:</i> Helm-Funk zum Quarterback schaltet exakt bei 15 Sekunden auf der Play Clock ab; Playcalls müssen in unter 8 Sekunden gesprochen werden.<br>• <i>College:</i> Große Signaltafeln und Handzeichen an der Sideline.<br>• <i>Jugend & Amateure:</i> Halte die Namen kurz!     function quiz() {
      document.querySelectorAll(".q").forEach(d => {
        try {
          const q = JSON.parse(d.dataset.q);
          d.innerHTML = '<h3>Quiz & Selbsttest</h3>' + q.map(x =>
            `<details><summary>${x[0]}</summary><p><b>${x[1]}</b></p><p>${x[2]}</p></details>`
          ).join('');
        } catch (e) { }
      });
    }

    function sim() {
      const s = $("#ck");
      if (!s) return;
      s.innerHTML = Object.keys(CK).map(k => `<option>${k}</option>`).join('');
      const u = () => {
        const r = CK[s.value];
        if (r) {
          $("#ckr").innerHTML = `<p><b>Game Clock:</b> ${r[0]}</p><p><b>Play Clock:</b> ${r[1]}</p>`;
        }
      };
      s.onchange = u;
      u();
    }

    let activeLearnPath = "general";
    try {
      const savedPath = localStorage.getItem("nfl_active_learn_path");
      if (savedPath && ["general", "player", "coach"].includes(savedPath)) {
        activeLearnPath = savedPath;
      }
    } catch (e) { }

    let curPlayerModuleId = "player_fundamentals_safety";
    let curCoachModuleId = "coach_philosophy_identity";
    let activePlayerFilter = "all";
    let activeCoachFilter = "all";

    let donePlayerModules = {};
    try { donePlayerModules = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("nfl_player_progress") || "{}"); } catch (e) { }

    let doneCoachModules = {};
    try { doneCoachModules = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("nfl_coach_progress") || "{}"); } catch (e) { }

    function getPathProgressCounts() {
      const genDone = Object.keys(doneLessons).filter(k => doneLessons[k]).length;
      const playDone = Object.keys(donePlayerModules).filter(k => donePlayerModules[k]).length;
      const coachDone = Object.keys(doneCoachModules).filter(k => doneCoachModules[k]).length;
      return {
        general: { done: genDone, total: L.length },
        player: { done: playDone, total: PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.length },
        coach: { done: coachDone, total: COACH_LEARNING_DATA.length },
        totalDone: genDone + playDone + coachDone,
        totalAll: L.length + PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.length + COACH_LEARNING_DATA.length
      };
    }

    function updateLearnPathBadges() {
      const p = getPathProgressCounts();
      const bGen = document.getElementById("path-badge-general");
      if (bGen) bGen.textContent = `${p.general.done} / ${p.general.total}`;
      const bPlay = document.getElementById("path-badge-player");
      if (bPlay) bPlay.textContent = `${p.player.done} / ${p.player.total}`;
      const bCoach = document.getElementById("path-badge-coach");
      if (bCoach) bCoach.textContent = `${p.coach.done} / ${p.coach.total}`;
      const bPlan = document.getElementById("path-badge-training-plan");
      if (bPlan && window.TrainingPlanEngine) {
        const stats = window.TrainingPlanEngine.getWeekStats(window.TrainingPlanEngine.state.currentWeek);
        bPlan.textContent = `Woche ${window.TrainingPlanEngine.state.currentWeek} (${stats.percent}%)`;
      }

      const globalStats = document.getElementById("learn-paths-global-stats");
      if (globalStats) {
        const pct = Math.round((p.totalDone / p.totalAll) * 100);
        globalStats.innerHTML = `
      <div class="learn-global-stat-item">
        <span class="learn-stat-val">${p.totalDone} / ${p.totalAll}</span>
        <span class="learn-stat-lbl">Module gemeistert (${pct}%)</span>
      </div>
      <div class="learn-global-stat-bar">
        <div class="learn-global-stat-fill" style="width: ${pct}%;"></div>
      </div>
    `;
      }
    }

    function switchLearnPath(pathId, targetModuleId) {
      if (!["general", "player", "coach", "training_plan"].includes(pathId)) pathId = "general";
      activeLearnPath = pathId;
      try { localStorage.setItem("nfl_active_learn_path", pathId); } catch (e) { }

      document.querySelectorAll(".learn-path-tab").forEach(tab => {
        tab.classList.toggle("active", tab.dataset.path === pathId);
      });

      const wrap = document.querySelector("#view-learn .wrap");
      const tpContainer = document.getElementById("training-plan-container");

      if (pathId === "training_plan") {
        if (wrap) wrap.style.display = "none";
        if (tpContainer) {
          tpContainer.style.display = "block";
          if (window.TrainingPlanEngine && typeof window.TrainingPlanEngine.render === "function") {
            window.TrainingPlanEngine.render();
          }
        }
      } else {
        if (wrap) wrap.style.display = "";
        if (tpContainer) tpContainer.style.display = "none";

        renderLearnFilterBar();
        renderNav();

        if (pathId === "general") {
          let idx = curLesson;
          if (typeof targetModuleId === "number") idx = targetModuleId;
          show(idx);
        } else if (pathId === "player") {
          let modId = targetModuleId || curPlayerModuleId || PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA[0].id;
          showPlayerModule(modId);
        } else if (pathId === "coach") {
          let modId = targetModuleId || curCoachModuleId || COACH_LEARNING_DATA[0].id;
          showCoachModule(modId);
        }
      }
      updateLearnPathBadges();
    }

    function renderLearnFilterBar() {
      const bar = document.getElementById("learn-filter-bar");
      if (!bar) return;

      if (activeLearnPath === "general") {
        bar.innerHTML = `
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="all">Alle</button>
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === '1' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="1">Lvl 1</button>
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === '2' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="2">Lvl 2</button>
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === '3' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="3">Lvl 3</button>
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === '4' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="4">Lvl 4</button>
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeLevelFilter === '5' ? 'active' : ''}" data-lvl="5">Lvl 5</button>
    `;
        bar.querySelectorAll("button[data-lvl]").forEach(btn => {
          btn.onclick = () => {
            bar.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
            btn.classList.add("active");
            activeLevelFilter = btn.dataset.lvl;
            renderNav();
          };
        });
      } else if (activeLearnPath === "player") {
        let chips = `<button class="filter-chip ${activePlayerFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" data-pcat="all">Alle</button>`;
        const cats = [
          { id: "fundamentals", label: "Fundamentals" },
          { id: "quarterback", label: "QB" },
          { id: "runningback", label: "RB" },
          { id: "receivers", label: "WR / TE" },
          { id: "offensive_line", label: "OL" },
          { id: "defensive_line", label: "DL" },
          { id: "linebacker", label: "LB" },
          { id: "defensive_backs", label: "DB" },
          { id: "special_teams_unit", label: "Special Teams" }
        ];
        chips += cats.map(c => `
      <button class="filter-chip ${activePlayerFilter === c.id ? 'active' : ''}" data-pcat="${c.id}">${c.label}</button>
    `).join("");
        bar.innerHTML = chips;
        bar.querySelectorAll("button[data-pcat]").forEach(btn => {
          btn.onclick = () => {
            bar.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
            btn.classList.add("active");
            activePlayerFilter = btn.dataset.pcat;
            renderNav();
          };
        });
      } else if (activeLearnPath === "coach") {
        let chips = `<button class="filter-chip ${activeCoachFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" data-ccat="all">Alle</button>`;
        const cats = [
          { id: "philosophie_staff", label: "Philosophie & Staff" },
          { id: "roster_schemes", label: "Roster & Schemen" },
          { id: "scouting_film", label: "Scouting & Film" },
          { id: "in_game_tactics", label: "In-Game Taktik" },
          { id: "practice_development", label: "Training & Kultur" }
        ];
        chips += cats.map(c => `
      <button class="filter-chip ${activeCoachFilter === c.id ? 'active' : ''}" data-ccat="${c.id}">${c.label}</button>
    `).join("");
        bar.innerHTML = chips;
        bar.querySelectorAll("button[data-ccat]").forEach(btn => {
          btn.onclick = () => {
            bar.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
            btn.classList.add("active");
            activeCoachFilter = btn.dataset.ccat;
            renderNav();
          };
        });
      }
    }

    function renderNav() {
      const tree = $("#nav-tree");
      if (!tree) return;

      if (activeLearnPath === "general") {
        const levels = activeLevelFilter === "all" ? [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] : [parseInt(activeLevelFilter)];

        tree.innerHTML = levels.map(v => {
          const lessonsInLevel = L.map((l, i) => ({ ...l, originalIdx: i })).filter(l => l.lv === v);
          if (!lessonsInLevel.length) return "";
          return `
        <h4>Level ${v}</h4>
        ${lessonsInLevel.map(l => `
          <a data-i="${l.originalIdx}" class="${l.originalIdx === curLesson ? 'on' : ''}${doneLessons[l.originalIdx] ? ' done' : ''}">
            ${l.t}
          </a>
        `).join('')}
      `;
        }).join('') + `
      <h4>Direkt-Aktionen</h4>
      <a onclick="setView('lab')">📋 Zum Football Lab</a>
      <a onclick="openChallengesSubtab('trainer')">🎯 Coverage Trainer</a>
      <a onclick="setView('glossary')">📖 Zum Glossar</a>
    `;
      } else if (activeLearnPath === "player") {
        let filteredCategories = PLAYER_CATEGORIES;
        if (activePlayerFilter !== "all") {
          filteredCategories = PLAYER_CATEGORIES.filter(c => c.id === activePlayerFilter);
        }

        tree.innerHTML = filteredCategories.map(cat => {
          const mods = PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.filter(m => m.category === cat.id);
          if (!mods.length) return "";
          return `
        <h4>${cat.title}</h4>
        ${mods.map(m => {
            const isDone = !!donePlayerModules[m.id];
            const isOn = m.id === curPlayerModuleId;
            return `
            <a onclick="showPlayerModule('${m.id}')" class="${isOn ? 'on' : ''}${isDone ? ' done' : ''}">
              ${m.title}
            </a>
          `;
          }).join('')}
      `;
        }).join('') + `
      <h4>Ausbildungs-Aktionen</h4>
      <a onclick="setView('pbuilder')">📐 Zum Play Builder</a>
      <a onclick="setView('playbook')">📖 Zum Playbook</a>
    `;
      } else if (activeLearnPath === "coach") {
        let filteredCategories = COACH_CATEGORIES;
        if (activeCoachFilter !== "all") {
          filteredCategories = COACH_CATEGORIES.filter(c => c.id === activeCoachFilter);
        }

        tree.innerHTML = filteredCategories.map(cat => {
          const mods = COACH_LEARNING_DATA.filter(m => m.category === cat.id);
          if (!mods.length) return "";
          return `
        <h4>${cat.title}</h4>
        ${mods.map(m => {
            const isDone = !!doneCoachModules[m.id];
            const isOn = m.id === curCoachModuleId;
            return `
            <a onclick="showCoachModule('${m.id}')" class="${isOn ? 'on' : ''}${isDone ? ' done' : ''}">
              ${m.title}
            </a>
          `;
          }).join('')}
      `;
        }).join('') + `
      <h4>Coach-Aktionen</h4>
      <a onclick="openChallengesSubtab('coach')">🧠 What Would You Call?</a>
      <a onclick="setView('statslab')">📊 Zum Stats Lab</a>
      <a onclick="setView('film')">🎥 Zum Film Room</a>
    `;
      }
    }

    function jumpCrossPerspective(pathId, targetId) {
      switchLearnPath(pathId, targetId);
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }

    function getCrossPerspectiveHtml(path, currentId) {
      let pers = null;
      if (path === "general") {
        pers = GENERAL_CROSS_PERSPECTIVES[currentId];
        if (!pers) return "";
        return `
      <div class="cross-perspectives-box">
        <div class="cp-title"><span class="cp-icon">🔄</span> Weiterführende Perspektiven zu diesem Thema</div>
        <p class="cp-desc">Vertiefe das Gelernte aus der Sicht der aktiven Spieler und des Coaching-Staffs:</p>
        <div class="cp-grid">
          ${pers.player ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-player" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('player', '${pers.player.id}')">
              <span class="cp-badge">🏈 Spielerausbildung</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${pers.player.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Technik & Drills ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
          ${pers.coach ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-coach" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('coach', '${pers.coach.id}')">
              <span class="cp-badge">🧠 Coachausbildung</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${pers.coach.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Schemes & Playcalling ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      } else if (path === "player") {
        const mod = PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.find(m => m.id === currentId);
        if (!mod || !mod.crossPerspectives) return "";
        const cp = mod.crossPerspectives;
        return `
      <div class="cross-perspectives-box">
        <div class="cp-title"><span class="cp-icon">🔄</span> Weiterführende Perspektiven zu diesem Thema</div>
        <p class="cp-desc">Verbinde die technische Ausführung mit dem theoretischen Fundament und der Coaching-Strategie:</p>
        <div class="cp-grid">
          ${cp.general ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-general" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('general', ${cp.general.lessonIdx})">
              <span class="cp-badge">📖 Allgemeines Wissen</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${cp.general.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Regeln & Grundlagen ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
          ${cp.coach ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-coach" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('coach', '${cp.coach.moduleId}')">
              <span class="cp-badge">🧠 Coachausbildung</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${cp.coach.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Playcalling & Scheme ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      } else if (path === "coach") {
        const mod = COACH_LEARNING_DATA.find(m => m.id === currentId);
        if (!mod || !mod.crossPerspectives) return "";
        const cp = mod.crossPerspectives;
        return `
      <div class="cross-perspectives-box">
        <div class="cp-title"><span class="cp-icon">🔄</span> Weiterführende Perspektiven zu diesem Thema</div>
        <p class="cp-desc">Betrachte die strategische Planung aus der Perspektive der Spieler-Ausführung und des Regelwerks:</p>
        <div class="cp-grid">
          ${cp.general ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-general" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('general', ${cp.general.lessonIdx})">
              <span class="cp-badge">📖 Allgemeines Wissen</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${cp.general.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Taktik-Theorie ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
          ${cp.player ? `
            <div class="cp-card cp-card-player" onclick="jumpCrossPerspective('player', '${cp.player.moduleId}')">
              <span class="cp-badge">🏈 Spielerausbildung</span>
              <div class="cp-card-label">${cp.player.label}</div>
              <span class="cp-link-arrow">Positionstechnik & Footwork ansehen →</span>
            </div>
          ` : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }
      return "";
    }

    function show(i) {
      curLesson = i;
      activeLearnPath = "general";
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);

      const l = L[i];
      doneLessons[i] = 1;
      try { localStorage.setItem("nfl", JSON.stringify(doneLessons)); } catch (e) { }
      updateMasteryBadge();
      updateLearnPathBadges();

      const m = $("#m");
      if (!m) return;
      m.innerHTML = `
    <div class="learn-module-header">
      <div class="learn-module-meta-row">
        <span class="lv">Level ${l.lv} · Allgemeines Football-Wissen</span>
        <span class="learn-read-time">📖 Lektion ${i + 1} von ${L.length}</span>
      </div>
      <h1 class="learn-module-title">${l.t}</h1>
    </div>
    ${getLabJumpHtml(i)}
    ${wl(l.h)}
    ${getCrossPerspectiveHtml("general", i)}
    <div class="nx">
      <button ${i ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="show(${i - 1})">← Zurück</button>
      <button ${i < L.length - 1 ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="show(${i + 1})">Weiter →</button>
    </div>
  `;
      quiz();
      sim();
      renderNav();
    }

    function showPlayerModule(moduleId) {
      curPlayerModuleId = moduleId;
      activeLearnPath = "player";
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);

      const mod = PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.find(m => m.id === moduleId) || PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA[0];
      donePlayerModules[mod.id] = 1;
      try { localStorage.setItem("nfl_player_progress", JSON.stringify(donePlayerModules)); } catch (e) { }
      updateMasteryBadge();
      updateLearnPathBadges();

      const m = $("#m");
      if (!m) return;

      const curIdx = PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.findIndex(x => x.id === mod.id);
      const prevMod = curIdx > 0 ? PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA[curIdx - 1] : null;
      const nextMod = curIdx < PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.length - 1 ? PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA[curIdx + 1] : null;

      let toolHtml = "";

        toolHtml = `

      let drillsHtml = "";

              <div class="drill-field drill-criterion"><b>✅ Überprüfbares Lernziel:</b> ${d.criterion}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    `;
      }

      let quizHtml = "";
      if (mod.quiz && mod.quiz.length) {
        quizHtml = `
      <div class="q" data-q='${JSON.stringify(mod.quiz.map(q => [q.q, q.a, q.exp]))}'></div>

      }

      m.innerHTML = `
    <div class="learn-module-header">

        <span class="player-pos-badge">🏈 ${mod.positions.join(', ')}</span>
        <span class="learn-diff-badge">${mod.difficulty}</span>
        <span class="learn-read-time">⏱️ ${mod.readTime} Lesezeit</span>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="objectives-box">
      <div class="objectives-title"><span class="obj-icon">🎯</span> Lernziele dieses Moduls</div>
      <ul class="objectives-list">
        ${mod.objectives.map(o => `<li>${o}</li>`).join('')}
      </ul>
    </div>

    ${toolHtml}

    <div class="pedagogical-grid">
      <div class="pedagogical-card card-was">
        <div class="pc-header"><span class="pc-icon">📌</span> WAS IST ES?</div>
        <div class="pc-content">${mod.was}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pedagogical-card card-warum">
        <div class="pc-header"><span class="pc-icon">💡</span> WARUM FUNKTIONIERT ES?</div>
        <div class="pc-content">${mod.warum}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pedagogical-card card-wann">

      <button ${nextMod ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="showPlayerModule('${nextMod ? nextMod.id : ''}')">Nächstes Modul →</button>
    </div>
  `;

      renderNav();

      <div class="pedagogical-card card-wie">

        <div class="pc-content">${mod.wie}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pedagogical-card card-fehler">
        <div class="pc-header"><span class="pc-icon">⚠️</span> TYPISCHE COACHING-FEHLER & GEGENMASSNAHMEN</div>
        <div class="pc-content">${mod.fehler}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="pedagogical-card card-level">
        <div class="pc-header"><span class="pc-icon">🛡️</span> LEVEL-UNTERSCHIEDE (NFL VS. COLLEGE VS. AMATEURE)</div>
        <div class="pc-content">${mod.levelDiff}</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    ${praxisHtml}
    ${taskHtml}

    ${getCrossPerspectiveHtml("coach", mod.id)}

    ${quizHtml}

    <div class="nx">
      <button ${prevMod ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="showCoachModule('${prevMod ? prevMod.id : ''}')">← Vorheriges Modul</button>
      <button ${nextMod ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="showCoachModule('${nextMod ? nextMod.id : ''}')">Nächstes Modul →</button>
    </div>
  `;
      quiz();
      renderNav();
    }


    /* ==================== 4. FILM ROOM MODULE ==================== */
    function renderFilmRoom() {
      const grid = $("#film-grid");
      if (!grid) return;

      grid.innerHTML = NFL_DATA.filmRoomBreakdowns.map(f => `
    <div class="film-card">
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
        <span class="film-badge">${f.category}</span>
        <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--mut);">${f.coach}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="film-title">${f.title}</div>
      <div class="film-body">${f.philosophy}</div>
      <div class="film-focus-box">
        <div class="film-focus-title">All-22 Film Scouting Fokus</div>
        <div>${f.all22Focus}</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-play" style="align-self:flex-start; margin-top:4px;" 
        onclick="openLabPreset('${f.preset.form}', '${f.preset.play}', '${f.preset.def}')">
        ⚡ Taktik im Football Lab simulieren
      </button>
    </div>
  `).join('');
    }

    /* ==================== PLAYBOOK & PLAY SIMULATOR JAVASCRIPT ==================== */
    let playbookEngine = null;
    let pbActiveSide = 'O'; // 'O' or 'D'
    let pbActiveCategory = 'all';
    let pbActivePersonnel = 'all';
    let pbSearchQuery = '';
    let pbActiveId = 'inside_zone';
    let pbCompareIdA = 'mesh';
    let pbCompareIdB = 'cover_2';

    const PB_CATEGORIES_O = [
      { key: 'all', label: 'Alle Offense (20)' },
      { key: 'run', label: 'Laufspiel (7)' },
      { key: 'pass', label: 'Pass-Konzepte (9)' },
      { key: 'play_action', label: 'Play Action (1)' },
      { key: 'rpo', label: 'RPO (1)' },
      { key: 'screen', label: 'Screen (1)' },
      { key: 'qb_run', label: 'QB Run (1)' }
    ];

    const PB_CATEGORIES_D = [
      { key: 'all', label: 'Alle Defense (9)' },
      { key: 'man_coverage', label: 'Man Coverage (2)' },
      { key: 'zone_coverage', label: 'Zone Coverage (4)' },
      { key: 'blitz', label: 'Blitz (1)' },
      { key: 'sim_pressure', label: 'Sim Pressure (1)' },
      { key: 'run_defense', label: 'Run Defense (1)' }
    ];

    function initPlaybook() {
      if (playbookEngine) return;

      const svg = document.getElementById("playbook-field-svg");
      if (!svg) return;

      playbookEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("playbook-field-svg", {
        showRoutes: true,
        showZones: true,
        showRush: true,
        showLabels: true,
        showTarget: true,
        viewMode: 'tactical',
        interactive: true,
        onPhaseChange: (phase, progress) => {
          const b = $("#pb-phase-badge");
          if (b) b.textContent = `🏈 ${phase}`;
        },
        onTimeUpdate: (progress, phase) => {
          const sc = $("#pb-field-scrubber");
          if (sc && !playbookEngine.isScrubbing) sc.value = Math.round(progress * 100);
          const to = $("#pb-time-readout");
          if (to) to.textContent = `${(progress * 3.2).toFixed(1)}s / 3.2s`;
        },
        onComplete: () => {
          const btn = $("#pb-btn-play");
          if (btn) btn.textContent = "▶ Play";
        }
      });

      // Playbook Controls Wiring
      $("#pb-btn-play").onclick = () => {
        if (playbookEngine.animating) {
          playbookEngine.pause();
          $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
        } else {
          playbookEngine.playSnap();
          $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "⏸ Pause";
        }
      };

      $("#pb-btn-pause").onclick = () => {
        playbookEngine.pause();
        $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
      };

      $("#pb-btn-step-back").onclick = () => {
        playbookEngine.step(-0.05);
        $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
      };

      $("#pb-btn-step-fwd").onclick = () => {
        playbookEngine.step(0.05);
        $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
      };

      $("#pb-btn-reset").onclick = () => {
        playbookEngine.reset();
        $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
      };

      const scrubber = $("#pb-field-scrubber");
      if (scrubber) {
        scrubber.onmousedown = () => { playbookEngine.isScrubbing = true; };
        scrubber.onmouseup = () => { playbookEngine.isScrubbing = false; };
        scrubber.oninput = e => {
          playbookEngine.pause();
          $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
          playbookEngine.setTime(e.target.value / 100);
        };
      }

      const selSpeed = $("#pb-sel-speed");
      if (selSpeed) {
        selSpeed.onchange = e => {
          playbookEngine.setSpeed(parseFloat(e.target.value));
        };
      }

      const selPers = $("#pb-sel-personnel");
      if (selPers) {
        selPers.onchange = e => {
          pbActivePersonnel = e.target.value;
          renderPlaybookCatalog();
        };
      }

      renderPlaybook();
    }

    function setPlaybookSide(side) {
      pbActiveSide = side;
      pbActiveCategory = 'all';

      $("#pb-mode-offense").classList.toggle("active", side === 'O');
      $("#pb-mode-defense").classList.toggle("active", side === 'D');
      $("#pb-mode-compare").classList.remove("active");

      $("#pb-standard-workspace").style.display = "grid";
      $("#pb-filters-bar").style.display = "flex";
      $("#pb-compare-workspace").style.display = "none";

      // Pick first item of this side
      if (side === 'O') {
        pbActiveId = Object.keys(NFL_DATA.plays)[0] || 'inside_zone';
      } else {
        pbActiveId = Object.keys(NFL_DATA.defenses)[0] || 'cover_0';
      }

      renderPlaybook();
    }

    function onPlaybookSearch(query) {
      pbSearchQuery = (query || '').toLowerCase().trim();
      renderPlaybookCatalog();

      // Optional Madden layer update
      if (typeof updatePlaybookMaddenCard === 'function') {
        updatePlaybookMaddenCard(id, side);
      }
    }

    function renderPlaybook() {
      if (!playbookEngine) initPlaybook();

      // 1. Render Category Filter Chips
      const chipsEl = $("#pb-category-chips");
      if (chipsEl) {
        const list = pbActiveSide === 'O' ? PB_CATEGORIES_O : PB_CATEGORIES_D;
        chipsEl.innerHTML = list.map(c => `
      <button class="filter-chip ${pbActiveCategory === c.key ? 'active' : ''}" 
              onclick="setPlaybookCategory('${c.key}')">
        ${c.label}
      </button>
    `).join('');
      }

      // 2. Render Catalog List
      renderPlaybookCatalog();

      // 3. Select Active Item in Simulator
      selectPlaybookItem(pbActiveId, pbActiveSide);
    }

    function setPlaybookCategory(cat) {
      pbActiveCategory = cat;
      renderPlaybook();
    }

    function getPlaybookItems() {
      if (pbActiveSide === 'O') {
        return Object.keys(NFL_DATA.plays).map(k => ({ id: k, ...NFL_DATA.plays[k] }));
      } else {
        return Object.keys(NFL_DATA.defenses).map(k => ({ id: k, ...NFL_DATA.defenses[k] }));
      }
    }

    function renderPlaybookCatalog() {
      const listEl = $("#playbook-list");
      if (!listEl) return;

      let items = getPlaybookItems();

      // Category filter
      if (pbActiveCategory !== 'all') {
        items = items.filter(it => it.category === pbActiveCategory);
      }

      // Personnel filter
      if (pbActivePersonnel !== 'all') {
        items = items.filter(it => it.personnel && it.personnel.includes(pbActivePersonnel));
      }

      // Search filter
      if (pbSearchQuery) {
        items = items.filter(it => {
          const text = `${it.name} ${it.category} ${it.personnel} ${it.summary || it.desc || ''} ${it.tacticalGoal || ''} ${it.reads || ''}`.toLowerCase();
          return text.includes(pbSearchQuery);
        });
      }

      const countEl = $("#pb-catalog-count");
      if (countEl) countEl.textContent = `${items.length} ${pbActiveSide === 'O' ? 'Offensive Spielzüge' : 'Defensive Schemes'} gefunden`;

      if (items.length === 0) {
        listEl.innerHTML = `
      <div style="padding: 24px; text-align: center; color: var(--mut); background: var(--bg-card); border-radius: var(--radius-md); border: 1px dashed var(--ln);">
        Keine Spielzüge für diese Filterkriterien gefunden.
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      // Ensure activeId is valid
      if (!items.some(it => it.id === pbActiveId) && items.length > 0) {
        pbActiveId = items[0].id;
      }

      listEl.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
        const isActive = it.id === pbActiveId;
        return `
      <div class="playbook-item-card ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectPlaybookItem('${it.id}', '${pbActiveSide}')">
        <div class="playbook-card-top">
          <span class="pb-category-pill ${it.category}">${it.category.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
          <span style="font-size:11.5px; color:var(--mut); font-weight:700;">${it.personnel || 'Standard'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="playbook-item-title">${it.name}</div>
        <div class="playbook-item-desc">${it.summary || it.desc || ''}</div>
        <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:var(--y); font-weight:700; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-top:2px;">
          <span>🎯 ${it.tacticalGoal ? it.tacticalGoal.substring(0, 48) + '...' : 'Taktischer Spielzug'}</span>
          <span>${isActive ? '● GELADEN' : '➔'}</span>
        </div>
