      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function selectPlaybookItem(id, side) {
      pbActiveId = id;
      pbActiveSide = side;

      let item = null;
      if (side === 'O') {
        item = NFL_DATA.plays[id];
      } else {
        item = NFL_DATA.defenses[id];
      }
      if (!item) return;

      // Highlight active in catalog list
      const allCards = document.querySelectorAll(".playbook-item-card");
      allCards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove("active"));

      // Update Simulator Header Box
      const titleEl = $("#pb-sim-title");
      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = item.name;

      const catBadge = $("#pb-sim-cat-badge");
      if (catBadge) {
        catBadge.textContent = item.category ? item.category.toUpperCase().replace('_', ' ') : 'PLAY';
        catBadge.className = `pb-category-pill ${item.category}`;
      }

      const persEl = $("#pb-sim-personnel");
      if (persEl) persEl.textContent = item.personnel || 'Personnel';

      const formEl = $("#pb-sim-formation");
      if (formEl) formEl.textContent = side === 'O' ? (NFL_DATA.formations[item.formation]?.name.split('(')[0] || 'Shotgun') : 'Base Defense Look';

      // Update Tactical Dossier
      const setTxt = (sel, val) => { const el = $(sel); if (el) el.textContent = val || 'Nicht spezifiziert.'; };
      setTxt("#pb-dos-goal", item.tacticalGoal || item.summary || item.desc);
      setTxt("#pb-dos-reads", item.reads || "High-to-Low Progression durch den Quarterback.");
      setTxt("#pb-dos-strengths", item.strengths || "Effektiv gegen Zonen- und Man-Deckungen.");
      setTxt("#pb-dos-weaknesses", item.weaknesses || "Anfällig für aggressive Press-Man oder schnelle Edge Rusher.");
      setTxt("#pb-dos-counters", item.counters || "Gegnerische Anpassungen durch Safety-Rotation.");

      // Sync with Simulator Field Engine
      if (playbookEngine) {
        if (side === 'O') {
          playbookEngine.loadSetup(item.formation || 'shotgun_11', item.id, 'cover_3');
          playbookEngine.options.showRoutes = true;
          playbookEngine.options.showZones = true;
        } else {
          playbookEngine.loadSetup('shotgun_11', 'mesh', item.id);
          playbookEngine.options.showRoutes = true;
          playbookEngine.options.showZones = true;
        }
        playbookEngine.reset();
        $("#pb-btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play";
      }

      // Update catalog card borders
      renderPlaybookCatalog();
    }

    function openCurrentPlayInLab() {
      if (pbActiveSide === 'O') {
        const item = NFL_DATA.plays[pbActiveId];
        if (item) {
          openLabPreset(item.formation || 'shotgun_11', item.id, 'cover_3');
        }
      } else {
        const item = NFL_DATA.defenses[pbActiveId];
        if (item) {
          openLabPreset('shotgun_11', 'mesh', item.id);
        }
      }
    }

    function compareActiveConcept() {
      pbCompareIdA = pbActiveId;
      // Pick an opposite or related concept for B
      if (pbActiveSide === 'O') {
        pbCompareIdB = 'cover_3';
      } else {
        pbCompareIdB = 'mesh';
      }
      togglePlaybookCompare(true);
    }

    function togglePlaybookCompare(show) {
      const std = $("#pb-standard-workspace");
      const cmp = $("#pb-compare-workspace");
      const filt = $("#pb-filters-bar");

      $("#pb-mode-offense").classList.remove("active");
      $("#pb-mode-defense").classList.remove("active");
      $("#pb-mode-compare").classList.toggle("active", show);

      if (show) {
        if (std) std.style.display = "none";
        if (filt) filt.style.display = "none";
        if (cmp) cmp.style.display = "flex";

        // Populate compare dropdowns
        populateCompareDropdowns();
        renderPlaybookCompare();
      } else {
        if (std) std.style.display = "grid";
        if (filt) filt.style.display = "flex";
        if (cmp) cmp.style.display = "none";
        setPlaybookSide(pbActiveSide);
      }
    }

    function populateCompareDropdowns() {
      const selA = $("#pb-cmp-select-a");
      const selB = $("#pb-cmp-select-b");
      if (!selA || !selB) return;

      const allItems = [
        ...Object.keys(NFL_DATA.plays).map(k => ({ id: k, name: `[Offense] ${NFL_DATA.plays[k].name}`, side: 'O' })),
        ...Object.keys(NFL_DATA.defenses).map(k => ({ id: k, name: `[Defense] ${NFL_DATA.defenses[k].name}`, side: 'D' }))
      ];

      const html = allItems.map(it => `<option value="${it.id}">${it.name}</option>`).join('');
      selA.innerHTML = html;
      selB.innerHTML = html;

      selA.value = pbCompareIdA;
      selB.value = pbCompareIdB;
    }

    function onCompareSelectChange() {
      pbCompareIdA = $("#pb-cmp-select-a").value;
      pbCompareIdB = $("#pb-cmp-select-b").value;
      renderPlaybookCompare();
    }

    function getCompareItem(id) {
      if (NFL_DATA.plays[id]) return { ...NFL_DATA.plays[id], side: 'O' };
      if (NFL_DATA.defenses[id]) return { ...NFL_DATA.defenses[id], side: 'D' };
      return null;
    }

    function renderPlaybookCompare() {
      const itemA = getCompareItem(pbCompareIdA);
      const itemB = getCompareItem(pbCompareIdB);
      if (!itemA || !itemB) return;

      // Render Card A
      $("#pb-cmp-card-a").innerHTML = renderCompareCardHtml(itemA, "A");
      // Render Card B
      $("#pb-cmp-card-b").innerHTML = renderCompareCardHtml(itemB, "B");

      // Render Matchup Text
      const textEl = $("#pb-cmp-matchup-text");
      if (textEl) {
        textEl.innerHTML = generateMatchupAnalysis(itemA, itemB);
      }
    }

    function renderCompareCardHtml(item, slot) {
      return `
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln); padding-bottom:12px;">
      <div>
        <div style="font-size:11px; font-weight:900; color:var(--y); text-transform:uppercase;">KONZEPT ${slot} (${item.side === 'O' ? 'OFFENSE' : 'DEFENSE'})</div>
        <h3 style="margin:4px 0; font-size:18px; color:var(--ink);">${item.name}</h3>
        <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:4px;">
          <span class="pb-category-pill ${item.category}">${item.category.replace('_', ' ')}</span>
          <span class="telemetry-label" style="font-size:11px;">${item.personnel || 'Standard'}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-subtle" style="font-size:11.5px; padding:4px 10px;" onclick="openLabPreset('${item.formation || 'shotgun_11'}', '${item.side === 'O' ? item.id : 'mesh'}', '${item.side === 'D' ? item.id : 'cover_3'}')">
        ⚡ Im Lab öffnen
      </button>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;">
      <div>
        <div class="dossier-title">🎯 Taktisches Ziel</div>
        <p class="dossier-text" style="font-size:13px;">${item.tacticalGoal || item.summary || item.desc}</p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="dossier-title">👁 Wichtigste Reads & Progression</div>
        <p class="dossier-text" style="font-size:13px;">${item.reads || 'Nicht angegeben.'}</p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="dossier-title" style="color:var(--g-light);">💪 Stärken & Bestes Matchup</div>
        <p class="dossier-text" style="font-size:13px;">${item.strengths || 'Nicht angegeben.'}</p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="dossier-title" style="color:#f87171;">⚠️ Schwachstellen & Anfälligkeiten</div>
        <p class="dossier-text" style="font-size:13px;">${item.weaknesses || 'Nicht angegeben.'}</p>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="dossier-title" style="color:var(--accent-purple);">🛡️ Taktischer Counter</div>
        <p class="dossier-text" style="font-size:13px;">${item.counters || 'Nicht angegeben.'}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function generateMatchupAnalysis(a, b) {
      // If Offense vs Defense
      if (a.side === 'O' && b.side === 'D') {
        return `
      <b>Duell-Dynamik: Offense ${a.name} vs. Defense ${b.name}</b><br>
      • <b>Kern-Konflikt:</b> ${a.name} versucht ${a.tacticalGoal.toLowerCase()}, während ${b.name} ${b.tacticalGoal.toLowerCase()}.<br>
      • <b>Schwachstellen-Fokus:</b> ${a.strengths.includes(b.name.split(' ')[0]) ? `<span style="color:var(--g-light); font-weight:800;">Sehr vorteilhaft für die Offense!</span> ${a.name} attackiert direkt die typischen Lücken von ${b.name}.` : `Ausgeglichenes Duell. Der Quarterback muss auf ${b.reads} achten.`}<br>
      • <b>Defensiver Counter:</b> ${b.counters || 'Safety-Anpassung und disziplinierter Pass Rush.'}
    `;
      } else if (a.side === 'D' && b.side === 'O') {
        return generateMatchupAnalysis(b, a);
      } else {
        // Concept vs Concept (Offense vs Offense or Defense vs Defense)
        return `
      <b>Strategischer Vergleich zweier ${a.side === 'O' ? 'Offensiv-Konzepte' : 'Defensiv-Schemes'}:</b><br>
      • <b>Unterschiedliche Schwerpunkte:</b> Während <b>${a.name}</b> primär auf <i>${a.tacticalGoal}</i> abzielt, fokussiert sich <b>${b.name}</b> auf <i>${b.tacticalGoal}</i>.<br>
      • <b>Einsatzbereich:</b> Verwende <b>${a.name}</b> vor allem ${a.strengths.substring(0, 80)}..., während <b>${b.name}</b> ideal ist bei ${b.strengths.substring(0, 80)}...
    `;
      }
    }

    /* ==================== 4. INTERACTIVE FILM ROOM JAVASCRIPT ==================== */
    function renderFilmRoom() {
      initFilmRoom();
    }
    let filmEngine = null;
    let filmActiveScenarioId = 'film_01_cover3_dagger';
    let filmActiveFilter = 'all';
    let filmActivePhase = 'presnap'; // 'presnap' | 'postsnap' | 'debrief'
    let filmAnswers = {}; // { [scenarioId]: { [qId]: optionId } }
    let filmTelestratorActive = true;

    // Load persisted statistics
    function getFilmStats() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('nfl_film_room_stats');
        if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (e) { }
      return {
        preSnapScore: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        coverageScore: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        qbReadScore: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        playIntentScore: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        completed: []
      };
    }

    function saveFilmStats(stats) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('nfl_film_room_stats', JSON.stringify(stats));
      } catch (e) { }
    }

    function initFilmRoom() {
      if (!NFL_DATA.filmScenarios || NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.length === 0) return;

      const svg = document.getElementById("film-field-svg");
      if (!svg) return;

      if (!filmEngine) {
        filmEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("film-field-svg", {
          showRoutes: false, // Pre-snap starts with routes hidden
          showZones: true,
          showRush: false,   // Rush hidden during pre-snap scan
          showLabels: true,
          showTarget: false,
          viewMode: 'tactical',
          interactive: true,
          onPlayerSelect: (p) => {
            highlightTelestratorPlayer(p.key);
          }
        });

        bindFilmEvents();
      }

      renderFilmFilterButtons();
      renderFilmScenarioStrip();
      selectFilmScenario(filmActiveScenarioId);
    }

    function bindFilmEvents() {
      // Filter buttons
      const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll("[data-film-filter]");
      filterBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          filterBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
          btn.classList.add("active");
          filmActiveFilter = btn.dataset.filmFilter;
          renderFilmScenarioStrip();
        });
      });

      // Phase tabs
      const phaseTabs = document.querySelectorAll("[data-film-phase]");
      phaseTabs.forEach(tab => {
        tab.addEventListener("click", () => {
          setFilmPhase(tab.dataset.filmPhase);
        });
      });

      // Controls
      const btnPreSnap = document.getElementById("btn-film-presnap");
      if (btnPreSnap) {
        btnPreSnap.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (!filmEngine) return;
          filmEngine.options.showRoutes = false;
          filmEngine.options.showRush = false;
          filmEngine.options.showTarget = false;
          filmEngine.reset();
          hideFilmMotionBanner();
          removeTelestratorHighlights();
        });
      }

      const btnMotion = document.getElementById("btn-film-motion");
      if (btnMotion) {
        btnMotion.addEventListener("click", runFilmMotion);
      }

      const btnPlay = document.getElementById("btn-film-play");
      if (btnPlay) {
        btnPlay.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (!filmEngine) return;
          filmEngine.options.showRoutes = true;
          filmEngine.options.showRush = true;
          filmEngine.options.showTarget = true;
          filmEngine.render();
          if (filmEngine.playSnap) filmEngine.playSnap(); else if (filmEngine.play) filmEngine.play();
        });
      }

      const btnPause = document.getElementById("btn-film-pause");
      if (btnPause) {
        btnPause.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (filmEngine) filmEngine.pause();
        });
      }

      const btnReset = document.getElementById("btn-film-reset");
      if (btnReset) {
        btnReset.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (filmEngine) filmEngine.reset();
          hideFilmMotionBanner();
          removeTelestratorHighlights();
        });
      }

      const btnSpeedHalf = document.getElementById("btn-film-speed-half");
      const btnSpeedOne = document.getElementById("btn-film-speed-one");
      if (btnSpeedHalf && btnSpeedOne) {
        btnSpeedHalf.addEventListener("click", () => {
          btnSpeedHalf.classList.add("active");
          btnSpeedOne.classList.remove("active");
          if (filmEngine) filmEngine.setSpeed(0.5);
        });
        btnSpeedOne.addEventListener("click", () => {
          btnSpeedOne.classList.add("active");
          btnSpeedHalf.classList.remove("active");
          if (filmEngine) filmEngine.setSpeed(1.0);
        });
      }

      const btnTelestrator = document.getElementById("btn-film-telestrator");
      if (btnTelestrator) {
        btnTelestrator.addEventListener("click", () => {
          filmTelestratorActive = !filmTelestratorActive;
          btnTelestrator.classList.toggle("active", filmTelestratorActive);
          if (!filmTelestratorActive) {
            removeTelestratorHighlights();
          }
        });
      }
    }

    function renderFilmFilterButtons() {
      const container = document.querySelector(".film-level-filters");
      if (!container) return;
      const counts = {
        all: NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.length,
        rookie: NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.filter(s => s.level === 'rookie').length,
        pro: NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.filter(s => s.level === 'pro').length,
        all_pro: NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.filter(s => s.level === 'all_pro').length
      };

      container.innerHTML = `
    <button class="film-filter-btn ${filmActiveFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" data-film-filter="all">Alle Level (${counts.all})</button>
    <button class="film-filter-btn ${filmActiveFilter === 'rookie' ? 'active' : ''}" data-film-filter="rookie">Rookie (${counts.rookie})</button>
    <button class="film-filter-btn ${filmActiveFilter === 'pro' ? 'active' : ''}" data-film-filter="pro">Pro (${counts.pro})</button>
    <button class="film-filter-btn ${filmActiveFilter === 'all_pro' ? 'active' : ''}" data-film-filter="all_pro">All-Pro (${counts.all_pro})</button>
  `;

      container.querySelectorAll(".film-filter-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          container.querySelectorAll(".film-filter-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
          btn.classList.add("active");
          filmActiveFilter = btn.dataset.filmFilter;
          renderFilmScenarioStrip();
        });
      });
    }

    function renderFilmScenarioStrip() {
      const strip = document.getElementById("film-scenario-strip");
      if (!strip) return;

      const stats = getFilmStats();
      const scenarios = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.filter(s => {
        if (filmActiveFilter === 'all') return true;
        return s.level === filmActiveFilter;
      });

      strip.innerHTML = scenarios.map(s => {
        const isCompleted = stats.completed.includes(s.id);
        const isActive = s.id === filmActiveScenarioId;

        return `
      <div class="film-scenario-card ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectFilmScenario('${s.id}')">
        <div class="film-card-header">
          <span class="film-badge-level ${s.level}">${s.levelLabel}</span>
          ${isCompleted ? '<span style="color:var(--g-light); font-size:11px; font-weight:800;">✓ ANALYSIERT</span>' : ''}
        </div>
        <div class="film-card-title">${s.title}</div>
        <div class="film-card-situation">
          <span>🏈 ${s.telemetry.downDistance}</span>
          <span>•</span>
          <span>⏱️ ${s.telemetry.quarter} ${s.telemetry.gameClock}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="film-card-tags">
          ${s.conceptTags.slice(0, 3).map(t => `<span class="film-tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function selectFilmScenario(id) {
      filmActiveScenarioId = id;
      const scenario = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === id);
      if (!scenario) return;

      // Update card active styles
      renderFilmScenarioStrip();

      // Update Matchup Subtitle
      const matchupTag = document.getElementById("film-field-matchup-tag");
      if (matchupTag) {
        matchupTag.textContent = scenario.subtitle;
      }

      // Update Telemetry HUD
      updateFilmTelemetryHUD(scenario);

      // Setup Field Engine
      if (filmEngine) {
        filmEngine.options.showRoutes = false; // Start pre-snap hidden
        filmEngine.options.showRush = false;
        filmEngine.options.showTarget = false;
        filmEngine.loadSetup(
          scenario.telemetry.offensiveFormation,
          scenario.telemetry.offensePlayId,
          scenario.telemetry.defenseSchemeId
        );
        removeTelestratorHighlights();
        hideFilmMotionBanner();
      }

      // Set default phase
      setFilmPhase("presnap");
    }

    function updateFilmTelemetryHUD(scenario) {
      const hud = document.getElementById("film-telemetry-hud");
      if (!hud) return;

      const t = scenario.telemetry;
      hud.innerHTML = `
    <div class="film-telemetry-group">
      <div class="film-hud-score">${t.score}</div>
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">DOWN & DISTANCE</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value highlight-y">${t.downDistance}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">FIELD POSITION</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value">${t.fieldPosition}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">GAME CLOCK</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value">${t.quarter} // ${t.gameClock}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="film-telemetry-group">
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">OFF PERSONNEL</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value highlight-cyan">${t.offensivePersonnel}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">DEF ALIGNMENT</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value">${t.defensiveAlignment.split('(')[0].trim()}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="film-hud-pill">
        <span class="film-hud-label">SAFETY SHELL</span>
        <span class="film-hud-value">${t.safetyAlignment.split(':')[0].trim()}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function setFilmPhase(phase) {
      filmActivePhase = phase;
      const tabs = document.querySelectorAll("[data-film-phase]");
      tabs.forEach(t => {
        t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.filmPhase === phase);
      });

      const scenario = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === filmActiveScenarioId);
      if (!scenario) return;

      const content = document.getElementById("film-phase-content");
      if (!content) return;

      if (phase === 'presnap') {
        renderPreSnapPhase(scenario, content);
      } else if (phase === 'postsnap') {
        renderPostSnapPhase(scenario, content);
      } else if (phase === 'debrief') {
        renderDebriefPhase(scenario, content);
      }
    }

    function renderPreSnapPhase(scenario, container) {
      const answers = filmAnswers[scenario.id] || {};

      container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="film-briefing-box">
      <div class="film-briefing-header">📋 Taktisches Coaching Briefing</div>
      <div style="margin-bottom: 6px;">${scenario.coachingBriefing.situationAnalysis}</div>
      <div style="color: var(--y); font-weight: 600;">Coach Notiz: ${scenario.coachingBriefing.coachNotes}</div>
    </div>

    ${scenario.preSnapQuestions.map((q, idx) => `
      <div class="film-question-card" id="card-${q.id}">
        <div class="film-q-meta">
          <span class="film-q-num">FRAGE ${idx + 1} // PRE-SNAP DIAGNOSE</span>
          <span class="film-q-cat">${getCategoryLabel(q.category)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="film-q-prompt">${q.prompt}</div>
        <div class="film-options-list">
          ${q.options.map(opt => {
        const selected = answers[q.id] === opt.id;
        let statusClass = '';
        if (selected) {
          statusClass = opt.isCorrect ? 'selected-correct' : 'selected-wrong';
        }
        return `
              <div class="film-option-item ${statusClass}" onclick="handleFilmAnswer('${scenario.id}', '${q.id}', '${opt.id}', 'presnap')">
                <span class="film-option-letter">${opt.id.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <span>${opt.text}</span>
              </div>
            `;
      }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div id="feedback-${q.id}">
          ${answers[q.id] ? renderFeedbackHtml(q, answers[q.id]) : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('')}

    <button class="film-phase-action-btn" onclick="transitionToPostSnap('${scenario.id}')">
      ▶ Pre-Snap fertig // Play ausführen & Post-Snap All-22 analysieren
    </button>
  `;
    }

    function renderPostSnapPhase(scenario, container) {
      const answers = filmAnswers[scenario.id] || {};

      container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="film-briefing-box" style="border-left-color: var(--g-light);">
      <div class="film-briefing-header" style="color: var(--g-light);">🎬 Post-Snap All-22 Schema-Analyse</div>
      <div>Das Play wurde ausgeführt. Beobachte die Bewegungen der Safeties, die Pass-Routen und den Quarterback-Read. Diagnostiziere das tatsächliche Scheme der Defense.</div>
    </div>

    ${scenario.postSnapQuestions.map((q, idx) => `
      <div class="film-question-card" id="card-${q.id}">
        <div class="film-q-meta">
          <span class="film-q-num">FRAGE ${idx + 1} // SCHEME BREAKDOWN</span>
          <span class="film-q-cat">${getCategoryLabel(q.category)}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="film-q-prompt">${q.prompt}</div>
        <div class="film-options-list">
          ${q.options.map(opt => {
        const selected = answers[q.id] === opt.id;
        let statusClass = '';
        if (selected) {
          statusClass = opt.isCorrect ? 'selected-correct' : 'selected-wrong';
        }
        return `
              <div class="film-option-item ${statusClass}" onclick="handleFilmAnswer('${scenario.id}', '${q.id}', '${opt.id}', 'postsnap')">
                <span class="film-option-letter">${opt.id.toUpperCase()}</span>
                <span>${opt.text}</span>
              </div>
            `;
      }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div id="feedback-${q.id}">
          ${answers[q.id] ? renderFeedbackHtml(q, answers[q.id]) : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('')}

    <button class="film-phase-action-btn" onclick="transitionToDebrief('${scenario.id}')">
      🏁 Analyse abschließen // Scouting Debrief & Performance Radar
    </button>
  `;
    }

    function renderDebriefPhase(scenario, container) {
      const stats = getFilmStats();

      // Mark as completed in stats if not already
      if (!stats.completed.includes(scenario.id)) {
        stats.completed.push(scenario.id);
        saveFilmStats(stats);
        renderFilmScenarioStrip();
      }

      // Calculate radar percentages
      const preSnapPct = stats.preSnapScore.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.preSnapScore.correct / stats.preSnapScore.total) * 100) : 0;
      const covPct = stats.coverageScore.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.coverageScore.correct / stats.coverageScore.total) * 100) : 0;
      const qbPct = stats.qbReadScore.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.qbReadScore.correct / stats.qbReadScore.total) * 100) : 0;
      const intentPct = stats.playIntentScore.total > 0 ? Math.round((stats.playIntentScore.correct / stats.playIntentScore.total) * 100) : 0;

      // Determine dynamic coaching advice
      let coachAdvice = "Hervorragende Arbeit im Film Room! Halte dein Auge diszipliniert auf den Safeties.";
      const lowest = Math.min(preSnapPct, covPct, qbPct, intentPct);
      if (lowest === preSnapPct && preSnapPct < 70) {
        coachAdvice = "Coach Fokus: Trainiere die Pre-Snap Erkennung! Zähle konsequent die Spieler in der Box (6 vs 7/8) und prüfe, ob die Mitte des Feldes durch einen oder zwei Safeties besetzt ist (MOFC vs MOFO).";
      } else if (lowest === covPct && covPct < 70) {
        coachAdvice = "Coach Fokus: Achte auf die Hüften und die Rotation nach dem Snap. Lass dich nicht von vorgetäuschtem Two-High täuschen – die ersten zwei Schritte der Safeties verraten die wahre Coverage!";
      } else if (lowest === qbPct && qbPct < 70) {
        coachAdvice = "Coach Fokus: Identifiziere vor jedem Snap den 'Conflict Defender'. Scanne dessen erste Reaktion im Dropback, bevor du den Ball freigibst.";
      } else if (lowest === intentPct && intentPct < 70) {
        coachAdvice = "Coach Fokus: Verstehe das Design des Spielzugs: Wo wird gestreckt (Clearout) und wer sticht in den freien Raum dahinter (Dig/Crosser/Under)?";
      }

      container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="film-debrief-container">
      <div class="film-debrief-summary">
        <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--g-light); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 6px;">
          ✓ All-22 Scouting Abschluss
        </div>
        ${scenario.coachDebrief.summary}
      </div>

      <div class="film-rule-card">
        <div class="film-rule-title">
          <span>🏆</span> Die Goldene NFL Coaching Regel
        </div>
        <div>${scenario.coachDebrief.keyTakeaway}</div>
      </div>

      <!-- 4-Dimensional Performance Meter -->
      <div style="margin-top: 4px;">
        <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px;">
          📊 Deine 4-Dimensionale Scouting-Leistung
        </div>
        <div class="film-radar-grid">
          <div class="film-radar-stat">
            <span class="film-radar-label">Pre-Snap Recognition</span>
            <div class="film-radar-value-row">
              <span class="film-radar-pct">${preSnapPct}%</span>
              <span class="film-radar-grade ${getGradeClass(preSnapPct)}">${getGrade(preSnapPct)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="film-radar-bar">
              <div class="film-radar-bar-fill" style="width: ${preSnapPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="film-radar-stat">
            <span class="film-radar-label">Coverage Recognition</span>
            <div class="film-radar-value-row">
              <span class="film-radar-pct">${covPct}%</span>
              <span class="film-radar-grade ${getGradeClass(covPct)}">${getGrade(covPct)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="film-radar-bar">
              <div class="film-radar-bar-fill" style="width: ${covPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="film-radar-stat">
            <span class="film-radar-label">Quarterback Reads</span>
            <div class="film-radar-value-row">
              <span class="film-radar-pct">${qbPct}%</span>
              <span class="film-radar-grade ${getGradeClass(qbPct)}">${getGrade(qbPct)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="film-radar-bar">
              <div class="film-radar-bar-fill" style="width: ${qbPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="film-radar-stat">
            <span class="film-radar-label">Play Intent & Scheme</span>
            <div class="film-radar-value-row">
              <span class="film-radar-pct">${intentPct}%</span>
              <span class="film-radar-grade ${getGradeClass(intentPct)}">${getGrade(intentPct)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="film-radar-bar">
              <div class="film-radar-bar-fill" style="width: ${intentPct}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="film-coach-advice-box">
        <span style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan);">HEAD COACH FEEDBACK:</span> ${coachAdvice}
      </div>

      <button class="film-phase-action-btn" onclick="nextFilmScenario()">
        Nächstes Filmszenario laden 🏈
      </button>
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function handleFilmAnswer(scenarioId, questionId, optionId, phase) {
      if (!filmAnswers[scenarioId]) filmAnswers[scenarioId] = {};
      const isFirstAttempt = !filmAnswers[scenarioId][questionId];
      filmAnswers[scenarioId][questionId] = optionId;

      const scenario = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === scenarioId);
      if (!scenario) return;

      const questions = phase === 'presnap' ? scenario.preSnapQuestions : scenario.postSnapQuestions;
      const question = questions.find(q => q.id === questionId);
      if (!question) return;

      const chosenOption = question.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!chosenOption) return;

      // Track stats only on first attempt to maintain authentic testing accuracy
      if (isFirstAttempt) {
        const stats = getFilmStats();
        const cat = question.category;
        if (stats[cat]) {
          stats[cat].total += 1;
          if (chosenOption.isCorrect) stats[cat].correct += 1;
          saveFilmStats(stats);
        }
      }

      // Update card UI
      const card = document.getElementById(`card-${questionId}`);
      if (card) {
        const options = card.querySelectorAll(".film-option-item");
        options.forEach((optEl, idx) => {
          optEl.classList.remove("selected-correct", "selected-wrong");
          const opt = question.options[idx];
          if (opt.id === optionId) {
            optEl.classList.add(opt.isCorrect ? "selected-correct" : "selected-wrong");
          }
        });

        const feedbackEl = document.getElementById(`feedback-${questionId}`);
        if (feedbackEl) {
          feedbackEl.innerHTML = renderFeedbackHtml(question, optionId);
        }
      }

      // Trigger on-field telestrator highlight if players are defined
      if (chosenOption.highlightPlayers && filmTelestratorActive) {
        highlightTelestratorPlayers(chosenOption.highlightPlayers);
      }
    }

    function renderFeedbackHtml(question, optionId) {
      const option = question.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!option) return '';

      const isCorrect = option.isCorrect;
      const statusTitle = isCorrect
        ? '✓ KORREKTER READ // COACHING LOB'
        : '✗ FEHLREAD // TACTICAL SCOUTING DETAIL ÜBERSEHEN';

      const playersJson = JSON.stringify(option.highlightPlayers || []);

      return `
    <div class="film-feedback-box ${isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'wrong'}">
      <div class="film-feedback-title">${statusTitle}</div>
      <div>${option.coachingFeedback}</div>
      ${option.highlightPlayers && option.highlightPlayers.length > 0 ? `
        <button class="film-feedback-highlight-btn" onclick='highlightTelestratorPlayers(${playersJson})'>
          🎯 Relevante Spieler auf dem Feld markieren
        </button>
      ` : ''}
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function transitionToPostSnap(scenarioId) {
      setFilmPhase("postsnap");
      if (filmEngine) {
        filmEngine.options.showRoutes = true;
        filmEngine.options.showRush = true;
        filmEngine.options.showTarget = true;
        filmEngine.render();
        if (filmEngine.playSnap) filmEngine.playSnap(); else if (filmEngine.play) filmEngine.play();
      }
    }

    function transitionToDebrief(scenarioId) {
      setFilmPhase("debrief");
    }

    function nextFilmScenario() {
      const currentIndex = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.findIndex(s => s.id === filmActiveScenarioId);
      const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.length;
      selectFilmScenario(NFL_DATA.filmScenarios[nextIndex].id);
    }

    // Pre-Snap Motion Animation
    function runFilmMotion() {
      const scenario = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === filmActiveScenarioId);
      if (!scenario || !scenario.telemetry.motion || !scenario.telemetry.motion.hasMotion) {
        showFilmMotionBanner("Keine Pre-Snap Motion für dieses Play geplant (statisches Alignment).");
        return;
      }

      const m = scenario.telemetry.motion;
      showFilmMotionBanner(m.tell);

      // If engine exists, animate the motion player across the field
      if (filmEngine && filmEngine.svg) {
        const playersLayer = filmEngine.svg.querySelector("#layer-players");
        if (playersLayer) {
          // Find motion player circle or text
          const nodes = playersLayer.querySelectorAll("g");
          nodes.forEach(g => {
            const text = g.querySelector("text");
            if (text && (text.textContent === 'Z' || text.textContent === 'WR' || text.textContent === 'F')) {
              g.style.transition = "transform 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)";
              g.style.transform = "translateX(-240px)";
              setTimeout(() => {
                g.style.transform = "none";
              }, 3500);
            }
          });
        }
      }
    }

    function showFilmMotionBanner(text) {
      const banner = document.getElementById("film-motion-banner");
      const bannerText = document.getElementById("film-motion-banner-text");
      if (banner && bannerText) {
        bannerText.textContent = text;
        banner.style.display = "flex";
      }
    }

    function hideFilmMotionBanner() {
      const banner = document.getElementById("film-motion-banner");
      if (banner) banner.style.display = "none";
    }

    // On-Field Telestrator Marker Highlights
    function highlightTelestratorPlayers(playerKeys) {
      if (!filmEngine || !filmEngine.svg || !playerKeys || playerKeys.length === 0) return;
      removeTelestratorHighlights();

      let layer = filmEngine.svg.querySelector("#layer-telestrator");
      if (!layer) {
        layer = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
        layer.setAttribute("id", "layer-telestrator");
        filmEngine.svg.appendChild(layer);
      }

      // Iterate over engine defensive/offensive players and draw pulsing rings
      const def = filmEngine.defense;
      const form = filmEngine.formation;

      playerKeys.forEach(key => {
        let target = null;
        if (def && def.players && def.players[key]) target = def.players[key];
        else if (form && form.players && form.players[key]) target = form.players[key];

        // Fuzzy matching by label
        if (!target && def && def.players) {
          for (let k in def.players) {
            if (k.toUpperCase().includes(key.toUpperCase()) || (def.players[k].label && def.players[k].label === key)) {
              target = def.players[k];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (target) {
          // Glowing pulsing ring
          const ring = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
          ring.setAttribute("cx", target.x);
          ring.setAttribute("cy", target.y);
          ring.setAttribute("r", "24");
          ring.setAttribute("fill", "none");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke", "#f59e0b");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3.5");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "6 3");
          ring.setAttribute("class", "telestrator-ring");
          layer.appendChild(ring);

          // Label pin
          const pin = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
          pin.setAttribute("x", target.x);
          pin.setAttribute("y", target.y - 28);
          pin.setAttribute("font-size", "10");
          pin.setAttribute("font-weight", "900");
          pin.setAttribute("fill", "#f59e0b");
          pin.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          pin.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
          pin.textContent = "KEY READ";
          layer.appendChild(pin);
        }
      });
    }

    function removeTelestratorHighlights() {
      if (!filmEngine || !filmEngine.svg) return;
      const layer = filmEngine.svg.querySelector("#layer-telestrator");
      if (layer) layer.innerHTML = "";
    }

    function highlightTelestratorPlayer(playerKey) {
      if (playerKey) highlightTelestratorPlayers([playerKey]);
    }

    // Helpers
    function getCategoryLabel(cat) {
      switch (cat) {
        case 'preSnapScore': return 'PRE-SNAP DIAGNOSE';
        case 'coverageScore': return 'COVERAGE RECOGNITION';
        case 'qbReadScore': return 'QUARTERBACK READ';
        case 'playIntentScore': return 'PLAY INTENT & SCHEME';
        default: return 'TACTICAL READ';
      }
    }

    function getGrade(pct) {
      if (pct >= 90) return 'A+';
      if (pct >= 80) return 'A';
      if (pct >= 70) return 'B';
      if (pct >= 60) return 'C';
      return 'ROOKIE';
    }

    function getGradeClass(pct) {
      if (pct >= 80) return 'a';
      if (pct >= 60) return 'b';
      return 'c';
    }

    /* ==================== QB VISION & RECOGNITION TRAINING JAVASCRIPT ==================== */
    let visionEngine = null;
    let currentFilmMode = 'breakdown'; // 'breakdown' | 'vision'
    let visionActiveChallengeId = 'vis_01_single_high_click_safety';
    let visionFilter = 'all';
    let visionTimerInterval = null;
    let visionTimeLeft = 12.0;
    let visionTimerRunning = false;
    let visionTelestratorActive = true;
    let visionChallengeAnswered = false;

    // Mode Switching: All-22 Game Film vs. QB Vision Training
    function switchFilmMode(mode) {
      currentFilmMode = mode;
      const btnBreakdown = document.getElementById("btn-mode-film-breakdown");
      const btnVision = document.getElementById("btn-mode-vision-training");
      const containerBreakdown = document.getElementById("film-breakdown-container");
      const containerVision = document.getElementById("film-vision-container");

      if (btnBreakdown) btnBreakdown.classList.toggle("active", mode === 'breakdown');
      if (btnVision) btnVision.classList.toggle("active", mode === 'vision');

      if (containerBreakdown) containerBreakdown.style.display = mode === 'breakdown' ? 'flex' : 'none';
      if (containerVision) containerVision.style.display = mode === 'vision' ? 'flex' : 'none';

      if (mode === 'vision') {
        initVisionTraining();
      } else {
        initFilmRoom();
      }
    }

    // Load persisted Vision statistics
    function getVisionStats() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('nfl_vision_stats');
        if (raw) return JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch (e) { }
      return {
        formationRecognition: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        personnelRecognition: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        coverageRecognition: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        pressureRecognition: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        offensiveIntent: { correct: 0, total: 0 },
        completed: [],
        totalScore: 0
      };
    }

    function saveVisionStats(stats) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('nfl_vision_stats', JSON.stringify(stats));
      } catch (e) { }
    }

    function initVisionTraining() {
      if (!NFL_DATA.visionChallenges || NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length === 0) return;

      const svg = document.getElementById("vision-field-svg");
      if (!svg) return;

      if (!visionEngine) {
        visionEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("vision-field-svg", {
          showRoutes: false,
          showZones: false,
          showRush: false,
          showLabels: true,
          showTarget: false,
          viewMode: 'tactical',
          interactive: true,
          onPlayerSelect: (p) => {
            handleVisionFieldClick(p);
          }
        });

        bindVisionEvents();
      }

      renderVisionFilters();
      loadVisionChallenge(visionActiveChallengeId);
      updateVisionRadarUI();
    }

    function bindVisionEvents() {
      // Timer controls
      const btnPauseClock = document.getElementById("btn-vision-pause-clock");
      if (btnPauseClock) {
        btnPauseClock.addEventListener("click", () => {
          if (visionTimerRunning) {
            stopVisionTimer();
            btnPauseClock.textContent = "▶";
          } else {
            startVisionTimer();
            btnPauseClock.textContent = "⏸";
          }
        });
      }

      const btnResetClock = document.getElementById("btn-vision-reset-clock");
      if (btnResetClock) {
        btnResetClock.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const c = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.find(ch => ch.id === visionActiveChallengeId);
          if (c) resetVisionClock(c.timeBudget || 12.0);
        });
      }
    }

    function renderVisionFilters() {
      const container = document.getElementById("vision-filter-pills");
      if (!container) return;

      const cats = [
        { key: 'all', label: 'Alle Skills (10)' },
        { key: 'coverageRecognition', label: 'Coverage (4)' },
        { key: 'pressureRecognition', label: 'Pressure & Blitz (2)' },
        { key: 'offensiveIntent', label: 'Conflict & Read (2)' },
        { key: 'formationRecognition', label: 'Formation & Box (2)' }
      ];

      container.innerHTML = cats.map(c => `
    <button class="vision-pill-btn ${visionFilter === c.key ? 'active' : ''}" 
      onclick="setVisionFilter('${c.key}')">${c.label}</button>
  `).join('');
    }

    function setVisionFilter(key) {
      visionFilter = key;
      renderVisionFilters();

      const filtered = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.filter(c => {
        if (visionFilter === 'all') return true;
        if (visionFilter === 'formationRecognition') {
          return c.skillCategory === 'formationRecognition' || c.skillCategory === 'personnelRecognition';
        }
        return c.skillCategory === visionFilter;
      });

      if (filtered.length > 0) {
        loadVisionChallenge(filtered[0].id);
      }
    }

    function loadVisionChallenge(id) {
      visionActiveChallengeId = id;
      visionChallengeAnswered = false;

      const challenge = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.find(c => c.id === id);
      if (!challenge) return;

      // Update HUD
      const idx = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.findIndex(c => c.id === id) + 1;
      const total = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length;

      const idxTag = document.getElementById("vision-challenge-index-tag");
      if (idxTag) idxTag.textContent = `Challenge ${idx} von ${total}`;

      const modeBadge = document.getElementById("vision-mode-badge");
      if (modeBadge) {
        if (challenge.interactionType === 'field_click') {
          modeBadge.textContent = "🎯 ON-FIELD TARGET CLICK";
          modeBadge.style.color = "var(--y)";
          modeBadge.style.borderColor = "rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.4)";
        } else if (challenge.interactionType === 'box_count') {
          modeBadge.textContent = "📊 BOX COUNT ANALYSE";
          modeBadge.style.color = "var(--accent-cyan)";
          modeBadge.style.borderColor = "rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.4)";
        } else {
          modeBadge.textContent = "🛡️ COVERAGE DIAGNOSE";
          modeBadge.style.color = "var(--g-light)";
          modeBadge.style.borderColor = "rgba(95, 191, 138, 0.4)";
        }
      }

      const levelBadge = document.getElementById("vision-level-badge");
      if (levelBadge) {
        levelBadge.textContent = challenge.levelLabel.split(':')[0].trim();
        levelBadge.className = `film-badge-level ${challenge.level}`;
      }

      const cardCat = document.getElementById("vision-card-cat");
      if (cardCat) cardCat.textContent = getVisionCategoryLabel(challenge.skillCategory);

      const cardSub = document.getElementById("vision-card-subtitle");
      if (cardSub) cardSub.textContent = challenge.subtitle;

      const promptTitle = document.getElementById("vision-prompt-title");
      if (promptTitle) promptTitle.textContent = challenge.prompt;

      const fieldStatus = document.getElementById("vision-field-status");
      if (fieldStatus) {
        if (challenge.interactionType === 'field_click') {
          fieldStatus.textContent = "🎯 Klicke direkt auf den gesuchten Spieler im Feld";
          fieldStatus.style.color = "var(--y)";
        } else {
          fieldStatus.textContent = "👁️ Scanne das Bild und wähle rechts die Diagnose";
          fieldStatus.style.color = "var(--mut)";
        }
      }

      // Setup Field
      if (visionEngine) {
        visionEngine.options.showRoutes = false;
        visionEngine.options.showZones = false;
        visionEngine.options.showRush = false;
        visionEngine.options.showTarget = false;
        visionEngine.loadSetup(challenge.formationKey, 'mesh', challenge.defenseKey);
        removeVisionTelestrator();
      }

      // Render Interaction Body
      renderVisionInteraction(challenge);

      // Clear Feedback
      const fb = document.getElementById("vision-feedback-container");
      if (fb) fb.innerHTML = "";

      // Start Play Clock Timer
      resetVisionClock(challenge.timeBudget || 12.0);
    }

    function renderVisionInteraction(c) {
      const container = document.getElementById("vision-interaction-body");
      if (!container) return;

      if (c.interactionType === 'field_click') {
        container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="vision-target-click-hint">
        <span style="font-size: 20px;">🎯</span>
        <div>
          <strong>Interaktives All-22 Ziel:</strong> Tippe oder klicke direkt auf den gesuchten Spieler auf dem Taktikfeld links. Dein Klick wird in Echtzeit ausgewertet.
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      } else {
        // Choice or Box Count options
        container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="film-options-list">
        ${c.options.map((opt, idx) => `
          <div class="film-option-item" id="vopt-${opt.id}" onclick="handleVisionOptionClick('${c.id}', '${opt.id}')">
            <span class="film-option-letter">${String.fromCharCode(65 + idx)}</span>
            <span>${opt.text}</span>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    `;
      }
    }

    // Handle On-Field Player Clicks in Vision Mode
    function handleVisionFieldClick(player) {
      if (currentFilmMode !== 'vision') return;
      const c = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.find(ch => ch.id === visionActiveChallengeId);
      if (!c || c.interactionType !== 'field_click') return;
      if (visionChallengeAnswered) return;

      visionChallengeAnswered = true;
      stopVisionTimer();

      const pKey = (player.key || '').toUpperCase();
      const pRole = (player.role || '').toUpperCase();
      const pLabel = (player.label || '').toUpperCase();

      const isMatch = c.targetPlayerKeys.some(targetKey => {
        const tk = targetKey.toUpperCase();
        return pKey.includes(tk) || pRole.includes(tk) || pLabel.includes(tk) || tk.includes(pKey);
      });

      // Record stats
      const stats = getVisionStats();
      const cat = c.skillCategory;
      if (stats[cat]) {
        stats[cat].total += 1;
        if (isMatch) stats[cat].correct += 1;
      }
      if (!stats.completed.includes(c.id)) {
        stats.completed.push(c.id);
      }
      saveVisionStats(stats);
      updateVisionRadarUI();

      // Show Feedback
      const fb = document.getElementById("vision-feedback-container");
      if (fb) {
        fb.innerHTML = `
      <div class="film-feedback-box ${isMatch ? 'correct' : 'wrong'}">
        <div class="film-feedback-title">
          ${isMatch ? '✓ VOLLE TREFFER-GENAUIGKEIT // EXZELLENTER READ' : '✗ FALSCHER SPIELER MARKIERT // SCOUTING DETAIL'}
        </div>
        <div>${isMatch ? c.didacticExplanation.success : c.didacticExplanation.miss}</div>
        <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mut);">
          Geklickt: ${player.label || player.key || 'Spieler'} // Gesucht: ${c.targetLabel}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }

      // Draw Telestrator Highlight on target
      highlightVisionTelestrator(c.targetPlayerKeys, isMatch);
    }

    // Handle Multiple Choice or Box Count options
    function handleVisionOptionClick(challengeId, optionId) {
      const c = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.find(ch => ch.id === challengeId);
      if (!c || !c.options) return;
      if (visionChallengeAnswered) return;

      visionChallengeAnswered = true;
      stopVisionTimer();

      const option = c.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!option) return;

      // Record stats
      const stats = getVisionStats();
      const cat = c.skillCategory;
      if (stats[cat]) {
        stats[cat].total += 1;
        if (option.isCorrect) stats[cat].correct += 1;
      }
      if (!stats.completed.includes(c.id)) {
        stats.completed.push(c.id);
      }
      saveVisionStats(stats);
      updateVisionRadarUI();

      // Highlight card
      const optEl = document.getElementById(`vopt-${optionId}`);
      if (optEl) {
        optEl.classList.add(option.isCorrect ? 'selected-correct' : 'selected-wrong');
      }

      // Show feedback
      const fb = document.getElementById("vision-feedback-container");
      if (fb) {
        fb.innerHTML = `
      <div class="film-feedback-box ${option.isCorrect ? 'correct' : 'wrong'}">
        <div class="film-feedback-title">
          ${option.isCorrect ? '✓ KORREKTE DIAGNOSE // COACHING LOB' : '✗ FEHLREAD // TACTICAL SCOUTING DETAIL'}
        </div>
        <div>${option.coachingFeedback}</div>
      </div>
    `;
      }

      // Highlight telestrator on field
      if (option.highlightPlayers || c.telestratorHighlights) {
        highlightVisionTelestrator(option.highlightPlayers || c.telestratorHighlights, option.isCorrect);
      }
    }

    // On-Field Telestrator Marker in Vision Mode
    function highlightVisionTelestrator(playerKeys, isSuccess) {
      if (!visionEngine || !visionEngine.svg || !playerKeys) return;
      removeVisionTelestrator();

      let layer = visionEngine.svg.querySelector("#layer-vision-telestrator");
      if (!layer) {
        layer = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
        layer.setAttribute("id", "layer-vision-telestrator");
        visionEngine.svg.appendChild(layer);
      }

      const def = visionEngine.defense;
      const form = visionEngine.formation;

      playerKeys.forEach(key => {
        let target = null;
        if (def && def.players && def.players[key]) target = def.players[key];
        else if (form && form.players && form.players[key]) target = form.players[key];

        if (!target && def && def.players) {
          for (let k in def.players) {
            if (k.toUpperCase().includes(key.toUpperCase()) || (def.players[k].label && def.players[k].label === key)) {
              target = def.players[k];
              break;
            }
          }
        }

        if (target) {
          const ring = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "circle");
          ring.setAttribute("cx", target.x);
          ring.setAttribute("cy", target.y);
          ring.setAttribute("r", "26");
          ring.setAttribute("fill", "none");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke", isSuccess ? "#5fbf8a" : "#f59e0b");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke-width", "3.5");
          ring.setAttribute("stroke-dasharray", "5 3");
          ring.setAttribute("class", "telestrator-ring");
          layer.appendChild(ring);

          const pin = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
          pin.setAttribute("x", target.x);
          pin.setAttribute("y", target.y - 30);
          pin.setAttribute("font-size", "10");
          pin.setAttribute("font-weight", "900");
          pin.setAttribute("fill", isSuccess ? "#5fbf8a" : "#f59e0b");
          pin.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
          pin.setAttribute("font-family", "system-ui, sans-serif");
          pin.textContent = isSuccess ? "ZIEL ERKANNT ✓" : "KEY READ 🎯";
          layer.appendChild(pin);
        }
      });
    }

    function removeVisionTelestrator() {
      if (!visionEngine || !visionEngine.svg) return;
      const layer = visionEngine.svg.querySelector("#layer-vision-telestrator");
      if (layer) layer.innerHTML = "";
    }

    function toggleVisionTelestrator() {
      visionTelestratorActive = !visionTelestratorActive;
      if (!visionTelestratorActive) removeVisionTelestrator();
    }

    // Navigation between challenges
    function nextVisionChallenge() {
      const currentIdx = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.findIndex(c => c.id === visionActiveChallengeId);
      const nextIdx = (currentIdx + 1) % NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length;
      loadVisionChallenge(NFL_DATA.visionChallenges[nextIdx].id);
    }

    function prevVisionChallenge() {
      const currentIdx = NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.findIndex(c => c.id === visionActiveChallengeId);
      const prevIdx = (currentIdx - 1 + NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length) % NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length;
      loadVisionChallenge(NFL_DATA.visionChallenges[prevIdx].id);
    }

    // Play Clock Timer Logic
    function resetVisionClock(seconds) {
      stopVisionTimer();
      visionTimeLeft = seconds;
      updateClockDisplay(visionTimeLeft);
      startVisionTimer();
    }

    function startVisionTimer() {
      stopVisionTimer();
      visionTimerRunning = true;
      const timerEl = document.getElementById("vision-clock-timer");

      visionTimerInterval = setInterval(() => {
        visionTimeLeft -= 0.1;
        if (visionTimeLeft <= 0) {
          visionTimeLeft = 0;
          stopVisionTimer();
          if (timerEl) timerEl.classList.add("warning");
        }
        updateClockDisplay(visionTimeLeft);
      }, 100);
    }

    function stopVisionTimer() {
      visionTimerRunning = false;
      if (visionTimerInterval) {
        clearInterval(visionTimerInterval);
        visionTimerInterval = null;
      }
    }

    function updateClockDisplay(sec) {
      const timerEl = document.getElementById("vision-clock-timer");
      if (!timerEl) return;
      timerEl.textContent = `${sec.toFixed(1)}s`;
      timerEl.classList.toggle("warning", sec <= 3.0 && sec > 0);
    }

    // 5-Dimensional Skill Radar & Performance Updating
    function updateVisionRadarUI() {
      const stats = getVisionStats();

      const getPct = (cat) => {
        if (!stats[cat] || stats[cat].total === 0) return 0;
        return Math.round((stats[cat].correct / stats[cat].total) * 100);
      };

      const formPct = getPct('formationRecognition');
      const persPct = getPct('personnelRecognition');
      const covPct = getPct('coverageRecognition');
      const pressPct = getPct('pressureRecognition');
      const intentPct = getPct('offensiveIntent');

      const setBar = (id, pct) => {
        const val = document.getElementById(`${id}-val`);
        const grade = document.getElementById(`${id}-grade`);
        const bar = document.getElementById(`${id}-bar`);
        if (val) val.textContent = `${pct}%`;
        if (grade) {
          grade.textContent = getVisionGrade(pct);
          grade.className = `film-radar-grade ${getVisionGradeClass(pct)}`;
        }
        if (bar) bar.style.width = `${pct}%`;
      };

      setBar('vskill-formation', formPct);
      setBar('vskill-personnel', persPct);
      setBar('vskill-coverage', covPct);
      setBar('vskill-pressure', pressPct);
      setBar('vskill-intent', intentPct);

      // Overall IQ Calculation
      const totalCorrect = (stats.formationRecognition.correct || 0) + (stats.personnelRecognition.correct || 0) +
        (stats.coverageRecognition.correct || 0) + (stats.pressureRecognition.correct || 0) +
        (stats.offensiveIntent.correct || 0);
      const totalAttempts = (stats.formationRecognition.total || 0) + (stats.personnelRecognition.total || 0) +
        (stats.coverageRecognition.total || 0) + (stats.pressureRecognition.total || 0) +
        (stats.offensiveIntent.total || 0);

      const overallAccuracy = totalAttempts > 0 ? (totalCorrect / totalAttempts) : 0.8;
      const completionBonus = (stats.completed.length / NFL_DATA.visionChallenges.length) * 20;
      const visionIQ = Math.min(135, Math.round(75 + overallAccuracy * 40 + completionBonus));

      const iqNum = document.getElementById("vision-iq-number");
      const iqRank = document.getElementById("vision-iq-rank");
      if (iqNum) iqNum.textContent = visionIQ;
      if (iqRank) {
        if (visionIQ >= 120) iqRank.textContent = "(All-Pro QB)";
        else if (visionIQ >= 105) iqRank.textContent = "(Varsity Starter)";
        else if (visionIQ >= 90) iqRank.textContent = "(Pro Prospect)";
        else iqRank.textContent = "(Rookie Scout)";
      }

      // Targeted Coach Advice
      const adviceEl = document.getElementById("vision-coach-advice");
      if (adviceEl) {
        const scores = [
          { name: "Coverage Recognition", pct: covPct, tip: "Achte zuerst auf die Tiefe beider Safeties (1 oder 2 hoch) und prüfe, ob die Mitte offen ist (MOFO)." },
          { name: "Pressure & Blitz", pct: pressPct, tip: "Scanne die A-Gaps nach mugged Linebackern und prüfe unblockierte Overhangs vor dem Snap." },
          { name: "Offensive Intent & Reads", pct: intentPct, tip: "Finde den 'Conflict Defender' im Apex-Raum und lies seine ersten Schritte im Mesh Point." },
          { name: "Formation & Personnel", pct: formPct, tip: "Zähle die Receiver auf beiden Flügeln, um Passing Strength (Trips vs 2x2) sofort zu bestimmen." }
        ];
        scores.sort((a, b) => a.pct - b.pct);
        adviceEl.innerHTML = `<span style="font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent-cyan);">COACH VISION TIPP:</span> Bei ${scores[0].name} liegt dein größter Hebel: ${scores[0].tip}`;
      }
    }

    function getVisionCategoryLabel(cat) {
      switch (cat) {
        case 'formationRecognition': return 'FORMATION RECOGNITION';
        case 'personnelRecognition': return 'PERSONNEL & BOX COUNT';
        case 'coverageRecognition': return 'COVERAGE & SHELL READ';
        case 'pressureRecognition': return 'PRESSURE & BLITZ SCAN';
        case 'offensiveIntent': return 'OFFENSIVE INTENT & READ';
        default: return 'PRE-SNAP VISION';
      }
    }

    function getVisionGrade(pct) {
      if (pct >= 90) return 'A+';
      if (pct >= 80) return 'A';
      if (pct >= 70) return 'B';
      if (pct >= 60) return 'C';
      return 'ROOKIE';
    }

    function getVisionGradeClass(pct) {
      if (pct >= 80) return 'a';
      if (pct >= 60) return 'b';
      return 'c';
    }

    /* ==================== WHAT WOULD YOU CALL? COACHING CONTROLLER ==================== */
    const callSimulatorState = {
      activeScenarioId: 'call_01_4th_and_1_opp_34',
      activeLevelFilter: 'all',
      activeOptionId: null,
      comparingAll: false,
      stats: {
        attempted: 0,
        completed: [],
        optimalCalls: 0,
        viableCalls: 0,
        traditionalCalls: 0,
        criticalErrors: 0,
        history: {}
      }
    };

    // Initialize State from LocalStorage
    try {
      const savedCallStats = localStorage.getItem('nfl_call_stats');
      if (savedCallStats) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedCallStats);
        if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
          callSimulatorState.stats = Object.assign(callSimulatorState.stats, parsed);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) { }

    function getCallStats() {
      return callSimulatorState.stats;
    }

    function saveCallStats() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('nfl_call_stats', JSON.stringify(callSimulatorState.stats));
      } catch (e) { }
    }

    function getAvailableCallScenarios() {
      if (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.whatWouldYouCallScenarios && NFL_DATA.whatWouldYouCallScenarios.length) {
        return NFL_DATA.whatWouldYouCallScenarios;
      }
      return [];
    }

    function initWhatWouldYouCall() {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      if (!scenarios || !scenarios.length) return;

      // 1. Setup Level Filter Buttons
      const levelBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.call-lvl-btn');
      levelBtns.forEach(btn => {
        btn.onclick = () => {
          const lvl = btn.dataset.lvl;
          callSimulatorState.activeLevelFilter = lvl;
          levelBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn));
          renderCallScenarioPills();

          // If current scenario not in this level, switch to first in filter
          const current = scenarios.find(s => s.id === callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId);
          if (lvl !== 'all' && (!current || current.level !== lvl)) {
            const first = scenarios.find(s => s.level === lvl);
            if (first) {
              loadCallScenario(first.id);
            }
          }
        };
      });

      // 2. Setup Next Scenario Button
      const nextBtn = document.getElementById('call-btn-next-scenario');
      if (nextBtn) {
        nextBtn.onclick = () => {
          const filtered = scenarios.filter(s => callSimulatorState.activeLevelFilter === 'all' || s.level === callSimulatorState.activeLevelFilter);
          const currIdx = filtered.findIndex(s => s.id === callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId);
          const nextIdx = (currIdx + 1) % filtered.length;
          loadCallScenario(filtered[nextIdx].id);
        };
      }

      // 3. Setup Compare All Button
      const compareBtn = document.getElementById('call-btn-compare-all');
      if (compareBtn) {
        compareBtn.onclick = () => toggleCompareAllOptions();
      }

      // 4. Render Scenario Carousel & Load Active Scenario
      renderCallScenarioPills();
      loadCallScenario(callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId || scenarios[0].id);

      // 5. Wire Clock Rules Quick Reference
      const sc = document.getElementById("ck-coach");
      if (sc && typeof CK !== 'undefined') {
        sc.innerHTML = Object.keys(CK).map(k => `<option value="${k}">${k}</option>`).join('');
        const uc = () => {
          const r = CK[sc.value];
          const res = document.getElementById("ckr-coach");
          if (r && res) {
            res.innerHTML = `
          <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:10px;">
            <div style="background:rgba(15,23,42,0.8); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px;">
              <span style="font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700;">Game Clock Status</span>
              <div style="color:#38bdf8; font-weight:700; margin-top:3px;">${r[0]}</div>
            </div>
            <div style="background:rgba(15,23,42,0.8); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); padding:8px 12px; border-radius:6px;">
              <span style="font-size:11px; color:#94a3b8; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700;">Play Clock Timer</span>
              <div style="color:#fbbf24; font-weight:700; margin-top:3px;">${r[1]}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
          }
        };
        sc.onchange = uc;
        uc();
      }
    }

    function renderCallScenarioPills() {
      const container = document.getElementById('call-scenario-pills');
      if (!container) return;

      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      const filter = callSimulatorState.activeLevelFilter;
      const filtered = scenarios.filter(s => filter === 'all' || s.level === filter);

      container.innerHTML = filtered.map(sc => {
        const isCompleted = callSimulatorState.stats.completed.includes(sc.id);
        const isActive = sc.id === callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId;
        const history = callSimulatorState.stats.history[sc.id];
        let badgeText = sc.level.toUpperCase();
        if (isCompleted) badgeText += ' ✓';

        return `
      <div class="call-pill-item ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="loadCallScenario('${sc.id}')">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
          <span class="call-pill-lvl">${badgeText}</span>
          ${history ? `<span style="font-size:10px; color:${history.epa && history.epa.startsWith('+') ? '#34d399' : '#f87171'}; font-weight:700;">${history.epa}</span>` : ''}
        </div>
        <div class="call-pill-title" title="${sc.title}">${sc.title}</div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function loadCallScenario(scenarioId) {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === scenarioId) || scenarios[0];
      if (!sc) return;

      callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId = sc.id;
      callSimulatorState.comparingAll = false;

      // Update pills active state
      renderCallScenarioPills();

      // Parse Score KC 17 - PHI 17
      const scoreParts = sc.telemetry.score ? sc.telemetry.score.split('-') : ['AWAY 0', 'HOME 0'];
      const awayPart = scoreParts[0] ? scoreParts[0].trim().split(' ') : ['AWY', '0'];
      const homePart = scoreParts[1] ? scoreParts[1].trim().split(' ') : ['HOM', '0'];

      const setTxt = (id, val) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = val || '';
      };

      setTxt('call-team-away', awayPart[0] || 'KC');
      setTxt('call-score-away', awayPart[1] || '17');
      setTxt('call-score-home', homePart[1] || '17');
      setTxt('call-team-home', homePart[0] || 'PHI');

      setTxt('call-hud-weather', sc.telemetry.weather || 'Standardbedingungen');
      setTxt('call-hud-quarter', sc.telemetry.quarter || 'Q1');
      setTxt('call-hud-gameclock', sc.telemetry.gameClock || '15:00');
      setTxt('call-hud-playclock', sc.telemetry.playClock || '0:25');
      setTxt('call-hud-down', sc.telemetry.downDistance || sc.telemetry.down);
      setTxt('call-hud-spot', sc.telemetry.fieldPosition || 'MID 50');
      setTxt('call-hud-timeouts', sc.telemetry.timeouts || 'Off: 3 | Def: 3');

      setTxt('call-meta-personnel', sc.telemetry.personnel);
      setTxt('call-meta-formation', sc.telemetry.offensiveFormation);
      setTxt('call-meta-defalign', sc.telemetry.defensiveAlignment);
      setTxt('call-meta-defcov', sc.telemetry.defensiveCoverage);

      setTxt('call-scenario-tag', sc.levelLabel || `Level: ${sc.level.toUpperCase()}`);
      setTxt('call-scenario-title', sc.title);
      setTxt('call-scenario-dilemma', sc.situationDilemma);

      // Render Decision Options
      const optContainer = document.getElementById('call-options-container');
      if (optContainer) {
        const history = callSimulatorState.stats.history[sc.id];
        optContainer.innerHTML = sc.options.map(opt => {
          const isSelected = history && history.optionId === opt.id;
          return `
        <button class="call-option-card ${isSelected ? 'selected' : ''}" id="call-opt-btn-${opt.id}" onclick="handleCallDecision('${sc.id}', '${opt.id}')">
          <div class="call-opt-main">
            <span class="call-opt-concept">${opt.concept}</span>
            <span class="call-opt-title">${opt.title}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="call-opt-badge-col">
            <span class="call-opt-badge">${formatCallType(opt.callType)}</span>
            <span class="call-epa-pill ${getEpaClass(opt.epaImpact)}">${opt.epaImpact}</span>
          </div>
        </button>
      `;
        }).join('');
      }

      // If user previously made a call in this scenario, display debrief
      const history = callSimulatorState.stats.history[sc.id];
      if (history && history.optionId) {
        renderCallDebrief(sc, history.optionId);
      } else {
        // Show Placeholder
        const placeholder = document.getElementById('call-debrief-placeholder');
        const content = document.getElementById('call-debrief-content');
        if (placeholder) placeholder.style.display = 'flex';
        if (content) content.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    function formatCallType(type) {
      const map = {
        'go_run': 'Run Play',
        'go_pass': 'Pass Play',
        'fg': 'Field Goal',
        'punt': 'Punt',
        'hard_count': 'Hard Count',
        'pat': 'Kick Extra Point',
        'two_point': '2-Point Attempt',
        'def_pass': 'Coverage Shell',
        'def_blitz': 'Pressure Blitz',
        'def_zone': 'Zone Match'
      };
      return map[type] || 'Play Call';
    }

    function getEpaClass(epa) {
      if (!epa) return 'epa-neu';
      if (epa.startsWith('+')) return 'epa-pos';
      if (epa.startsWith('-')) return 'epa-neg';
      return 'epa-neu';
    }

    function getGradeClass(grade) {
      if (!grade) return 'grade-viable';
      const g = grade.toLowerCase();
      if (g.includes('optimal')) return 'grade-optimal';
      if (g.includes('vertretbar') || g.includes('viable')) return 'grade-viable';
      if (g.includes('traditionell') || g.includes('konservativ')) return 'grade-traditional';
      if (g.includes('fehler') || g.includes('kritisch') || g.includes('risiko')) return 'grade-critical';
      return 'grade-viable';
    }

    function handleCallDecision(scenarioId, optionId) {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === scenarioId);
      if (!sc) return;

      const opt = sc.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!opt) return;

      callSimulatorState.activeOptionId = optionId;

      // Update selected class on cards
      document.querySelectorAll('.call-option-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
      const activeBtn = document.getElementById(`call-opt-btn-${optionId}`);
      if (activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('selected');

      // Record Stats
      const stats = callSimulatorState.stats;
      const isNew = !stats.completed.includes(sc.id);
      if (isNew) {
        stats.attempted += 1;
        stats.completed.push(sc.id);
      }

      // Categorize call quality
      const gradeLower = (opt.evaluationGrade || '').toLowerCase();
      if (gradeLower.includes('optimal')) stats.optimalCalls += 1;
      else if (gradeLower.includes('vertretbar')) stats.viableCalls += 1;
      else if (gradeLower.includes('traditionell')) stats.traditionalCalls += 1;
      else if (gradeLower.includes('fehler') || gradeLower.includes('kritisch')) stats.criticalErrors += 1;

      stats.history[sc.id] = {
        optionId: opt.id,
        grade: opt.evaluationGrade,
        epa: opt.epaImpact,
        timestamp: Date.now()
      };

      saveCallStats();
      renderCallScenarioPills();

      // Render Debrief
      renderCallDebrief(sc, optionId);

      // Update Progress View if active
      if (typeof renderProgressView === 'function') {
        try { renderProgressView(); } catch (e) { }
      }
    }

    function renderCallDebrief(scenario, optionId) {
      const opt = scenario.options.find(o => o.id === optionId);
      if (!opt) return;

      const placeholder = document.getElementById('call-debrief-placeholder');
      const content = document.getElementById('call-debrief-content');
      if (placeholder) placeholder.style.display = 'none';
      if (content) content.style.display = 'flex';

      const setTxt = (id, val) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = val || '';
      };

      setTxt('call-res-choice-title', opt.title);

      // Grade pill
      const gradeEl = document.getElementById('call-res-grade');
      if (gradeEl) {
        gradeEl.textContent = opt.evaluationGrade;
        gradeEl.className = `call-grade-pill ${getGradeClass(opt.evaluationGrade)}`;
      }

      // EPA pill
      const epaEl = document.getElementById('call-res-epa');
      if (epaEl) {
        epaEl.textContent = opt.epaImpact;
        epaEl.className = `call-epa-pill ${getEpaClass(opt.epaImpact)}`;
      }

      setTxt('call-res-rationale', opt.detailedRationale);
      setTxt('call-res-pros', opt.pros);
      setTxt('call-res-risks', opt.risks);
      setTxt('call-res-field-impact', opt.fieldPositionImpact);
      setTxt('call-res-clock-impact', opt.clockAndScoreImpact);

      // Consensus
      const con = scenario.consensus || {};
      setTxt('call-con-rec', con.professionalRecommendation);
      setTxt('call-con-alt', con.alternativeViable);
      setTxt('call-con-pitfall', con.traditionalPitfall);
      setTxt('call-con-golden', con.goldenRule);
    }

    function toggleCompareAllOptions() {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId);
      if (!sc) return;

      callSimulatorState.comparingAll = !callSimulatorState.comparingAll;
      const compareBtn = document.getElementById('call-btn-compare-all');
      if (compareBtn) {
        compareBtn.textContent = callSimulatorState.comparingAll ? '✕ Detailansicht schließen' : '🔄 Alle Optionen vergleichen';
      }

      const rationaleBox = document.querySelector('.call-rationale-box');
      if (!rationaleBox) return;

      if (callSimulatorState.comparingAll) {
        rationaleBox.innerHTML = `
      <span class="call-section-heading">Direkter Vergleich aller Play-Calls:</span>
      <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top:8px;">
        ${sc.options.map(o => `
          <div style="background:rgba(15,23,42,0.9); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="handleCallDecision('${sc.id}', '${o.id}')">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;">
              <span style="font-weight:700; color:#f1f5f9; font-size:13.5px;">${o.title}</span>
              <div style="display:flex; gap:6px;">
                <span class="call-grade-pill ${getGradeClass(o.evaluationGrade)}" style="font-size:11px; padding:2px 6px;">${o.evaluationGrade}</span>
                <span class="call-epa-pill ${getEpaClass(o.epaImpact)}" style="font-size:11px; padding:2px 6px;">${o.epaImpact}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p style="margin:0; font-size:12.5px; color:#cbd5e1; line-height:1.4;">${o.detailedRationale}</p>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    `;
      } else {
        // Restore single rationale
        const currentHistory = callSimulatorState.stats.history[sc.id];
        const currentOpt = sc.options.find(o => o.id === (callSimulatorState.activeOptionId || (currentHistory ? currentHistory.optionId : sc.options[0].id)));
        if (currentOpt) {
          rationaleBox.innerHTML = `
        <span class="call-section-heading">Taktische Analyse deines Calls:</span>
        <p id="call-res-rationale">${currentOpt.detailedRationale}</p>
      `;
        }
      }
    }

    // Backward Compatibility Wrappers for any legacy calls
    function initCoach() {
      initWhatWouldYouCall();
    }

    function loadCoachScenario(idx) {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      if (scenarios && scenarios[idx]) {
        loadCallScenario(scenarios[idx].id);
      }
    }

    function handleCoachOption(optIndex) {
      const scenarios = getAvailableCallScenarios();
      const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === callSimulatorState.activeScenarioId);
      if (sc && sc.options && sc.options[optIndex]) {
        handleCallDecision(sc.id, sc.options[optIndex].id);
      }
    }

    /* ==================== NFL GAME CLOCK & PLAY CLOCK SIMULATOR ==================== */
    let currentLabMode = 'field'; // 'field' | 'clock'

    function switchLabMode(mode) {
      currentLabMode = mode;
      const btnField = document.getElementById('btn-lab-mode-field');
      const btnClock = document.getElementById('btn-lab-mode-clock');
      const fieldContainer = document.getElementById('lab-field-container');
      const clockContainer = document.getElementById('lab-clock-container');

      if (btnField) btnField.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'field');
      if (btnClock) btnClock.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'clock');

      if (fieldContainer) fieldContainer.style.display = mode === 'field' ? 'block' : 'none';
      if (clockContainer) clockContainer.style.display = mode === 'clock' ? 'flex' : 'none';

      if (mode === 'field' && labEngine) {
        labEngine.render();
      }
      if (mode === 'clock' && typeof clockEngine !== 'undefined') {
        clockEngine.init();
      }
    }

    function openClockSimulator(scenarioId) {
      setView('lab');
      switchLabMode('clock');
      if (scenarioId && typeof clockEngine !== 'undefined') {
        clockEngine.loadScenario(scenarioId);
      }
    }

    const clockEngine = {
      // Game Clock State
      gameClock: {
        totalSeconds: 120.0,
        isRunning: false,
        restartCondition: 'snap', // 'snap' | 'ref_wind' | 'continuous' | 'kickoff'
        timerHandle: null
      },

      // Play Clock State
      playClock: {
        secondsRemaining: 40,
        maxDuration: 40,
        isRunning: false,
        status: '40s', // '40s' | '25s' | 'off'
        timerHandle: null,
        delayOfGame: false
      },

      // Context State
      context: {
        quarter: 4,
        down: 2,
        distance: 6,
        isGoalToGo: false,
        yardLine: 'OPP 35',
        possession: 'HOME',
        homeScore: 21,
        awayScore: 24,
        homeTimeouts: 2,
        awayTimeouts: 3,
        activeScenarioId: 'sandbox',
        scenarioStepIndex: 0
      },

      simSpeed: 1, // 1, 2, 5
      eventHistory: [],
      isInitialized: false,

      init() {
        if (this.isInitialized) return;
        this.isInitialized = true;

        this.renderScenarioPills();
        this.renderEventCards();
        this.updateDisplay();
        this.startTicker();
      },

      startTicker() {
        if (this.tickerHandle) clearInterval(this.tickerHandle);
        this.tickerHandle = setInterval(() => {
          this.tick();
        }, 100); // 100ms interval for smooth sub-second clock
      },

      tick() {
        const delta = 0.1 * this.simSpeed;
        let needsUpdate = false;

        // 1. Tick Game Clock if running
        if (this.gameClock.isRunning && this.gameClock.totalSeconds > 0) {
          const prevSec = this.gameClock.totalSeconds;
          this.gameClock.totalSeconds = Math.max(0, this.gameClock.totalSeconds - delta);
          needsUpdate = true;

          // Two-minute warning check in Q2 or Q4
          if ((this.context.quarter === 2 || this.context.quarter === 4) && prevSec > 120.0 && this.gameClock.totalSeconds <= 120.0) {
            this.gameClock.totalSeconds = 120.0;
            this.triggerEvent('event_two_minute_warning');
            return;
          }

          // Quarter end check
          if (this.gameClock.totalSeconds <= 0) {
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.playClock.isRunning = false;
            this.handleQuarterEnd();
          }
        }
