        // 2. Tick Play Clock if running
        if (this.playClock.isRunning && this.playClock.secondsRemaining > 0) {
          this.playClock.secondsRemaining = Math.max(0, this.playClock.secondsRemaining - delta);
          needsUpdate = true;

          if (this.playClock.secondsRemaining <= 0) {
            this.playClock.delayOfGame = true;
            this.playClock.isRunning = false;
            this.handleDelayOfGame();
          }
        }

        if (needsUpdate) {
          this.updateDisplay();
        }
      },

      toggleRunning() {
        this.gameClock.isRunning = !this.gameClock.isRunning;
        if (this.gameClock.isRunning) {
          this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
        }
        this.updateDisplay();
      },

      snapBall() {
        // Snapping the ball always starts the game clock (unless untimed down)
        this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
        this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
        // Reset play clock to off or running during play
        this.playClock.delayOfGame = false;
        this.playClock.isRunning = false;

        this.showRuleRationale(
          "Ball gesnappt (Snap)",
          "Rule 4-3: Offizieller Snap",
          "Der Ball wurde legal gesnappt. Dadurch startet die Game Clock unmittelbar und läuft während des Spielzugs kontinuierlich weiter.",
          "Läuft kontinuierlich",
          "Aktuell aktiv",
          "Aus während des Spielzugs",
          "NFL Rule 4-3-1: 'The game clock starts when the ball is legally snapped.'"
        );

        this.logEvent("⚡ Ball Snap", "Spielzug gestartet");
        this.updateDisplay();
      },

      tickStep(seconds) {
        if (this.gameClock.totalSeconds > 0) {
          this.gameClock.totalSeconds = Math.max(0, this.gameClock.totalSeconds - seconds);
        }
        if (this.playClock.secondsRemaining > 0) {
          this.playClock.secondsRemaining = Math.max(0, this.playClock.secondsRemaining - seconds);
        }
        this.updateDisplay();
      },

      setSpeed(s) {
        this.simSpeed = s;
        [1, 2, 5].forEach(val => {
          const btn = document.getElementById(`btn-speed-${val}`);
          if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', val === s);
        });
      },

      consumeTimeout(team) {
        if (team === 'off' && this.context.homeTimeouts > 0) {
          this.context.homeTimeouts -= 1;
          this.triggerEvent('event_timeout');
        } else if (team === 'def' && this.context.awayTimeouts > 0) {
          this.context.awayTimeouts -= 1;
          this.triggerEvent('event_timeout');
        }
      },

      triggerEvent(eventId) {
        const ev = (typeof NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS !== 'undefined') ? NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS.find(e => e.id === eventId) : null;
        if (!ev) return;

        const isInside2Min = (this.context.quarter === 2 || this.context.quarter === 4) && this.gameClock.totalSeconds <= 120.0;
        const isInside5Min = this.context.quarter === 4 && this.gameClock.totalSeconds <= 300.0;

        switch (eventId) {
          case 'event_complete_in_bounds':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.advanceDownAndDistance(7);
            break;

          case 'event_incomplete_pass':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.advanceDownOnly();
            break;

          case 'event_sack_run_in_bounds':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.advanceDownAndDistance(-6);
            break;

          case 'event_first_down_in_bounds':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.context.down = 1;
            this.context.distance = 10;
            break;

          case 'event_out_of_bounds':
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;

            if (isInside2Min || isInside5Min) {
              // Inside 2m Q2 or 5m Q4: stops until snap!
              this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
              this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            } else {
              // Outside: stops temporarily until referee wind (Ready for Play)
              this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
              this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'ref_wind';
              setTimeout(() => {
                if (this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'ref_wind') {
                  this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
                  this.updateDisplay();
                }
              }, 2500 / this.simSpeed);
            }
            this.advanceDownAndDistance(8);
            break;

          case 'event_qb_spike':
            this.gameClock.totalSeconds = Math.max(0, this.gameClock.totalSeconds - 2.0);
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.advanceDownOnly();
            break;

          case 'event_timeout':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 25;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 25;
            this.playClock.status = '25s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            break;

          case 'event_two_minute_warning':
            this.gameClock.totalSeconds = 120.0;
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 25;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 25;
            this.playClock.status = '25s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            break;

          case 'event_penalty':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            // Check 10-second runoff
            if (isInside2Min && this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'continuous' && this.context.homeTimeouts === 0) {
              this.gameClock.totalSeconds = Math.max(0, this.gameClock.totalSeconds - 10.0);
            }
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'ref_wind';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 25;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 25;
            this.playClock.status = '25s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            break;

          case 'event_change_of_possession':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 25;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 25;
            this.playClock.status = '25s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.context.possession = this.context.possession === 'HOME' ? 'AWAY' : 'HOME';
            this.context.down = 1;
            this.context.distance = 10;
            break;

          case 'event_score':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'kickoff';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 25;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 25;
            this.playClock.status = '25s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            if (this.context.possession === 'HOME') this.context.homeScore += 7;
            else this.context.awayScore += 7;
            break;

          case 'event_kneel_down':
            this.gameClock.isRunning = true;
            this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'continuous';
            this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
            this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
            this.playClock.status = '40s';
            this.playClock.isRunning = true;
            this.advanceDownAndDistance(-1);
            break;
        }

        this.showRuleRationale(
          ev.name,
          ev.ruleTitle,
          ev.rationale,
          this.gameClock.isRunning ? "Läuft kontinuierlich" : (this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'snap' ? "Angehalten (Bis zum Snap)" : "Angehalten (Bis Ref-Wind)"),
          this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'snap' ? "Beim nächsten Snap" : (this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'ref_wind' ? "Auf Schiedsrichter-Signal (Ready)" : "Bereits aktiv"),
          `${ev.playClockDuration} Sekunden (${ev.playClockDuration === 40 ? 'Standard' : 'Administrativ'})`,
          ev.nflRuleRef
        );

        this.logEvent(ev.name, `GC: ${this.formatClock(this.gameClock.totalSeconds)} | PC: ${Math.ceil(this.playClock.secondsRemaining)}s`);
        this.checkScenarioProgress(eventId);
        this.updateDisplay();
      },

      advanceDownAndDistance(yardsGained) {
        if (this.context.distance <= yardsGained) {
          this.context.down = 1;
          this.context.distance = 10;
        } else {
          this.context.distance = Math.max(1, this.context.distance - yardsGained);
          this.context.down = (this.context.down % 4) + 1;
        }
      },

      advanceDownOnly() {
        this.context.down = (this.context.down % 4) + 1;
      },

      handleDelayOfGame() {
        this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
        this.showRuleRationale(
          "⚠️ Delay of Game Flagge!",
          "Rule 4-6-1: Spielverzögerung",
          "Die 40- bzw. 25-Sekunden-Play-Clock ist abgelaufen, bevor der Ball gesnappt wurde! Die Schiedsrichter pfeifen den Spielzug ab: 5 Yards Strafe gegen die Offense, Wiederholung des Downs.",
          "Gestoppt für Strafe",
          "Auf Schiedsrichter-Signal",
          "25 Sekunden nach Administration",
          "NFL Rule 4, Section 6, Article 1: 'Failure to snap the ball before the play clock expires is Delay of Game (5-yard penalty).'"
        );
        this.logEvent("⚠️ Delay of Game", "5 Yards Strafe (Play Clock abgelaufen)");
      },

      handleQuarterEnd() {
        this.showRuleRationale(
          "Ende des Viertels",
          "Rule 4-1-2: Ablauf der regulären Spielzeit",
          `Die Game Clock für Viertel ${this.context.quarter} ist abgelaufen.`,
          "0:00 (Beendet)",
          "Nächstes Viertel",
          "Off",
          "NFL Rule 4, Section 1: 'Each period consists of 15 minutes.'"
        );
      },

      showRuleRationale(title, tag, body, gcStatus, restart, pcStatus, nflRef) {
        const tEl = document.getElementById('clock-rule-title');
        const tagEl = document.getElementById('clock-rule-tag');
        const bEl = document.getElementById('clock-rule-body');
        const refEl = document.getElementById('clock-rule-ref');
        const mCard = document.getElementById('clock-rule-metrics');
        const mgc = document.getElementById('clock-metric-gc');
        const mr = document.getElementById('clock-metric-restart');
        const mpc = document.getElementById('clock-metric-pc');

        if (tEl) tEl.textContent = title;
        if (tagEl) tagEl.textContent = tag;
        if (refEl) refEl.textContent = nflRef ? nflRef.split(':')[0] : 'NFL Rule 4';
        if (bEl) bEl.innerHTML = `<p>${body}</p>${nflRef ? `<p style="margin-top:8px; font-size:12px; color:#facc15; font-style:italic;">"${nflRef}"</p>` : ''}`;

        if (mCard) mCard.style.display = 'grid';
        if (mgc) mgc.textContent = gcStatus;
        if (mr) mr.textContent = restart;
        if (mpc) mpc.textContent = pcStatus;
      },

      logEvent(name, note) {
        this.eventHistory.unshift({
          name,
          note,
          gc: this.formatClock(this.gameClock.totalSeconds),
          pc: Math.ceil(this.playClock.secondsRemaining),
          time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString()
        });
        this.renderEventLog();
      },

      clearEventLog() {
        this.eventHistory = [];
        this.renderEventLog();
      },

      renderEventLog() {
        const container = document.getElementById('clock-event-log-list');
        if (!container) return;

        if (!this.eventHistory.length) {
          container.innerHTML = '<div class="log-empty-state">Noch keine Events im aktuellen Drive ausgelöst.</div>';
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = this.eventHistory.slice(0, 15).map(item => `
      <div class="log-item">
        <div class="log-item-left">
          <span class="log-item-icon">⏱</span>
          <span class="log-item-name">${item.name}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="log-item-clocks">${item.note}</div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
      },

      formatClock(sec) {
        const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
        const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
        const ms = Math.floor((sec % 1) * 10);
        return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}.${ms}`;
      },

      updateDisplay() {
        // 1. Game Clock Digits
        const gcEl = document.getElementById('hud-gc-digits');
        if (gcEl) {
          gcEl.textContent = this.formatClock(this.gameClock.totalSeconds);
          if (this.gameClock.totalSeconds <= 120 && (this.context.quarter === 2 || this.context.quarter === 4)) {
            gcEl.style.color = '#ef4444';
          } else {
            gcEl.style.color = '#38bdf8';
          }
        }

        // 2. Game Clock Status Pill
        const gcPill = document.getElementById('hud-gc-status-pill');
        const gcSub = document.getElementById('hud-gc-restart-info');
        if (gcPill) {
          if (this.gameClock.isRunning) {
            gcPill.textContent = 'LÄUFT (IN-BOUNDS)';
            gcPill.className = 'clock-status-pill running';
            if (gcSub) gcSub.textContent = 'Läuft kontinuierlich weiter';
          } else {
            if (this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'snap') {
              gcPill.textContent = 'STOPPT (BIS SNAP)';
              gcPill.className = 'clock-status-pill stopped';
              if (gcSub) gcSub.textContent = 'Startet beim nächsten Snap';
            } else if (this.gameClock.restartCondition === 'ref_wind') {
              gcPill.textContent = 'STOPPT (REF-SIGNAL)';
              gcPill.className = 'clock-status-pill refwind';
              if (gcSub) gcSub.textContent = 'Startet auf Ready-Signal des Referees';
            } else {
              gcPill.textContent = 'ANGEHALTEN';
              gcPill.className = 'clock-status-pill stopped';
            }
          }
        }

        // 3. Play Clock Digits
        const pcEl = document.getElementById('hud-pc-digits');
        const pcPill = document.getElementById('hud-pc-status-pill');
        const pcSub = document.getElementById('hud-pc-type-info');
        const pcSec = Math.ceil(this.playClock.secondsRemaining);

        if (pcEl) {
          pcEl.textContent = pcSec;
          if (this.playClock.delayOfGame) {
            pcEl.className = 'clock-digits-display play-digits play-critical';
          } else if (pcSec <= 5) {
            pcEl.className = 'clock-digits-display play-digits play-critical';
          } else if (pcSec <= 10) {
            pcEl.className = 'clock-digits-display play-digits play-warning';
          } else {
            pcEl.className = 'clock-digits-display play-digits';
          }
        }

        if (pcPill) {
          pcPill.textContent = `${this.playClock.maxDuration} SEK`;
        }
        if (pcSub) {
          pcSub.textContent = this.playClock.maxDuration === 40 ? 'Standard 40s nach Tackle' : 'Administrativ 25s nach Unterbrechung';
        }

        // 4. Toggle Play/Pause Button
        const playBtn = document.getElementById('btn-clock-toggle-play');
        if (playBtn) {
          if (this.gameClock.isRunning) {
            playBtn.textContent = '⏸ Game Clock anhalten';
            playBtn.classList.add('running');
          } else {
            playBtn.textContent = '▶ Game Clock starten';
            playBtn.classList.remove('running');
          }
        }

        // 5. Scoreboard & Context
        const qtrEl = document.getElementById('hud-quarter-val');
        if (qtrEl) qtrEl.textContent = `Q${this.context.quarter}`;

        const ddEl = document.getElementById('hud-down-distance-val');
        if (ddEl) ddEl.textContent = `${this.context.down}th & ${this.context.distance}`;

        const spotEl = document.getElementById('hud-spot-val');
        if (spotEl) spotEl.textContent = `Ball an ${this.context.yardLine}`;

        const scoreOff = document.getElementById('hud-score-off');
        const scoreDef = document.getElementById('hud-score-def');
        if (scoreOff) scoreOff.textContent = this.context.homeScore;
        if (scoreDef) scoreDef.textContent = this.context.awayScore;

        // 6. Timeouts Dots
        this.renderTimeoutDots('hud-to-dots-off', this.context.homeTimeouts, 'off');
        this.renderTimeoutDots('hud-to-dots-def', this.context.awayTimeouts, 'def');
      },

      renderTimeoutDots(containerId, count, team) {
        const container = document.getElementById(containerId);
        if (!container) return;
        container.innerHTML = [1, 2, 3].map(i => `
      <span class="to-dot ${i <= count ? 'active' : 'inactive'}" 
            title="${i <= count ? `Timeout für ${team.toUpperCase()} nehmen` : 'Aufgebraucht'}"
            onclick="clockEngine.consumeTimeout('${team}')"></span>
    `).join('');
      },

      renderScenarioPills() {
        const container = document.getElementById('clock-scen-pills-container');
        if (!container) return;

        const scenarios = (typeof NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS !== 'undefined') ? NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS : [];
        const allPills = [
          { id: 'sandbox', title: 'Freier Modus (Sandbox)' },
          ...scenarios
        ];

        container.innerHTML = allPills.map(s => `
      <button class="clock-scen-pill ${s.id === this.context.activeScenarioId ? 'active' : ''}" 
              onclick="clockEngine.loadScenario('${s.id}')">
        ${s.title}
      </button>
    `).join('');
      },

      renderEventCards() {
        const container = document.getElementById('clock-events-grid');
        if (!container) return;

        const events = (typeof NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS !== 'undefined') ? NFL_CLOCK_EVENTS : [];
        container.innerHTML = events.map(ev => {
          let pillClass = 'pill-run';
          let pillText = 'UHR LÄUFT';
          if (ev.gameClockAction === 'stops') {
            pillClass = 'pill-stop';
            pillText = 'UHR STOPPT';
          } else if (ev.gameClockAction === 'conditional') {
            pillClass = 'pill-cond';
            pillText = '2M / 5M REGEL';
          }

          return `
        <div class="clock-event-card" onclick="clockEngine.triggerEvent('${ev.id}')">
          <div class="clock-event-top">
            <span class="clock-event-icon">${ev.icon}</span>
            <span class="clock-event-name">${ev.name}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clock-event-desc">${ev.desc}</div>
          <span class="clock-event-pill ${pillClass}">${pillText} • ${ev.playClockDuration}s PC</span>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      loadScenario(scenarioId) {
        this.context.activeScenarioId = scenarioId;
        this.context.scenarioStepIndex = 0;
        this.renderScenarioPills();

        const detailBadge = document.getElementById('scen-active-badge');
        const detailTitle = document.getElementById('scen-active-title');
        const detailDesc = document.getElementById('scen-active-desc');
        const taskBox = document.getElementById('scen-active-task-box');
        const taskP = document.getElementById('scen-active-task');

        if (scenarioId === 'sandbox') {
          this.resetToDefaults();
          if (detailBadge) detailBadge.textContent = 'Freier Modus';
          if (detailTitle) detailTitle.textContent = 'Freie Uhren-Simulation';
          if (detailDesc) detailDesc.textContent = 'Du befindest dich im freien Sandbox-Modus. Du kannst beliebige Spielstände, Zeiten und Timeouts einstellen und die Auswirkung jedes Football-Events erforschen.';
          if (taskBox) taskBox.style.display = 'none';
          return;
        }

        const scenarios = (typeof NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS !== 'undefined') ? NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS : [];
        const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === scenarioId);
        if (!sc) return;

        // Apply initial scenario state
        this.context.quarter = sc.initial.quarter;
        this.gameClock.totalSeconds = sc.initial.gameClockSeconds;
        this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
        this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
        this.playClock.secondsRemaining = sc.initial.playClock;
        this.playClock.maxDuration = sc.initial.playClock;
        this.playClock.isRunning = false;

        this.context.down = sc.initial.down;
        this.context.distance = sc.initial.distance;
        this.context.yardLine = sc.initial.fieldPosition;
        this.context.homeScore = sc.initial.homeScore;
        this.context.awayScore = sc.initial.awayScore;
        this.context.homeTimeouts = sc.initial.timeouts;
        this.context.awayTimeouts = sc.initial.oppTimeouts;
        this.context.possession = sc.initial.possession;

        if (detailBadge) detailBadge.textContent = `${sc.level} Szenario`;
        if (detailTitle) detailTitle.textContent = sc.title;
        if (detailDesc) detailDesc.textContent = sc.description;
        if (taskBox) taskBox.style.display = 'block';
        if (taskP) taskP.textContent = sc.coachingTask;

        this.showRuleRationale(
          `Szenario geladen: ${sc.title}`,
          `Szenario-Start: ${sc.level}`,
          sc.description,
          "Angehalten",
          "Auf deinen Play-Call",
          `${sc.initial.playClock}s`,
          "Coaching Mission gestartet"
        );

        this.updateDisplay();
      },

      checkScenarioProgress(eventId) {
        if (this.context.activeScenarioId === 'sandbox') return;
        const scenarios = (typeof NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS !== 'undefined') ? NFL_CLOCK_SCENARIOS : [];
        const sc = scenarios.find(s => s.id === this.context.activeScenarioId);
        if (!sc || !sc.recommendedSequence) return;

        if (sc.recommendedSequence[this.context.scenarioStepIndex] === eventId) {
          this.context.scenarioStepIndex += 1;
          if (this.context.scenarioStepIndex >= sc.recommendedSequence.length) {
            setTimeout(() => {
              alert(`🎯 Szenario erfolgreich gemeistert!

Du hast die Uhren-Strategie für "${sc.title}" perfekt nach den offiziellen NFL-Regeln angewendet.`);
            }, 500);
          }
        }
      },

      resetToDefaults() {
        this.gameClock.totalSeconds = 120.0;
        this.gameClock.isRunning = false;
        this.gameClock.restartCondition = 'snap';
        this.playClock.secondsRemaining = 40;
        this.playClock.maxDuration = 40;
        this.playClock.isRunning = false;
        this.playClock.delayOfGame = false;
        this.context.quarter = 4;
        this.context.down = 2;
        this.context.distance = 6;
        this.context.yardLine = 'OPP 35';
        this.context.homeScore = 21;
        this.context.awayScore = 24;
        this.context.homeTimeouts = 2;
        this.context.awayTimeouts = 3;
        this.simSpeed = 1;
        this.updateDisplay();
      }
    };

    /* ==================== INTERACTIVE GLOSSARY & KNOWLEDGE GRAPH ENGINE ==================== */

    const glossaryEngine = {
      state: {
        activeTermId: 'cover_3',
        searchQuery: '',
        activeCategory: 'all',
        activeLevel: 'all',
        sortBy: 'alpha',
        graphMode: 'ego', // 'ego' | 'cluster'
        graphDepth: 1,
        zoom: 1.0,
        pan: { x: 0, y: 0 },
        isDragging: false,
        dragStart: { x: 0, y: 0 },
        isInitialized: false
      },

      categoryColors: {
        'defense_coverage': '#38bdf8',
        'safety_alignment': '#6366f1',
        'offense_pass': '#f97316',
        'offense_run': '#10b981',
        'formations_personnel': '#a855f7',
        'pressure_fronts': '#f43f5e',
        'game_rules_clock': '#f59e0b'
      },

      categoryLabels: {
        'defense_coverage': '🛡️ Coverages',
        'safety_alignment': '👀 Safety & Box',
        'offense_pass': '🏈 Pass-Konzepte',
        'offense_run': '🏃 Laufspiel',
        'formations_personnel': '📐 Formationen',
        'pressure_fronts': '💥 Pressure & Fronts',
        'game_rules_clock': '⏱️ Regeln & Uhren'
      },

      init() {
        if (this.state.isInitialized) return;
        this.state.isInitialized = true;

        // Search input listener
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('glossary-search-input');
        if (searchInput) {
          searchInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
            this.state.searchQuery = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            this.renderCards();
          });
        }

        // Attach pan/zoom listeners to SVG viewport
        this.setupSvgPanZoom();

        // Initial render
        this.renderCards();
        this.selectTerm(this.state.activeTermId, false);
      },

      getAllTerms() {
        if (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.glossary && NFL_DATA.glossary.length > 0) {
          return NFL_DATA.glossary;
        }
        if (typeof NFL_GLOSSARY_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_GLOSSARY_DATA.length > 0) {
          return NFL_GLOSSARY_DATA;
        }
        return [];
      },

      getTermById(id) {
        const terms = this.getAllTerms();
        return terms.find(t => t.id === id) || null;
      },

      setCategory(cat) {
        this.state.activeCategory = cat;
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('#glossary-cat-pills .gloss-pill');
        pills.forEach(p => {
          p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.cat === cat);
        });
        this.renderCards();
      },

      setLevel(lvl) {
        this.state.activeLevel = lvl;
        const pills = document.querySelectorAll('#glossary-lvl-pills .gloss-pill');
        pills.forEach(p => {
          p.classList.toggle('active', p.dataset.lvl === lvl);
        });
        this.renderCards();
      },

      setSorting(sortBy) {
        this.state.sortBy = sortBy;
        this.renderCards();
      },

      clearSearch() {
        this.state.searchQuery = '';
        const input = document.getElementById('glossary-search-input');
        if (input) input.value = '';
        this.renderCards();
      },

      resetFilters() {
        this.state.searchQuery = '';
        this.state.activeCategory = 'all';
        this.state.activeLevel = 'all';
        this.state.sortBy = 'alpha';

        const input = document.getElementById('glossary-search-input');
        if (input) input.value = '';

        const sortSelect = document.getElementById('glossary-sort-select');
        if (sortSelect) sortSelect.value = 'alpha';

        this.setCategory('all');
        this.setLevel('all');
      },

      filterTerms() {
        const all = this.getAllTerms();
        const q = this.state.searchQuery;
        const cat = this.state.activeCategory;
        const lvl = this.state.activeLevel;

        return all.filter(t => {
          // Category filter
          if (cat !== 'all' && t.category !== cat) return false;
          // Level filter
          if (lvl !== 'all' && t.level !== lvl) return false;
          // Search query filter
          if (q) {
            const textToSearch = [
              t.term,
              t.shortDef,
              t.longExpl,
              t.gameContext,
              t.examples,
              ...(t.tags || [])
            ].join(' ').toLowerCase();

            if (!textToSearch.includes(q)) return false;
          }
          return true;
        });
      },

      sortTerms(terms) {
        const copy = [...terms];
        if (this.state.sortBy === 'alpha') {
          copy.sort((a, b) => a.term.localeCompare(b.term, 'de'));
        } else if (this.state.sortBy === 'level') {
          const order = { 'basic': 1, 'tactical': 2, 'advanced': 3 };
          copy.sort((a, b) => (order[a.level] || 9) - (order[b.level] || 9));
        } else if (this.state.sortBy === 'category') {
          copy.sort((a, b) => a.category.localeCompare(b.category));
        }
        return copy;
      },

      renderCards() {
        const container = document.getElementById('glossary-cards-container');
        const countEl = document.getElementById('glossary-result-count');
        if (!container) return;

        const filtered = this.filterTerms();
        const sorted = this.sortTerms(filtered);

        if (countEl) {
          const total = this.getAllTerms().length;
          countEl.textContent = `${sorted.length} von ${total} Begriffen gefunden`;
        }

        if (sorted.length === 0) {
          container.innerHTML = `
        <div style="text-align:center; padding: 40px 16px; color: var(--mut);">
          <div style="font-size:32px; margin-bottom:8px;">🔍</div>
          <div style="font-weight:700; color:#fff; margin-bottom:4px;">Keine Begriffe gefunden</div>
          <p style="font-size:12px; margin:0 0 12px;">Kein Eintrag passt zu deinen aktuellen Filterkriterien.</p>
          <button class="gloss-pill active" onclick="glossaryEngine.resetFilters()">Filter zurücksetzen</button>
        </div>
      `;
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = sorted.map(t => {
          const isActive = t.id === this.state.activeTermId;
          const catColor = this.categoryColors[t.category] || '#38bdf8';
          const relCount = (t.relatedTerms && t.relatedTerms.length) || 0;
          const lvlTagClass = `tag-${t.level}`;

          return `
        <div 
          class="gloss-card ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" 
          id="gloss-card-${t.id}"
          onclick="glossaryEngine.selectTerm('${t.id}')"
          role="option"
          aria-selected="${isActive}"
        >
          <div class="card-top-row">
            <h4 class="card-title">${t.term}</h4>
            <div class="card-badges">
              <span class="tag-badge ${lvlTagClass}">${t.levelLabel}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="card-snippet">${t.shortDef}</p>
          <div class="card-footer-info">
            <span style="color: ${catColor}; font-weight:600; font-size:11px;">
              ${this.categoryLabels[t.category] || t.categoryLabel}
            </span>
            <span class="card-rel-count" title="${relCount} verknüpfte Konzepte">
              🔗 ${relCount}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      selectTerm(termId, scrollIntoView = true) {
        const term = this.getTermById(termId);
        if (!term) return;

        this.state.activeTermId = termId;

        // Update active class on card elements
        const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.gloss-card');
        cards.forEach(c => {
          c.classList.toggle('active', c.id === `gloss-card-${termId}`);
          c.setAttribute('aria-selected', c.id === `gloss-card-${termId}` ? 'true' : 'false');
        });

        // Update focus term indicator
        const focusNameEl = document.getElementById('graph-focus-term-name');
        if (focusNameEl) focusNameEl.textContent = term.term;

        // Render detail dossier
        this.renderDossier(term);

        // Render Knowledge Graph centered on this term
        this.renderGraph();

        // Scroll card into view in browser list if requested
        if (scrollIntoView) {
          const activeCard = document.getElementById(`gloss-card-${termId}`);
          if (activeCard) {
            activeCard.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
          }
        }
      },

      renderDossier(term) {
        const container = document.getElementById('glossary-term-dossier');
        if (!container) return;

        const catColor = this.categoryColors[term.category] || '#38bdf8';
        const lvlTagClass = `tag-${term.level}`;

        // Action buttons based on available crossLinks
        const actionButtons = [];
        if (term.crossLinks) {
          if (term.crossLinks.playbookId) {
            actionButtons.push(`
          <button class="dossier-action-btn" onclick="openPlaybookWithConcept('${term.crossLinks.playbookId}')">
            📋 Im Playbook ansehen
          </button>
        `);
          }
          if (term.crossLinks.filmScenarioId) {
            actionButtons.push(`
          <button class="dossier-action-btn" onclick="openFilmScenarioWithId('${term.crossLinks.filmScenarioId}')">
            🎥 Im Film Room analysieren
          </button>
        `);
          }
          if (term.crossLinks.callScenarioId) {
            actionButtons.push(`
          <button class="dossier-action-btn" onclick="openCallScenarioWithId('${term.crossLinks.callScenarioId}')">
            🧠 Im Coach Lab entscheiden
          </button>
        `);
          }
          if (typeof term.crossLinks.lessonIndex === 'number') {
            actionButtons.push(`
          <button class="dossier-action-btn" onclick="openWikiLesson(${term.crossLinks.lessonIndex})">
            📖 In Wiki-Lektion ${term.crossLinks.lessonIndex + 1}
          </button>
        `);
          }
        }

        // Always offer Clock Simulator link for clock/rule terms
        if (term.category === 'game_rules_clock') {
          actionButtons.push(`
        <button class="dossier-action-btn" onclick="openClockSimulator()">
          ⏱️ Im Clock Simulator testen
        </button>
      `);
        }

        // Related Terms Chips
        const relatedChips = (term.relatedTerms || []).map(r => {
          const relTerm = this.getTermById(r.id);
          const title = relTerm ? relTerm.term : r.id;
          const relColor = relTerm ? (this.categoryColors[relTerm.category] || '#38bdf8') : '#38bdf8';

          return `
        <button 
          class="related-term-chip" 
          onclick="glossaryEngine.selectTerm('${r.id}')"
          title="Zu '${title}' springen"
        >
          <div class="chip-header">
            <span class="chip-rel-badge" style="color: ${relColor};">${r.rel}</span>
            <span class="chip-term-title">${title}</span>
          </div>
          <p class="chip-desc">${r.desc}</p>
        </button>
      `;
        }).join('');

        // Tags
        const tagPills = (term.tags || []).map(tag => `
      <span class="tag-pill">#${tag}</span>
    `).join('');

        container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="dossier-header-row">
        <div>
          <h2 class="dossier-main-title">${term.term}</h2>
          <div class="dossier-meta-chips">
            <span class="dossier-category-pill" style="background: ${catColor}22; color: ${catColor}; border: 1px solid ${catColor}55;">
              ${this.categoryLabels[term.category] || term.categoryLabel}
            </span>
            <span class="tag-badge ${lvlTagClass}">${term.levelLabel}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="dossier-actions">
          ${actionButtons.join('')}
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Quick Definition Callout -->
      <div class="dossier-callout" style="border-left-color: ${catColor};">
        <div class="dossier-callout-label" style="color: ${catColor};">Kurzdefinition</div>
        <p class="dossier-callout-text">${term.shortDef}</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Comprehensive Technical Breakdown -->
      <div class="dossier-section">
        <div class="dossier-sec-title">📖 Taktische Tiefenanalyse & Mechanik</div>
        <p class="dossier-sec-content">${term.longExpl}</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Practical Game & Situational Context -->
      <div class="dossier-section">
        <div class="dossier-sec-title">🏈 NFL Spiel- & Situationsbezug</div>
        <p class="dossier-sec-content">${term.gameContext}</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Real World NFL Examples & Scheme Tree -->
      <div class="dossier-section">
        <div class="dossier-sec-title">⭐ Bekannte NFL-Schemes & Coaches</div>
        <p class="dossier-sec-content" style="color: #f1f5f9; font-weight: 500;">${term.examples}</p>
      </div>

      <!-- Related Terms (Knowledge Graph Links) -->
      <div class="dossier-section">
        <div class="dossier-sec-title">🕸️ Vernetzte Football-Konzepte (Knowledge Network)</div>
        <div class="related-terms-grid">
          ${relatedChips || '<p style="color:var(--mut); font-size:12px;">Keine direkten Verknüpfungen definiert.</p>'}
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Search Tags -->
      <div class="dossier-section">
        <div class="tags-row">
          ${tagPills}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      },

      setGraphMode(mode) {
        this.state.graphMode = mode;
        const btnEgo = document.getElementById('btn-graph-mode-ego');
        const btnCluster = document.getElementById('btn-graph-mode-cluster');
        if (btnEgo) btnEgo.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'ego');
        if (btnCluster) btnCluster.classList.toggle('active', mode === 'cluster');

        this.renderGraph();
      },

      graphZoom(factor) {
        this.state.zoom = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.5, this.state.zoom * factor));
        this.updateGraphTransform();
      },

      graphResetView() {
        this.state.zoom = 1.0;
        this.state.pan = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        this.updateGraphTransform();
      },

      updateGraphTransform() {
        const root = document.getElementById('svg-graph-root');
        if (!root) return;
        root.setAttribute(
          'transform',
          `translate(${this.state.pan.x}, ${this.state.pan.y}) scale(${this.state.zoom})`
        );
      },

      setupSvgPanZoom() {
        const viewport = document.getElementById('glossary-graph-viewport');
        if (!viewport) return;

        viewport.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
          // Ignore clicks on interactive node elements
          if (e.target.closest('.graph-node-group')) return;
          this.state.isDragging = true;
          this.state.dragStart = { x: e.clientX - this.state.pan.x, y: e.clientY - this.state.pan.y };
        });

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
          if (!this.state.isDragging) return;
          this.state.pan = {
            x: e.clientX - this.state.dragStart.x,
            y: e.clientY - this.state.dragStart.y
          };
          this.updateGraphTransform();
        });

        window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
          this.state.isDragging = false;
        });

        viewport.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const zoomDelta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9;
          this.graphZoom(zoomDelta);
        }, { passive: false });
      },

      renderGraph() {
        const root = document.getElementById('svg-graph-root');
        if (!root) return;

        const currentTerm = this.getTermById(this.state.activeTermId);
        if (!currentTerm) return;

        if (this.state.graphMode === 'cluster') {
          this.renderClusterGraph(root);
          return;
        }

        // Default: 'ego' focused neighborhood network
        this.renderEgoGraph(root, currentTerm);
      },

      renderEgoGraph(root, centerTerm) {
        const cx = 400;
        const cy = 180;
        const related = centerTerm.relatedTerms || [];
        const count = related.length;
        const radius = count > 5 ? 135 : 120;

        let linksHtml = '';
        let nodesHtml = '';

        // Center Node Color
        const centerColor = this.categoryColors[centerTerm.category] || '#38bdf8';

        // Calculate Radial Coordinates for 1st-degree neighbors
        const neighborNodes = related.map((rel, i) => {
          const angle = (2 * Math.PI * i / count) - (Math.PI / 2);
          const nx = cx + radius * Math.cos(angle);
          const ny = cy + radius * Math.sin(angle);
          const termData = this.getTermById(rel.id);
          const color = termData ? (this.categoryColors[termData.category] || '#38bdf8') : '#38bdf8';
          const label = termData ? termData.term : rel.id;
          return { id: rel.id, x: nx, y: ny, rel: rel.rel, desc: rel.desc, color, label, termData };
        });

        // 1. Draw Links from Center to Neighbors
        neighborNodes.forEach(node => {
          const midX = (cx + node.x) / 2;
          const midY = (cy + node.y) / 2;

          // Link line
          linksHtml += `
        <line 
          x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" 
          x2="${node.x}" y2="${node.y}" 
          class="graph-link-line" 
          marker-end="url(#arrow-link)"
        />
      `;

          // Relationship Pill Badge midway
          if (node.rel) {
            const textWidth = Math.min(80, node.rel.length * 6 + 12);
            linksHtml += `
          <g transform="translate(${midX}, ${midY})">
            <rect 
              x="${-textWidth / 2}" y="-8" 
              width="${textWidth}" height="16" 
              rx="8" class="graph-link-pill"
            />
            <text y="3" class="graph-link-text">${node.rel}</text>
          </g>
        `;
          }
        });

        // 2. Draw Secondary Interconnections among neighbors (if they relate to each other!)
        for (let i = 0; i < neighborNodes.length; i++) {
          for (let j = i + 1; j < neighborNodes.length; j++) {
            const nA = neighborNodes[i];
            const nB = neighborNodes[j];
            if (nA.termData && nA.termData.relatedTerms && nA.termData.relatedTerms.some(r => r.id === nB.id)) {
              linksHtml += `
            <line 
              x1="${nA.x}" y1="${nA.y}" 
              x2="${nB.x}" y2="${nB.y}" 
              stroke="rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)" 
              stroke-dasharray="3 3"
              stroke-width="1.2"
            />
          `;
            }
          }
        }

        // 3. Draw Center Node
        nodesHtml += `
      <g 
        class="graph-node-group center-focus-node" 
        transform="translate(${cx}, ${cy})"
        onclick="glossaryEngine.selectTerm('${centerTerm.id}')"
        onmouseenter="glossaryEngine.showTooltip(evt, '${centerTerm.id}')"
        onmouseleave="glossaryEngine.hideTooltip()"
      >
        <!-- Pulsing halo -->
        <circle r="34" class="node-center-halo"></circle>
        <!-- Main node circle -->
        <circle 
          r="26" 
          fill="${centerColor}" 
          stroke="#ffffff" 
          stroke-width="3" 
          class="node-bg" 
          filter="url(#glow-center)"
        ></circle>
        <!-- Node Center Dot -->
        <circle r="10" fill="#0f172a"></circle>
        <!-- Title Text -->
        <text y="42" class="graph-node-title" style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800;">${centerTerm.term}</text>
      </g>
    `;

        // 4. Draw Neighbor Nodes
        neighborNodes.forEach(node => {
          nodesHtml += `
        <g 
          class="graph-node-group" 
          transform="translate(${node.x}, ${node.y})"
          onclick="glossaryEngine.selectTerm('${node.id}')"
          onmouseenter="glossaryEngine.showTooltip(evt, '${node.id}')"
          onmouseleave="glossaryEngine.hideTooltip()"
        >
          <circle 
            r="18" 
            fill="${node.color}" 
            stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)" 
            stroke-width="2" 
            class="node-bg"
          ></circle>
          <circle r="6" fill="#0f172a"></circle>
          <text y="30" class="graph-node-title">${node.label}</text>
        </g>
      `;
        });

        root.innerHTML = linksHtml + nodesHtml;
        this.updateGraphTransform();
      },

      renderClusterGraph(root) {
        const cx = 400;
        const cy = 180;
        const clusters = [
          { cat: 'defense_coverage', label: 'Coverages', color: '#38bdf8', anchorId: 'cover_3' },
          { cat: 'safety_alignment', label: 'Safety & Box', color: '#6366f1', anchorId: 'single_high' },
          { cat: 'offense_pass', label: 'Pass-Konzepte', color: '#f97316', anchorId: 'mesh' },
          { cat: 'offense_run', label: 'Laufspiel', color: '#10b981', anchorId: 'inside_zone' },
          { cat: 'formations_personnel', label: 'Formationen', color: '#a855f7', anchorId: 'personnel_11' },
          { cat: 'pressure_fronts', label: 'Pressure', color: '#f43f5e', anchorId: 'blitz' },
          { cat: 'game_rules_clock', label: 'Regeln & Uhren', color: '#f59e0b', anchorId: 'game_clock' }
        ];

        const clusterRadius = 135;
        let linksHtml = '';
        let nodesHtml = '';

        // Center NFL Knowledge Hub
        nodesHtml += `
      <g class="graph-node-group" transform="translate(${cx}, ${cy})">
        <circle r="30" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3"></circle>
        <text y="4" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12px" font-weight="800" fill="#fff">NFL CORE</text>
        <text y="46" class="graph-node-title" style="font-size:12px;">Theorie-Atlas</text>
      </g>
    `;

        clusters.forEach((c, idx) => {
          const angle = (2 * Math.PI * idx / clusters.length) - (Math.PI / 2);
          const x = cx + clusterRadius * Math.cos(angle);
          const y = cy + clusterRadius * Math.sin(angle);

          // Link from core to cluster hub
          linksHtml += `
        <line x1="${cx}" y1="${cy}" x2="${x}" y2="${y}" stroke="${c.color}66" stroke-width="2" />
      `;

          nodesHtml += `
        <g 
          class="graph-node-group" 
          transform="translate(${x}, ${y})"
          onclick="glossaryEngine.setCategory('${c.cat}'); glossaryEngine.selectTerm('${c.anchorId}'); glossaryEngine.setGraphMode('ego');"
        >
          <circle r="22" fill="${c.color}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2"></circle>
          <text y="34" class="graph-node-title">${c.label}</text>
        </g>
      `;
        });

        root.innerHTML = linksHtml + nodesHtml;
        this.updateGraphTransform();
      },

      showTooltip(evt, termId) {
        const tooltip = document.getElementById('graph-tooltip');
        const term = this.getTermById(termId);
        if (!tooltip || !term) return;

        tooltip.innerHTML = `
      <div style="font-weight:700; color:#fff; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:2px;">${term.term}</div>
      <div style="color:${this.categoryColors[term.category] || '#38bdf8'}; font-weight:600; font-size:10px; margin-bottom:4px;">
        ${this.categoryLabels[term.category] || term.categoryLabel} • ${term.levelLabel}
      </div>
      <p style="margin:0; font-size:11px; line-height:1.3; color:#cbd5e1;">${term.shortDef}</p>
      <div style="margin-top:6px; font-size:10px; color:#38bdf8; font-weight:600;">Klicken zum Fokussieren ➔</div>
    `;

        tooltip.style.display = 'block';

        const viewport = document.getElementById('glossary-graph-viewport');
        if (viewport) {
          const rect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
          const mouseX = evt.clientX - rect.left;
          const mouseY = evt.clientY - rect.top;

          let left = mouseX + 15;
          let top = mouseY - 20;

          if (left + 220 > rect.width) left = mouseX - 235;
          if (top + 100 > rect.height) top = mouseY - 90;

          tooltip.style.left = `${Math.max(10, left)}px`;
          tooltip.style.top = `${Math.max(10, top)}px`;
        }
      },

      hideTooltip() {
        const tooltip = document.getElementById('graph-tooltip');
        if (tooltip) tooltip.style.display = 'none';
      }
    };

    /* ==================== GLOBAL HELPER FUNCTIONS ==================== */

    function openGlossaryTerm(termId) {
      setView('glossary');
      if (typeof glossaryEngine !== 'undefined') {
        glossaryEngine.resetFilters();
        glossaryEngine.selectTerm(termId, true);
      }
    }

    function getGlossaryTerm(termId) {
      if (typeof glossaryEngine !== 'undefined') {
        return glossaryEngine.getTermById(termId);
      }
      return null;
    }

    // Backward-compatible renderGlossary(q)
    function renderGlossary(q) {
      if (typeof glossaryEngine !== 'undefined') {
        glossaryEngine.init();
        if (typeof q === 'string') {
          glossaryEngine.state.searchQuery = q.toLowerCase();
          const input = document.getElementById('glossary-search-input');
          if (input) input.value = q;
          glossaryEngine.renderCards();
        }
      }

      // Also populate legacy fallback if present
      const list = document.getElementById('glossary-list');
      if (list && typeof G !== 'undefined') {
        const query = (q || "").toLowerCase();
        const matches = G.filter(g => g.join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query));
        list.innerHTML = matches.map(g => `
      <div class="co" style="margin-bottom:14px;">
        <h3 style="margin-top:0; color:var(--g-light); font-size:18px;">${g[0]}</h3>
        <p style="margin:4px 0;"><b>Bedeutung:</b> ${g[1]}</p>
        <p style="margin:4px 0; color:var(--mut);"><b>Im Spiel:</b> ${g[2]}</p>
        <p style="margin:4px 0; font-size:13px;"><b>Verwandte Begriffe:</b> ${g[3]}</p>
      </div>
    `).join('');
      }
    }

    // Cross-module quick linkers
    function openPlaybookWithConcept(conceptId) {
      setView('playbook');
      if (typeof selectPlaybookItem === 'function') {
        selectPlaybookItem(conceptId);
      }
    }

    function openFilmScenarioWithId(scenarioId) {
      setView('film');
      if (typeof switchFilmMode === 'function') switchFilmMode('film');
      if (typeof selectFilmScenario === 'function') {
        selectFilmScenario(scenarioId);
      }
    }

    function openCallScenarioWithId(scenarioId) {
      setView('challenges');
      if (typeof openChallengesSubtab === 'function') {
        openChallengesSubtab('coach');
      }
      if (typeof loadCallScenario === 'function') {
        loadCallScenario(scenarioId);
      }
    }

    function openWikiLesson(lessonIndex) {
      setView('learn');
      if (typeof show === 'function') {
        show(lessonIndex);
      }
    }

    /* ==================== CENTRAL FOOTBALL PROGRESS & MASTERY ENGINE ==================== */

    const progressEngine = {
      storageKey: 'nfl_mastery_progress_v2',

      state: {
        activeLevel: 1, // 1 to 5
        topicFilterLevel: 'all',
        topicFilterStatus: 'all',
        topicStates: {}, // topicId -> { readCount, practiceSuccessCount, practiceTotalCount, status, lastActive }
        recentActivities: [],
        skillRatings: {
          preSnapRead: 0,
          coverageRecognition: 0,
          pressureRecognition: 0,
          playIntent: 0,
          situationalCalling: 0,
          clockManagement: 0
        },
        isInitialized: false
      },

      init() {
        if (this.state.isInitialized) return;
        this.state.isInitialized = true;

        this.loadState();
        this.syncWithExistingModules();
        this.evaluateAllTopics();
        this.calculateSkillRatings();
        this.saveState();

        this.render();
      },

      loadState() {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
          if (saved) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
              if (parsed.topicStates) this.state.topicStates = parsed.topicStates;
              if (parsed.recentActivities) this.state.recentActivities = parsed.recentActivities;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Could not load mastery state from localStorage:", e);
        }
      },

      saveState() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify({
            topicStates: this.state.topicStates,
            recentActivities: this.state.recentActivities.slice(0, 10),
            activeLevel: this.state.activeLevel
          }));
        } catch (e) { }
      },

      getCurriculumTopics() {
        if (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.curriculumTopics) {
          return NFL_DATA.curriculumTopics;
        }
        return [];
      },

      getMasteryLevels() {
        if (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.masteryLevels) {
          return NFL_DATA.masteryLevels;
        }
        return [
          { level: 1, name: "Zuschauer", color: "#38bdf8", tagline: "Football Basics & Spielregeln" },
          { level: 2, name: "Football Fan", color: "#10b981", tagline: "Roster, Personnel & Formations" },
          { level: 3, name: "Taktischer Zuschauer", color: "#f59e0b", tagline: "Safety Shells & Pass-Konzepte" },
          { level: 4, name: "Football Nerd", color: "#a855f7", tagline: "All-22 Film Room & Pressure" },
          { level: 5, name: "Advanced", color: "#f43f5e", tagline: "Coordinator Decisions & EPA Models" }
        ];
      },

      syncWithExistingModules() {
        // 1. Sync Lesson Progress (from doneLessons)
        if (typeof doneLessons !== 'undefined' && typeof doneLessons === 'object') {
          Object.keys(doneLessons).forEach(idx => {
            this.recordLessonActivity(parseInt(idx), true, false);
          });
        }

        // 2. Sync Film Room Progress
        try {
          const fStats = (typeof getFilmStats === 'function') ? getFilmStats() : null;
          if (fStats && fStats.completed) {
            fStats.completed.forEach(scenId => {
              this.recordFilmRoomActivity(scenId, true, false);
            });
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // 3. Sync Vision Challenges Progress
        try {
          const vStats = (typeof getVisionStats === 'function') ? getVisionStats() : null;
          if (vStats && vStats.completed) {
            vStats.completed.forEach(chId => {
              this.recordVisionActivity(chId, true, false);
            });
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // 4. Sync What Would You Call Decisions
        try {
          const cStats = (typeof getCallStats === 'function') ? getCallStats() : null;
          if (cStats && cStats.completed) {
            cStats.completed.forEach(callId => {
              this.recordCallActivity(callId, 'optimal', false);
            });
          }
        } catch (e) { }
      },

      ensureTopicRecord(topicId) {
        if (!this.state.topicStates[topicId]) {
          this.state.topicStates[topicId] = {
            readCount: 0,
            practiceSuccessCount: 0,
            practiceTotalCount: 0,
            status: 'available',
            lastActive: null
          };
        }
        return this.state.topicStates[topicId];
      },

      evaluateTopicStatus(topic) {
        const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(topic.id);
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();

        // 1. Check Prerequisites
        if (topic.prerequisites && topic.prerequisites.length > 0) {
          const allPrereqsMet = topic.prerequisites.every(pId => {
            const pRec = this.state.topicStates[pId];
            return pRec && (pRec.status === 'completed' || pRec.status === 'mastered');
          });
          if (!allPrereqsMet) {
            rec.status = 'locked';
            return 'locked';
          }
        }

        // 2. Check Level Gate
        // Topics in Level > activeLevel are locked if prior levels are < 70% completed
        if (topic.level > 1) {
          const prevLevelTopics = topics.filter(t => t.level === topic.level - 1);
          const prevCompleted = prevLevelTopics.filter(t => {
            const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
            return r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered');
          }).length;

          if (prevLevelTopics.length > 0 && (prevCompleted / prevLevelTopics.length) < 0.6) {
            rec.status = 'locked';
            return 'locked';
          }
        }

        // 3. Evaluate Completion & True Mastery
        const minReads = topic.masteryCriteria ? topic.masteryCriteria.minReads : 1;
        const minPractices = topic.masteryCriteria ? topic.masteryCriteria.minPractices : 2;
        const minAccuracy = topic.masteryCriteria ? topic.masteryCriteria.minAccuracy : 80;

        const accuracy = rec.practiceTotalCount > 0 ? (rec.practiceSuccessCount / rec.practiceTotalCount) * 100 : 0;

        if (rec.readCount >= minReads && rec.practiceSuccessCount >= minPractices && accuracy >= minAccuracy) {
          rec.status = 'mastered';
        } else if (rec.readCount >= 1 && rec.practiceSuccessCount >= 1) {
          rec.status = 'completed';
        } else if (rec.readCount > 0 || rec.practiceTotalCount > 0) {
          rec.status = 'in_progress';
        } else {
          rec.status = 'available';
        }

        return rec.status;
      },

      evaluateAllTopics() {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        topics.forEach(t => {
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        // Evaluate active stage of user (Level 1 to 5)
        let currentLvl = 1;
        for (let lvl = 1; lvl <= 5; lvl++) {
          const lvlTopics = topics.filter(t => t.level === lvl);
          if (!lvlTopics.length) continue;
          const finished = lvlTopics.filter(t => {
            const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
            return r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered');
          }).length;
          if (finished / lvlTopics.length >= 0.65) {
            currentLvl = Math.min(5, lvl + 1);
          }
        }
        this.state.activeLevel = currentLvl;
      },

      calculateSkillRatings() {
        let preSnapScore = 0, preSnapTotal = 0;
        let covScore = 0, covTotal = 0;
        let presScore = 0, presTotal = 0;
        let intentScore = 0, intentTotal = 0;
        let callScore = 0, callTotal = 0;
        let clockScore = 0, clockTotal = 0;

        // From Film Room stats
        try {
          const fStats = (typeof getFilmStats === 'function') ? getFilmStats() : null;
          if (fStats) {
            if (fStats.preSnapScore.total > 0) { preSnapScore += fStats.preSnapScore.correct; preSnapTotal += fStats.preSnapScore.total; }
            if (fStats.coverageScore.total > 0) { covScore += fStats.coverageScore.correct; covTotal += fStats.coverageScore.total; }
            if (fStats.playIntentScore.total > 0) { intentScore += fStats.playIntentScore.correct; intentTotal += fStats.playIntentScore.total; }
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // From Vision stats
        try {
          const vStats = (typeof getVisionStats === 'function') ? getVisionStats() : null;
          if (vStats) {
            if (vStats.coverageRecognition && vStats.coverageRecognition.total > 0) {
              covScore += vStats.coverageRecognition.correct; covTotal += vStats.coverageRecognition.total;
            }
            if (vStats.pressureRecognition && vStats.pressureRecognition.total > 0) {
              presScore += vStats.pressureRecognition.correct; presTotal += vStats.pressureRecognition.total;
            }
            if (vStats.offensiveIntent && vStats.offensiveIntent.total > 0) {
              intentScore += vStats.offensiveIntent.correct; intentTotal += vStats.offensiveIntent.total;
            }
            if (vStats.formationRecognition && vStats.formationRecognition.total > 0) {
              preSnapScore += vStats.formationRecognition.correct; preSnapTotal += vStats.formationRecognition.total;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // From Coach Lab calls
        try {
          const cStats = (typeof getCallStats === 'function') ? getCallStats() : null;
          if (cStats) {
            const totalCalls = cStats.optimalCalls + cStats.viableCalls + cStats.traditionalCalls + cStats.criticalErrors;
            if (totalCalls > 0) {
              callScore = cStats.optimalCalls + cStats.viableCalls;
              callTotal = totalCalls;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // From Coverage Trainer
        try {
          if (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined' && trainerState.score > 0) {
            covScore += Math.min(20, Math.floor(trainerState.score / 25));
            covTotal += Math.max(1, Math.min(25, Math.floor(trainerState.score / 20)));
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        const calcPct = (s, t) => t > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((s / t) * 100)) : 0;

        this.state.skillRatings.preSnapRead = calcPct(preSnapScore, preSnapTotal);
        this.state.skillRatings.coverageRecognition = calcPct(covScore, covTotal);
        this.state.skillRatings.pressureRecognition = calcPct(presScore, presTotal);
        this.state.skillRatings.playIntent = calcPct(intentScore, intentTotal);
        this.state.skillRatings.situationalCalling = calcPct(callScore, callTotal);

        // Clock skill: evaluated from completed topics in rules & clock
        const clockTopics = this.getCurriculumTopics().filter(t => t.category === 'game_rules_clock');
        const clockMastered = clockTopics.filter(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          return r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered');
        }).length;
        this.state.skillRatings.clockManagement = clockTopics.length > 0 ? Math.round((clockMastered / clockTopics.length) * 100) : 0;
      },

      generateRecommendations() {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const recs = [];

        // Rule 1: Near-Mastery Topics (Topic is completed, needs 1 more practice for Mastered)
        const nearMastery = topics.find(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          return r && r.status === 'completed' && r.practiceSuccessCount < (t.masteryCriteria ? t.masteryCriteria.minPractices : 2);
        });

        if (nearMastery) {
          let actionLabel = "Praxis abschließen";
          let actionFn = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('topic', '${nearMastery.id}')`;
          if (nearMastery.associatedItems.filmScenarios.length) {
            actionLabel = "Im Film Room anwenden";
            actionFn = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('film', '${nearMastery.associatedItems.filmScenarios[0]}')`;
          } else if (nearMastery.associatedItems.visionChallenges.length) {
            actionLabel = "In Vision Challenge testen";
            actionFn = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('vision', '${nearMastery.associatedItems.visionChallenges[0]}')`;
          } else if (nearMastery.associatedItems.callScenarios.length) {
            actionLabel = "Im Coach Lab entscheiden";
            actionFn = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('call', '${nearMastery.associatedItems.callScenarios[0]}')`;
          }

          recs.push({
            type: 'mastery',
            typeBadge: '⭐ Mastery-Abschluss',
            badgeBg: 'rgba(250, 204, 21, 0.2)',
            badgeColor: '#facc15',
            title: `${nearMastery.title} meistern`,
            reason: 'Theorie abgeschlossen: Schließe noch eine erfolgreiche Praxis-Aufgabe ab, um dieses Thema vollständig zu meistern.',
            btnLabel: actionLabel,
            btnAction: actionFn
          });
        }

        // Rule 2: Practice Gap (Topic has been read, but practiceCount === 0)
        const practiceGap = topics.find(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          return r && r.readCount > 0 && r.practiceSuccessCount === 0 && (
            t.associatedItems.filmScenarios.length ||
            t.associatedItems.visionChallenges.length ||
            t.associatedItems.callScenarios.length
          );
        });

        if (practiceGap && recs.length < 3) {
          let targetLabel = "Praxistest starten";
          let targetAction = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('topic', '${practiceGap.id}')`;
          if (practiceGap.associatedItems.filmScenarios.length) {
            targetLabel = "All-22 Film starten";
            targetAction = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('film', '${practiceGap.associatedItems.filmScenarios[0]}')`;
          } else if (practiceGap.associatedItems.visionChallenges.length) {
            targetLabel = "Vision Challenge starten";
            targetAction = `progressEngine.openTopicAction('vision', '${practiceGap.associatedItems.visionChallenges[0]}')`;
          }

          recs.push({
            type: 'practice_gap',
            typeBadge: '🏈 Praxislücke schließen',
            badgeBg: 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.2)',
            badgeColor: '#38bdf8',
            title: `Praxistest: ${practiceGap.title}`,
            reason: 'Du hast die Theorie gelesen. Um dauerhaftes Football-Verständnis aufzubauen, wende das Schema jetzt in einer Challenge an.',
            btnLabel: targetLabel,
            btnAction: targetAction
          });
        }

        // Rule 3: Diagnostic Skill Gap (Lowest Skill Rating)
        const skills = [
          { key: 'pressureRecognition', label: 'Pressure & Blitz', action: "progressEngine.openTopicAction('vision', 'vis_04_blitz_slot_creeper')", actionTxt: "Blitz-Erkennung trainieren" },
          { key: 'coverageRecognition', label: 'Coverage-Erkennung', action: "progressEngine.openTopicAction('trainer', '')", actionTxt: "Coverage-Trainer starten" },
          { key: 'situationalCalling', label: 'Situational Play Calling', action: "progressEngine.openTopicAction('call', 'call_01_4th_and_1_opp_34')", actionTxt: "4th-Down Entscheidungen üben" },
          { key: 'preSnapRead', label: 'Pre-Snap Reading', action: "progressEngine.openTopicAction('vision', 'vis_01_two_high_shell')", actionTxt: "Safety Shells trainieren" }
        ];

        skills.sort((a, b) => (this.state.skillRatings[a.key] || 0) - (this.state.skillRatings[b.key] || 0));
        const lowestSkill = skills[0];

        if (recs.length < 3) {
          recs.push({
            type: 'skill_gap',
            typeBadge: '👁️ Taktischer Fokus',
            badgeBg: 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2)',
            badgeColor: '#c084fc',
            title: `${lowestSkill.label} verbessern`,
            reason: `Dein Skill-Rating bei ${lowestSkill.label} liegt aktuell bei ${this.state.skillRatings[lowestSkill.key] || 0}%. Gezieltes Training stärkt dein Scouting-Auge.`,
            btnLabel: lowestSkill.actionTxt,
            btnAction: lowestSkill.action
          });
        }

        // Rule 4: Next Available Unread Topic in Current Level
        if (recs.length < 3) {
          const nextAvailable = topics.find(t => {
            const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
            return t.level === this.state.activeLevel && (!r || r.readCount === 0) && r && r.status === 'available';
          });

          if (nextAvailable) {
            recs.push({
              type: 'new_topic',
              typeBadge: '📖 Nächstes Thema',
              badgeBg: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)',
              badgeColor: '#34d399',
              title: nextAvailable.title,
              reason: `Empfohlene nächste Theoriestufe für Stufe ${nextAvailable.level} (${nextAvailable.levelName}).`,
              btnLabel: 'Thema aufschlagen',
              btnAction: `progressEngine.openTopicAction('topic', '${nextAvailable.id}')`
            });
          }
        }

        return recs;
      },

      // Event recording hooks across modules
      recordLessonActivity(lessonIdx, passedQuiz = false, shouldSave = true) {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const matchingTopics = topics.filter(t => t.associatedItems && t.associatedItems.lessons && t.associatedItems.lessons.includes(lessonIdx));

        matchingTopics.forEach(t => {
          const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(t.id);
          rec.readCount = Math.max(1, rec.readCount);
          rec.lastActive = Date.now();
          if (passedQuiz) {
            rec.practiceSuccessCount += 1;
            rec.practiceTotalCount += 1;
          }
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        this.logRecentActivity('lesson', lessonIdx, `Lektion ${lessonIdx + 1}`);
        if (shouldSave) {
          this.calculateSkillRatings();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
        }
      },

      recordGlossaryActivity(termId, shouldSave = true) {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const matchingTopics = topics.filter(t => t.associatedItems && t.associatedItems.glossaryTerms && t.associatedItems.glossaryTerms.includes(termId));

        matchingTopics.forEach(t => {
          const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(t.id);
          rec.readCount = Math.max(1, rec.readCount);
          rec.lastActive = Date.now();
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        this.logRecentActivity('glossary', termId, `Begriff: ${termId}`);
        if (shouldSave) {
          this.saveState();
        }
      },

      recordFilmRoomActivity(scenarioId, isCorrect = true, shouldSave = true) {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const matchingTopics = topics.filter(t => t.associatedItems && t.associatedItems.filmScenarios && t.associatedItems.filmScenarios.includes(scenarioId));

        matchingTopics.forEach(t => {
          const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(t.id);
          rec.practiceTotalCount += 1;
          if (isCorrect) rec.practiceSuccessCount += 1;
          rec.lastActive = Date.now();
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        this.logRecentActivity('film', scenarioId, `Film Room: ${scenarioId}`);
        if (shouldSave) {
          this.calculateSkillRatings();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
        }
      },

      recordVisionActivity(challengeId, isCorrect = true, shouldSave = true) {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const matchingTopics = topics.filter(t => t.associatedItems && t.associatedItems.visionChallenges && t.associatedItems.visionChallenges.includes(challengeId));

        matchingTopics.forEach(t => {
          const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(t.id);
          rec.practiceTotalCount += 1;
          if (isCorrect) rec.practiceSuccessCount += 1;
          rec.lastActive = Date.now();
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        this.logRecentActivity('vision', challengeId, `Vision: ${challengeId}`);
        if (shouldSave) {
          this.calculateSkillRatings();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
        }
      },

      recordCallActivity(callId, grade = 'optimal', shouldSave = true) {
        const isSuccess = grade === 'optimal' || grade === 'viable';
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const matchingTopics = topics.filter(t => t.associatedItems && t.associatedItems.callScenarios && t.associatedItems.callScenarios.includes(callId));

        matchingTopics.forEach(t => {
          const rec = this.ensureTopicRecord(t.id);
          rec.practiceTotalCount += 1;
          if (isSuccess) rec.practiceSuccessCount += 1;
          rec.lastActive = Date.now();
          this.evaluateTopicStatus(t);
        });

        this.logRecentActivity('call', callId, `Coach Call: ${callId}`);
        if (shouldSave) {
          this.calculateSkillRatings();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
        }
      },

      logRecentActivity(type, id, label) {
        this.state.recentActivities = [
          { type, id, label, time: Date.now() },
          ...this.state.recentActivities.filter(a => a.id !== id)
        ].slice(0, 8);
      },

      openTopicAction(type, targetId) {
        if (type === 'topic') {
          const topic = this.getCurriculumTopics().find(t => t.id === targetId);
          if (topic) {
            if (topic.associatedItems.lessons.length) {
              setView('learn');
              if (typeof show === 'function') show(topic.associatedItems.lessons[0]);
            } else if (topic.associatedItems.glossaryTerms.length) {
              openGlossaryTerm(topic.associatedItems.glossaryTerms[0]);
            }
          }
        } else if (type === 'lesson') {
          setView('learn');
          if (typeof show === 'function') show(parseInt(targetId));
        } else if (type === 'glossary') {
          openGlossaryTerm(targetId);
        } else if (type === 'film') {
          setView('film');
          if (typeof switchFilmMode === 'function') switchFilmMode('film');
          if (typeof selectFilmScenario === 'function') selectFilmScenario(targetId);
        } else if (type === 'vision') {
          setView('film');
          if (typeof switchFilmMode === 'function') switchFilmMode('vision');
          if (typeof selectVisionChallenge === 'function') selectVisionChallenge(targetId);
        } else if (type === 'call') {
          setView('challenges');
          if (typeof openChallengesSubtab === 'function') openChallengesSubtab('coach');
          if (typeof loadCallScenario === 'function') loadCallScenario(targetId);
        } else if (type === 'trainer') {
          setView('challenges');
          if (typeof openChallengesSubtab === 'function') openChallengesSubtab('trainer');
        } else if (type === 'clock') {
          openClockSimulator(targetId);
        }
      },

      setTopicFilterLevel(lvl) {
        this.state.topicFilterLevel = lvl;
        this.renderTopicGrid();
      },

      setTopicFilterStatus(status) {
        this.state.topicFilterStatus = status;
        this.renderTopicGrid();
      },

      render() {
        this.renderHeaderAndHero();
        this.renderLadder();
        this.renderRecommendations();
        this.renderSkills();
        this.renderTopicGrid();
        this.renderCategories();
        this.renderRecentList();
      },

      renderHeaderAndHero() {
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const levels = this.getMasteryLevels();
        const activeLevelData = levels.find(l => l.level === this.state.activeLevel) || levels[0];

        const masteredCount = topics.filter(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          return r && r.status === 'mastered';
        }).length;

        const completedCount = topics.filter(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          return r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered');
        }).length;

        const totalTopics = topics.length || 22;
        const globalPct = Math.round((masteredCount / totalTopics) * 100);

        let totalPractices = 0;
        let totalSuccess = 0;
        Object.values(this.state.topicStates).forEach(r => {
          totalPractices += (r.practiceTotalCount || 0);
          totalSuccess += (r.practiceSuccessCount || 0);
        });
        const accuracyRate = totalPractices > 0 ? Math.round((totalSuccess / totalPractices) * 100) : 0;

        const stageBadge = document.getElementById('prog-user-stage-badge');
        if (stageBadge) {
          stageBadge.textContent = activeLevelData.title || `Stufe ${this.state.activeLevel}: ${activeLevelData.name}`;
          stageBadge.style.color = activeLevelData.color || '#38bdf8';
          stageBadge.style.borderColor = activeLevelData.color || '#38bdf8';
        }

        const pctLabel = document.getElementById('prog-global-pct-label');
        if (pctLabel) pctLabel.textContent = `${globalPct}%`;

        const bar = document.getElementById('prog-global-bar');
        if (bar) bar.style.width = `${globalPct}%`;

        const mEl = document.getElementById('prog-mastered-count');
        if (mEl) mEl.textContent = masteredCount;

        const cEl = document.getElementById('prog-completed-count');
        if (cEl) cEl.textContent = completedCount;

        const accEl = document.getElementById('prog-accuracy-rate');
        if (accEl) accEl.textContent = `${accuracyRate}%`;
      },

      renderLadder() {
        const container = document.getElementById('progress-ladder-steps');
        if (!container) return;

        const levels = this.getMasteryLevels();
        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();

        container.innerHTML = levels.map(l => {
          const lvlTopics = topics.filter(t => t.level === l.level);
          const finished = lvlTopics.filter(t => {
            const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
            return r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered');
          }).length;
          const mastered = lvlTopics.filter(t => {
            const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
            return r && r.status === 'mastered';
          }).length;

          const pct = lvlTopics.length > 0 ? Math.round((finished / lvlTopics.length) * 100) : 0;
          const isCurrent = l.level === this.state.activeLevel;
          const isComplete = pct === 100;
          const isLocked = l.level > this.state.activeLevel;

          let statusBadge = `<span class="ladder-prog-pill" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color:#94a3b8;">${finished}/${lvlTopics.length} (${pct}%)</span>`;
          if (isComplete) {
            statusBadge = `<span class="ladder-prog-pill" style="background:rgba(16,185,129,0.2); color:#34d399;">✓ 100% Bereit</span>`;
          } else if (isCurrent) {
            statusBadge = `<span class="ladder-prog-pill" style="background:rgba(56,189,248,0.2); color:#38bdf8;">★ Aktuelle Stufe (${pct}%)</span>`;
          } else if (isLocked) {
            statusBadge = `<span class="ladder-prog-pill" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color:#64748b;">🔒 Gesperrt</span>`;
          }

          return `
        <div 
          class="ladder-step-box ${isCurrent ? 'current' : ''} ${isComplete ? 'completed-step' : ''} ${isLocked ? 'locked-step' : ''}"
          onclick="progressEngine.setTopicFilterLevel('${l.level}')"
          title="Klicken, um Themen von Stufe ${l.level} anzuzeigen"
        >
          <span class="ladder-num">Stufe ${l.level}</span>
          <span class="ladder-name" style="color: ${l.color};">${l.name}</span>
          <span class="ladder-desc">${l.tagline}</span>
          ${statusBadge}
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      renderRecommendations() {
        const container = document.getElementById('prog-recommendations-container');
        if (!container) return;

        const recs = this.generateRecommendations();
        if (!recs.length) {
          container.innerHTML = `
        <div style="grid-column: 1/-1; padding: 24px; text-align: center; color: var(--mut);">
          🎉 Großartige Leistung! Alle empfohlenen Meilensteine deiner aktuellen Stufe sind abgeschlossen.
        </div>
      `;
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = recs.map(r => `
      <div class="prog-rec-card">
        <div>
          <span class="rec-type-badge" style="background:${r.badgeBg}; color:${r.badgeColor};">
            ${r.typeBadge}
          </span>
          <h4 class="rec-title">${r.title}</h4>
          <p class="rec-reason">${r.reason}</p>
        </div>
        <button class="rec-action-btn" onclick="${r.btnAction}">
          ${r.btnLabel} ➔
        </button>
      </div>
    `).join('');
      },

      renderSkills() {
        const container = document.getElementById('prog-skills-container');
        if (!container) return;

        const skillDefs = [
