          { key: 'preSnapRead', name: 'Pre-Snap Reading', desc: 'Formation, Box Count & Safety Shell' },
          { key: 'coverageRecognition', name: 'Coverage Recognition', desc: 'Man vs Zone, Cover 1 bis 6' },
          { key: 'pressureRecognition', name: 'Pressure & Blitz', desc: 'Mug Front, Hot Reads & Sim Pressure' },
          { key: 'playIntent', name: 'Play Intent & Conflict', desc: 'RPO Conflict, High-Low & Flow' },
          { key: 'situationalCalling', name: 'Situational Play Calling', desc: '4th Down, EPA, Risiko & Hebel' },
          { key: 'clockManagement', name: 'Clock & Crunchtime', desc: '2-Minute Drill, Spike, 10s Runoff' }
        ];

        container.innerHTML = skillDefs.map(s => {
          const pct = this.state.skillRatings[s.key] || 0;
          let badgeTxt = "Rookie";
          let badgeColor = "#94a3b8";
          let barColor = "#38bdf8";

          if (pct >= 85) { badgeTxt = "All-Pro"; badgeColor = "#facc15"; barColor = "#facc15"; }
          else if (pct >= 65) { badgeTxt = "Fortgeschritten"; badgeColor = "#38bdf8"; barColor = "#38bdf8"; }
          else if (pct >= 35) { badgeTxt = "Solide"; badgeColor = "#34d399"; barColor = "#34d399"; }

          return `
        <div class="skill-card">
          <div class="skill-header">
            <div>
              <div class="skill-name">${s.name}</div>
              <small style="color:var(--mut); font-size:10px;">${s.desc}</small>
            </div>
            <span class="skill-rating-badge" style="background:${badgeColor}22; color:${badgeColor}; border:1px solid ${badgeColor}44;">
              ${badgeTxt} (${pct}%)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="skill-bar-wrap">
            <div class="skill-bar-fill" style="width: ${pct}%; background: ${barColor};"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      renderTopicGrid() {
        const container = document.getElementById('prog-topics-grid');
        if (!container) return;

        const allTopics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const lvlFilter = this.state.topicFilterLevel;
        const statFilter = this.state.topicFilterStatus;

        const filtered = allTopics.filter(t => {
          if (lvlFilter !== 'all' && t.level !== parseInt(lvlFilter)) return false;
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          const status = r ? r.status : 'available';
          if (statFilter !== 'all' && status !== statFilter) return false;
          return true;
        });

        if (!filtered.length) {
          container.innerHTML = `
        <div style="grid-column: 1/-1; padding: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--mut);">
          Keine Themen für diesen Filter gefunden.
        </div>
      `;
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = filtered.map(t => {
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id] || { status: 'available', readCount: 0, practiceSuccessCount: 0 };
          const statusClass = `status-${r.status}`;
          const statusPillClass = `pill-status-${r.status}`;

          const statusLabels = {
            'mastered': '⭐ Gemeistert',
            'completed': '🔵 Abgeschlossen',
            'in_progress': '🟡 In Bearbeitung',
            'available': '🟢 Verfügbar',
            'locked': '🔒 Gesperrt'
          };

          // Generate action buttons
          const actionBtns = [];
          if (t.associatedItems.lessons.length) {
            actionBtns.push(`<button class="topic-action-btn" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('lesson', '${t.associatedItems.lessons[0]}')">📖 Lektion ${t.associatedItems.lessons[0] + 1}</button>`);
          }
          if (t.associatedItems.filmScenarios.length) {
            actionBtns.push(`<button class="topic-action-btn" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('film', '${t.associatedItems.filmScenarios[0]}')">🎥 Film Room</button>`);
          }
          if (t.associatedItems.visionChallenges.length) {
            actionBtns.push(`<button class="topic-action-btn" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('vision', '${t.associatedItems.visionChallenges[0]}')">👁️ Vision</button>`);
          }
          if (t.associatedItems.callScenarios.length) {
            actionBtns.push(`<button class="topic-action-btn" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('call', '${t.associatedItems.callScenarios[0]}')">🧠 Coach Call</button>`);
          }
          if (t.associatedItems.clockScenarios.length) {
            actionBtns.push(`<button class="topic-action-btn" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('clock', '${t.associatedItems.clockScenarios[0]}')">⏱️ Clock Sim</button>`);
          }

          return `
        <div class="prog-topic-card ${statusClass}">
          <div>
            <div class="topic-header-row">
              <h4 class="topic-title">${t.title}</h4>
              <div class="topic-badges">
                <span class="topic-status-pill ${statusPillClass}">${statusLabels[r.status] || r.status}</span>
                <span style="font-size:10px; color:var(--mut); font-weight:600;">Stufe ${t.level}: ${t.levelName}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p class="topic-desc" style="margin-top:6px;">${t.desc}</p>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div class="topic-progress-box">
              <span>Theorie: <strong>${r.readCount > 0 ? 'Gelesen ✓' : 'Offen'}</strong></span>
              <span>Praxis-Erfolge: <strong>${r.practiceSuccessCount} / ${t.masteryCriteria ? t.masteryCriteria.minPractices : 2}</strong></span>
            </div>
            <div class="topic-action-bar">
              ${actionBtns.join('')}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      renderCategories() {
        const container = document.getElementById('prog-categories-breakdown');
        if (!container) return;

        const topics = this.getCurriculumTopics();
        const catMap = {};

        topics.forEach(t => {
          if (!catMap[t.category]) {
            catMap[t.category] = { label: t.categoryLabel, total: 0, completed: 0, mastered: 0 };
          }
          catMap[t.category].total += 1;
          const r = this.state.topicStates[t.id];
          if (r && (r.status === 'completed' || r.status === 'mastered')) catMap[t.category].completed += 1;
          if (r && r.status === 'mastered') catMap[t.category].mastered += 1;
        });

        container.innerHTML = Object.values(catMap).map(c => {
          const pct = Math.round((c.completed / c.total) * 100);
          return `
        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px;">
          <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:12px; font-weight:700;">
            <span style="color:#cbd5e1;">${c.label} (${c.completed}/${c.total})</span>
            <span style="color:#38bdf8;">${pct}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="progress-bar-wrap" style="height:6px; margin:0;">
            <div class="progress-bar-fill" style="width:${pct}%; background:#38bdf8;"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      },

      renderRecentList() {
        const container = document.getElementById('prog-recent-activity-list');
        if (!container) return;

        if (!this.state.recentActivities.length) {
          container.innerHTML = `<p style="color:var(--mut); font-size:12px; margin:0;">Noch keine Aktivitäten aufgezeichnet.</p>`;
          return;
        }

        container.innerHTML = this.state.recentActivities.map(a => `
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding:6px 10px; border-radius:6px; font-size:11px;">
        <span style="color:#fff; font-weight:600;">${a.label}</span>
        <button class="topic-action-btn" style="padding:2px 6px; font-size:10px;" onclick="progressEngine.openTopicAction('${a.type}', '${a.id}')">
          Öffnen ➔
        </button>
      </div>
    `).join('');
      },

      resetProgress() {
        if (confirm("Möchtest du deinen Lernfortschritt wirklich auf Null zurücksetzen?")) {
          try {
            localStorage.removeItem(this.storageKey);
          } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Storage reset failed:", e);
          }
          this.state.topicStates = {};
          this.state.recentActivities = [];
          this.state.activeLevel = 1;
          this.evaluateAllTopics();
          this.calculateSkillRatings();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
          alert("Fortschritt wurde erfolgreich zurückgesetzt.");
        }
      }
    };

    /* ==================== GLOBAL BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY HELPERS ==================== */

    function getMasteryData() {
      const counts = typeof getPathProgressCounts === 'function' ? getPathProgressCounts() : {
        totalDone: Object.keys(doneLessons || {}).filter(k => doneLessons[k]).length,
        totalAll: (typeof L !== 'undefined' ? L.length : 19),
        general: { done: Object.keys(doneLessons || {}).filter(k => doneLessons[k]).length, total: 19 }
      };

      const totalDone = counts.totalDone;
      const totalAll = counts.totalAll;
      const pct = totalAll > 0 ? Math.round((totalDone / totalAll) * 100) : 0;

      let rank = "Level 1: Rookie";
      let stage = 1;
      let desc = "Grundlagen, Downs & erste Fundamentals";
      if (pct >= 85) { stage = 5; rank = "Level 5: Master Strategist / Head Coach"; desc = "Exzellenz in Schema-Design, All-22 & In-Game Calling"; }
      else if (pct >= 60) { stage = 4; rank = "Level 4: Tactical Coordinator"; desc = "Fortgeschrittene Schemes, Match Quarters & EPA"; }
      else if (pct >= 35) { stage = 3; rank = "Level 3: Varsity Analyst"; desc = "Solides Taktikwissen, Reads & Positionstechnik"; }
      else if (pct >= 15) { stage = 2; rank = "Level 2: Film Room Cadet"; desc = "Downs, Formationen & Positions-Aufgaben"; }

      return {
        rank: rank,
        title: rank.split(': ')[1] || "Rookie",
        desc: desc,
        totalWeight: pct,
        completedLessons: totalDone,
        totalLessons: totalAll,
        progressPercent: pct,
        stage: stage,
        counts: counts
      };
    }

    function updateMasteryBadge() {
      const m = getMasteryData();
      const b = document.getElementById("mastery-badge");
      if (b) b.textContent = m.rank;
    }

    function renderProgressView() {
      if (typeof progressEngine !== 'undefined') {
        progressEngine.init();
        progressEngine.render();
      }
    }

    /* ==================== TACTICAL FIELD LAB CONTROLS ==================== */
    function openLabPreset(formKey, playKey, defKey) {
      setView('lab');
      if (formKey) $("#sel-formation").value = formKey;
      if (playKey) $("#sel-play").value = playKey;
      if (defKey) $("#sel-defense").value = defKey;
      labEngine.loadSetup(formKey, playKey, defKey);
    }

    function initFieldLab() {
      labEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("field-svg", {
        onPlayerSelect: (player, side, play, phase) => updateInspector(player, side, play, phase),
        onPhaseChange: (phase, progress) => {
          const badge = $("#play-phase-badge");
          if (badge) {
            badge.textContent = `🏈 ${phase}`;
            if (phase === "PRE-SNAP") badge.style.color = "var(--y)";
            else if (phase === "SNAP & RELEASE") badge.style.color = "var(--accent-cyan)";
            else if (phase === "PLAY IN PROGRESS") badge.style.color = "var(--g-light)";
            else badge.style.color = "var(--accent-purple)";
          }
        },
        onTimeUpdate: (progress, phase) => {
          const sc = $("#field-scrubber");
          if (sc && !labEngine.isScrubbing) sc.value = Math.floor(progress * 100);
          const to = $("#time-readout");
          if (to) to.textContent = `${(progress * 3.2).toFixed(1)}s / 3.2s`;
        }
      });

      const selForm = $("#sel-formation");
      const selPlay = $("#sel-play");
      const selDef = $("#sel-defense");
      const selMode = $("#sel-field-mode");

      selForm.innerHTML = Object.keys(NFL_DATA.formations).map(k =>
        `<option value="${k}">${NFL_DATA.formations[k].name}</option>`
      ).join('');

      selPlay.innerHTML = Object.keys(NFL_DATA.plays).map(k =>
        `<option value="${k}">${NFL_DATA.plays[k].name}</option>`
      ).join('');

      selDef.innerHTML = Object.keys(NFL_DATA.defenses).map(k =>
        `<option value="${k}">${NFL_DATA.defenses[k].name}</option>`
      ).join('');

      const sync = () => labEngine.loadSetup(selForm.value, selPlay.value, selDef.value);

      selForm.onchange = sync;
      selPlay.onchange = () => {
        const p = NFL_DATA.plays[selPlay.value];
        if (p && p.formation && NFL_DATA.formations[p.formation]) {
          selForm.value = p.formation;
        }
        sync();
      };
      selDef.onchange = sync;

      selMode.onchange = e => {
        labEngine.setViewMode(e.target.value);
      };

      // Layer Toggles
      $("#chk-routes").onchange = e => { labEngine.options.showRoutes = e.target.checked; labEngine.render(); };
      $("#chk-zones").onchange = e => { labEngine.options.showZones = e.target.checked; labEngine.render(); };
      $("#chk-rush").onchange = e => { labEngine.options.showRush = e.target.checked; labEngine.render(); };
      $("#chk-labels").onchange = e => { labEngine.options.showLabels = e.target.checked; labEngine.render(); };
      $("#chk-target").onchange = e => { labEngine.options.showTarget = e.target.checked; labEngine.render(); };

      // Playback Controls
      $("#btn-play").onclick = () => {
        if (labEngine.animating) {
          labEngine.pause();
          $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
        } else {
          labEngine.playSnap();
          $("#btn-play").textContent = "⏸ Pause";
        }
      };
      $("#btn-pause").onclick = () => {
        labEngine.pause();
        $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
      };
      $("#btn-step-back").onclick = () => {
        labEngine.step(-0.05);
        $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
      };
      $("#btn-step-fwd").onclick = () => {
        labEngine.step(0.05);
        $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
      };
      $("#btn-reset").onclick = () => {
        labEngine.reset();
        $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
      };

      const scrubber = $("#field-scrubber");
      scrubber.onmousedown = () => { labEngine.isScrubbing = true; };
      scrubber.onmouseup = () => { labEngine.isScrubbing = false; };
      scrubber.oninput = e => {
        labEngine.pause();
        $("#btn-play").textContent = "▶ Play Snap";
        labEngine.setTime(e.target.value / 100);
      };

      $("#sel-speed").onchange = e => {
        labEngine.speed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
      };

      sync();
    }

    function updateInspector(player, side, play, phase) {
      const badge = $("#insp-badge");
      if (!badge) return;
      badge.textContent = player.id;
      badge.className = `player-badge ${side === 'O' ? 'offense' : 'defense'}`;

      const curPhase = phase || (labEngine ? labEngine.phase : "PRE-SNAP");
      $("#insp-name").textContent = `${player.name || player.id} (${side === 'O' ? 'Offense' : 'Defense'})`;

      // Dynamic Alignment
      let alignDesc = `X: ${player.x}, Y: ${player.y}`;
      if (side === 'O') {
        if (player.id === 'QB') alignDesc = "Shotgun / Under Center (7 / 5 / 0 yds Depth)";
        else if (player.id === 'RB' || player.id === 'FB') alignDesc = "Backfield Alignment, Offset / Downhill Stance";
        else if (player.id.startsWith('T') || player.id.startsWith('G') || player.id === 'C') alignDesc = "Line of Scrimmage, 2-pt / 3-pt Stance";
        else if (player.id === 'X' || player.id === 'Z') alignDesc = "Split Out (Numbers / Boundary), 1-yd on/off LOS";
        else if (player.id.startsWith('TE') || player.id === 'Y') alignDesc = "Inline Tight End Y-Alignment oder Flex Wing";
        else if (player.id.startsWith('H')) alignDesc = "Slot Alignment, 5 yds Inside vom Perimeter WR";
      } else {
        if (player.id.startsWith('C') && player.id.length <= 3) alignDesc = "Outside CB, 5-7 yds Off-Man oder Press Bail";
        else if (player.id === 'FS' || player.id === 'SS') alignDesc = "Safety Shell, 12-15 yds Deep Landmark";
        else if (player.id.includes('LB') || player.id === 'MIKE' || player.id === 'WILL' || player.id === 'SAM') alignDesc = "Second Level, 4-5 yds hinter Defensive Line";
        else alignDesc = "Defensive Front (0/1/3/5/7-Technique)";
      }
      $("#insp-align").textContent = alignDesc;

      // Assignment based on Phase & Tracks
      let phaseAssign = player.role || "Pass Protection / Execution";
      if (play && play.tracks && play.tracks[player.id]) {
        const track = play.tracks[player.id];
        const curProg = labEngine ? labEngine.progress : 0;
        const curWp = track.slice().reverse().find(w => w.t <= curProg) || track[0];
        if (curWp && curWp.action) {
          phaseAssign = `[${curPhase}]: ${curWp.action}`;
        }
      } else {
        phaseAssign = `[${curPhase}]: ${player.role || 'Reguläre Aufgabe'}`;
      }
      $("#insp-assign").textContent = phaseAssign;

      // Position-specific Coaching Telemetry
      let coachingRead = "";
      let tipBox = "";
      if (side === "O") {
        if (player.id === "QB") {
          coachingRead = "Liest Pre-Snap Safety Depth (Single vs Two High), Box Count & Mike LB. Post-Snap High-to-Low Progression.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>QB Read:</b> Gegen Quarters oder Cover 2 den Ball nicht blind erzwingen. Wenn tief gedeckt ist, nimm den freien Checkdown!`;
        } else if (player.id === "RB") {
          coachingRead = "Scannt A/B-Gap Blitz. Bei Zone Run liest er First-Level D-Line Hüften und schneidet explosiv in die Cutback Lane.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>RB Key:</b> One Cut and Go! Zögere nicht an der Line, folge dem Pulling Blocker bzw. dem Zonen-Winkel.`;
        } else if (player.id === "X" || player.id === "Z" || player.id.startsWith("H")) {
          coachingRead = "Liest CB-Leverage (Inside vs Outside) und Cushion. Attackiert den Blindspot und erzeugt Trennung am Break-Point.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>WR Technique:</b> Am Release die Hüften des Cornerbacks drehen lassen, um beim Cut maximalen Raum zu gewinnen.`;
        } else {
          coachingRead = "Erkennt Front (Over/Under) und Stunts. Hält Pass-Pocket-Breite oder schiebt Zone Combos auf Linebacker.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>OL Anchor:</b> Hände eng an der Brust halten, tiefer Schwerpunkt gegen Power Bull-Rush.`;
        }
      } else {
        if (player.id === "FS" || player.id === "SS") {
          coachingRead = "Liest Release von WR #2 & #3. In Cover 3 tiefe Mitte sichern, in Cover 2 Deep-Half gegen Fade/Corner absichern.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>Safety Read:</b> Niemals zu früh auf Play-Action beißen! Tiefe Routen haben vor Unter-Routen immer Priorität.`;
        } else if (player.id.startsWith("C") && player.id.length <= 3) {
          coachingRead = "Liest Hip Turn des Receivers. In Press Release stören, in Off-Man Cushion bewahren und Break attackieren.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>CB Read:</b> Im Smash-Konzept bei Hitch des WRs nicht sofort springen, wenn Z die Corner-Route in deinen Rücken läuft!`;
        } else if (player.id.includes("LB") || player.id === "MIKE" || player.id === "WILL" || player.id === "SAM") {
          coachingRead = "Run/Pass Read über Guard-Pull oder Flow. Droppt in Hook/Curl-Zone oder füllt das Run-Gap.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>LB Eye Discipline:</b> Guards lügen nie! Wenn der Guard pullt, folge sofort der Strömung zur Playside.`;
        } else {
          coachingRead = "Attackiert den Blocker mit Hebelwirkung (Pad Level) und presst die Pocket ein bzw. stoppt den A/B-Gap Run.";
          tipBox = `💡 <b>Pass Rush Key:</b> Pass Rush Lane diszipliniert halten (Contain), damit der QB nicht aus der Pocket scramblen kann.`;
        }
      }
      $("#insp-read").textContent = coachingRead;
      $("#insp-tip").innerHTML = tipBox;
    }

    /* ==================== COVERAGE TRAINER MODULE ==================== */
    function initTrainer() {
      trainerEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("trainer-svg", {
        interactive: false,
        showZones: false,
        showRoutes: false,
        showTarget: false
      });

      $("#trainer-btn-reset").onclick = () => {
        trainerState.score = 0;
        trainerState.streak = 0;
        trainerState.curIndex = 0;
        try { localStorage.setItem("nfl_trainer", JSON.stringify(trainerState)); } catch (e) { }
        loadTrainerScenario(0);
      };

      $("#trainer-btn-next").onclick = () => {
        trainerState.curIndex = (trainerState.curIndex + 1) % NFL_DATA.trainerScenarios.length;
        loadTrainerScenario(trainerState.curIndex);
      };
    }

    function loadTrainerScenario(idx) {
      if (!trainerEngine && typeof initTrainer === 'function') initTrainer();
      if (!trainerEngine) return;
      const sc = NFL_DATA.trainerScenarios[idx];
      if (!sc) return;

      trainerState.answered = false;
      $("#trainer-step").textContent = `${idx + 1} / ${NFL_DATA.trainerScenarios.length}`;
      $("#trainer-score").textContent = `${trainerState.score} Pkt`;
      $("#trainer-streak").textContent = `🔥 ${trainerState.streak}`;
      $("#trainer-qtopic").textContent = sc.topic;
      $("#trainer-qprompt").textContent = sc.prompt;

      trainerEngine.loadSetup(sc.formation, "mesh", sc.defense);
      trainerEngine.options.showZones = false;
      trainerEngine.options.showRoutes = false;
      trainerEngine.render();

      $("#trainer-clues").innerHTML = sc.clues.map(c => `
    <div class="clue-box">
      <div class="clue-label">${c.label}</div>
      <div class="clue-val">${c.val}</div>
    </div>
  `).join('');

      $("#trainer-choices").innerHTML = sc.choices.map((ch, i) => `
    <button class="choice-btn" data-ci="${i}">
      <span class="choice-title">${ch.text}</span>
      <span class="choice-desc">${ch.desc}</span>
    </button>
  `).join('');

      $("#trainer-debrief").classList.remove("active");

      document.querySelectorAll(".choice-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.onclick = () => handleTrainerAnswer(parseInt(btn.dataset.ci));
      });
    }

    function handleTrainerAnswer(choiceIndex) {
      if (trainerState.answered) return;
      trainerState.answered = true;

      const sc = NFL_DATA.trainerScenarios[trainerState.curIndex];
      const choice = sc.choices[choiceIndex];
      const btns = document.querySelectorAll(".choice-btn");

      btns.forEach((b, i) => {
        b.disabled = true;
        if (sc.choices[i].correct) b.classList.add("correct");
        if (i === choiceIndex && !sc.choices[i].correct) b.classList.add("incorrect");
      });

      if (choice.correct) {
        trainerState.score += 100 + (trainerState.streak * 20);
        trainerState.streak += 1;
      } else {
        trainerState.streak = 0;
      }

      try { localStorage.setItem("nfl_trainer", JSON.stringify(trainerState)); } catch (e) { }
      updateMasteryBadge();

      $("#trainer-score").textContent = `${trainerState.score} Pkt`;
      $("#trainer-streak").textContent = `🔥 ${trainerState.streak}`;

      trainerEngine.options.showZones = true;
      trainerEngine.render();
      trainerEngine.playSnap();

      const debrief = $("#trainer-debrief");
      $("#debrief-title").textContent = choice.correct ? "✅ Richtig erkannt!" : "❌ Nicht ganz!";
      $("#debrief-title").style.color = choice.correct ? "#5fbf8a" : "#f43f5e";
      $("#debrief-text").innerHTML = sc.debrief;
      debrief.classList.add("active");
    }

    /* ==================== GLOBAL SEARCH ==================== */
    function search(q) {
      if (!q) {
        setView('home');
        return;
      }
      setView('learn');
      renderNav();
      const m = $("#m");
      const query = q.toLowerCase();
      const lessonMatches = L.map((l, i) => [l, i]).filter(([l]) => (l.t + l.h).toLowerCase().includes(query));
      const glossMatches = (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.glossary)
        ? NFL_DATA.glossary.filter(t => [t.term, t.shortDef, t.longExpl, ...(t.tags || [])].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query))
        : [];

      if (lessonMatches.length === 0 && glossMatches.length === 0) {
        m.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cmd-empty-state">
        <div class="cmd-empty-icon">🔍</div>
        <div class="cmd-empty-title">Keine Treffer für "${q}"</div>
        <div class="cmd-empty-desc">Probiere andere Begriffe wie "Cover 3", "Mesh", "EPA", "Duo", "Zone", "11 Personnel", "Safety" oder "Blitz".</div>
        <button class="btn-subtle" onclick="$('#s').value=''; search('');" style="margin-top: 8px;">Suche zurücksetzen</button>
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      m.innerHTML = `
    <h1>Suchergebnisse: "${q}"</h1>
    <h2>Lektionen</h2>
    ${lessonMatches.map(([l, i]) => `
      <p><a class="w" data-i="${i}"><b>${l.t}</b></a> <span class="lv">Level ${l.lv}</span></p>
    `).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--mut);">Keine passenden Lektionen gefunden.</p>'}

        <h2>Glossar & Knowledge Graph Treffer</h2>
    ${glossMatches.map(t => `
      <div class="co" style="cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:12px; transition:all 0.15s ease;" onclick="openGlossaryTerm('${t.id}')">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
          <b style="color:#38bdf8; font-size:15px;">${t.term}</b>
          <span style="font-size:11px; background:rgba(56,189,248,0.15); color:#38bdf8; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px;">${t.categoryLabel}</span>
        </div>
        <p style="margin:4px 0; color:#e2e8f0; font-size:13px;">${t.shortDef}</p>
        <small style="color:var(--mut);">Klicken, um im interaktiven Knowledge Graph zu öffnen ➔</small>
      </div>
    `).join('') || '<p style="color:var(--mut);">Keine Glossar-Treffer.</p>'}
  `;
    }
