    // Logic functions for Play Builder

    // 1. Formation Analysis
    function analyzeFormationDetails(formation) {
      if (!formation || !formation.players) {
        return { name: "Custom Formation", personnel: "11 Personnel", backfield: "Shotgun", spread: "Balanced" };
      }
      const players = formation.players;
      const qb = players.find(p => p.id === "QB") || { x: 285, y: 300 };
      const rbs = players.filter(p => p.id.startsWith("RB") || p.id.startsWith("FB") || p.id === "HB");
      const tes = players.filter(p => p.id.startsWith("TE") || p.id === "Y");
      const wrs = players.filter(p => p.id.startsWith("WR") || p.id === "X" || p.id === "Z" || p.id === "H" || p.id === "F");

      // Personnel Grouping
      const numRBs = rbs.length;
      const numTEs = tes.length;
      const numWRs = wrs.length;
      const personnelCode = `${numRBs}${numTEs} Personnel`;
      const personnelDetail = `${personnelCode} (${numRBs} RB, ${numTEs} TE, ${numWRs} WR)`;

      // Backfield alignment
      let backfield = "Shotgun";
      if (qb.x >= 335) backfield = "Under Center";
      else if (qb.x < 315 && rbs.length === 1 && Math.abs(rbs[0].y - qb.y) < 20 && rbs[0].x < qb.x) backfield = "Pistol";
      else if (rbs.length === 0) backfield = "Empty Backfield";

      // Receiver distribution
      const leftReceivers = [...wrs, ...tes].filter(p => p.y < 280);
      const rightReceivers = [...wrs, ...tes].filter(p => p.y > 320);
      let spread = `${leftReceivers.length}x${rightReceivers.length}`;

      let formationName = `${backfield} ${spread}`;
      if (spread === "3x1" || spread === "1x3") formationName = `${backfield} Trips (${spread})`;
      else if (spread === "2x2") formationName = `${backfield} Spread 2x2`;
      else if (spread === "3x2" || spread === "2x3") formationName = `${backfield} Empty Spread`;

      // Check Bunch
      const checkBunch = (group) => {
        if (group.length < 3) return false;
        for (let i = 0; i < group.length; i++) {
          for (let j = i + 1; j < group.length; j++) {
            const dx = group[i].x - group[j].x;
            const dy = group[i].y - group[j].y;
            if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 75) return false;
          }
        }
        return true;
      };
      if (checkBunch(rightReceivers) || checkBunch(leftReceivers)) {
        formationName = `${backfield} Bunch`;
      }

      return {
        name: formationName,
        personnel: personnelDetail,
        personnelCode,
        numRBs,
        numTEs,
        numWRs,
        backfield,
        spread
      };
    }

    // 2. Route Geometries & Keyframe Tracks Generator
    function computeRouteGeometry(player, routeType) {
      const px = player.x;
      const py = player.y;
      const isLeft = py < 300;
      const outDir = isLeft ? -1 : 1;
      const inDir = isLeft ? 1 : -1;

      let path = "";
      let label = routeType.toUpperCase();
      let track = [];

      switch (routeType.toLowerCase()) {
        case "go":
        case "streak":
        case "fly":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 360} ${py}`;
          label = "9-Go";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.45, x: px + 140, y: py, action: "Vertical Stem" },
            { t: 0.75, x: px + 280, y: py, action: "Burn DB" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 360, y: py, action: "Deep Catch" }
          ];
          break;

        case "slant":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 60} ${py} L ${px + 160} ${py + inDir * 90}`;
          label = "2-Slant";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.45, x: px + 60, y: py, action: "3-Step Stem" },
            { t: 0.70, x: px + 120, y: py + inDir * 55, action: "Cut Inside" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 160, y: py + inDir * 90, action: "Catch in Stride" }
          ];
          break;

        case "out":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 140} ${py} L ${px + 140} ${py + outDir * 75}`;
          label = "Speed Out";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.55, x: px + 140, y: py, action: "Square Stem" },
            { t: 0.80, x: px + 140, y: py + outDir * 50, action: "90° Out Cut" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 140, y: py + outDir * 75, action: "Toe Drag" }
          ];
          break;

        case "in":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 100} ${py} L ${px + 100} ${py + inDir * 140}`;
          label = "Shallow In";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.50, x: px + 100, y: py, action: "5y Stem" },
            { t: 0.75, x: px + 100, y: py + inDir * 80, action: "In Cut" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 100, y: py + inDir * 140, action: "Catch Across" }
          ];
          break;

        case "dig":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 200} ${py} L ${px + 200} ${py + inDir * 140}`;
          label = "12y Dig";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.60, x: px + 200, y: py, action: "Deep 12y Stem" },
            { t: 0.80, x: px + 200, y: py + inDir * 70, action: "Square In Cut" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 200, y: py + inDir * 140, action: "Target Window" }
          ];
          break;

        case "post":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 180} ${py} L ${px + 320} 300`;
          label = "8-Post";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.55, x: px + 180, y: py, action: "Vertical Stem" },
            { t: 0.78, x: px + 260, y: py + (300 - py) * 0.6, action: "Post Break" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 320, y: 300, action: "Goalpost Window" }
          ];
          break;

        case "corner":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 180} ${py} L ${px + 300} ${py + outDir * 110}`;
          label = "7-Corner";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.55, x: px + 180, y: py, action: "Push DB Inside" },
            { t: 0.80, x: px + 250, y: py + outDir * 65, action: "Corner Break" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 300, y: py + outDir * 110, action: "Pylon Catch" }
          ];
          break;

        case "curl":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 180} ${py} L ${px + 150} ${py + inDir * 15}`;
          label = "Curl / Hitch";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.60, x: px + 180, y: py, action: "Drive DB Back" },
            { t: 0.80, x: px + 160, y: py + inDir * 10, action: "Hard Plant" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 150, y: py + inDir * 15, action: "Turn to QB" }
          ];
          break;

        case "comeback":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 220} ${py} L ${px + 180} ${py + outDir * 35}`;
          label = "Comeback";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.65, x: px + 220, y: py, action: "Sell Go Route" },
            { t: 0.82, x: px + 195, y: py + outDir * 20, action: "Comeback Plant" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 180, y: py + outDir * 35, action: "Boundary Catch" }
          ];
          break;

        case "flat":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 40} ${py + outDir * 40} L ${px + 60} ${py + outDir * 80}`;
          label = "Flat Route";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.50, x: px + 40, y: py + outDir * 40, action: "Quick Release" },
            { t: 0.75, x: px + 60, y: py + outDir * 80, action: "Open in Flat" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 90, y: py + outDir * 95, action: "YAC Burst" }
          ];
          break;

        case "seam":
          const hashY = isLeft ? 250 : 350;
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 50} ${hashY} L ${px + 360} ${hashY}`;
          label = "Seam Vertical";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.40, x: px + 50, y: hashY, action: "Stem to Hash" },
            { t: 0.70, x: px + 220, y: hashY, action: "Push Safety" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 360, y: hashY, action: "Seam Catch" }
          ];
          break;

        case "wheel":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 50} ${py + outDir * 60} L ${px + 280} ${py + outDir * 60}`;
          label = "Wheel Route";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.45, x: px + 50, y: py + outDir * 60, action: "Flat Stem" },
            { t: 0.75, x: px + 170, y: py + outDir * 60, action: "Turn up Sideline" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 280, y: py + outDir * 60, action: "Wheel Touchdown" }
          ];
          break;

        default:
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L ${px + 120} ${py}`;
          label = "Release";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 1.0, x: px + 120, y: py, action: "Route End" }
          ];
      }

      return { path, label, track };
    }

    // 3. Run Concept Geometries & Tracks
    function computeRunConceptGeometry(player, runType) {
      const px = player.x;
      const py = player.y;
      let path = "";
      let label = "Run Track";
      let track = [];

      switch (runType.toLowerCase()) {
        case "inside_run":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 330 300 L 460 305`;
          label = "Inside Zone A/B-Gap";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.40, x: 330, y: 300, action: "Mesh Hand-off" },
            { t: 0.70, x: 390, y: 300, action: "Hit A-Gap Hole" },
            { t: 1.0, x: 460, y: 305, action: "2nd Level Burst" }
          ];
          break;

        case "outside_run":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 320 380 L 370 450 L 480 470`;
          label = "Outside Zone Stretch";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.45, x: 320, y: 380, action: "Mesh & Stretch Lateral" },
            { t: 0.75, x: 370, y: 450, action: "Perimeter Corner" },
            { t: 1.0, x: 480, y: 470, action: "Sideline Touchdown" }
          ];
          break;

        case "cutback":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 330 370 L 360 350 L 460 250`;
          label = "Zone Cutback";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.45, x: 330, y: 370, action: "Press Frontside" },
            { t: 0.70, x: 360, y: 350, action: "Plant & Cut Back" },
            { t: 1.0, x: 460, y: 250, action: "Backside Crease" }
          ];
          break;

        case "counter":
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 270 320 L 370 370 L 470 380`;
          label = "Counter Step & Wrap";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: px, y: py, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.40, x: 270, y: 320, action: "Misdirection Step" },
            { t: 0.70, x: 370, y: 370, action: "Follow Pulling Tackle" },
            { t: 1.0, x: 470, y: 380, action: "Daylight Burst" }
          ];
          break;
      }
      return { path, label, track };
    }

    // 4. Pre-Snap Motions
    function computeMotionGeometry(player, motionType) {
      const px = player.x;
      const py = player.y;
      const isLeft = py < 300;
      let path = "";
      let label = "Pre-Snap Motion";
      let start = { x: px, y: py };
      let end = { x: px, y: py };
      let track = [];

      switch (motionType.toLowerCase()) {
        case "jet":
          end = { x: 310, y: isLeft ? 440 : 160 };
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 310 ${isLeft ? 300 : 300} L ${end.x} ${end.y}`;
          label = "Jet Motion";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Motion Start" },
            { t: 0.10, x: 310, y: 300, action: "Sprint across QB" },
            { t: 0.20, x: end.x, y: end.y, action: "Ball Snapped in Full Motion" }
          ];
          break;

        case "orbit":
          end = { x: 320, y: isLeft ? 400 : 200 };
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 250 ${isLeft ? 320 : 280} L ${end.x} ${end.y}`;
          label = "Orbit Arc";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Motion Start" },
            { t: 0.10, x: 250, y: isLeft ? 320 : 280, action: "Arc behind QB" },
            { t: 0.20, x: end.x, y: end.y, action: "Snap" }
          ];
          break;

        case "across":
          end = { x: 340, y: isLeft ? 390 : 210 };
          path = `M ${px} ${py} L 320 300 L ${end.x} ${end.y}`;
          label = "Across Shift";
          track = [
            { t: 0, x: px, y: py, action: "Motion Start" },
            { t: 0.10, x: 320, y: 300, action: "Shift" },
            { t: 0.20, x: end.x, y: end.y, action: "Set Alignment" }
          ];
          break;
      }

      return { path, label, start, end, track };
    }

    // 5. Tactical Analysis Engine
    function analyzePlayArchitecture(play, formation, defense) {
      const formInfo = analyzeFormationDetails(formation);
      const routes = play.routes || [];
      const runPath = play.runPath;
      const motion = play.motion;
      const blocking = play.blocking || [];

      // Determine Play Type
      let playType = "Pass Concept";
      if (runPath) {
        playType = runPath.type === "counter" ? "Gap Scheme Run (Counter)" : "Zone Run Scheme";
        if (routes.length >= 2) playType = "Run-Pass Option (RPO)";
      } else {
        // Check depths
        const hasDeep = routes.some(r => ["go", "post", "corner", "wheel", "seam"].includes(r.type?.toLowerCase()));
        const hasQuick = routes.some(r => ["slant", "flat", "curl"].includes(r.type?.toLowerCase()));
        if (hasDeep) playType = "Deep Choice / Vertical Shot";
        else if (hasQuick) playType = "Quick Game (3-Step Drop)";
        else playType = "Intermediate Dropback (5-Step Drop)";
      }

      // Detect Primary Concept
      const routeTypes = routes.map(r => r.type?.toLowerCase() || "");
      let primaryConcept = "Custom Tactical Concept";
      let conceptDesc = "Individuell entworfene Pass- und Laufkombination mit flexibler Progression.";

      if (runPath && runPath.type === "counter") {
        primaryConcept = "GT Counter Concept";
        conceptDesc = "Klassisches Misdirection-Laufspiel: Backside Pullers überladen die Angriffsseite, während der RB geduldig der Leitblockade folgt.";
      } else if (runPath && runPath.type === "inside_run") {
        primaryConcept = "Inside Zone / Duo Concept";
        conceptDesc = "Downhill-Laufspiel zentriert auf A/B-Gaps mit Combo-Blocks an den Defensive Tackles.";
      } else if (runPath && runPath.type === "outside_run") {
        primaryConcept = "Outside Zone / Stretch Concept";
        conceptDesc = "Horizontale Dehnung der Front bis zur Seitenlinie mit Fokus auf Reach-Blocks.";
      } else if (routeTypes.includes("corner") && (routeTypes.includes("curl") || routeTypes.includes("flat"))) {
        primaryConcept = "Smash Concept (Cover 2 Beater)";
        conceptDesc = "Klassischer High-Low-Stretch auf den Cornerback: Der flache Hitch bindet den CB, während der Corner-Cut die Nahtstelle hinter ihm attackiert.";
      } else if (routeTypes.filter(r => r === "go" || r === "seam").length >= 3) {
        primaryConcept = "Four Verticals (Cover 3 Beater)";
        conceptDesc = "Vier vertikale Routen strecken die Defense tief und erzwingen ein 4-gegen-3 Übergewicht gegen die tiefen Verteidiger.";
      } else if (routeTypes.includes("dig") && (routeTypes.includes("seam") || routeTypes.includes("go") || routeTypes.includes("post"))) {
        primaryConcept = "Dagger Concept (Clearout & Dig)";
        conceptDesc = "Vertikaler Seam-Clearout zieht den tiefen Free Safety aus dem Fenster, wodurch der 15-Yard Dig dahinter frei wird.";
      } else if (routeTypes.filter(r => r.includes("drag") || r === "in").length >= 2) {
        primaryConcept = "Mesh Concept (Crossing Drags)";
        conceptDesc = "Zwei kreuzende Drags auf 5 Yards Tiefe schütteln Verteidiger durch natürliche Pick-Situationen (Rubs) in Man Coverage ab.";
      } else if (routeTypes.includes("out") && routeTypes.includes("flat") && (routeTypes.includes("go") || routeTypes.includes("post"))) {
        primaryConcept = "Flood / Sail Concept (3-Level Stretch)";
        conceptDesc = "Drei-Ebenen-Flutung der Spielfeldseite (Deep, Intermediate Sail, Flat) überlastet Zonenverteidiger an der Boundary.";
      } else if (routeTypes.includes("slant") && routeTypes.includes("flat")) {
        primaryConcept = "Dragon / Slant-Flat Concept";
        conceptDesc = "Effizienter 2-Mann-High-Low auf den Flat-Verteidiger für schnellen 3-Step-Rhythmus.";
      }

      // Defensive Coverage Matchup Matrix
      let covRatings = [
        { name: "Cover 0", label: "Cover 0 Blitz", score: 70, note: "Gefahr bei fehlenden Hot Reads" },
        { name: "Cover 1", label: "Cover 1 Man", score: 80, note: "Separation durch Cuts" },
        { name: "Cover 2", label: "Cover 2 Zone", score: 75, note: "Guter High-Low Stretch" },
        { name: "Cover 3", label: "Cover 3 Sky", score: 85, note: "Exzellente Nahtstellen-Ausnutzung" },
        { name: "Cover 4", label: "Cover 4 Quarters", score: 75, note: "Underneath Zonen frei" },
        { name: "Cover 6", label: "Cover 6 Split", score: 80, note: "Gegen Halbfeld-Schwäche" }
      ];

      if (primaryConcept.includes("Mesh") || routeTypes.includes("slant")) {
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").score = 95;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").note = "Perfekter Blitz-Beater mit schnellen Outlets";
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 1").score = 92;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 1").note = "Mesh Pick erzeugt freie Separation";
      }
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Four Verticals") || primaryConcept.includes("Dagger")) {
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 3").score = 95;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 3").note = "4 Vertikale überlasten 3 tiefe Drittel";
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").score = 45;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").note = "Lange Entwicklungszeit ohne Hot Read";
      }
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Smash")) {
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 2").score = 95;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 2").note = "Corner-Route isoliert den Cloud CB";
      }
      if (runPath) {
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 2").score = 88;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 2").note = "Leichte 6-Mann-Box begünstigt Laufspiel";
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").score = 50;
        covRatings.find(c => c.name === "Cover 0").note = "8+ Mann an der Line of Scrimmage";
      }

      // Tactical Strengths
      const strengths = [];
      if (motion) strengths.push(`Pre-Snap ${motion.type.toUpperCase()} Motion erzwingt defensive Zonen-Verschiebungen und deckt Man vs. Zone Coverage vor dem Snap auf.`);
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Mesh")) strengths.push("Natürlicher Rub/Pick-Effekt eliminiert Man-Coverage-Verteidiger.");
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Smash")) strengths.push("High-Low-Dilemma für den Cornerback im Flat-Bereich.");
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Dagger")) strengths.push("Tiefer Seam bindet den Free Safety und isoliert den 15-Yard Dig komplett.");
      if (primaryConcept.includes("Four Verticals")) strengths.push("Mathematische Überlegenheit mit 4 Deep Threats gegen 3 Zonenverteidiger.");
      if (runPath) strengths.push("Physisches Laufkonzept zwingt Defense zur Aufgabe leichter Pass-Coverages.");
      if (strengths.length < 3) strengths.push("Klare Receiver-Progression mit schnellem Not-Checkdown.");

      // Weaknesses & Risks
      const weaknesses = [];
      if (routes.filter(r => r.type === "go" || r.type === "post" || r.type === "corner").length >= 2) {
        weaknesses.push("Lange Dropback-Entwicklungszeit (> 2.7s): Anfällig für aggressive 5-Mann Blitzes.");
      }
      if (blocking.length === 0 && !runPath) {
        weaknesses.push("Standard 5-Mann Pass Protection: Kein RB/TE Blitz Pickup vorgesehen.");
      }
      if (formInfo.numRBs === 0) {
        weaknesses.push("Empty Backfield: Keine zusätzliche Protection in der Pocket; QB muss Ball extrem schnell loswerden.");
      }
      if (weaknesses.length === 0) {
        weaknesses.push("Disziplinierte Zonen-Verteidiger können Zwischenräume zustellen.");
      }

      // Progression & Coaching Points
      let progression = "1. Pre-Snap: Safety Shell (Single-High MOFC vs Two-High MOFO) identifizieren.\n" +
        "2. Alert Read: Günstiges 1-on-1 Matchup auf der Außenseite.\n" +
        "3. Primary Read: Zentrales Konzept-Fenster im Timing werfen.\n" +
        "4. Checkdown: Ballcarrier / Flat Route bei Pass Rush Druck anvisieren.";

      if (runPath) {
        progression = "1. Pre-Snap: Anzahl der Box-Verteidiger zählen (Count the Box: <= 6 = Run!).\n" +
          "2. Mesh: Sauberer Ball-Exchange am Mesh Point zwischen QB und RB.\n" +
          "3. Read Key: First-Level DT oder Pulling Tackle Lead-Block folgen.\n" +
          "4. Burst: North-South Beschleunigung durch die erzeugte Lücke.";
      }

      return {
        formation: formInfo,
        playType,
        primaryConcept,
        conceptDesc,
        coverageMatrix: covRatings,
        strengths,
        weaknesses,
        progression
      };
    }

    console.log('PlayBuilder logic module verified successfully!');

    /* ==================== COMPLETE PLAY BUILDER ENGINE ==================== */

    // Global state for Play Builder
    let pbState = {
      activeTab: 'offense',
      currentPlay: null,
      selectedPlayerId: 'X',
      selectedSide: 'O',
      isDragging: null,
      myPlays: [],
      activePlayId: 'custom_trips_dagger'
    };

    // Storage helper
    function loadMyPlaysFromStorage() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem('nfl_my_plays');
        if (raw) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            pbState.myPlays = parsed;
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to load my plays from localStorage", e);
      }
      // Fallback to defaults
      pbState.myPlays = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PB_DEFAULT_MY_PLAYS));
      saveMyPlaysToStorage();
    }

    function saveMyPlaysToStorage() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('nfl_my_plays', JSON.stringify(pbState.myPlays));
        const badge = document.getElementById("pb-badge-play-count");
        if (badge) badge.textContent = pbState.myPlays.length;
        renderMyPlaysList();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to save my plays to localStorage", e);
      }
    }

    // Initialize Play Builder
    function initPlayBuilder() {
      if (builderEngine) return;

      const svg = document.getElementById("builder-field-svg");
      if (!svg) return;

      loadMyPlaysFromStorage();

      // Find initial play
      pbState.currentPlay = pbState.myPlays.find(p => p.id === pbState.activePlayId) || pbState.myPlays[0];

      // Instantiate FootballFieldEngine with full capabilities
      builderEngine = new FootballFieldEngine("builder-field-svg", {
        showRoutes: true,
        showZones: true,
        showRush: true,
        showLabels: true,
        showTarget: true,
        viewMode: 'tactical',
        interactive: true,
        onPlayerSelect: (p, side) => {
          selectBuilderPlayer(p.id, side);
        },
        onPhaseChange: (phase, progress) => {
          const badge = document.getElementById("pb-builder-phase-badge");
          if (badge) badge.textContent = `🏈 ${phase}`;
        },
        onTimeUpdate: (progress, phase) => {
          const sc = document.getElementById("pb-builder-scrubber");
          if (sc && !builderEngine.isScrubbing) sc.value = Math.round(progress * 100);
          const to = document.getElementById("pb-builder-time-readout");
          if (to) to.textContent = `${(progress * 3.2).toFixed(1)}s / 3.2s`;
        },
        onComplete: () => {
          const btn = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-play");
          if (btn) btn.textContent = "▶ Play";
        }
      });

      // Attach SVG Drag & Drop
      setupBuilderDragging(svg);

      // Wire Playback controls
      wireBuilderPlayback();

      // Load active play into engine
      loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(pbState.currentPlay);

      // Wire formation & defense presets
      wirePresetDropdowns();
    }

    function wireBuilderPlayback() {
      const btnPlay = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-play");
      if (btnPlay) {
        btnPlay.onclick = () => {
          if (builderEngine.animating) {
            builderEngine.pause();
            btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
          } else {
            builderEngine.playSnap();
            btnPlay.textContent = "⏸ Pause";
          }
        };
      }

      const btnPause = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-pause");
      if (btnPause) {
        btnPause.onclick = () => {
          builderEngine.pause();
          if (btnPlay) btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
        };
      }

      const btnStepBack = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-step-back");
      if (btnStepBack) {
        btnStepBack.onclick = () => {
          builderEngine.step(-0.05);
          if (btnPlay) btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
        };
      }

      const btnStepFwd = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-step-fwd");
      if (btnStepFwd) {
        btnStepFwd.onclick = () => {
          builderEngine.step(0.05);
          if (btnPlay) btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
        };
      }

      const btnReset = document.getElementById("pbuilder-btn-reset");
      if (btnReset) {
        btnReset.onclick = () => {
          builderEngine.reset();
          if (btnPlay) btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
        };
      }

      const scrubber = document.getElementById("pb-builder-scrubber");
      if (scrubber) {
        scrubber.onmousedown = () => { builderEngine.isScrubbing = true; };
        scrubber.onmouseup = () => { builderEngine.isScrubbing = false; };
        scrubber.oninput = (e) => {
          builderEngine.pause();
          if (btnPlay) btnPlay.textContent = "▶ Play";
          builderEngine.setTime(e.target.value / 100);
        };
      }

      const selSpeed = document.getElementById("pbuilder-sel-speed");
      if (selSpeed) {
        selSpeed.onchange = (e) => {
          builderEngine.setSpeed(parseFloat(e.target.value));
        };
      }

      // Top action buttons - use idempotent .onclick to prevent stacking listeners on re-render
      const btnSave = document.getElementById("pb-btn-save");
      if (btnSave) btnSave.onclick = saveActivePlay;

      const btnNew = document.getElementById("pb-btn-new");
      if (btnNew) btnNew.onclick = createNewPlay;

      const btnDup = document.getElementById("pb-btn-duplicate");
      if (btnDup) btnDup.onclick = duplicateActivePlay;

      const btnAna = document.getElementById("pb-btn-analyze");
      if (btnAna) btnAna.onclick = runPlayBuilderAnalysis;

      const btnExp = document.getElementById("pb-btn-export-modal");
      if (btnExp) btnExp.onclick = openExportModal;

      const btnTPb = document.getElementById("pb-btn-test-playbook");
      if (btnTPb) btnTPb.onclick = testPlayInPlaybook;

      const btnTFm = document.getElementById("pb-btn-test-film");
      if (btnTFm) btnTFm.onclick = testPlayInFilmRoom;
    }

    function setupBuilderDragging(svg) {
      let activePointerId = null;
      let pointerDownPos = null;

      svg.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
        const targetNode = e.target.closest(".field-player-node");
        pointerDownPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, time: Date.now() };

        if (targetNode) {
          const playerId = targetNode.getAttribute("data-player-id");
          const side = targetNode.getAttribute("data-side") || "O";
          if (!playerId) return;

          activePointerId = e.pointerId;
          try { svg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { }

          selectBuilderPlayer(playerId, side);

          const player = getPlayerObject(playerId, side);
          if (!player) return;

          pbState.isDragging = {
            playerId,
            side,
            origX: player.x,
            origY: player.y,
            hasMoved: false
          };
          svg.classList.add("dragging");
          return;
        }

        // Tap-to-Place alternative: User tapped on the field canvas while a player is selected
        if (pbState.selectedPlayerId && pbState.selectedSide) {
          const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
          pt.x = e.clientX;
          pt.y = e.clientY;
          const svgP = pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());
          placePlayerAtCoords(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide, Math.round(svgP.x), Math.round(svgP.y));
        }
      });

      svg.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        if (!pbState.isDragging) return;

        if (pointerDownPos) {
          const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - pointerDownPos.x, e.clientY - pointerDownPos.y);
          if (dist > 5) pbState.isDragging.hasMoved = true;
        }

        const pt = svg.createSVGPoint();
        pt.x = e.clientX;
        pt.y = e.clientY;
        const svgP = pt.matrixTransform(svg.getScreenCTM().inverse());

        let newX = Math.round(svgP.x);
        let newY = Math.round(svgP.y);

        // Grid snap
        const snapOn = document.getElementById("pb-chk-grid-snap")?.checked;
        if (snapOn) {
          newX = Math.round(newX / 10) * 10;
          newY = Math.round(newY / 10) * 10;
        }

        // Field boundary bounds
        newX = Math.max(60, Math.min(820, newX));
        newY = Math.max(55, Math.min(545, newY));

        // Scrimmage constraint
        if (pbState.isDragging.side === 'O') {
          newX = Math.min(350, newX);
        } else {
          newX = Math.max(350, newX);
        }

        const player = getPlayerObject(pbState.isDragging.playerId, pbState.isDragging.side);
        if (player) {
          player.x = newX;
          player.y = newY;
          reanchorPlayerPaths(player);
          builderEngine.render();
          updateInspectorCoords(player);
        }
      });

      const stopDrag = (e) => {
        if (pbState.isDragging) {
          const wasTap = !pbState.isDragging.hasMoved;
          const selectedId = pbState.isDragging.playerId;
          const selectedSide = pbState.isDragging.side;

          pbState.isDragging = null;
          svg.classList.remove("dragging");
          if (activePointerId !== null) {
            try { svg.releasePointerCapture(activePointerId); } catch (err) { }
            activePointerId = null;
          }
          regeneratePlayTracks();
          runPlayBuilderAnalysis();

          if (wasTap) {
            const banner = document.getElementById("pb-touch-helper-banner");
            if (banner) {
              banner.style.display = "flex";
              banner.innerHTML = `<span>🎯 <b>${selectedId}</b> gewählt. Tippe auf das Feld zum Platzieren oder nutze die Pfeile unten.</span><button onclick="document.getElementById('pb-touch-helper-banner').style.display='none'" style="background:none;border:none;color:#38bdf8;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;padding-left:8px;">✕</button>`;
            }
          }
        }
      };

      svg.addEventListener("pointerup", stopDrag);
      svg.addEventListener("pointercancel", stopDrag);
    }

    function placePlayerAtCoords(playerId, side, newX, newY) {
      const player = getPlayerObject(playerId, side);
      if (!player) return;

      const snapOn = document.getElementById("pb-chk-grid-snap")?.checked;
      if (snapOn) {
        newX = Math.round(newX / 10) * 10;
        newY = Math.round(newY / 10) * 10;
      }

      newX = Math.max(60, Math.min(820, newX));
      newY = Math.max(55, Math.min(545, newY));

      if (side === 'O') {
        newX = Math.min(350, newX);
      } else {
        newX = Math.max(350, newX);
      }

      player.x = newX;
      player.y = newY;
      reanchorPlayerPaths(player);
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorCoords(player);
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();

      const banner = document.getElementById("pb-touch-helper-banner");
      if (banner) {
        banner.style.display = "flex";
        banner.innerHTML = `<span>✅ <b>${playerId}</b> platziert bei (X: ${newX}, Y: ${newY}).</span><button onclick="document.getElementById('pb-touch-helper-banner').style.display='none'" style="background:none;border:none;color:#38bdf8;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;padding-left:8px;">✕</button>`;
      }
    }

    function nudgeBuilderPlayer(dx, dy) {
      if (!pbState.selectedPlayerId || !pbState.selectedSide) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Bitte tippe zuerst auf einen Spieler auf dem Feld!', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      const player = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide);
      if (!player) return;
      placePlayerAtCoords(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide, player.x + dx, player.y + dy);
    }

    function nudgeBuilderPlayerToLos() {
      if (!pbState.selectedPlayerId || !pbState.selectedSide) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') showToast('Bitte tippe zuerst auf einen Spieler auf dem Feld!', 'warning');
        return;
      }
      const player = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide);
      if (!player) return;
      const targetX = pbState.selectedSide === 'O' ? 340 : 355;
      placePlayerAtCoords(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide, targetX, player.y);
    }

    function getPlayerObject(playerId, side) {
      if (side === 'O' && builderEngine?.formation?.players) {
        return builderEngine.formation.players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
      }
      if (side === 'D' && builderEngine?.defense?.players) {
        return builderEngine.defense.players.find(p => p.id === playerId);
      }
      return null;
    }

    function reanchorPlayerPaths(player) {
      const play = pbState.currentPlay;
      if (!play) return;

      // Re-anchor route if present
      if (play.routes) {
        const r = play.routes.find(route => route.id === player.id);
        if (r) {
          const geom = computeRouteGeometry(player, r.type || "go");
          r.path = geom.path;
        }
      }

      // Re-anchor run path
      if (play.runPath && play.runPath.playerId === player.id) {
        const rgeom = computeRunConceptGeometry(player, play.runPath.type || "inside_run");
        play.runPath.path = rgeom.path;
      }

      // Re-anchor motion
      if (play.motion && play.motion.playerId === player.id) {
        const mgeom = computeMotionGeometry(player, play.motion.type || "jet");
        play.motion.start = mgeom.start;
        play.motion.end = mgeom.end;
        play.motion.path = mgeom.path;
      }

      // Re-anchor blocking
      if (play.blocking) {
        const b = play.blocking.find(block => block.id === player.id);
        if (b) {
          b.path = `M ${player.x} ${player.y} L ${player.x - 15} ${player.y}`;
        }
      }
    }

    function loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(play) {
      if (!play) return;
      pbState.currentPlay = play;
      pbState.activePlayId = play.id;

      // Sync title & input
      const titleInput = document.getElementById("pb-play-title-input");
      if (titleInput) titleInput.value = play.name || "Custom Concept";

      // Build or resolve formation object
      let formObj = null;
      if (typeof play.formation === 'object' && play.formation !== null) {
        formObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(play.formation));
      } else {
        const key = play.formation || 'shotgun_11';
        formObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DATA.formations[key] || NFL_DATA.formations.shotgun_11));
      }

      // Resolve defense object
      let defObj = null;
      const defKey = play.defenseSetup?.defenseKey || "cover_3";
      if (defKey !== 'none') {
        defObj = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DATA.defenses[defKey] || NFL_DATA.defenses.cover_3));
      }

      // Generate tracks
      regeneratePlayTracks(play, formObj, defObj);

      // Load into engine
      builderEngine.loadSetup(formObj, play, defObj);

      // Set initial selected player
      selectBuilderPlayer(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide);

      // Update UI & Analysis
      updateTagsAndBadges();
      renderRosters();
      renderMyPlaysList();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function selectBuilderPlayer(playerId, side) {
      pbState.selectedPlayerId = playerId;
      pbState.selectedSide = side;

      builderEngine.selectedPlayer = getPlayerObject(playerId, side);
      builderEngine.renderPlayers();

      // Switch palette tab if needed
      if (side === 'O' && pbState.activeTab !== 'offense' && pbState.activeTab !== 'myplays') {
        setBuilderPaletteTab('offense');
      } else if (side === 'D' && pbState.activeTab !== 'defense' && pbState.activeTab !== 'myplays') {
        setBuilderPaletteTab('defense');
      }

      updateInspectorView();
    }

    function setBuilderPaletteTab(tab) {
      pbState.activeTab = tab;
      ['offense', 'defense', 'myplays'].forEach(t => {
        const el = document.getElementById(`pb-palette-${t}`);
        const btn = document.getElementById(`pb-tab-${t}`);
        if (el) el.style.display = t === tab ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', t === tab);
      });
    }

    function updateInspectorView() {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, pbState.selectedSide);
      if (!p) return;

      if (pbState.selectedSide === 'O') {
        const j = document.getElementById("pb-insp-jersey");
        if (j) j.textContent = p.id;
        const n = document.getElementById("pb-insp-name");
        if (n) n.textContent = p.name || `Position ${p.id}`;
        updateInspectorCoords(p);

        // Highlight active route
        const currentRoute = pbState.currentPlay.routes?.find(r => r.id === p.id);
        const crText = document.getElementById("pb-insp-current-route");
        if (crText) crText.textContent = currentRoute ? (currentRoute.type || currentRoute.label) : "Keine Route";

        document.querySelectorAll(".pb-route-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.classList.toggle("active", currentRoute && btn.dataset.route === currentRoute.type?.toLowerCase());
        });

        // Run concept active
        const isRunActive = pbState.currentPlay.runPath?.playerId === p.id;
        document.querySelectorAll(".pb-concept-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.classList.toggle("active", isRunActive && btn.dataset.run === pbState.currentPlay.runPath?.type);
        });

        // Motion active
        const isMotionActive = pbState.currentPlay.motion?.playerId === p.id;
        document.querySelectorAll(".pb-motion-btn").forEach(btn => {
          btn.classList.toggle("active", isMotionActive && btn.dataset.motion === pbState.currentPlay.motion?.type);
        });

      } else {
        // Defense Inspector
        const j = document.getElementById("pb-insp-def-jersey");
        if (j) j.textContent = p.id;
        const n = document.getElementById("pb-insp-def-name");
        if (n) n.textContent = p.name || `Defender ${p.id}`;
        const c = document.getElementById("pb-insp-def-coord");
        if (c) c.textContent = `Position: x=${p.x}, y=${p.y}`;
      }
    }

    function updateInspectorCoords(p) {
      const c = document.getElementById("pb-insp-coord");
      if (c) c.textContent = `Position: x=${p.x}, y=${p.y}`;
    }

    // Assignment Handlers
    function assignRouteToSelected(routeType) {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay) return;

      if (!pbState.currentPlay.routes) pbState.currentPlay.routes = [];
      // Remove existing
      pbState.currentPlay.routes = pbState.currentPlay.routes.filter(r => r.id !== p.id);

      const geom = computeRouteGeometry(p, routeType);
      pbState.currentPlay.routes.push({
        id: p.id,
        type: routeType,
        label: geom.label,
        path: geom.path
      });

      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function removeRouteFromSelected() {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay || !pbState.currentPlay.routes) return;
      pbState.currentPlay.routes = pbState.currentPlay.routes.filter(r => r.id !== p.id);
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function assignRunConceptToSelected(runType) {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay) return;

      const geom = computeRunConceptGeometry(p, runType);
      pbState.currentPlay.runPath = {
        playerId: p.id,
        type: runType,
        label: geom.label,
        path: geom.path
      };

      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function removeRunFromSelected() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;
      pbState.currentPlay.runPath = null;
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function assignMotionToSelected(motionType) {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay) return;

      const geom = computeMotionGeometry(p, motionType);
      pbState.currentPlay.motion = {
        playerId: p.id,
        type: motionType,
        start: geom.start,
        end: geom.end,
        path: geom.path,
        timing: 'pre_snap'
      };

      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function removeMotionFromSelected() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;
      pbState.currentPlay.motion = null;
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function assignBlockingToSelected(blockType) {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay) return;

      if (!pbState.currentPlay.blocking) pbState.currentPlay.blocking = [];
      pbState.currentPlay.blocking = pbState.currentPlay.blocking.filter(b => b.id !== p.id);

      let bpath = `M ${p.x} ${p.y} L ${p.x - 15} ${p.y}`;
      let blabel = blockType.toUpperCase();
      if (blockType === "kickout_pull") {
        bpath = `M ${p.x} ${p.y} L ${p.x - 20} ${p.y} L ${p.x - 20} 390 L 375 390`;
        blabel = "Kickout";
      } else if (blockType === "lead_pull") {
        bpath = `M ${p.x} ${p.y} L ${p.x - 25} ${p.y} L ${p.x - 25} 360 L 415 360`;
        blabel = "Lead Pull";
      } else if (blockType === "drive_block") {
        bpath = `M ${p.x} ${p.y} L ${p.x + 25} ${p.y}`;
        blabel = "Drive";
      }

      pbState.currentPlay.blocking.push({
        id: p.id,
        type: blockType,
        label: blabel,
        path: bpath
      });

      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function removeBlockingFromSelected() {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'O');
      if (!p || !pbState.currentPlay || !pbState.currentPlay.blocking) return;
      pbState.currentPlay.blocking = pbState.currentPlay.blocking.filter(b => b.id !== p.id);
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function assignDefAssignmentToSelected(type) {
      const p = getPlayerObject(pbState.selectedPlayerId, 'D');
      if (!p || !builderEngine.defense) return;

      p.role = type;
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      updateInspectorView();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    // Track Generation for Fluid Simulation
    function regeneratePlayTracks(play, formation, defense) {
      play = play || pbState.currentPlay;
      formation = formation || builderEngine?.formation;
      defense = defense || builderEngine?.defense;
      if (!play || !formation) return;

      play.tracks = {};

      // 1. Offense Tracks
      formation.players.forEach(p => {
        // Check motion
        let hasMotion = play.motion && play.motion.playerId === p.id;
        let motionGeom = hasMotion ? computeMotionGeometry(p, play.motion.type) : null;

        // Check route
        let route = play.routes?.find(r => r.id === p.id);
        let routeGeom = route ? computeRouteGeometry(p, route.type) : null;

        // Check run
        let isRun = play.runPath && play.runPath.playerId === p.id;
        let runGeom = isRun ? computeRunConceptGeometry(p, play.runPath.type) : null;

        if (hasMotion) {
          const snapX = motionGeom.end.x;
          const snapY = motionGeom.end.y;
          play.tracks[p.id] = [
            ...motionGeom.track,
            { t: 0.50, x: snapX + 60, y: snapY, action: "Post-Motion Burst" },
            { t: 0.80, x: snapX + 160, y: snapY, action: "Open Window" },
            { t: 1.0, x: snapX + 240, y: snapY, action: "YAC" }
          ];
        } else if (routeGeom) {
          play.tracks[p.id] = routeGeom.track;
        } else if (runGeom) {
          play.tracks[p.id] = runGeom.track;
        } else if (p.id === "QB") {
          play.tracks[p.id] = [
            { t: 0, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
            { t: 0.20, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Snap" },
            { t: 0.50, x: p.x - 15, y: p.y, action: "3-Step Drop" },
            { t: 0.80, x: p.x - 10, y: p.y, action: "Set Feet & Throw" },
            { t: 1.0, x: p.x - 5, y: p.y, action: "Follow Through" }
          ];
        } else if (p.id.startsWith("L") || p.id.startsWith("R") || p.id === "C") {
          // Check if pulling
          const blk = play.blocking?.find(b => b.id === p.id);
          if (blk && blk.type === "kickout_pull") {
            play.tracks[p.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Snap" },
              { t: 0.50, x: p.x - 20, y: 320, action: "Pull behind Center" },
              { t: 0.80, x: 370, y: 380, action: "Kickout Edge" },
              { t: 1.0, x: 380, y: 395, action: "Seal Block" }
            ];
          } else if (blk && blk.type === "lead_pull") {
            play.tracks[p.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Snap" },
              { t: 0.55, x: p.x - 25, y: 320, action: "Wrap around Guard" },
              { t: 0.80, x: 410, y: 360, action: "Lead into Hole" },
              { t: 1.0, x: 430, y: 365, action: "Pancake Block" }
            ];
          } else {
            // Standard pass pro / drive
            play.tracks[p.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: p.x, y: p.y, action: "Snap" },
              { t: 0.55, x: p.x - 8, y: p.y, action: "Strike Rusher" },
              { t: 1.0, x: p.x - 5, y: p.y, action: "Anchor Pocket" }
            ];
          }
        }
      });

      // 2. Defense Tracks
      if (defense && defense.players) {
        defense.tracks = {};
        defense.players.forEach(dp => {
          const role = (dp.role || "").toLowerCase();
          if (role.includes("rush") || role.includes("blitz")) {
            defense.tracks[dp.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Get-Off" },
              { t: 0.65, x: 310, y: 300, action: "Pressure Pocket" },
              { t: 1.0, x: 275, y: 300, action: "Sack Rush" }
            ];
          } else if (role.includes("deep") || role.includes("third") || role.includes("half") || role.includes("quarter")) {
            defense.tracks[dp.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Read QB" },
              { t: 0.65, x: dp.x + 50, y: dp.y, action: "Zone Drop" },
              { t: 1.0, x: dp.x + 80, y: dp.y, action: "Break on Ball" }
            ];
          } else if (role.includes("man")) {
            // Shadow nearest receiver
            defense.tracks[dp.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Press Stance" },
              { t: 0.25, x: dp.x + 10, y: dp.y, action: "Mirror Release" },
              { t: 0.65, x: dp.x + 90, y: dp.y, action: "Trail Technique" },
              { t: 1.0, x: dp.x + 180, y: dp.y, action: "Contest Catch" }
            ];
          } else {
            // Underneath hook / curl
            defense.tracks[dp.id] = [
              { t: 0, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Pre-Snap" },
              { t: 0.20, x: dp.x, y: dp.y, action: "Read Mesh" },
              { t: 0.60, x: dp.x + 20, y: dp.y, action: "Sink into Hook" },
              { t: 1.0, x: dp.x + 35, y: dp.y, action: "Tackle" }
            ];
          }
        });
      }
    }

    // Preset Handlers
    function wirePresetDropdowns() {
      const btnForm = document.getElementById("pb-btn-apply-formation");
      if (btnForm) {
        btnForm.onclick = () => {
          const val = document.getElementById("pb-sel-formation").value;
          applyFormationPreset(val);
        };
      }

      const btnDef = document.getElementById("pb-btn-apply-defense");
      if (btnDef) {
        btnDef.onclick = () => {
          const val = document.getElementById("pb-sel-defense").value;
          applyDefensePreset(val);
        };
      }
    }

    function applyFormationPreset(key) {
      if (key === "custom_blank") {
        builderEngine.formation = {
          name: "Custom Blank Canvas",
          players: [
            { id: "C", name: "Center", x: 350, y: 300, side: "O" },
            { id: "QB", name: "Quarterback", x: 285, y: 300, side: "O" },
            { id: "RB", name: "Running Back", x: 285, y: 340, side: "O" },
            { id: "LT", name: "Left Tackle", x: 350, y: 240, side: "O" },
            { id: "LG", name: "Left Guard", x: 350, y: 270, side: "O" },
            { id: "RG", name: "Right Guard", x: 350, y: 330, side: "O" },
            { id: "RT", name: "Right Tackle", x: 350, y: 360, side: "O" },
            { id: "TE", name: "Tight End", x: 350, y: 390, side: "O" },
            { id: "X", name: "Wide Receiver (X)", x: 350, y: 100, side: "O" },
            { id: "Z", name: "Wide Receiver (Z)", x: 350, y: 500, side: "O" },
            { id: "H", name: "Slot Receiver (H)", x: 345, y: 180, side: "O" }
          ]
        };
      } else {
        builderEngine.formation = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DATA.formations[key] || NFL_DATA.formations.shotgun_11));
      }

      pbState.currentPlay.formation = builderEngine.formation;
      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      renderRosters();
      updateTagsAndBadges();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    function applyDefensePreset(key) {
      if (key === "none") {
        builderEngine.defense = null;
        pbState.currentPlay.defenseSetup = { defenseKey: "none" };
      } else {
        builderEngine.defense = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DATA.defenses[key] || NFL_DATA.defenses.cover_3));
        pbState.currentPlay.defenseSetup = { defenseKey: key };
      }

      regeneratePlayTracks();
      builderEngine.render();
      renderRosters();
      runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
    }

    // Live Tactical Analysis Execution & UI Rendering
    function runPlayBuilderAnalysis() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay || !builderEngine) return;

      const analysis = analyzePlayArchitecture(pbState.currentPlay, builderEngine.formation, builderEngine.defense);

      // Update UI Cards
      const fn = document.getElementById("pb-an-formation-name");
      if (fn) fn.textContent = analysis.formation.name;

      const pd = document.getElementById("pb-an-personnel-desc");
      if (pd) pd.textContent = analysis.formation.personnel;

      const cn = document.getElementById("pb-an-concept-name");
      if (cn) cn.textContent = analysis.primaryConcept;

      const cd = document.getElementById("pb-an-concept-desc");
      if (cd) cd.textContent = analysis.conceptDesc;

      // Render Coverage Matrix
      const mat = document.getElementById("pb-an-coverage-matrix");
      if (mat) {
        mat.innerHTML = analysis.coverageMatrix.map(c => `
      <div class="pb-cov-row">
        <span class="pb-cov-name">${c.name}</span>
        <div class="pb-cov-bar-track">
          <div class="pb-cov-bar-fill ${c.score >= 80 ? 'high' : c.score >= 65 ? 'mid' : 'low'}" style="width: ${c.score}%;"></div>
        </div>
        <span class="pb-cov-rating" style="color: ${c.score >= 80 ? '#22c55e' : c.score >= 65 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444'};">
          ${c.score}%
        </span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--mut); margin-left: 73px; margin-top: -3px; margin-bottom: 3px;">
        ${c.note}
      </div>
    `).join('');
      }

      // Render Strengths
      const sl = document.getElementById("pb-an-strengths-list");
      if (sl) {
        sl.innerHTML = analysis.strengths.map(s => `
      <li class="pb-callout-item strength">
        <span>✔</span> <span>${s}</span>
      </li>
    `).join('');
      }

      // Render Weaknesses
      const wl = document.getElementById("pb-an-weaknesses-list");
      if (wl) {
        wl.innerHTML = analysis.weaknesses.map(w => `
      <li class="pb-callout-item weakness">
        <span>⚠</span> <span>${w}</span>
      </li>
    `).join('');
      }

      // Progression
      const pr = document.getElementById("pb-an-progression-desc");
      if (pr) pr.textContent = analysis.progression;

      // Header badges update
      updateTagsAndBadges(analysis);

      // Optional Madden layer update
      if (typeof renderPlayBuilderMaddenDossier === 'function') {
        renderPlayBuilderMaddenDossier(pbState.currentPlay, analysis.primaryConcept);
      }
    }

    function updateTagsAndBadges(analysis) {
      const p = pbState.currentPlay;
      if (!p) return;

      const pillType = document.getElementById("pb-pill-type");
      if (pillType) {
        const isRun = p.runPath || p.category === "run";
        pillType.textContent = isRun ? "RUN SCHEME" : "PASS PLAY";
        pillType.className = `pb-tag-pill ${isRun ? 'run' : 'pass'}`;
      }

      const pillPers = document.getElementById("pb-pill-personnel");
      if (pillPers && analysis) {
        pillPers.textContent = analysis.formation.personnelCode.toUpperCase();
      }

      const pillForm = document.getElementById("pb-pill-formation");
      if (pillForm && analysis) {
        pillForm.textContent = analysis.formation.name.split('(')[0].trim().toUpperCase();
      }

      const pillConcept = document.getElementById("pb-pill-concept");
      if (pillConcept && analysis) {
        pillConcept.textContent = analysis.primaryConcept.toUpperCase();
      }
    }

    // Roster lists rendering
    function renderRosters() {
      const offList = document.getElementById("pb-offense-roster-list");
      if (offList && builderEngine.formation?.players) {
        offList.innerHTML = builderEngine.formation.players.map(p => {
          const isSel = pbState.selectedSide === 'O' && pbState.selectedPlayerId === p.id;
          const route = pbState.currentPlay.routes?.find(r => r.id === p.id);
          const isRun = pbState.currentPlay.runPath?.playerId === p.id;
          const isMotion = pbState.currentPlay.motion?.playerId === p.id;
          const blk = pbState.currentPlay.blocking?.find(b => b.id === p.id);

          let tag = "Alignment";
          if (route) tag = `Route: ${route.type}`;
          else if (isRun) tag = "Ballcarrier";
          else if (blk) tag = `Block: ${blk.label}`;
          if (isMotion) tag += " (Motion)";

          return `
        <div class="pb-roster-item ${isSel ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectBuilderPlayer('${p.id}', 'O')">
          <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
            <span style="font-weight:900; color:var(--y);">${p.id}</span>
            <span style="color:var(--ink);">${p.name || ''}</span>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size:10px; color:var(--mut);">${tag}</span>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      }

      const defList = document.getElementById("pb-defense-roster-list");
      if (defList && builderEngine.defense?.players) {
        defList.innerHTML = builderEngine.defense.players.map(dp => {
          const isSel = pbState.selectedSide === 'D' && pbState.selectedPlayerId === dp.id;
          return `
        <div class="pb-roster-item ${isSel ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectBuilderPlayer('${dp.id}', 'D')">
          <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
            <span style="font-weight:900; color:var(--accent-crimson);">${dp.id}</span>
            <span style="color:var(--ink);">${dp.name || ''}</span>
          </div>
          <span style="font-size:10px; color:var(--mut);">${dp.role || 'Defender'}</span>
        </div>
      `;
        }).join('');
      }
    }

    // "My Plays" Library Management
    function renderMyPlaysList(filterQuery = "") {
      const container = document.getElementById("pb-myplays-list");
      if (!container) return;

      const query = (filterQuery || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      const plays = pbState.myPlays.filter(p => {
        if (!query) return true;
        return (p.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(query) || (p.summary || "").toLowerCase().includes(query);
      });

      if (plays.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cmd-empty-state" style="padding:22px 14px; margin:4px 0;">
        <div class="cmd-empty-icon" style="font-size:24px;">⚡</div>
        <div class="cmd-empty-title" style="font-size:13px;">Keine Plays gefunden</div>
        <div class="cmd-empty-desc" style="font-size:11.5px;">Erstelle eigene Schemes oder nutze die Presets oben, um Spielzüge in deiner Bibliothek abzulegen.</div>
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = plays.map(p => {
        const isAct = p.id === pbState.activePlayId;
        return `
      <div class="pb-play-card ${isAct ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="loadPlayById('${p.id}')">
        <div class="pb-play-card-top">
          <span class="pb-tag-pill ${p.category === 'run' ? 'run' : 'pass'}">${(p.category || 'PLAY').toUpperCase()}</span>
          <span style="font-size:10px; color:var(--mut);">${p.personnel?.split('(')[0] || '11 Pers.'}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="pb-play-card-title">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="pb-play-card-desc">${(p.summary || p.tacticalGoal || '').substring(0, 75)}...</div>
        <div class="pb-play-card-actions" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
          <button class="pb-action-btn" style="padding:3px 7px; font-size:10.5px;" onclick="duplicatePlayById('${p.id}')" title="Play duplizieren">
            📋 Kopieren
          </button>
          <button class="pb-action-btn danger" style="padding:3px 7px; font-size:10.5px;" onclick="deletePlayById('${p.id}')" title="Play löschen">
            🗑️ Löschen
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function filterMyPlays(query) {
      renderMyPlaysList(query);
    }

    function loadPlayById(id) {
      const found = pbState.myPlays.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (found) {
        loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(found);
      }
    }

    function onPlayTitleChange(newName) {
      if (pbState.currentPlay) {
        pbState.currentPlay.name = newName || "Custom Concept";
        saveMyPlaysToStorage();
      }
    }

    function saveActivePlay() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;
      const title = document.getElementById("pb-play-title-input")?.value || pbState.currentPlay.name;
      pbState.currentPlay.name = title;

      // Ensure play is saved in myPlays list
      const idx = pbState.myPlays.findIndex(p => p.id === pbState.currentPlay.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        pbState.myPlays[idx] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pbState.currentPlay));
      } else {
        pbState.myPlays.unshift(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pbState.currentPlay)));
      }

      saveMyPlaysToStorage();
      alert("Play erfolgreich in 'Meine Plays' gespeichert!");
    }

    function createNewPlay() {
      const newId = `custom_play_${Date.now()}`;
      const blankPlay = {
        id: newId,
        name: "Neues Taktik-Play",
        category: "pass",
        side: "O",
        formation: "shotgun_11",
        personnel: "11 Personnel (1 RB, 1 TE, 3 WR)",
        summary: "Eigenes neu entworfenes NFL-Konzept.",
        tacticalGoal: "Horizontale und vertikale Zonen-Dehnung.",
        reads: "1. Pre-Snap -> 2. Primary Read -> 3. Checkdown.",
        targetWindow: { x: 450, y: 300, rx: 40, ry: 30 },
        routes: [
          { id: "X", path: "M 350 100 L 480 100", type: "Go", label: "Streak" },
          { id: "Z", path: "M 350 500 L 480 500", type: "Go", label: "Streak" },
          { id: "H", path: "M 345 180 L 410 240 L 410 360", type: "In", label: "Crosser" }
        ],
        blocking: [],
        defenseSetup: { defenseKey: "cover_3" },
        tracks: {}
      };

      pbState.myPlays.unshift(blankPlay);
      saveMyPlaysToStorage();
      loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(blankPlay);
    }

    function duplicateActivePlay() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;
      duplicatePlayById(pbState.currentPlay.id);
    }

    function duplicatePlayById(id) {
      const orig = pbState.myPlays.find(p => p.id === id);
      if (!orig) return;

      const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(orig));
      copy.id = `custom_play_${Date.now()}`;
      copy.name = `${orig.name} (Kopie)`;
      pbState.myPlays.unshift(copy);
      saveMyPlaysToStorage();
      loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(copy);
    }

    function deletePlayById(id) {
      if (pbState.myPlays.length <= 1) {
        alert("Mindestens ein Play muss in der Bibliothek verbleiben.");
        return;
      }
      if (!confirm("Möchtest du dieses Play wirklich löschen?")) return;

      pbState.myPlays = pbState.myPlays.filter(p => p.id !== id);
      saveMyPlaysToStorage();

      if (pbState.currentPlay.id === id) {
        loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(pbState.myPlays[0]);
      }
    }

    // Export / Import
    function openExportModal() {
      const m = document.getElementById("pb-modal-export");
      const area = document.getElementById("pb-export-json-area");
      if (!m || !area) return;

      area.value = JSON.stringify(pbState.currentPlay, null, 2);
      m.style.display = "flex";
    }

    function closeExportModal() {
      const m = document.getElementById("pb-modal-export");
      if (m) m.style.display = "none";
    }

    function copyExportJson() {
      const area = document.getElementById("pb-export-json-area");
      if (area) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(area.value);
        alert("JSON in die Zwischenablage kopiert!");
      }
    }

    function downloadPlayJson() {
      const p = pbState.currentPlay;
      if (!p) return;
      const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(p, null, 2);
      const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: "application/json" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${p.id || 'nfl_play'}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }

    function importPlayFromJson() {
      const area = document.getElementById("pb-export-json-area");
      if (!area) return;
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(area.value);
        if (!parsed.id) parsed.id = `imported_play_${Date.now()}`;
        if (!parsed.name) parsed.name = "Importiertes Play";

        pbState.myPlays.unshift(parsed);
        saveMyPlaysToStorage();
        loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(parsed);
        closeExportModal();
        alert("Play erfolgreich importiert!");
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Ungültiges JSON-Format. Bitte überprüfe die Daten.");
      }
    }

    // Integration into Playbook Simulator
    function testPlayInPlaybook() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;
      // Register in global NFL_DATA.plays
      NFL_DATA.plays[pbState.currentPlay.id] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pbState.currentPlay));

      setView('playbook');
      selectPlaybookItem(pbState.currentPlay.id, 'O');
    }

    // Integration into Film Room Scenarios
    function testPlayInFilmRoom() {
      if (!pbState.currentPlay) return;

      const play = pbState.currentPlay;
      const scenarioId = `film_scenario_${play.id}`;

      // Build Film Room Scenario
      const newScenario = {
        id: scenarioId,
        title: `Film Room Breakdown: ${play.name}`,
        category: play.category === 'run' ? "Laufspiel & Fronts" : "Pass-Konzepte & Coverages",
        difficulty: "Fortgeschritten",
        summary: play.summary || "All-22 Film Room Szenario für das neu erstellte Play.",
        downAndDistance: "2nd & 6 an der gegnerischen 38-Yard-Linie",
        gameSituation: "4. Viertel, 02:45 verbleibend | Score: 21 - 24 Rückstand",
        all22Focus: "Beobachte das Timing der Routen-Breaks und die Reaktion der Defensiv-Backs.",
        preset: {
          form: typeof play.formation === 'string' ? play.formation : "shotgun_11",
          play: play.id,
          def: play.defenseSetup?.defenseKey || "cover_3"
        },
        preSnapQuestions: [
          {
            id: `q_${play.id}_presnap`,
            category: "preSnapReadScore",
            prompt: `Welche primäre Deckungs-Struktur zeigt die Defense gegen das Play '${play.name}'?`,
            options: [
              {
                id: "a",
                text: "Zonendeckung mit tiefer Absicherung gegen Nahtstellen und Deep Shots.",
                isCorrect: true,
                coachingFeedback: "Hervorragend erkannt! Die Defense steht mit Zone Eyes ausgerichtet, um Crossing Drags und Seams vor sich zu halten."
              },
              {
                id: "b",
                text: "All-Out Man Blitz ohne Absicherung.",
                isCorrect: false,
                coachingFeedback: "Die Safeties sichern die Tiefe ab; es handelt sich um keinen All-Out Blitz."
              }
            ]
          }
        ],
        postSnapQuestions: [
          {
            id: `q_${play.id}_post`,
            category: "playIntentScore",
            prompt: `Was war der taktische Schlüssel für den Raumgewinn in diesem Spielzug?`,
            options: [
              {
                id: "a",
                text: "Exaktes Timing beim Routen-Cut direkt in das offene Target Window.",
                isCorrect: true,
                coachingFeedback: "Perfekt! Genau so wurde das Play im Play Builder konzipiert: Der Receiver nutzt den Leverage-Vorteil für den freien Catch."
              },
              {
                id: "b",
                text: "Zufälliger Scramble des Quarterbacks.",
                isCorrect: false,
                coachingFeedback: "Das Play folgte der exakt eingezeichneten Progression und dem vorgegebenen Timing."
              }
            ]
          }
        ],
        coachDebrief: {
          summary: `Erfolgreiche Exekution von ${play.name}. Die im Play Builder konfigurierte Route streckte die Defense wie berechnet.`,
          keyTakeaway: "Diszipliniertes Routen-Timing und korrekte Protection schaffen verlässliche Passfenster."
        }
      };

      // Register play & scenario
      NFL_DATA.plays[play.id] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(play));
      if (!NFL_DATA.filmScenarios) NFL_DATA.filmScenarios = [];
      const existingIdx = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.findIndex(s => s.id === scenarioId);
      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        NFL_DATA.filmScenarios[existingIdx] = newScenario;
      } else {
        NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.unshift(newScenario);
      }

      setView('film');
      if (typeof selectFilmScenario === 'function') {
        selectFilmScenario(scenarioId);
      }
    }

    // Layer visibility toggles
    function toggleBuilderLayer(layer, isVisible) {
      if (!builderEngine) return;
      if (layer === "routes") builderEngine.options.showRoutes = isVisible;
      if (layer === "blocking") builderEngine.options.showBlocking = isVisible;
      if (layer === "motion") builderEngine.options.showMotion = isVisible;
      if (layer === "zones") builderEngine.options.showZones = isVisible;
      if (layer === "rush") builderEngine.options.showRush = isVisible;
      builderEngine.render();
    }

    console.log('Complete PlayBuilder engine ready!');


    function renderPlayBuilder() {
      if (!builderEngine) {
        initPlayBuilder();
      } else {
        builderEngine.render();
        runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
      }
    }
