    // Extensible Data Adapter Architecture for Live External APIs
    class StatsDataAdapter {
      constructor(sourceName = "demo_reference_model") {
        this.sourceName = sourceName;
        this.isLive = false;
      }

      async fetchMetricData(metricId) {
        // In future: hook up real endpoints (e.g. nflverse, ESPN, Next Gen Stats)
        const metric = NFL_ADVANCED_METRICS.find(m => m.id === metricId);
        return {
          source: this.sourceName,
          isDemo: true,
          disclaimer: NFL_STATS_DISCLAIMER,
          data: metric
        };
      }

      getAllMetrics() {
        return NFL_ADVANCED_METRICS;
      }
    }

    const statsAdapter = new StatsDataAdapter();

    /* ==================== STATS LAB JAVASCRIPT LOGIC & VISUALIZER ==================== */

    let slState = {
      activeMetricId: "epa",
      activeCategory: "all",
      activeChart: "matrix",
      searchQuery: ""
    };

    function initStatsLab() {
      renderStatsCatalog();
      selectStatsMetric(slState.activeMetricId);
      renderActiveStatsChart();
    }

    function renderStatsLab() {
      renderStatsCatalog();
      selectStatsMetric(slState.activeMetricId);
      renderActiveStatsChart();
    }

    function filterStatsByCategory(cat) {
      slState.activeCategory = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll("#sl-category-chips .sl-chip").forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.cat === cat);
      });
      renderStatsCatalog();
    }

    function onStatsSearch(query) {
      slState.searchQuery = (query || "").toLowerCase().trim();
      renderStatsCatalog();
    }

    function renderStatsCatalog() {
      const container = document.getElementById("sl-catalog-list");
      if (!container) return;

      let metrics = statsAdapter.getAllMetrics();

      // Category filter
      if (slState.activeCategory !== "all") {
        metrics = metrics.filter(m => m.category === slState.activeCategory);
      }

      // Search filter
      if (slState.searchQuery) {
        metrics = metrics.filter(m => {
          const haystack = `${m.name} ${m.shortCode} ${m.headline} ${m.category}`.toLowerCase();
          return haystack.includes(slState.searchQuery);
        });
      }

      if (metrics.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
      <div style="padding: 20px; text-align: center; color: var(--mut); font-size: 12.5px; border: 1px dashed var(--ln); border-radius: var(--radius-md);">
        Keine Metriken für diese Filter gefunden.
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      container.innerHTML = metrics.map(m => {
        const isActive = m.id === slState.activeMetricId;
        return `
      <div class="sl-catalog-card ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectStatsMetric('${m.id}')">
        <div class="sl-card-header">
          <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
            <span>${m.icon}</span>
            <span class="sl-metric-code">${m.shortCode}</span>
          </div>
          <span class="sl-tag-pill ${m.category}">${m.category.toUpperCase()}</span>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink);">${m.name}</div>
        <div class="sl-card-desc">${m.headline}</div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    function selectStatsMetric(id) {
      slState.activeMetricId = id;
      const metric = NFL_ADVANCED_METRICS.find(m => m.id === id) || NFL_ADVANCED_METRICS[0];

      // Highlight in catalog list
      document.querySelectorAll(".sl-catalog-card").forEach(c => c.classList.remove("active"));

      // Update Hero box
      const iconEl = document.getElementById("sl-hero-icon");
      if (iconEl) iconEl.textContent = metric.icon;

      const tagEl = document.getElementById("sl-hero-tag");
      if (tagEl) {
        tagEl.textContent = `${metric.category.toUpperCase()} METRIK`;
        tagEl.className = `sl-tag-pill ${metric.category}`;
      }

      const titleEl = document.getElementById("sl-hero-title");
      if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = metric.name;

      const headEl = document.getElementById("sl-hero-headline");
      if (headEl) headEl.textContent = metric.headline;

      // Update 5 Pillars
      const setEl = (sel, text) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(sel);
        if (el) el.textContent = text || "";
      };

      setEl("sl-pillar-measure", metric.whatItMeasures);
      setEl("sl-pillar-why", metric.whyItMatters);
      setEl("sl-pillar-formula", metric.formula);
      setEl("sl-pillar-calc-desc", "Formel & mathematische Modellierung zur statistischen Normalisierung.");
      setEl("sl-pillar-when", metric.whenUseful);
      setEl("sl-pillar-limits", metric.limitations);

      // Cross-module link to Playbook
      if (typeof getLinkedPlayForStatMetric === 'function') {
        const linked = getLinkedPlayForStatMetric(metric.id);
        const crossDesc = document.getElementById("sl-crosslink-desc");
        if (crossDesc) crossDesc.innerHTML = "<strong>" + linked.name + ":</strong> " + linked.desc;
        const crossBtn = document.getElementById("sl-crosslink-btn");
        if (crossBtn) {
          crossBtn.onclick = () => {
            openPlaybookWithConcept(linked.playId);
            showToast("📖 Playbook geöffnet: " + linked.name, "info");
          };
        }
      }

      // Update Benchmarks
      if (metric.benchmarks) {
        setEl("sl-tier-elite", metric.benchmarks.elite);
        setEl("sl-tier-above", metric.benchmarks.aboveAverage);
        setEl("sl-tier-avg", metric.benchmarks.average);
        setEl("sl-tier-poor", metric.benchmarks.belowAverage);
      }

      // Update Situational Splits Table
      const tableBody = document.getElementById("sl-splits-table-body");
      if (tableBody && metric.situationalSplits) {
        tableBody.innerHTML = metric.situationalSplits.map(s => `
      <tr>
        <td style="font-weight:700;">${s.situation}</td>
        <td style="color:var(--y); font-weight:800; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;">${s.demoVal}</td>
        <td style="color:var(--mut); font-family:monospace;">${s.leagueAvg}</td>
        <td>
          <span style="background:rgba(34,197,94,0.14); color:#4ade80; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.3);">
            ${s.evaluation}
          </span>
        </td>
      </tr>
    `).join('');
      }

      // Update Tactical Playbook Bridge
      const bridgeText = document.getElementById("sl-bridge-text");
      if (bridgeText) {
        bridgeText.textContent = metric.tacticalPlaybookTieIn || "Direkte Verbindung zu Play-Design und Scheme-Execution.";
      }

      // Auto-switch chart to contextually relevant chart if applicable
      if (metric.category === "passing" && id === "cpoe") {
        switchStatsChart("cpoe", false);
      } else if (metric.category === "rush") {
        switchStatsChart("havoc", false);
      } else if (id === "any_a" || id === "passer_rating_qbr") {
        switchStatsChart("radar", false);
      } else if (id === "epa" || id === "success_rate") {
        switchStatsChart("matrix", false);
      }
    }

    // Chart Switching and Rendering
    function switchStatsChart(chartType, forceRender = true) {
      slState.activeChart = chartType;

      const buttons = [
        { id: "sl-chart-tab-matrix", key: "matrix" },
        { id: "sl-chart-tab-cpoe", key: "cpoe" },
        { id: "sl-chart-tab-havoc", key: "havoc" },
        { id: "sl-chart-tab-radar", key: "radar" }
      ];

      buttons.forEach(b => {
        const el = document.getElementById(b.id);
        if (el) el.classList.toggle("active", b.key === chartType);
      });

      if (forceRender) {
        renderActiveStatsChart();
      }
    }

    function renderActiveStatsChart() {
      const svg = document.getElementById("stats-chart-svg");
      const caption = document.getElementById("sl-chart-caption");
      if (!svg) return;

      switch (slState.activeChart) {
        case "matrix":
          renderMatrixChart(svg, caption);
          break;
        case "cpoe":
          renderCpoeChart(svg, caption);
          break;
        case "havoc":
          renderHavocChart(svg, caption);
          break;
        case "radar":
          renderRadarComparisonChart(svg, caption);
          break;
      }
    }

    // 1. Matrix Chart: EPA/Play vs. Success Rate (4 Quadrants)
    function renderMatrixChart(svg, caption) {
      if (caption) {
        caption.textContent = "EPA/Play (Vertikal) vs. Success Rate (Horizontal) | Quadrant 1 (Oben-Rechts): Meisterschafts-Level | Demo-Modellierung";
      }

      svg.innerHTML = `
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="q1-grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.22)"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.04)"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <filter id="sl-glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
        <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!-- Background Grid -->
    <rect x="60" y="30" width="700" height="280" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.02)" stroke="var(--ln)" stroke-width="1.5" rx="6"/>
    
    <!-- Quadrant 1 Highlight: Elite -->
    <rect x="410" y="30" width="350" height="140" fill="url(#q1-grad)"/>

    <!-- Center Axes (League Averages: SR = 46.5%, EPA = +0.05) -->
    <line x1="410" y1="30" x2="410" y2="310" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>

    // ------------------ ENRICH NFL_DATA (ZERO REDUNDANCY) ------------------
    function enrichNflDataWithMadden() {
      if (typeof NFL_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      // 1. Enrich Plays
      if (NFL_DATA.plays) {
        Object.keys(NFL_DATA.plays).forEach(id => {
          if (MADDEN_TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE[id]) {
            NFL_DATA.plays[id].madden = MADDEN_TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE[id];
          }
        });
      }

      // 2. Enrich Defenses
      if (NFL_DATA.defenses) {
        Object.keys(NFL_DATA.defenses).forEach(id => {
          if (MADDEN_TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE[id]) {
            NFL_DATA.defenses[id].madden = MADDEN_TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE[id];
          }
        });
      }

      // 3. Enrich Formations with Madden Meta
      const FORMATION_MADDEN_TIPS = {
        shotgun_11: {
          maddenUsage: "Standard-Formation aller Madden-Playbooks. Exzellent für Quick Passing und RPOs.",
          personnelTip: "11 Personnel zwingt die Defense in Nickel (5 DBs). Bestrafe 'Light Boxes' mit Inside Zone!",
          beginnerMistake: "Zu berechenbar passen: Wenn du in Shotgun nur wirfst, stellt der Gegner Pass Rush Aggressive ein."
        },
        shotgun_trips_11: {
          maddenUsage: "Beliebteste E-Sport-Turnierformation. Zieht gegnerische Safeties zur 3-Receiver-Seite.",
          personnelTip: "Nutze den isolierten X-Receiver für 1-on-1 Man-Beater (Curls, Drags, Slants).",
          beginnerMistake: "Die Trips-Seite blind überwerfen und den abdriftenden Free Safety übersehen."
        },
        shotgun_bunch_11: {
          maddenUsage: "Die stärkste Formation in Madden seit über einem Jahrzehnt. Kompakte Receiver verhindern Jamming.",
          personnelTip: "Generiert freie Crossing-Routen gegen Press-Man-to-Man Coverage.",
          beginnerMistake: "Schutz bei Heavy Blitzes vernachlässigen: Bunch hat oft nur 5 Blocker an der Line."
        },
        singleback_12: {
          maddenUsage: "Zwei Tight Ends geben überlegenes Run-Blocking. Zwingt Defense in Base 4-3 oder 3-4.",
          personnelTip: "12 Personnel schafft physische Mismatches gegen Nickel-Defenses.",
          beginnerMistake: "Zu berechenbar laufen: Nutze Play Action Bootleg, wenn der Gegner auf den Lauf spekuliert."
        },
        under_center_12: {
          maddenUsage: "Play Action schlägt hier am stärksten zu, da KI-Linebacker deutlicher auf den Fake anbeißen.",
          personnelTip: "Klassisches Shanahan/McVay Outside Zone + Bootleg Scheme.",
          beginnerMistake: "Gegen All-Out Cover 0 Blitzes Under Center bleiben – Pocket kollabiert schneller als in Shotgun."
        },
        i_formation_21: {
          maddenUsage: "Old-School Power Football. Fullback führt den Weg für Goal-Line und Short Yardage.",
          personnelTip: "21 Personnel: Fullback blockt den gegnerischen Mike-Linebacker im A-Gap frei.",
          beginnerMistake: "Auf 3rd & Long in I-Form bleiben: Zu wenige Pass-Routen für intermediate Raumgewinn."
        },
        empty_10: {
          maddenUsage: "5 Wide Receiver, kein Running Back im Backfield. Maximale Pass-Optionen und Spread.",
          personnelTip: "Zwingt die Defense in Dime oder Quarter. Zeigt Zonen-Zuweisungen glasklar auf.",
          beginnerMistake: "Kein zusätzlicher Blocker! Bei Blitz MUSS der Ball in unter 1.2 Sekunden geworfen werden."
        },
        pistol_11: {
          maddenUsage: "Kombiniert Shotgun-Passübersicht mit Downhill-Laufwegen des Running Backs.",
          personnelTip: "Ideal für Read Option und RPO Schemes.",
          beginnerMistake: "Den Mesh-Point beim Read Option zu früh abbrechen."
        }
      };

      if (NFL_DATA.formations) {
        Object.keys(NFL_DATA.formations).forEach(id => {
          if (FORMATION_MADDEN_TIPS[id]) {
            NFL_DATA.formations[id].madden = FORMATION_MADDEN_TIPS[id];
          }
        });
      }

      console.log("NFL_DATA enriched with Madden Tactical Layer!");
    }


    /* ==================== MADDEN TACTICAL LAYER LOGIC ==================== */

    let maddenModeEnabled = false;

    try {
      maddenModeEnabled = localStorage.getItem("nfl_madden_mode") === "true";
    } catch (e) {
      maddenModeEnabled = false;
    }

    function initMaddenLayer() {
      // Enrich structured data
      enrichNflDataWithMadden();

      // Wire header buttons
      const toggleBtn = document.getElementById("btn-madden-toggle");
      if (toggleBtn) {
        toggleBtn.onclick = toggleMaddenMode;
      }

      const guideBtn = document.getElementById("btn-madden-guide");
      if (guideBtn) {
        guideBtn.onclick = openMaddenGuideModal;
      }

      updateMaddenToggleButtons();

      // Sync if on playbook
      if (typeof pbActiveId !== 'undefined' && pbActiveId) {
        updatePlaybookMaddenCard(pbActiveId, typeof pbActiveSide !== 'undefined' ? pbActiveSide : 'O');
      }
    }

    function toggleMaddenMode() {
      maddenModeEnabled = !maddenModeEnabled;
      try {
        localStorage.setItem("nfl_madden_mode", maddenModeEnabled ? "true" : "false");
      } catch (e) { }

      updateMaddenToggleButtons();

      // Sync Playbook
      if (typeof pbActiveId !== 'undefined' && pbActiveId) {
        updatePlaybookMaddenCard(pbActiveId, typeof pbActiveSide !== 'undefined' ? pbActiveSide : 'O');
      }

      // Sync Play Builder
      if (typeof runPlayBuilderAnalysis === 'function') {
        runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
      }

      // Visual toast notification
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(maddenModeEnabled
          ? "🎮 Madden-Ebene aktiviert! Taktische Controller-Tipps & Mechaniken werden angezeigt."
          : "🏈 Madden-Ebene deaktiviert. Reiner NFL-Taktikmodus aktiv.");
      }
    }

    function updateMaddenToggleButtons() {
      const toggleBtn = document.getElementById("btn-madden-toggle");
      if (toggleBtn) {
        toggleBtn.classList.toggle("active", maddenModeEnabled);
        toggleBtn.innerHTML = maddenModeEnabled
          ? `<span>🎮</span> Madden: AN`
          : `<span>🎮</span> Madden: AUS`;
        toggleBtn.title = maddenModeEnabled
          ? "Optionale Madden-Ebene aktiv (Klicke zum Deaktivieren für reines NFL-Whiteboard)"
          : "Optionale Madden-Ebene inaktiv (Klicke zum Aktivieren von Controller-Tipps & Gameplay-Mechaniken)";
      }
    }

    function updatePlaybookMaddenCard(playId, side) {
      const card = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-card");
      if (!card) return;

      if (!maddenModeEnabled) {
        card.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }

      const item = side === 'O'
        ? (NFL_DATA.plays ? NFL_DATA.plays[playId] : null)
        : (NFL_DATA.defenses ? NFL_DATA.defenses[playId] : null);

      const data = (item && item.madden) ? item.madden : MADDEN_TACTICAL_KNOWLEDGE[playId] || {
        maddenName: item ? item.name : "Allgemeines Konzept",
        howItWorksInMadden: "Nutze Pre-Snap Progression Reads. Beobachte den menschlichen User-Defender über der Mitte.",
        whatToLookFor: "Achte auf die Safety-Tiefe vor dem Snap (Single-High vs. Two-High) und lies den ersten Read.",
        beginnerMistakes: "Zu schnelles Werfen des ersten Reads oder vorzeitiges Sprinten hinter der Line of Scrimmage.",
        controllerMechanics: "Touch Pass über Linebacker; Bullet Pass in enge Zonen mit Pass Lead.",
        nflRealityVsMadden: "🏈 Reales NFL-Football: Komplexe Raumdeckung; 🎮 Madden-Mechanik: KI-Zonen hängen stark von Ratings und Coaching Adjustments ab."
      };

      card.style.display = "block";

      const nameEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-name");
      if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = `🎮 In Madden umgesetzt: ${data.maddenName}`;

      const howEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-how");
      if (howEl) howEl.textContent = data.howItWorksInMadden;

      const readsEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-reads");
      if (readsEl) readsEl.textContent = data.whatToLookFor;

      const mistEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-mistakes");
      if (mistEl) mistEl.textContent = data.beginnerMistakes;

      const diffEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-diff");
      if (diffEl) diffEl.textContent = data.nflRealityVsMadden;

      const ctrlEl = document.getElementById("pb-dos-madden-controls");
      if (ctrlEl) {
        ctrlEl.innerHTML = `
      <span style="font-size:16px;">🕹️</span>
      <div>
        <strong>Controller & Steuerung:</strong> ${data.controllerMechanics}
      </div>
    `;
      }
    }

    function renderPlayBuilderMaddenDossier(play, primaryConcept) {
      const container = document.getElementById("pb-an-madden-box");
      if (!container) return;

      if (!maddenModeEnabled) {
        container.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }

      container.style.display = "flex";

      // Contextual analysis of the custom built play
      const isRun = play.runPath || play.category === "run";
      let advice = "";
      let mistake = "";
      let mechanics = "";
      let diff = "";

      if (isRun) {
        advice = "Laufspiel-Exekution: Folge den O-Line Blöcken mit sanften Korrekturen des linken Sticks. Halte den Sprint-Knopf (R2/RT) unbedingt losgelassen, bis die Line of Scrimmage überquert ist!";
        mistake = "⚠️ Die Sprint-Falle: Vorzeitiges Sprinten im Backfield triggert die 'Block Shed'-Logik der gegnerischen D-Line und führt zum vorzeitigen Tackle for Loss.";
        mechanics = "Pre-Snap Line Call: L1/LB -> R2/RT für O-Line Pinch oder Slide. 'ID the Mike' (L1 -> X/Square) auf den wichtigsten A-Gap Linebacker setzen.";
        diff = "🏈 NFL: O-Line passt ihren Push an die Front an | 🎮 Madden: Sprint-Knopf bestimmt KI-Block-Shed-Wahrscheinlichkeit.";
      } else {
        // Check routes present in play
        const routes = (play.players || []).filter(p => p.route && p.side === 'O').map(p => p.route.type);
        const hasMotion = !!play.motion;

        if (hasMotion) {
          advice = "Pre-Snap Motion Tell: Nutze die Jet/Orbit Motion 1.5 Sekunden vor dem Snap. Folgt der gegnerische CB dem Receiver über das Feld? $\\rightarrow$ Man-Coverage! Bleibt er auf seiner Seite? $\\rightarrow$ Zone-Coverage!";
        } else if (routes.includes("corner") || routes.includes("out")) {
          advice = "Out/Corner-Passfenster: Wirf die Out/Corner-Route mit Pass Lead zur Außenlinie (Linker Stick 9 oder 3 Uhr), sobald der Receiver seinen Break macht.";
        } else if (routes.includes("slant") || routes.includes("dig") || routes.includes("in")) {
          advice = "Mitten-Routen vs. User: Lies den menschlichen User-Defender über der Mitte. Er kann nur eine Route decken. Wirf mit Touch/Bullet Pass auf die entgegengesetzte Seite.";
        } else {
          advice = "Pass-Progression: Gehe die Routen von tief nach flach durch. Wenn keine Zone offen ist, wirf den RB-Checkdown vor der Line.";
        }

        mistake = "1. Stures Bullet-Pass Werfen gegen Linebacker mit 'Lurker'-Ability.\n2. In die Mitte werfen, ohne die Safety-Rotation nach dem Snap zu prüfen.";
        mechanics = "Bullet Pass = Knopf halten; Touch Pass = Knopf mittellang tippen; Lob = kurz antippen; High Point = L1/LB + Wurfknopf.";
        diff = "🏈 NFL: Progression basiert auf Augen des Safeties | 🎮 Madden: User-Defender baitet oft absichtlich falsche Würfe.";
      }

      container.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.25); padding-bottom:6px;">
      <span style="font-size:12px; font-weight:800; color:var(--accent-cyan); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
        <span>🎮</span> In Madden umgesetzt: Gameplay-Analyse
      </span>
      <div class="madden-badge-group">
        <span class="madden-pill-badge real">🏈 REALE NFL</span>
        <span class="madden-pill-badge game">🎮 MADDEN MECH</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:var(--ink-secondary); line-height:1.5;">
      <strong>🕹️ Gameplay-Tipp:</strong> ${advice}
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:11.5px; color:#fde68a; line-height:1.5;">
      <strong>⚠️ Typischer Anfängerfehler:</strong> ${mistake}
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:11px; color:#bae6fd; font-family:monospace; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.35); padding:6px 8px; border-radius:4px; border:1px dashed rgba(56,189,248,0.3);">
      🕹️ ${mechanics}
    </div>

    <div style="font-size:11px; color:#6ee7b7; border-top:1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.2); padding-top:5px;">
      ${diff}
    </div>
  `;
    }

    // Modal Handlers
    function openMaddenGuideModal() {
      const m = document.getElementById("modal-madden-guide");
      if (m) m.style.display = "flex";
    }

    function closeMaddenGuideModal() {
      const m = document.getElementById("modal-madden-guide");
      if (m) m.style.display = "none";
    }

    function switchMaddenGuideTab(tabKey) {
      const tabBtns = document.querySelectorAll(".madden-guide-tab-btn");
      tabBtns.forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle("active", b.getAttribute("data-madden-tab") === tabKey);
      });

      const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll(".madden-guide-tab-pane");
      tabContents.forEach(p => {
        p.style.display = p.getAttribute("id") === `madden-tab-${tabKey}` ? "block" : "none";
      });
    }




    /* ==================== AUDIT LOGIC & COMMAND CENTER INTEGRATION ==================== */

    // 1. Unified HUD Toast System
    function showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 3200) {
      let container = document.getElementById("cmd-toast-container");
      if (!container) {
        container = document.createElement("div");
        container.id = "cmd-toast-container";
        container.setAttribute("role", "status");
        container.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
        document.body.appendChild(container);
      }

      const toast = document.createElement("div");
      toast.className = `cmd-toast ${type}`;

      let icon = "ℹ️";
      if (type === "success") icon = "✅";
      if (type === "error") icon = "⚠️";

      toast.innerHTML = `
    <span style="font-size: 16px;">${icon}</span>
    <span style="flex: 1;">${message}</span>
  `;

      container.appendChild(toast);

      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.style.opacity = "0";
        toast.style.transform = "translateY(15px) scale(0.95)";
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (toast.parentNode) toast.parentNode.removeChild(toast);
        }, 300);
      }, duration);
    }

    // 2. Cross-Module Bridges: Playbook -> Play Builder
    function openCurrentPlayInBuilder() {
      if (typeof pbActiveSide === 'undefined' || typeof pbActiveId === 'undefined') return;

      if (pbActiveSide === 'O') {
        const play = (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.plays) ? NFL_DATA.plays[pbActiveId] : null;
        if (play) {
          setView('playbuilder');
          if (typeof loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder === 'function') {
            loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(play);
          }
          showToast(`✏️ Spielzug "${play.name}" im Play Builder zur Bearbeitung geladen!`, "success");
        }
      } else {
        // Defense
        const defItem = (typeof NFL_DATA !== 'undefined' && NFL_DATA.defenses) ? NFL_DATA.defenses[pbActiveId] : null;
        setView('playbuilder');
        if (typeof builderEngine !== 'undefined' && builderEngine) {
          builderEngine.loadSetup('shotgun_11', 'mesh', pbActiveId);
          if (typeof runPlayBuilderAnalysis === 'function') runPlayBuilderAnalysis();
          showToast(`🛡️ Defense-Schema "${defItem ? defItem.name : pbActiveId}" im Play Builder geladen!`, "success");
        }
      }
    }

    // 3. Cross-Module Bridges: Film Room -> Playbook & Play Builder
    function openCurrentFilmInPlaybook() {
      if (typeof filmActiveScenarioId === 'undefined' || typeof NFL_DATA === 'undefined') return;
      const scen = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === filmActiveScenarioId);
      if (!scen || !scen.telemetry || !scen.telemetry.offensePlayId) return;

      const playId = scen.telemetry.offensePlayId;
      setView('playbook');
      if (typeof selectPlaybookItem === 'function') {
        selectPlaybookItem(playId, 'O');
      }
      showToast(`📖 Film-Room-Konzept im Playbook geöffnet!`, "info");
    }

    function openCurrentFilmInBuilder() {
      if (typeof filmActiveScenarioId === 'undefined' || typeof NFL_DATA === 'undefined') return;
      const scen = NFL_DATA.filmScenarios.find(s => s.id === filmActiveScenarioId);
      if (!scen || !scen.telemetry || !scen.telemetry.offensePlayId) return;

      const play = NFL_DATA.plays[scen.telemetry.offensePlayId];
      if (play) {
        setView('playbuilder');
        if (typeof loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder === 'function') {
          loadCurrentPlayIntoBuilder(play);
        }
        showToast(`✏️ Film-Konzept "${play.name}" im Play Builder geladen!`, "success");
      }
    }

    };

    function openConceptFromGlossary(term) {
      const match = GLOSSARY_PLAYBOOK_MAP[term];
      if (!match) return;

      if (match.type === "playbook") {
        setView("playbook");
        if (typeof selectPlaybookItem === 'function') {
          selectPlaybookItem(match.id, match.side);
        }
        showToast(`📖 "${term}" im interaktiven Playbook geöffnet!`, "info");
      } else if (match.type === "stats") {
        setView("stats");
        if (typeof selectStatsMetric === 'function') {
          selectStatsMetric(match.id);
        }
        showToast(`📊 "${term}" im Stats Lab geöffnet!`, "info");
      }
    }

    // 5. Progressive Disclosure Controller for Stats Lab
    let statsDisclosureLevel = "starter"; // "starter", "advanced", "pro"

    function setStatsDisclosureLevel(level) {
      statsDisclosureLevel = level;

      // Update Segmented Button styles
      document.querySelectorAll(".sl-seg-btn").forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.level === level);
      });

      // Control formula disclosure
      const formulaDetails = document.getElementById("sl-details-formula");
      if (formulaDetails) {
        if (level === "pro") {
          formulaDetails.setAttribute("open", "");
        } else {
          formulaDetails.removeAttribute("open");
        }
      }

      showToast(`Taktische Tiefe auf "${level === 'starter' ? '🟢 Einsteiger' : level === 'advanced' ? '🟡 Fortgeschritten' : '🔵 All-Pro / Mathematiker'}" gesetzt.`, "info", 2000);
    }

    // Helper to get linked play for any stat metric
    function getLinkedPlayForStatMetric(metricId) {
      const map = {
        epa: { playId: "inside_zone", name: "Inside Zone / Duo", desc: "EPA belohnt hohe Run-Effizienz bei 1st & 10." },
        success_rate: { playId: "duo", name: "Duo & Power", desc: "Short-Yardage Konzepte für maximale Success Rate." },
        cpoe: { playId: "four_verts", name: "Four Verticals & Deep Shots", desc: "Messe QB-Ballplatzierung in engen Deep Windows." },
        air_yards_yac: { playId: "flood", name: "Flood Concept", desc: "Deep Sail Out-Route vs. Flat Checkdown YAC." },
        any_a: { playId: "dagger", name: "Dagger Concept", desc: "Großer Raumgewinn bei minimiertem Sack-Risiko." },
        passer_rating_qbr: { playId: "mesh", name: "Mesh / Shallow Cross", desc: "Rhythmus-Kurzpässe mit hoher Completion %." },
        havoc_rates: { playId: "fire_zone_3", name: "Fire Zone 3 & Sim Pressure", desc: "Erzeuge Havoc mit unblockten Rushers." },
        coverage_success: { playId: "cover_3", name: "Cover 3 Match & Cover 4", desc: "Zonenkontrolle zur Minimierung von Pass EPA." },
        dvoa: { playId: "outside_zone", name: "Outside Zone / Stretch", desc: "Gegnerbereinigte Effizienz gegen Elite-Defenses." }
      };
      return map[metricId] || { playId: "inside_zone", name: "Inside Zone", desc: "Klassisches Standardkonzept." };
    }

    // Global modal close on Escape key
    document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        if (typeof closeMaddenGuideModal === 'function') closeMaddenGuideModal();
        if (typeof closeExportModal === 'function') closeExportModal();
        if (typeof closeHelpModal === 'function') closeHelpModal();
      }
    });

    /* ==================== NFL COMMAND CENTER CONTROLLER ==================== */
    /* ==========================================================================
       NFL COMMAND CENTER - CONTROLLER & INTERACTION LOGIC
       ========================================================================== */

    let currentHomeHubTab = 'tactics';
    let activeConfFilter = 'all';
    let activeDivFilter = 'all';
    let activeStatsConfFilter = 'all';
    let currentStatsSort = { key: 'ppg', dir: 'desc' };
    let currentResourceCategory = 'all';
    let userTierlistState = null;
    let draggedTeamId = null;

    // Initialize Command Center on Load / Tab Switch
    function initHomeCommandCenter() {
      updateHomeHeroProgress();
      initTierlistData();
      renderTeamsGrid();
      renderLeagueStatsTable();
      renderTierlistCanvas();
      renderExternalResources();
    }

    // 1. HOME HERO & PROGRESS SYNC
    function updateHomeHeroProgress() {
      try {
        if (typeof getMasteryData === 'function') {
          const mastery = getMasteryData();
          const levelTitleEl = document.getElementById('home-level-title');
          const progressBarEl = document.getElementById('home-progress-bar');
          const statLessonsEl = document.getElementById('home-stat-lessons');
          const statChallengesEl = document.getElementById('home-stat-challenges');
          const statStreakEl = document.getElementById('home-stat-streak');

          if (levelTitleEl && mastery.rank) {
            levelTitleEl.textContent = `${mastery.rank} (Lvl ${mastery.level || 1})`;
          }
          if (progressBarEl) {
            progressBarEl.style.width = `${Math.min(100, Math.max(5, mastery.progressPercent || 10))}%`;
          }
          if (statLessonsEl && mastery.completedLessons !== undefined) {
            statLessonsEl.textContent = `${mastery.completedLessons} / ${mastery.totalLessons || 18}`;
          }
          if (statChallengesEl && mastery.score !== undefined) {
            statChallengesEl.textContent = `${mastery.score} Pkt`;
          }
          if (statStreakEl && mastery.streak !== undefined) {
            statStreakEl.textContent = `🔥 ${mastery.streak}`;
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not sync home hero progress:", err);
      }
    }

    // 2. HUB SWITCHER
    function switchHomeHub(tabKey) {
      currentHomeHubTab = tabKey;

      // Toggle tab buttons
      document.querySelectorAll('.hub-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.hub === tabKey);
      });

      // Toggle panes
      document.querySelectorAll('.home-hub-pane').forEach(pane => {
        pane.classList.toggle('active', pane.id === `hub-pane-${tabKey}`);
      });

      // Lazy render
      if (tabKey === 'teams') renderTeamsGrid();
      if (tabKey === 'stats') renderLeagueStatsTable();
      if (tabKey === 'tierlist') renderTierlistCanvas();
      if (tabKey === 'resources') renderExternalResources();
    }

    // 3. 32 NFL TEAMS OVERVIEW
    function setTeamsConfFilter(filter, el) {
      activeConfFilter = filter;
      activeDivFilter = 'all';
      document.querySelectorAll('#hub-pane-teams .cmd-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      if (el) el.classList.add('active');
      renderTeamsGrid();
    }

    function setTeamsDivFilter(divName, el) {
      activeDivFilter = divName;
      activeConfFilter = 'all';
      document.querySelectorAll('#hub-pane-teams .cmd-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      if (el) el.classList.add('active');
      renderTeamsGrid();
    }

    function filterNFLTeams() {
      renderTeamsGrid();
    }

    function renderTeamsGrid() {
      const container = document.getElementById('nfl-teams-container');
      if (!container || typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const searchInput = document.getElementById('nfl-teams-search');
      const query = (searchInput && searchInput.value) ? searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';

      // Filter teams
      const filtered = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.filter(t => {
        if (activeConfFilter !== 'all' && t.conf !== activeConfFilter) return false;
        if (activeDivFilter !== 'all' && t.division !== activeDivFilter) return false;
        if (query) {
          const match = t.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.city.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.abbr.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.headCoach.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.stadium.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.offScheme.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.defScheme.toLowerCase().includes(query);
          if (!match) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      if (filtered.length === 0) {
        container.innerHTML = `
      <div style="grid-column: 1 / -1; text-align: center; padding: 48px 16px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">
        <div style="font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 8px;">🔍</div>
        <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-primary);">Keine NFL-Teams gefunden</div>
        <div style="font-size: 13px; margin-top: 4px;">Versuche einen anderen Suchbegriff oder setze die Filter zurück.</div>
        <button class="cmd-chip active" style="margin-top: 14px; cursor: pointer;" onclick="resetTeamsFilter()">Alle 32 Teams anzeigen</button>
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      // Group by Division
      const divisions = [
        "AFC East", "AFC North", "AFC South", "AFC West",
        "NFC East", "NFC North", "NFC South", "NFC West"
      ];

      const afcDivisions = divisions.filter(d => d.startsWith('AFC'));
      const nfcDivisions = divisions.filter(d => d.startsWith('NFC'));

      function buildDivisionHtml(divName) {
        const divTeams = filtered.filter(t => t.division === divName);
        if (divTeams.length === 0) return '';

        const teamsHtml = divTeams.map(t => `
      <div class="nfl-team-card" onclick="openTeamDossier('${t.id}')" title="Klicken für vollständiges Dossier & Scheme-Details" tabindex="0" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' ')openTeamDossier('${t.id}')">
        <div class="team-badge-avatar" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, ${t.primaryColor} 0%, ${t.secondaryColor} 100%);">
          <span style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);">${t.abbr}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="team-card-info">
          <div class="team-card-name">${t.name}</div>
          <div class="team-card-sub">🏟️ ${t.stadium} • 👔 ${t.headCoach}</div>
          <div class="team-card-scheme-pill">⚡ ${escapeHtml(t.offScheme.split('/')[0] || t.offScheme)}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');

        return `
      <div class="nfl-division-block">
        <div class="nfl-division-title">${divName} (${divTeams.length})</div>
        <div class="nfl-division-teams">
          ${teamsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }

      const afcHtml = afcDivisions.map(d => buildDivisionHtml(d)).join('');
      const nfcHtml = nfcDivisions.map(d => buildDivisionHtml(d)).join('');

      container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="nfl-conf-column">
      <div class="nfl-conf-header">
        <span class="nfl-conf-title afc">🔴 AFC Conference</span>
      </div>
      ${afcHtml || '<div style="color:var(--ink-secondary); font-size:13px; padding:12px;">Keine Teams in dieser Auswahl.</div>'}
    </div>
    <div class="nfl-conf-column">
      <div class="nfl-conf-header">
        <span class="nfl-conf-title nfc">🔵 NFC Conference</span>
      </div>
      ${nfcHtml || '<div style="color:var(--ink-secondary); font-size:13px; padding:12px;">Keine Teams in dieser Auswahl.</div>'}
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function resetTeamsFilter() {
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('nfl-teams-search');
      if (searchInput) searchInput.value = '';
      activeConfFilter = 'all';
      activeDivFilter = 'all';
      document.querySelectorAll('#hub-pane-teams .cmd-chip').forEach(c => {
        c.classList.toggle('active', c.dataset.filter === 'all');
      });
      renderTeamsGrid();
    }

    // 4. TEAM DOSSIER MODAL & PLAYBOOK CONNECTION
    function openTeamDossier(teamId) {
      if (typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA === 'undefined') return;
      const team = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.find(t => t.id === teamId);
      if (!team) return;

      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-team-dossier');
      const body = document.getElementById('modal-team-dossier-body');
      if (!modal || !body) return;

      const offEpaClass = team.stats.offEpa >= 0.05 ? 'positive' : (team.stats.offEpa < 0 ? 'negative' : '');
      const defEpaClass = team.stats.defEpa <= -0.05 ? 'positive' : (team.stats.defEpa > 0.05 ? 'negative' : '');

      body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="team-modal-content">
      <div class="team-modal-header" style="border-left: 4px solid ${team.primaryColor};">
        <div class="team-modal-identity">
          <div class="team-modal-avatar" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, ${team.primaryColor} 0%, ${team.secondaryColor} 100%);">
            <span style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);">${team.abbr}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="team-modal-name-group">
            <h2 class="team-modal-title">${team.name}</h2>
            <div class="team-modal-division">🏛️ ${team.division} (${team.conf}) • 📍 ${team.city}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="team-modal-body-grid">
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">HEAD COACH</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val">👔 ${team.headCoach}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">HOME STADIUM</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val">🏟️ ${team.stadium}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">OFFENSIVE SCHEME & PLAYCALLING</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val" style="color: #6ee7b7;">⚡ ${team.offScheme}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">DEFENSIVE SYSTEM & COVERAGE PHILOSOPHIE</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val" style="color: #93c5fd;">🛡️ ${team.defScheme}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Benchmark Stats Overview -->
      <div style="margin: 18px 0;">
        <div style="font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-secondary); letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px;">
          📊 Benchmark-Leistungsdaten (Saison-Referenz)
        </div>
        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(100px, 1fr)); gap: 8px;">
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">PPG</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary);">${team.stats.ppg}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">YPG TOTAL</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary);">${team.stats.ypg}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">PASS YDS</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary);">${team.stats.passYpg}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">RUSH YDS</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary);">${team.stats.rushYpg}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">OFF EPA</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: ${team.stats.offEpa >= 0 ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e'};">${team.stats.offEpa > 0 ? '+' : ''}${team.stats.offEpa}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">DEF EPA</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: ${team.stats.defEpa <= 0 ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e'};">${team.stats.defEpa > 0 ? '+' : ''}${team.stats.defEpa}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">TO DIFF</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: ${team.stats.toDiff >= 0 ? '#10b981' : '#f43f5e'};">${team.stats.toDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${team.stats.toDiff}</div>
          </div>
          <div style="background: var(--bg-card); padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <div style="font-size: 10px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">SACKS</div>
            <div style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-primary);">${team.stats.sacks}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Playbook Link Box -->
      <div style="background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; margin-top: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap;">
        <div>
          <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #10b981; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase;">SCHEME PLAYBOOK VERKNÜPFUNG</div>
          <div style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-primary); margin-top: 2px;">
            Signatur-Konzept: <b>${team.playbookName || 'Offensives Kern-Konzept'}</b>
          </div>
          <div style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-secondary); margin-top: 2px;">
            Simuliere und lerne dieses Play direkt im interaktiven Playbook & Lab.
          </div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-continue" style="padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px;" onclick="closeTeamDossier(); openPlaybookWithConcept('${team.playbookConcept || 'mesh'}')">
          📖 Im Playbook öffnen ➔
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeTeamDossier() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-team-dossier');
      if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // 5. LEAGUE STATS OVERVIEW
    function setStatsSort(colKey) {
      if (currentStatsSort.key === colKey) {
        currentStatsSort.dir = currentStatsSort.dir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
      } else {
        currentStatsSort.key = colKey;
        // Natural directions: EPA def is better if lower, most others better if higher
        currentStatsSort.dir = (colKey === 'defEpa') ? 'asc' : 'desc';
      }
      renderLeagueStatsTable();
    }

    function setStatsConfFilter(conf, el) {
      activeStatsConfFilter = conf;
      document.querySelectorAll('#hub-pane-stats .cmd-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      if (el) el.classList.add('active');
      renderLeagueStatsTable();
    }

    function filterNFLStats() {
      renderLeagueStatsTable();
    }

    function renderLeagueStatsTable() {
      const tbody = document.getElementById('nfl-stats-tbody');
      if (!tbody || typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const searchInput = document.getElementById('nfl-stats-search');
      const query = (searchInput && searchInput.value) ? searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase() : '';

      // Filter
      let list = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.filter(t => {
        if (activeStatsConfFilter !== 'all' && t.conf !== activeStatsConfFilter) return false;
        if (query) {
          const match = t.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.city.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.abbr.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
            t.division.toLowerCase().includes(query);
          if (!match) return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      // Sort
      const key = currentStatsSort.key;
      const dir = currentStatsSort.dir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;

      list.sort((a, b) => {
        let valA, valB;
        if (key === 'team') {
          valA = a.name;
          valB = b.name;
          return valA.localeCompare(valB) * dir;
        } else if (key === 'conf') {
          valA = a.division;
          valB = b.division;
          return valA.localeCompare(valB) * dir;
        } else {
          valA = a.stats[key] !== undefined ? a.stats[key] : 0;
          valB = b.stats[key] !== undefined ? b.stats[key] : 0;
          return (valA - valB) * dir;
        }
      });

      // Update header arrow indicators
      document.querySelectorAll('.nfl-stats-table th[data-sort]').forEach(th => {
        th.classList.remove('sorted-asc', 'sorted-desc');
        if (th.dataset.sort === key) {
          th.classList.add(currentStatsSort.dir === 'asc' ? 'sorted-asc' : 'sorted-desc');
        }
      });

      // Find max values for mini bars
      const maxPpg = Math.max(...NFL_TEAMS_DATA.map(t => t.stats.ppg));
      const maxYpg = Math.max(...NFL_TEAMS_DATA.map(t => t.stats.ypg));

      tbody.innerHTML = list.map((t, idx) => {
        const offEpaClass = t.stats.offEpa >= 0.05 ? 'positive' : (t.stats.offEpa < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral');
        const defEpaClass = t.stats.defEpa <= -0.05 ? 'positive' : (t.stats.defEpa > 0.05 ? 'negative' : 'neutral');
        const toDiffClass = t.stats.toDiff > 0 ? 'positive' : (t.stats.toDiff < 0 ? 'negative' : 'neutral');

        return `
      <tr onclick="openTeamDossier('${t.id}')" title="Klicken für Team-Dossier">
        <td>
          <div class="stat-cell-team">
            <div class="team-badge-avatar" style="width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, ${t.primaryColor} 0%, ${t.secondaryColor} 100%);">
              <span style="font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff;">${t.abbr}</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span style="font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-primary);">${t.name}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td>
          <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">${t.division}</span>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px;">
            <span>${t.stats.ppg.toFixed(1)}</span>
            <div class="stat-bar-container">
              <div class="stat-bar-mini" style="width: ${(t.stats.ppg / maxPpg * 100).toFixed(0)}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td>
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px;">
            <span>${t.stats.ypg.toFixed(1)}</span>
            <div class="stat-bar-container">
              <div class="stat-bar-mini" style="width: ${(t.stats.ypg / maxYpg * 100).toFixed(0)}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td>${t.stats.passYpg.toFixed(1)}</td>
        <td>${t.stats.rushYpg.toFixed(1)}</td>
        <td>
          <span class="stat-mini-pill ${offEpaClass}">
            ${t.stats.offEpa > 0 ? '+' : ''}${t.stats.offEpa.toFixed(2)}
          </span>
        </td>
        <td>
          <span class="stat-mini-pill ${defEpaClass}">
            ${t.stats.defEpa > 0 ? '+' : ''}${t.stats.defEpa.toFixed(2)}
          </span>
        </td>
        <td>
          <span class="stat-mini-pill ${toDiffClass}">
            ${t.stats.toDiff > 0 ? '+' : ''}${t.stats.toDiff}
          </span>
        </td>
        <td>${t.stats.sacks}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    // 6. INTERACTIVE TIERLIST CONTROLLER
    const TIERLIST_STORAGE_KEY = 'nfl_command_tierlist_v1';

    function initTierlistData() {
      if (userTierlistState) return;

      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(TIERLIST_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            userTierlistState = parsed;
            return;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Could not load tierlist from localStorage:", e);
      }

      // Fallback to default
      resetTierlistToDefault(false);
    }

    function resetTierlistToDefault(render = true) {
      if (typeof NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS === 'undefined') return;
      // Deep clone default tiers
      userTierlistState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS));
      // Ensure unranked pool exists
      userTierlistState.unranked = [];

      saveTierlistState(false);
      if (render) {
        renderTierlistCanvas();
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast("Tierlist auf Standard zurückgesetzt", "success");
        }
      }
    }

    function saveTierlistState(showNotification = true) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(TIERLIST_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(userTierlistState));
        const indicator = document.getElementById('tierlist-saved-indicator');
        if (indicator) {
          indicator.style.opacity = '1';
          indicator.textContent = '✓ Lokal gespeichert';
          setTimeout(() => { if (indicator) indicator.style.opacity = '0.7'; }, 2000);
        }
        if (showNotification && typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast("Tierlist erfolgreich gespeichert!", "success");
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to save tierlist to localStorage:", e);
      }
    }

    function renderTierlistCanvas() {
      initTierlistData();
      const canvas = document.getElementById('tierlist-canvas');
      const unrankedZone = document.getElementById('tierlist-unranked-dropzone');
      const unrankedCountEl = document.getElementById('tierlist-unranked-count');
      if (!canvas || !userTierlistState || typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      // Build team map
      const teamMap = {};
      NFL_TEAMS_DATA.forEach(t => { teamMap[t.id] = t; });

      // 1. Render Active Tiers
      canvas.innerHTML = userTierlistState.map((tier, idx) => {
        const teamsHtml = (tier.teams || []).map(tId => {
          const team = teamMap[tId];
          if (!team) return '';
          return buildTierTeamItemHtml(team, tier.id);
        }).join('');

        return `
      <div class="tier-row" data-tier-id="${tier.id}" ondragover="handleTierDragOver(event)" ondragleave="handleTierDragLeave(event)" ondrop="handleTierDrop(event, '${tier.id}')">
        <div class="tier-label-box" style="background-color: ${tier.color};" onclick="promptRenameTier('${tier.id}')" title="Klicken zum Umbenennen des Tiers">
          <span class="tier-title-text" id="tier-lbl-${tier.id}">${escapeHtml(tier.label)}</span>
          <span class="tier-count-sub">${(tier.teams || []).length} Teams • ✏️</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tier-items-dropzone" id="tier-zone-${tier.id}">
          ${teamsHtml || '<div style="color:var(--ink-secondary); font-size:12px; font-style:italic; align-self:center; padding-left:12px;">Teams hierhin ziehen...</div>'}
        </div>
        <div class="tier-row-controls">
          <button class="tier-ctrl-btn" onclick="promptRenameTier('${tier.id}')" title="Tier umbenennen">✏️</button>
          <button class="tier-ctrl-btn" onclick="clearTier('${tier.id}')" title="Tier leeren (Teams in Pool)">🧹</button>
          <button class="tier-ctrl-btn danger" onclick="deleteTier('${tier.id}')" title="Tier löschen">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');

      // 2. Identify unranked teams (Teams in 32 list but in no tier)
      const assignedTeamIds = new Set();
      userTierlistState.forEach(tier => {
        (tier.teams || []).forEach(id => assignedTeamIds.add(id));
      });

      const unrankedTeams = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.filter(t => !assignedTeamIds.has(t.id));

      if (unrankedCountEl) {
        unrankedCountEl.textContent = `${unrankedTeams.length} Teams`;
      }

      if (unrankedZone) {
        if (unrankedTeams.length === 0) {
          unrankedZone.innerHTML = `
        <div style="color: #10b981; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
          <span>✓ Alle 32 NFL-Teams sind in deiner Tierlist eingeordnet!</span>
        </div>
      `;
        } else {
          unrankedZone.innerHTML = unrankedTeams.map(team => buildTierTeamItemHtml(team, 'unranked')).join('');
        }
      }
    }

    function buildTierTeamItemHtml(team, currentTierId) {
      return `
    <div class="tier-team-item" 
         id="team-chip-${team.id}"
         draggable="true" 
         data-team-id="${team.id}"
         data-current-tier="${currentTierId}"
         ondragstart="handleTierDragStart(event, '${team.id}')"
         ondragend="handleTierDragEnd(event)"
         onclick="handleTierTeamTap(event, '${team.id}', '${currentTierId}')"
         style="border-bottom: 2px solid ${team.secondaryColor};"
         title="${team.name} (${team.division}) - Ziehen oder Antippen zum Verschieben">
      <div class="tier-team-chip-badge" style="background: ${team.primaryColor};">
        ${team.abbr}
      </div>
      <div class="tier-team-chip-name">${team.city}</div>
      <button class="tier-chip-menu-btn" onclick="openTierQuickMove(event, '${team.id}', '${currentTierId}')" title="In anderes Tier verschieben">▾</button>
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function handleTierTeamTap(e, teamId, currentTierId) {
      if (e.target.closest('.tier-chip-menu-btn')) return;
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768 || ('ontouchstart' in window) || navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        openTierQuickMove(e, teamId, currentTierId);
      }
    }

    // DRAG & DROP HANDLERS
    function handleTierDragStart(e, teamId) {
      draggedTeamId = teamId;
      e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', teamId);
      e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
      const chip = document.getElementById(`team-chip-${teamId}`);
      if (chip) chip.classList.add('dragging');
    }

    function handleTierDragEnd(e) {
      draggedTeamId = null;
      document.querySelectorAll('.tier-team-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('dragging'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.tier-row').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
      const unranked = document.getElementById('tierlist-unranked-box');
      if (unranked) unranked.classList.remove('drag-over');
    }

    function handleTierDragOver(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
      const row = e.currentTarget;
      if (row) row.classList.add('drag-over');
    }

    function handleTierDragLeave(e) {
      const row = e.currentTarget;
      if (row) row.classList.remove('drag-over');
    }

    function handleTierDrop(e, targetTierId) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const row = e.currentTarget;
      if (row) row.classList.remove('drag-over');

      const teamId = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || draggedTeamId;
      if (!teamId) return;

      moveTeamToTier(teamId, targetTierId);
    }

    function handleUnrankedDrop(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const box = document.getElementById('tierlist-unranked-box');
      if (box) box.classList.remove('drag-over');

      const teamId = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || draggedTeamId;
      if (!teamId) return;

      moveTeamToTier(teamId, 'unranked');
    }

    // MOVE LOGIC
    function moveTeamToTier(teamId, targetTierId) {
      if (!userTierlistState) return;

      // Remove from everywhere
      userTierlistState.forEach(tier => {
        tier.teams = (tier.teams || []).filter(id => id !== teamId);
      });

      // Add to target if not unranked
      if (targetTierId !== 'unranked') {
        const targetTier = userTierlistState.find(t => t.id === targetTierId);
        if (targetTier) {
          if (!targetTier.teams) targetTier.teams = [];
          targetTier.teams.push(teamId);
        }
      }

      saveTierlistState(false);
      renderTierlistCanvas();
    }

    // QUICK MOVE MODAL / POPUP
    function openTierQuickMove(e, teamId, currentTierId) {
      if (e) {
        if (typeof e.stopPropagation === 'function') e.stopPropagation();
        if (typeof e.preventDefault === 'function') e.preventDefault();
      }

      const team = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.find(t => t.id === teamId);
      if (!team) return;

      // Remove existing dropdown/backdrop if any
      closeTierQuickMove();

      const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;

      // Add backdrop on mobile
      if (isMobile) {
        const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
        backdrop.id = 'tier-quick-backdrop';
        backdrop.className = 'tier-quick-backdrop';
        backdrop.onclick = closeTierQuickMove;
        document.body.appendChild(backdrop);
      }

      const popover = document.createElement('div');
      popover.id = 'tier-quick-menu-popover';
      popover.className = isMobile ? 'tier-quick-popover mobile-sheet' : 'tier-quick-popover';

      const tierOptions = userTierlistState.map(tier => `
    <button class="tier-quick-popover-item" onclick="moveTeamToTier('${teamId}', '${tier.id}'); closeTierQuickMove(); if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('${team.name} nach ${escapeHtml(tier.label)} verschoben', 'success');">
      <span style="display:inline-block; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:3px; background:${tier.color}; margin-right:10px;"></span>
      <span>${escapeHtml(tier.label)}</span>
      ${tier.id === currentTierId ? '<span style="margin-left:auto; color:var(--g-light);">✓ Aktuell</span>' : ''}
    </button>
  `).join('');

      popover.innerHTML = `
    <div class="tier-quick-popover-header">
      <span><b>${team.name}</b> verschieben:</span>
      ${isMobile ? '<button class="mobile-drawer-close" onclick="closeTierQuickMove()" aria-label="Schließen" style="background:none;border:none;color:#94a3b8;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;">✕</button>' : ''}
    </div>
    <div class="tier-quick-options-scroll">
      ${tierOptions}
      <button class="tier-quick-popover-item danger" onclick="moveTeamToTier('${teamId}', 'unranked'); closeTierQuickMove(); if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast('${team.name} in Unranked Pool gelegt', 'info');" style="margin-top: 6px; border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4); color: #f87171;">
        📦 Zurück in Unranked Pool
      </button>
    </div>
  `;

      if (!isMobile) {
        const rect = (e && e.target && typeof e.target.getBoundingClientRect === 'function') ? e.target.getBoundingClientRect() : { bottom: 100, left: 100 };
        popover.style.position = 'fixed';
        popover.style.top = `${Math.min(window.innerHeight - 250, rect.bottom + 4)}px`;
        popover.style.left = `${Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - 240, rect.left - 80))}px`;
        popover.style.zIndex = '9999';
      }

      document.body.appendChild(popover);

      // Auto-close on click outside
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.addEventListener('click', closeTierQuickMove, { once: true });
      }, 10);
    }

    function closeTierQuickMove() {
      const existing = document.getElementById('tier-quick-menu-popover');
      if (existing && typeof existing.remove === 'function') existing.remove();
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('tier-quick-backdrop');
      if (backdrop && typeof backdrop.remove === 'function') backdrop.remove();
    }

    // TIER CUSTOMIZATION: RENAME, ADD, CLEAR, DELETE
    function promptRenameTier(tierId) {
      const tier = userTierlistState.find(t => t.id === tierId);
      if (!tier) return;

      const newName = prompt(`Neuer Name für das Tier:`, tier.label);
      if (newName && newName.trim()) {
        tier.label = newName.trim();
        saveTierlistState(false);
        renderTierlistCanvas();
      }
    }

    function promptAddNewTier() {
      const name = prompt("Name für das neue Tier (z.B. 'Super Bowl Sleeper' oder 'Offense Elite'):", "Neues Tier");
      if (!name || !name.trim()) return;

      const colors = ["#e11d48", "#f97316", "#eab308", "#10b981", "#06b6d4", "#6366f1", "#a855f7", "#ec4899"];
      const randomColor = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
      const newId = `tier_${Date.now()}`;

      userTierlistState.push({
        id: newId,
        label: name.trim(),
        color: randomColor,
        teams: []
      });

      saveTierlistState(false);
      renderTierlistCanvas();
      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Tier "${name.trim()}" hinzugefügt`, "success");
      }
    }

    function clearTier(tierId) {
      const tier = userTierlistState.find(t => t.id === tierId);
      if (!tier) return;
      tier.teams = [];
      saveTierlistState(false);
      renderTierlistCanvas();
    }

    function deleteTier(tierId) {
      if (userTierlistState.length <= 1) {
        alert("Mindestens ein Tier muss bestehen bleiben!");
        return;
      }
      const confirmDel = confirm("Tier wirklich löschen? Enthaltene Teams werden in den Pool verschoben.");
      if (!confirmDel) return;

      userTierlistState = userTierlistState.filter(t => t.id !== tierId);
      saveTierlistState(false);
      renderTierlistCanvas();
    }

    function exportTierlistAsText() {
      if (!userTierlistState || typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const teamMap = {};
      NFL_TEAMS_DATA.forEach(t => { teamMap[t.id] = t; });

      let text = "🏆 MEINE NFL TIERLIST (Football Command Center)\n=====================================\n\n";
      userTierlistState.forEach(tier => {
        text += `[${tier.label}]\n`;
        if (!tier.teams || tier.teams.length === 0) {
          text += "  (Keine Teams)\n";
        } else {
          const names = tier.teams.map(id => teamMap[id] ? `${teamMap[id].name} (${teamMap[id].abbr})` : id);
          text += `  • ${names.join(", ")}\n`;
        }
        text += "\n";
      });

      if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
          if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast("Tierlist-Zusammenfassung in die Zwischenablage kopiert! 📋", "success");
          } else {
            alert("Tierlist in die Zwischenablage kopiert!");
          }
        }).catch(err => {
          console.warn("Clipboard copy error:", err);
          alert(text);
        });
      } else {
        alert(text);
      }
    }

    // 7. CENTRAL EXTERNAL RESOURCES QUICKLINKS
    function setResourcesFilter(cat, el) {
      currentResourceCategory = cat;
      document.querySelectorAll('#hub-pane-resources .cmd-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      if (el) el.classList.add('active');
      renderExternalResources();
    }

    function renderExternalResources() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('resources-grid');
      if (!grid || typeof NFL_EXTERNAL_RESOURCES === 'undefined') return;

      const list = NFL_EXTERNAL_RESOURCES.filter(r => {
        if (currentResourceCategory === 'all') return true;
        if (currentResourceCategory === 'official' && (r.category.includes('News') || r.badge === 'Official' || r.badge === 'Mainstream')) return true;
        if (currentResourceCategory === 'stats' && (r.category.includes('Stats') || r.category.includes('EPA') || r.category.includes('Analytics') || r.category.includes('DVOA'))) return true;
        if (currentResourceCategory === 'film' && (r.category.includes('Film') || r.category.includes('Tape') || r.category.includes('Video') || r.category.includes('Podcasts'))) return true;
        return false;
      });

      grid.innerHTML = list.map(res => `
    <div class="resource-card">
      <div class="resource-card-top">
        <div class="resource-icon-badge">
          <span class="resource-icon">${res.icon || '🔗'}</span>
          <div>
            <div class="resource-title">${res.title}</div>
            <div class="resource-category">${res.category}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="resource-badge">${res.badge}</span>
      </div>
      <p class="resource-desc">${res.desc}</p>
      <div class="resource-footer">
        <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-secondary); font-family: monospace;">${escapeHtml(res.url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').split('/')[0])}</span>
        <a href="${res.url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="resource-link-btn" title="${res.title} in neuem Tab öffnen">
          Öffnen ↗
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
    }

    // Utility HTML escape
    function escapeHtml(str) {
      if (!str) return '';
      return String(str)
        .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
        .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
        .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
        .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
        .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
    }

    // Global escape handler for modals
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeTeamDossier();
        closeTierQuickMove();
      }
    });

        { slotId: "k", label: "Placekicker", short: "K", posGroup: "ST", allowedPos: ["K"], required: true },
        { slotId: "p", label: "Punter", short: "P", posGroup: "ST", allowedPos: ["P"], required: true },
        { slotId: "rs", label: "Return Specialist", short: "RS", posGroup: "ST", allowedPos: ["WR", "RB", "CB", "ST"], required: false }
      ]
    };

    // ==================== DEFAULT PRESET TEMPLATES ====================
    const NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS = [
      {
        id: "preset_allpro",
        name: "🏆 2024 All-Pro Superteam",
        description: "Das ultimative Dream Team der NFL mit den dominantesten All-Pro Akteuren.",
        offScheme: "Shanahan West Coast / High-Speed Motion",
        defScheme: "Fangio 2-High Shell / Match Quarters",
        colors: { primary: "#0ea5e9", secondary: "#f59e0b" },
        slots: {
          qb1: "pm_mahomes",
          qb2: "cj_stroud",
          rb1: "c_mccaffrey",
          rb2: "d_henry",
          wr1: "j_jefferson",
          wr2: "t_hill",
          wr3: "cd_lamb",
          wr4: "ar_stbrown",
          te1: "g_kittle",
          te2: "t_kelce",
          lt: "t_williams",
          lg: "j_thuney",
          c: "c_humphrey",
          rg: "z_martin",
          rt: "p_sewell",
          edge1: "m_garrett",
          edge2: "tj_watt",
          dt1: "c_jones",
          dt2: "d_lawrence",
          lb1: "f_warner",
          lb2: "r_smith",

          cb1: "s_gardner",

          ncb: "t_mcduffie",
          fs: "j_bates",
          ss: "k_hamilton",
          db_sub: "a_winfield",
          dl_sub: "m_parsons",
