          p: "aj_cole",
          rs: "t_hill"
        }
      },
      {
        id: "preset_spread_speed",
        name: "⚡ Modern Speed & Space Offense",
        description: "Maximale Trennung, 11-Personnel Deep Shots und blitzschnelle Secondary.",
        offScheme: "Spread Air Raid / Motion Shot",
        defScheme: "Spagnuolo Aggressive Blitz & Cover 1",
        colors: { primary: "#10b981", secondary: "#6366f1" },
        slots: {
          qb1: "l_jackson",
          qb2: "j_love",
          rb1: "j_gibbs",
          rb2: "b_hall",
          wr1: "j_chase",
          wr2: "t_hill",
          wr3: "ar_stbrown",
          wr4: "g_wilson",
          te1: "s_laporta",
          te2: "b_bowers",
          lt: "t_wirfs",
          lg: "q_nelson",
          c: "t_linderbaum",
          rg: "c_lindstrom",
          rt: "l_johnson",
          edge1: "m_parsons",
          edge2: "a_hutchinson",
          dt1: "q_williams",
          dt2: "j_carter",
          lb1: "p_queen",
          lb2: "j_owusu",
          lb3: "d_davis",
          cb1: "s_gardner",
          cb2: "d_stingley",
          ncb: "d_witherspoon",
          fs: "x_mckinney",
          ss: "k_hamilton",
          db_sub: "d_bland",
          dl_sub: "w_anderson",
          k: "b_aubrey",
          p: "t_townsend",
          rs: "j_gibbs"
        }
      }
    ];


    /* ==================== NFL REAL PLAYER TEAM BUILDER CONTROLLER ==================== */
    /* ==========================================================================
       NFL REAL PLAYER TEAM BUILDER - CONTROLLER & ENGINE
       ========================================================================== */

    const TEAM_BUILDER_STORAGE_KEY = 'nfl_team_builder_rosters_v2';
    const TEAM_BUILDER_ACTIVE_KEY = 'nfl_team_builder_active_v2';

    let currentRoster = null;
    let savedRostersList = [];
    let activeTargetSlotId = 'qb1';
    let playerPoolFilters = {
      query: '',
      posGroup: 'ALL',
      team: 'ALL'
    };

    // 1. INITIALIZATION
    function initTeamBuilder() {
      loadSavedRostersFromStorage();
      loadActiveRosterFromStorage();

      // Populate Scheme Dropdowns if present
      initSchemeSelectors();

      // Render components
      renderRosterIdentity();
      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();
    }

    // 2. STORAGE & STATE LOADING
    function loadSavedRostersFromStorage() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(TEAM_BUILDER_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          savedRostersList = JSON.parse(raw);
        } else {
          // Seed with default presets
          if (typeof NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS !== 'undefined') {
            savedRostersList = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS)).map(p => ({
              ...p,
              id: p.id,
              createdAt: Date.now(),
              updatedAt: Date.now()
            }));
            saveRostersCatalog();
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not load saved rosters:", err);
        savedRostersList = [];
      }
    }

    function saveRostersCatalog() {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(TEAM_BUILDER_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(savedRostersList));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save rosters catalog:", err);
      }
    }

    function loadActiveRosterFromStorage() {
      try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(TEAM_BUILDER_ACTIVE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
          currentRoster = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (currentRoster && currentRoster.slots) return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Could not load active roster:", err);
      }

      // Fallback to Preset 1 (All-Pro) or empty structure
      if (typeof NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS !== 'undefined' && NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS.length > 0) {
        currentRoster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS[0]));
        currentRoster.id = `roster_${Date.now()}`;
        currentRoster.createdAt = Date.now();
        currentRoster.updatedAt = Date.now();
      } else {
        currentRoster = createBlankRosterObject("My Custom Franchise");
      }
      saveActiveRosterState();
    }

    function saveActiveRosterState() {
      try {
        if (currentRoster) {
          currentRoster.updatedAt = Date.now();
          localStorage.setItem(TEAM_BUILDER_ACTIVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(currentRoster));

          // Also update in saved catalog if present
          const existingIdx = savedRostersList.findIndex(r => r.id === currentRoster.id);
          if (existingIdx !== -1) {
            savedRostersList[existingIdx] = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentRoster));
            saveRostersCatalog();
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Failed to save active roster:", err);
      }
    }

    function createBlankRosterObject(name = "New Franchise") {
      return {
        id: `roster_${Date.now()}`,
        name: name,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
        offScheme: "Shanahan West Coast / High-Speed Motion",
        defScheme: "Fangio 2-High Shell / Match Quarters",
        colors: { primary: "#0ea5e9", secondary: "#f59e0b" },
        slots: {}
      };
    }

    // 3. TEAM IDENTITY & SCHEME CONTROLS
    function initSchemeSelectors() {
      const offSelect = document.getElementById('tb-off-scheme-select');
      const defSelect = document.getElementById('tb-def-scheme-select');

      const offSchemes = [
        "Shanahan West Coast / High-Speed Motion",
        "Spread Air Raid / Motion Shot",
        "Heavy 12/13 Personnel Duo & Power Run",
        "Spread / Play-Action Deep Shots",
        "West Coast Quick Rhythm & RPO",
        "11 Personnel Duo / Naked Boot"
      ];

      const defSchemes = [
        "Fangio 2-High Shell / Match Quarters",
        "Spagnuolo Aggressive Blitz & Cover 1",
        "Nickel 4-2-5 Cover 4/2 Match",
        "4-3 Over Cover 3 / Quarters Aggressive",
        "Macdonald Disguise / Post-Snap Rotation",
        "3-4 Multi-Front / Simulated Pressure"
      ];

      if (offSelect && offSelect.options && offSelect.options.length <= 1) {
        offSelect.innerHTML = offSchemes.map(s => `<option value="${s}">${s}</option>`).join('');
      }
      if (defSelect && defSelect.options && defSelect.options.length <= 1) {
        defSelect.innerHTML = defSchemes.map(s => `<option value="${s}">${s}</option>`).join('');
      }
    }

    function renderRosterIdentity() {
      if (!currentRoster) return;

      const nameInput = document.getElementById('tb-team-name-input');
      const avatarEl = document.getElementById('tb-team-avatar');
      const cardEl = document.querySelector('.tb-identity-card');
      const offSelect = document.getElementById('tb-off-scheme-select');
      const defSelect = document.getElementById('tb-def-scheme-select');

      if (nameInput) nameInput.value = currentRoster.name || "My Custom Franchise";
      if (offSelect && currentRoster.offScheme) offSelect.value = currentRoster.offScheme;
      if (defSelect && currentRoster.defScheme) defSelect.value = currentRoster.defScheme;

      const primaryColor = (currentRoster.colors && currentRoster.colors.primary) || "#0ea5e9";
      const secondaryColor = (currentRoster.colors && currentRoster.colors.secondary) || "#f59e0b";

      if (cardEl) {
        cardEl.style.setProperty('--tb-primary-color', primaryColor);
        cardEl.style.setProperty('--tb-secondary-color', secondaryColor);
      }

      if (avatarEl) {
        avatarEl.style.background = `linear-gradient(135deg, ${primaryColor} 0%, ${secondaryColor} 100%)`;
        const initials = (currentRoster.name || "MC").split(" ").map(w => w[0]).join("").substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
        avatarEl.textContent = initials || "🏈";
      }
    }

    function updateTeamNameFromInput() {
      const nameInput = document.getElementById('tb-team-name-input');
      if (nameInput && currentRoster) {
        currentRoster.name = nameInput.value.trim() || "My Franchise";
        renderRosterIdentity();
        saveActiveRosterState();
      }
    }

    function updateSchemeFromSelect(type) {
      if (!currentRoster) return;
      if (type === 'offense') {
        const s = document.getElementById('tb-off-scheme-select');
        if (s) currentRoster.offScheme = s.value;
      } else if (type === 'defense') {
        const s = document.getElementById('tb-def-scheme-select');
        if (s) currentRoster.defScheme = s.value;
      }
      saveActiveRosterState();
    }

    // 4. METRICS & ROSTER HEALTH SUMMARY
    function updateRosterMetrics() {
      if (!currentRoster || typeof NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE === 'undefined' || typeof NFL_PLAYERS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const allSlots = [
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special
      ];

      const totalSlotsCount = allSlots.length; // 32
      let filledCount = 0;
      let offCount = 0;
      let defCount = 0;
      let stCount = 0;
      let totalRating = 0;
      let totalCap = 0;

      const playerMap = {};
      NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.forEach(p => { playerMap[p.id] = p; });

      allSlots.forEach(slot => {
        const playerId = currentRoster.slots[slot.slotId];
        if (playerId && playerMap[playerId]) {
          filledCount++;
          const p = playerMap[playerId];
          totalRating += (p.ovrRating || 85);
          totalCap += (p.capHit || 5.0);

          if (slot.slotId.startsWith('qb') || slot.slotId.startsWith('rb') || slot.slotId.startsWith('wr') || slot.slotId.startsWith('te') || ['lt', 'lg', 'c', 'rg', 'rt'].includes(slot.slotId)) {
            offCount++;
          } else if (slot.slotId.startsWith('edge') || slot.slotId.startsWith('dt') || slot.slotId.startsWith('lb') || slot.slotId.startsWith('cb') || slot.slotId === 'ncb' || ['fs', 'ss', 'db_sub', 'dl_sub'].includes(slot.slotId)) {
            defCount++;
          } else {
            stCount++;
          }
        }
      });

      const avgRating = filledCount > 0 ? Math.round(totalRating / filledCount) : 0;
      const SALARY_CAP_LIMIT = 255.4; // NFL 2024 Cap Benchmark in $M
      const capAvailable = Math.max(0, SALARY_CAP_LIMIT - totalCap);

      // Update DOM elements
      const elFilled = document.getElementById('tb-metric-filled');
      const elOffense = document.getElementById('tb-metric-offense');
      const elDefense = document.getElementById('tb-metric-defense');
      const elSpecial = document.getElementById('tb-metric-special');
      const elRating = document.getElementById('tb-metric-rating');
      const elCap = document.getElementById('tb-metric-cap');

      if (elFilled) elFilled.textContent = `${filledCount} / ${totalSlotsCount}`;
      if (elOffense) elOffense.textContent = `${offCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense.length}`;
      if (elDefense) elDefense.textContent = `${defCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense.length}`;
      if (elSpecial) elSpecial.textContent = `${stCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special.length}`;
      if (elRating) elRating.textContent = avgRating > 0 ? `${avgRating} OVR` : `---`;
      if (elCap) elCap.textContent = `$${totalCap.toFixed(1)}M / $${SALARY_CAP_LIMIT}M`;

      // Update phase headers
      const countOffEl = document.getElementById('tb-count-offense');
      const countDefEl = document.getElementById('tb-count-defense');
      const countSpEl = document.getElementById('tb-count-special');
      if (countOffEl) countOffEl.textContent = `${offCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense.length} Besetzt`;
      if (countDefEl) countDefEl.textContent = `${defCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense.length} Besetzt`;
      if (countSpEl) countSpEl.textContent = `${stCount} / ${NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special.length} Besetzt`;
    }

    // 5. RENDER ROSTER BOARD (DEPTH CHART)
    function renderRosterBoard() {
      if (!currentRoster || typeof NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE === 'undefined' || typeof NFL_PLAYERS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const playerMap = {};
      NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.forEach(p => { playerMap[p.id] = p; });

      // 1. Offense Sections
      const offGridEl = document.getElementById('tb-offense-slots-grid');
      if (offGridEl) {
        offGridEl.innerHTML = NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense.map(slot => buildSlotCardHtml(slot, playerMap)).join('');
      }

      // 2. Defense Sections
      const defGridEl = document.getElementById('tb-defense-slots-grid');
      if (defGridEl) {
        defGridEl.innerHTML = NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense.map(slot => buildSlotCardHtml(slot, playerMap)).join('');
      }

      // 3. Special Teams Sections
      const spGridEl = document.getElementById('tb-special-slots-grid');
      if (spGridEl) {
        spGridEl.innerHTML = NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special.map(slot => buildSlotCardHtml(slot, playerMap)).join('');
      }
    }

    function buildSlotCardHtml(slot, playerMap) {
      const playerId = currentRoster.slots[slot.slotId];
      const player = playerId ? playerMap[playerId] : null;
      const isActive = activeTargetSlotId === slot.slotId;

      if (!player) {
        return `
      <div class="tb-slot-card ${isActive ? 'active-target' : ''}" 
           id="tb-slot-${slot.slotId}" 
           onclick="selectTargetSlot('${slot.slotId}')"
           tabindex="0"
           title="Klicken, um diesen Slot im Spieler-Browser zu wählen">
        <div class="tb-slot-header">
          <span class="tb-slot-badge">${slot.short}</span>
          <span class="tb-slot-label">${slot.label}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="tb-slot-empty-content">
          <span>➕ Spieler zuweisen</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }

      const teamColor = getTeamColorByAbbr(player.team);

      return `
    <div class="tb-slot-card filled ${isActive ? 'active-target' : ''}" 
         id="tb-slot-${slot.slotId}"
         onclick="selectTargetSlot('${slot.slotId}')"
         tabindex="0"
         title="${player.name} (${player.pos} • ${player.team}) - Klicken zum Fokussieren">
      <div class="tb-slot-header">
        <span class="tb-slot-badge">${slot.short}</span>
        <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;">
          <span class="tb-slot-player-rating">${player.ovrRating || 90}</span>
          <button class="tb-slot-btn danger" onclick="removePlayerFromSlot('${slot.slotId}', event)" title="Spieler aus Slot entfernen">✕</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tb-slot-player-content">
        <div class="tb-slot-player-avatar" style="background: ${teamColor};">
          #${player.jersey || player.pos}
        </div>
        <div class="tb-slot-player-info">
          <div class="tb-slot-player-name">${player.name}</div>
          <div class="tb-slot-player-sub">${player.pos} • ${player.team} • ${player.archetype.split('/')[0]}</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="tb-slot-actions">
        <button class="tb-slot-btn" onclick="openPlayerDetailModal('${player.id}', event)">🔍 Details</button>
        <button class="tb-slot-btn" onclick="selectTargetSlot('${slot.slotId}', event)">🔄 Ersetzen</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
    }

    function getTeamColorByAbbr(abbr) {
      if (typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA !== 'undefined') {
        const t = NFL_TEAMS_DATA.find(x => x.abbr === abbr);
        if (t) return t.primaryColor;
      }
      return '#3b82f6';
    }

    // 6. SLOT SELECTION & AUTOMATIC FILTERING
    function selectTargetSlot(slotId, e) {
      if (e) e.stopPropagation();
      activeTargetSlotId = slotId;

      // Highlight slot cards
      document.querySelectorAll('.tb-slot-card').forEach(c => {
        c.classList.toggle('active-target', c.id === `tb-slot-${slotId}`);
      });

      // Find slot definition
      const allSlots = [
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special
      ];
      const slotDef = allSlots.find(s => s.slotId === slotId);

      // Update target pill in player pool
      const pillEl = document.getElementById('tb-pool-active-slot');
      if (pillEl && slotDef) {
        pillEl.textContent = `Ziel-Slot: ${slotDef.label} (${slotDef.short})`;
      }

      // Smart auto-filter player pool
      if (slotDef) {
        playerPoolFilters.posGroup = slotDef.posGroup;
        updatePoolPosChipActive(slotDef.posGroup);
      }

      renderPlayerPool();
    }

    function updatePoolPosChipActive(posGroup) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.tb-pos-chip').forEach(btn => {
        btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.pos === posGroup);
      });
    }

    // 7. ASSIGNMENT & REMOVAL ENGINE
    function assignPlayerToSlot(playerId, slotId = activeTargetSlotId) {
      if (!currentRoster || !slotId) return;

      const previousSlotForPlayer = Object.keys(currentRoster.slots).find(s => currentRoster.slots[s] === playerId);
      if (previousSlotForPlayer && previousSlotForPlayer !== slotId) {
        // Player is currently assigned to another slot. Move them gracefully.
        delete currentRoster.slots[previousSlotForPlayer];
      }

      currentRoster.slots[slotId] = playerId;
      saveActiveRosterState();

      // Find next empty slot to accelerate roster assembling
      advanceToNextEmptySlot(slotId);

      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();

      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        const p = NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.find(x => x.id === playerId);
        showToast(`${p ? p.name : 'Spieler'} zu ${slotId.toUpperCase()} zugewiesen!`, 'success');
      }
    }

    function advanceToNextEmptySlot(currentSlotId) {
      const allSlots = [
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense,
        ...NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special
      ];

      const currentIndex = allSlots.findIndex(s => s.slotId === currentSlotId);
      // Search forwards from current
      for (let i = currentIndex + 1; i < allSlots.length; i++) {
        if (!currentRoster.slots[allSlots[i].slotId]) {
          selectTargetSlot(allSlots[i].slotId);
          return;
        }
      }
      // Wrap around
      for (let i = 0; i < currentIndex; i++) {
        if (!currentRoster.slots[allSlots[i].slotId]) {
          selectTargetSlot(allSlots[i].slotId);
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    function removePlayerFromSlot(slotId, e) {
      if (e) e.stopPropagation();
      if (!currentRoster || !currentRoster.slots[slotId]) return;

      delete currentRoster.slots[slotId];
      saveActiveRosterState();

      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();
    }

    function clearCurrentRoster() {
      if (!currentRoster) return;
      if (!confirm("Möchtest du alle Spieler aus dem aktuellen Roster entfernen?")) return;

      currentRoster.slots = {};
      saveActiveRosterState();

      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();

      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast("Roster vollständig geleert", "info");
      }
    }

    // 8. PLAYER POOL SEARCH & FILTER
    function setPlayerPoolPosFilter(posGroup, btnEl) {
      playerPoolFilters.posGroup = posGroup;
      document.querySelectorAll('.tb-pos-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
      if (btnEl) btnEl.classList.add('active');
      renderPlayerPool();
    }

    function filterPlayerPool() {
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('tb-pool-search');
      if (searchInput) {
        playerPoolFilters.query = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
      }
      renderPlayerPool();
    }

    function renderPlayerPool() {
      const listEl = document.getElementById('tb-pool-players-list');
      if (!listEl || typeof NFL_PLAYERS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const targetSlotId = activeTargetSlotId;
      const q = playerPoolFilters.query;
      const pGroup = playerPoolFilters.posGroup;

      // Filter
      const list = NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.filter(p => {
        // Pos group filter
        if (pGroup !== 'ALL') {
          if (pGroup === 'OL' && !['LT', 'LG', 'C', 'RG', 'RT', 'OL'].includes(p.pos)) return false;
          if (pGroup === 'DL' && !['DT', 'DL'].includes(p.pos)) return false;
          if (pGroup === 'EDGE' && !['EDGE', 'DE'].includes(p.pos)) return false;
          if (pGroup === 'ST' && !['K', 'P', 'ST'].includes(p.pos)) return false;
          if (pGroup === 'S' && !['FS', 'SS', 'S'].includes(p.pos)) return false;
          if (['QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE', 'LB', 'CB'].includes(pGroup) && p.pos !== pGroup) return false;
        }

        // Text search
        if (q) {
          const match = p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            p.team.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            p.teamName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            p.college.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            p.archetype.toLowerCase().includes(q);
          if (!match) return false;
        }

        return true;
      });

      if (list.length === 0) {
        listEl.innerHTML = `
      <div style="text-align: center; padding: 32px 12px; color: var(--ink-secondary);">
        <div style="font-size: 24px; margin-bottom: 6px;">🔍</div>
        <div style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;">Keine passenden Spieler gefunden</div>
        <div style="font-size: 11px; margin-top: 4px;">Versuche einen anderen Filter oder lösche die Suche.</div>
      </div>
    `;
        return;
      }

      // Build assigned lookup
      const assignedSlots = {};
      if (currentRoster && currentRoster.slots) {
        Object.keys(currentRoster.slots).forEach(slot => {
          assignedSlots[currentRoster.slots[slot]] = slot;
        });
      }

      listEl.innerHTML = list.map(player => {
        const assignedSlot = assignedSlots[player.id];
        const isAssignedToActive = assignedSlot === targetSlotId;
        const teamColor = getTeamColorByAbbr(player.team);

        return `
      <div class="tb-pool-item ${isAssignedToActive ? 'assigned-here' : ''}">
        <div class="tb-pool-item-left" onclick="openPlayerDetailModal('${player.id}')" style="cursor: pointer;" title="Klicken für Spieler-Dossier">
          <div class="tb-pool-avatar" style="background: ${teamColor};">
            #${player.jersey || player.pos}
          </div>
          <div class="tb-pool-info">
            <div class="tb-pool-name">
              ${player.name}
              <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #10b981; margin-left: 4px;">${player.ovrRating} OVR</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tb-pool-details">
              ${player.pos} • ${player.team} • $${player.capHit}M • ${player.archetype.split('/')[0]}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="tb-pool-actions">
          ${isAssignedToActive
            ? `<span style="font-size: 10.5px; color: #10b981; font-weight: 700;">✓ Zugewiesen</span>`
            : assignedSlot
              ? `<button class="btn-assign-player" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: var(--ink-secondary);" onclick="assignPlayerToSlot('${player.id}')" title="Aktuell in Slot [${assignedSlot.toUpperCase()}]. Klicken zum Verschieben.">⇄ Verschieben</button>`
              : `<button class="btn-assign-player" onclick="assignPlayerToSlot('${player.id}')" title="Zu aktuellem Slot zuweisen">+ Zuweisen</button>`
          }
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');
    }

    // 9. PLAYER DETAIL MODAL
    function openPlayerDetailModal(playerId, e) {
      if (e) e.stopPropagation();
      if (typeof NFL_PLAYERS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const player = NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.find(p => p.id === playerId);
      if (!player) return;

      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-tb-player-detail');
      const body = document.getElementById('modal-tb-player-body');
      if (!modal || !body) return;

      const teamColor = getTeamColorByAbbr(player.team);
      const assignedSlot = currentRoster && Object.keys(currentRoster.slots).find(s => currentRoster.slots[s] === playerId);

      const skillsHtml = player.skills ? Object.entries(player.skills).map(([key, val]) => `
    <div style="background: rgba(15,23,42,0.6); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;">
      <span style="font-size: 11px; color: var(--ink-secondary); text-transform: capitalize;">${key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, ' $1')}</span>
      <span style="font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: #38bdf8;">${val}</span>
    </div>
  `).join('') : '';

      body.innerHTML = `
    <div class="team-modal-content">
      <div class="team-modal-header" style="border-left: 4px solid ${teamColor};">
        <div class="team-modal-identity">
          <div class="team-modal-avatar" style="background: ${teamColor};">
            #${player.jersey || player.pos}
          </div>
          <div class="team-modal-name-group">
            <h2 class="team-modal-title">${player.name}</h2>
            <div class="team-modal-division">📍 ${player.pos} • ${player.teamName} (#${player.jersey}) • ${player.archetype}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; color: #10b981; background: rgba(16,185,129,0.15); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 8px;">
          ${player.ovrRating} OVR
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="team-modal-body-grid">
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">ALTER & ERFAHRUNG</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val">${player.age} Jahre • ${player.experience} Jahre in der NFL</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">MAßE & COLLEGE</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val">${player.height} • ${player.weight} • ${player.college}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">BENCHMARK SALARY CAP HIT</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val" style="color: #6ee7b7;">💰 $${player.capHit}M / Jahr (Cap Benchmark)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="team-modal-info-card">
          <div class="team-modal-card-label">ROSTER STATUS</div>
          <div class="team-modal-card-val" style="color: ${assignedSlot ? '#38bdf8' : 'var(--ink-secondary)'};">
            ${assignedSlot ? `✅ Zugewiesen als <b>${assignedSlot.toUpperCase()}</b>` : `Frei verfügbar (Nicht zugewiesen)`}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div style="font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 8px;">
          ⚡ Spieler-Attribute & Skill-Profil
        </div>
        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(130px, 1fr)); gap: 8px;">
          ${skillsHtml}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px;">
        <div style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 4px;">SCOUTING NOTE & SCHEME FIT</div>
        <div style="font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-primary); line-height: 1.5;">${player.notes || 'Herausragender Leistungsträger der Franchise.'}</div>
      </div>

      <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px;">
        <button class="btn-tb" onclick="closePlayerDetailModal()">Schließen</button>
        <button class="btn-tb primary" onclick="assignPlayerToSlot('${player.id}'); closePlayerDetailModal();">
          In aktiven Slot zuweisen
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closePlayerDetailModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-tb-player-detail');
      if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    }

    // 10. SAVED ROSTERS MANAGEMENT MODAL
    function openSavedRostersModal() {
      loadSavedRostersFromStorage();
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-tb-saved-rosters');
      const listEl = document.getElementById('tb-saved-rosters-list');
      if (!modal || !listEl) return;

      listEl.innerHTML = savedRostersList.map(roster => {
        const isActive = currentRoster && currentRoster.id === roster.id;
        const filledCount = Object.keys(roster.slots || {}).length;
        const dateStr = new Date(roster.updatedAt || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('de-DE');

        return `
      <div class="tb-saved-card ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}">
        <div class="tb-saved-info">
          <div class="tb-saved-title">${roster.name} ${isActive ? '<span style="color:#10b981; font-size:11px;">(Aktiv)</span>' : ''}</div>
          <div class="tb-saved-meta">
            ${filledCount} / 32 Spieler • ${roster.offScheme ? roster.offScheme.split('/')[0] : 'Scheme'} • Zuletzt: ${dateStr}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tb-saved-actions">
          <button class="btn-tb primary" onclick="loadRosterById('${roster.id}'); closeSavedRostersModal();" ${isActive ? 'disabled style="opacity:0.6;"' : ''}>
            Laden
          </button>
          <button class="btn-tb" onclick="duplicateRosterById('${roster.id}')" title="Duplizieren">
            📋
          </button>
          <button class="btn-tb danger" onclick="deleteRosterById('${roster.id}')" title="Löschen">
            🗑️
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      }).join('');

      modal.style.display = 'flex';
    }

    function closeSavedRostersModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('modal-tb-saved-rosters');
      if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
    }

    function loadRosterById(rosterId) {
      const roster = savedRostersList.find(r => r.id === rosterId);
      if (!roster) return;

      currentRoster = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(roster));
      saveActiveRosterState();

      renderRosterIdentity();
      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();

      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Roster "${roster.name}" geladen!`, 'success');
      }
    }

    function createNewRosterPrompt() {
      const name = prompt("Name für das neue NFL-Roster:", "Mein Dream Team");
      if (!name || !name.trim()) return;

      currentRoster = createBlankRosterObject(name.trim());
      savedRostersList.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentRoster)));
      saveRostersCatalog();
      saveActiveRosterState();

      renderRosterIdentity();
      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();

      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Neues Roster "${name.trim()}" erstellt!`, 'success');
      }
    }

    function duplicateCurrentRoster() {
      if (!currentRoster) return;
      const newName = `Kopie von ${currentRoster.name}`;
      const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentRoster));
      copy.id = `roster_${Date.now()}`;
      copy.name = newName;
      copy.createdAt = Date.now();
      copy.updatedAt = Date.now();

      savedRostersList.push(copy);
      currentRoster = copy;

      saveRostersCatalog();
      saveActiveRosterState();

      renderRosterIdentity();
      renderRosterBoard();
      updateRosterMetrics();
      renderPlayerPool();

      if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
        showToast(`Roster dupliziert als "${newName}"`, 'success');
      }
    }

    function duplicateRosterById(rosterId) {
      const source = savedRostersList.find(r => r.id === rosterId);
      if (!source) return;

      const copy = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(source));
      copy.id = `roster_${Date.now()}`;
      copy.name = `Kopie von ${source.name}`;
      copy.createdAt = Date.now();
      copy.updatedAt = Date.now();

      savedRostersList.push(copy);
      saveRostersCatalog();
      openSavedRostersModal();
    }

    function deleteRosterById(rosterId) {
      if (savedRostersList.length <= 1) {
        alert("Mindestens ein Roster muss im System verbleiben!");
        return;
      }
      if (!confirm("Möchtest du dieses gespeicherte Roster wirklich unwiderruflich löschen?")) return;

      savedRostersList = savedRostersList.filter(r => r.id !== rosterId);
      saveRostersCatalog();

      if (currentRoster && currentRoster.id === rosterId) {
        loadRosterById(savedRostersList[0].id);
      } else {
        openSavedRostersModal();
      }
    }

    function loadPresetTemplatePrompt() {
      if (typeof NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS === 'undefined') return;

      const options = NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS.map((p, idx) => `${idx + 1}: ${p.name}`).join("\n");
      const choice = prompt(`Wähle ein vordefiniertes NFL-Roster Preset:\n\n${options}\n\nGib die Nummer (1 oder 2) ein:`, "1");
      if (!choice) return;

      const idx = parseInt(choice, 10) - 1;
      if (idx >= 0 && idx < NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS.length) {
        const preset = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_ROSTER_PRESETS[idx]));
        preset.id = `roster_${Date.now()}`;
        preset.createdAt = Date.now();
        preset.updatedAt = Date.now();

        currentRoster = preset;
        savedRostersList.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(preset)));
        saveRostersCatalog();
        saveActiveRosterState();

        renderRosterIdentity();
        renderRosterBoard();
        updateRosterMetrics();
        renderPlayerPool();

        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast(`Preset "${preset.name}" erfolgreich geladen!`, 'success');
        }
      }
    }

    // 11. EXPORT ROSTER AS TEXT / CLIPBOARD
    function exportRosterAsText() {
      if (!currentRoster || typeof NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE === 'undefined' || typeof NFL_PLAYERS_DATA === 'undefined') return;

      const playerMap = {};
      NFL_PLAYERS_DATA.forEach(p => { playerMap[p.id] = p; });

      let text = `🏈 NFL ROSTER REPORT: ${currentRoster.name.toUpperCase()}\n`;
      text += `=========================================================\n`;
      text += `Offensive Scheme: ${currentRoster.offScheme || 'Standard'}\n`;
      text += `Defensive Scheme: ${currentRoster.defScheme || 'Standard'}\n\n`;

      function appendSection(title, slots) {
        text += `--- ${title.toUpperCase()} ---\n`;
        slots.forEach(slot => {
          const pId = currentRoster.slots[slot.slotId];
          const p = pId ? playerMap[pId] : null;
          if (p) {
            text += `[${slot.short.padEnd(6)}] ${p.name} (${p.team} • #${p.jersey}) - ${p.ovrRating} OVR\n`;
          } else {
            text += `[${slot.short.padEnd(6)}] (OFFEN - Kein Spieler zugewiesen)\n`;
          }
        });
        text += `\n`;
      }

      appendSection("Offense", NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.offense);
      appendSection("Defense", NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.defense);
      appendSection("Special Teams", NFL_ROSTER_STRUCTURE.special);

      if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
          if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
            showToast("Vollständiger Roster-Report in die Zwischenablage kopiert! 📋", "success");
          } else {
            alert("Roster in Zwischenablage kopiert!");
          }
        }).catch(err => {
          console.warn("Clipboard write failed:", err);
          alert(text);
        });
      } else {
        alert(text);
      }
    }

    // Global modal ESC handler
    window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closePlayerDetailModal();
        closeSavedRostersModal();
      }
    });


    /* ==================== GLOBAL INITIALIZATION ==================== */
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => setView(b.dataset.tab));
      });

      $("#brand-home").addEventListener("click", () => setView("home"));
      $("#mastery-badge").addEventListener("click", () => setView("profile"));

      document.querySelectorAll(".subtab-btn").forEach(b => {
        b.addEventListener("click", () => openChallengesSubtab(b.dataset.subtab));
      });

      document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip[data-lvl]").forEach(c => {
        c.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip[data-lvl]").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
          c.classList.add("active");
          activeLevelFilter = c.dataset.lvl;
          renderNav();
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip[data-pcat]").forEach(c => {
        c.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.querySelectorAll(".filter-chip[data-pcat]").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
          c.classList.add("active");
          activePlayFilter = c.dataset.pcat;
          renderPlaybook();
        });
      });

      const btnResetProg = $("#btn-reset-progress");
      if (btnResetProg) {
        btnResetProg.onclick = () => {
          if (confirm("Möchtest du deinen Lernstand und deine Scores wirklich zurücksetzen?")) {
            try {
              localStorage.removeItem("nfl");
              localStorage.removeItem("nfl_trainer");
            } catch (e) {
              console.warn("Storage reset failed:", e);
            }
            doneLessons = {};
            trainerState = { curIndex: 0, score: 0, streak: 0, answered: false };
            updateMasteryBadge();
            setView("home");
          }
        };
      }

      document.addEventListener("click", e => {
        const a = e.target.closest("[data-i],[data-t]");
        if (!a) return;
        if (a.dataset.t) {
          $("#s").value = a.dataset.t;
          search(a.dataset.t);
        } else if (a.dataset.i !== undefined) {
          $("#s").value = "";
          setView("learn");
          show(a.dataset.i === 'g' ? 'g' : +a.dataset.i);
        }
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" && e.target.dataset.t) e.target.click();
      });

      $("#s").oninput = e => search(e.target.value.trim());

      function toggleTheme() {
        const root = document.documentElement;
        const isDark = root.dataset.theme === "dark" || (!root.dataset.theme && matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme:dark)").matches);
        const newTheme = isDark ? "light" : "dark";
        root.dataset.theme = newTheme;
        try { localStorage.setItem('nfl_theme', newTheme); } catch (e) { }
        if (typeof UserProfileEngine !== 'undefined' && UserProfileEngine.state) {
          UserProfileEngine.state.themePreference = newTheme;
          if (typeof UserProfileEngine.saveState === 'function') UserProfileEngine.saveState();
        }
      }
      window.toggleTheme = toggleTheme;
      if ($("#th")) $("#th").onclick = toggleTheme;

      initFieldLab();
      initTrainer();
      initCoach();
      renderFilmRoom();
      renderPlaybook();
      initPlayBuilder();
      initTeamBuilder();
      initStatsLab();
      initMaddenLayer();
      updateMasteryBadge();
      if (window.TrainingPlanEngine && typeof window.TrainingPlanEngine.init === 'function') window.TrainingPlanEngine.init();
      if (window.UserProfileEngine && typeof window.UserProfileEngine.init === 'function') window.UserProfileEngine.init();

      if (typeof switchLearnPath === 'function') switchLearnPath(activeLearnPath); else show(0);
      // Initialize Portal Engine and smart routing
      if (window.PortalEngine && typeof window.PortalEngine.init === 'function') {
        window.PortalEngine.init();
      } else {
        setView("home");
      }
    });

    // ==================== MOBILE NAVIGATION & DRAWER HELPERS ====================
    function toggleMobileMoreDrawer() {
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-more-drawer');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer-backdrop');
      if (!drawer || !backdrop) return;
      if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) {
        closeMobileMoreDrawer();
      } else {
        openMobileMoreDrawer();
      }
    }

    function openMobileMoreDrawer() {
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-more-drawer');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer-backdrop');
      if (drawer) drawer.classList.add('open');
      if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.add('open');
      updateMobileMaddenState();
    }

    function closeMobileMoreDrawer() {
      const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-more-drawer');
      const backdrop = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer-backdrop');
      if (drawer) drawer.classList.remove('open');
      if (backdrop) backdrop.classList.remove('open');
    }

    function updateMobileMaddenState() {
      const indicator = document.getElementById('mob-madden-indicator');
      if (!indicator) return;
      const isEnabled = typeof isMaddenModeEnabled === 'function' ? isMaddenModeEnabled() : false;
      indicator.textContent = isEnabled ? '🎮 Madden: AN' : '🎮 Madden: AUS';
      indicator.style.color = isEnabled ? 'var(--g-light, #10b981)' : 'inherit';
    }

    // Close drawer on Escape key
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeMobileMoreDrawer();
        closeTierQuickMove();
      }
    });

        configured: false,
        activeRole: 'qb',
        experienceLevel: 'Rookie', // Rookie, Varsity, All-Pro
        timeBudget: 'standard', // light (~2h/3 sess), standard (~4h/5 sess), intensive (~6-8h/7 sess)
        environment: 'solo', // theory, solo, team
        learningMethod: 'balanced', // practical, analytical, balanced
        selectedGoals: [],
        customGoal: '',
        currentWeek: 1, // 1, 2, 3, 4
        streak: 0,
        lastCompletedDate: null,
        filterDay: 'all', // 'all', 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
        filterType: 'all', // 'all', 'theorie', 'film', 'technik', 'quiz', 'rest'
        weeksHistory: {
          1: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
          2: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
          3: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
          4: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} }
        }
      },

      init() {
        this.loadState();
        if (!this.state.configured) {
          this.setDefaultGoalsForRole(this.state.activeRole);
        }
        this.render();
        this.updateGlobalBadge();
      },

      loadState() {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
          if (saved) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
              this.state = Object.assign({}, this.state, parsed);
              // Ensure all 4 weeks exist in weeksHistory
              if (!this.state.weeksHistory) this.state.weeksHistory = {};
              for (let w = 1; w <= 4; w++) {
                if (!this.state.weeksHistory[w]) {
                  this.state.weeksHistory[w] = {
                    completedSessionIds: [],
                    taskStates: {},
                    sessionDayOverrides: {},
                    skippedSessionIds: [],
                    sessionNotes: {}
                  };
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[TrainingPlan] Failed to load state:', e);
        }
      },

      saveState() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(this.state));
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[TrainingPlan] Failed to save state:', e);
        }
        this.updateGlobalBadge();
      },

      setDefaultGoalsForRole(roleId) {
        const meta = TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[roleId];
        if (meta && meta.defaultGoals) {
          this.state.selectedGoals = [...meta.defaultGoals];
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // USER ACTIONS & INTERACTIVITY
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      selectRole(roleId) {
        if (!TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[roleId]) return;
        this.state.activeRole = roleId;
        this.setDefaultGoalsForRole(roleId);
        this.state.configured = true;
        this.saveState();
        if (typeof UserProfileEngine !== 'undefined' && UserProfileEngine.state) {
          UserProfileEngine.state.roleId = roleId;
          if (typeof UserProfileEngine.saveState === 'function') UserProfileEngine.saveState();
          if (typeof UserProfileEngine.updateHeaderProfileBadge === 'function') UserProfileEngine.updateHeaderProfileBadge();
        }
        this.render();
        this.showToast(`🎯 Rolle gewechselt zu: ${TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[roleId].name}`);
      },

      setWeek(weekNumber) {
        if (weekNumber < 1 || weekNumber > 4) return;
        this.state.currentWeek = weekNumber;
        this.saveState();
        this.render();
      },

      nextWeek() {
        if (this.state.currentWeek < 4) {
          this.setWeek(this.state.currentWeek + 1);
          this.showToast(`🚀 Willkommen in Woche ${this.state.currentWeek}!`);
        } else {
          this.showToast(`🏆 Du hast alle 4 Ausbildungswochen erreicht!`);
        }
      },

      prevWeek() {
        if (this.state.currentWeek > 1) {
          this.setWeek(this.state.currentWeek - 1);
        }
      },

      toggleTask(sessionId, taskIdx) {
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week];
        const taskKey = `${sessionId}_t${taskIdx}`;

        weekData.taskStates[taskKey] = !weekData.taskStates[taskKey];

        // Check if all tasks in this session are completed
        const session = this.getSessionById(sessionId, week);
        if (session && session.tasks && session.tasks.length > 0) {
          const allDone = session.tasks.every((t, idx) => !!weekData.taskStates[`${sessionId}_t${idx}`]);
          const isCompleted = weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(sessionId);

          if (allDone && !isCompleted) {
            weekData.completedSessionIds.push(sessionId);
            this.updateStreak();
            this.showToast(`✅ Session "${session.title}" abgeschlossen!`);
          } else if (!allDone && isCompleted) {
            weekData.completedSessionIds = weekData.completedSessionIds.filter(id => id !== sessionId);
          }
        }

        this.saveState();
        this.render();
      },

      toggleSessionComplete(sessionId) {
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week];
        const session = this.getSessionById(sessionId, week);
        if (!session) return;

        const isDone = weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(sessionId);

        if (isDone) {
          // Unmark complete
          weekData.completedSessionIds = weekData.completedSessionIds.filter(id => id !== sessionId);
          // Uncheck tasks
          if (session.tasks) {
            session.tasks.forEach((_, idx) => {
              delete weekData.taskStates[`${sessionId}_t${idx}`];
            });
          }
        } else {
          // Mark complete
          weekData.completedSessionIds.push(sessionId);
          // Un-skip if it was skipped
          weekData.skippedSessionIds = weekData.skippedSessionIds.filter(id => id !== sessionId);
          // Check all tasks
          if (session.tasks) {
            session.tasks.forEach((_, idx) => {
              weekData.taskStates[`${sessionId}_t${idx}`] = true;
            });
          }
          this.updateStreak();
          this.showToast(`✅ Session "${session.title}" als erledigt markiert!`);
        }

        this.saveState();
        this.render();
      },

      skipSession(sessionId) {
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week];
        if (weekData.skippedSessionIds.includes(sessionId)) {
          weekData.skippedSessionIds = weekData.skippedSessionIds.filter(id => id !== sessionId);
          this.showToast(`Session wieder in den Wochenplan aufgenommen.`);
        } else {
          weekData.skippedSessionIds.push(sessionId);
          weekData.completedSessionIds = weekData.completedSessionIds.filter(id => id !== sessionId);
          this.showToast(`⏭️ Session übersprungen.`);
        }
        this.saveState();
        this.render();
      },

      rescheduleSession(sessionId, targetDayIndex) {
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week];
        const days = ["Montag", "Dienstag", "Mittwoch", "Donnerstag", "Freitag", "Samstag", "Sonntag"];

        targetDayIndex = parseInt(targetDayIndex, 10);
        if (targetDayIndex >= 0 && targetDayIndex <= 6) {
          weekData.sessionDayOverrides[sessionId] = targetDayIndex;
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
          this.showToast(`📅 Session nach ${days[targetDayIndex]} verschoben.`);
        }
      },

      saveSessionNote(sessionId, text) {
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week];
        weekData.sessionNotes[sessionId] = text;
        this.saveState();
        this.showToast(`💾 Notiz gespeichert.`);
      },

      resetWeek(weekNumber) {
        if (!confirm(`Möchtest du Woche ${weekNumber} wirklich zurücksetzen? Alle Haken und Notizen dieser Woche werden gelöscht.`)) return;
        this.state.weeksHistory[weekNumber] = {
          completedSessionIds: [],
          taskStates: {},
          sessionDayOverrides: {},
          skippedSessionIds: [],
          sessionNotes: {}
        };
        this.saveState();
        this.render();
        this.showToast(`🔄 Woche ${weekNumber} wurde zurückgesetzt.`);
      },

      updateStreak() {
        const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        if (this.state.lastCompletedDate !== today) {
          this.state.streak = (this.state.streak || 0) + 1;
          this.state.lastCompletedDate = today;
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // DATA HELPERS
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      getSessionById(sessionId, weekNumber) {
        const roleCur = TRAINING_PLAN_CURRICULUM[this.state.activeRole];
        if (!roleCur || !roleCur[weekNumber]) return null;
        return roleCur[weekNumber].sessions.find(s => s.id === sessionId);
      },

      getEffectiveSessionsForWeek(weekNumber) {
        const roleCur = TRAINING_PLAN_CURRICULUM[this.state.activeRole];
        if (!roleCur || !roleCur[weekNumber]) return [];

        let sessions = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(roleCur[weekNumber].sessions));
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[weekNumber] || { sessionDayOverrides: {}, completedSessionIds: [], skippedSessionIds: [] };

        // Apply day overrides
        const days = ["Montag", "Dienstag", "Mittwoch", "Donnerstag", "Freitag", "Samstag", "Sonntag"];
        sessions.forEach(s => {
          if (weekData.sessionDayOverrides && typeof weekData.sessionDayOverrides[s.id] === 'number') {
            s.dayIndex = weekData.sessionDayOverrides[s.id];
            s.day = days[s.dayIndex];
          }
        });

        // Filter by timeBudget if user chose "light" or "standard"
        // "light" takes ~3 sessions: Days Mo, Mi, Sa + Review
        // "standard" takes ~5 sessions: Days Mo, Di, Do, Fr, Sa
        // "intensive" takes all 7 sessions
        if (this.state.timeBudget === 'light') {
          // Keep theory, one field drill, review, plus any completed
          sessions = sessions.filter((s, idx) => {
            return idx === 0 || idx === 2 || idx === 6 || (weekData.completedSessionIds && weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(s.id));
          });
        } else if (this.state.timeBudget === 'standard') {
          sessions = sessions.filter((s, idx) => {
            return idx !== 3 || (weekData.completedSessionIds && weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(s.id)); // Drop 1 optional session
          });
        }

        // Sort by dayIndex
        sessions.sort((a, b) => a.dayIndex - b.dayIndex);

        return sessions;
      },

      getWeekStats(weekNumber) {
        const sessions = this.getEffectiveSessionsForWeek(weekNumber);
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[weekNumber] || { completedSessionIds: [], skippedSessionIds: [] };

        const totalSessions = sessions.length;
        const completedCount = sessions.filter(s => weekData.completedSessionIds && weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(s.id)).length;
        const skippedCount = sessions.filter(s => weekData.skippedSessionIds && weekData.skippedSessionIds.includes(s.id)).length;

        const percent = totalSessions > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalSessions) * 100) : 0;

        let totalDurationMin = 0;
        let completedDurationMin = 0;
        sessions.forEach(s => {
          totalDurationMin += (s.durationMin || 0);
          if (weekData.completedSessionIds && weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(s.id)) {
            completedDurationMin += (s.durationMin || 0);
          }
        });

        return {
          totalSessions,
          completedCount,
          skippedCount,
          percent,
          totalHours: (totalDurationMin / 60).toFixed(1),
          completedHours: (completedDurationMin / 60).toFixed(1)
        };
      },

      updateGlobalBadge() {
        const badge = document.getElementById('path-badge-training-plan');
        if (badge) {
          const stats = this.getWeekStats(this.state.currentWeek);
          badge.textContent = `Woche ${this.state.currentWeek} (${stats.percent}%)`;
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // TOOL DEEP-LINK HANDLER
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      jumpToTool(type, target) {
        switch (type) {
          case 'module':
            if (typeof target === 'string') {
              if (PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA && PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.some(m => m.id === target)) {
                if (typeof switchLearnPath === 'function') switchLearnPath('player', target);
              } else if (COACH_LEARNING_DATA && COACH_LEARNING_DATA.some(m => m.id === target)) {
                if (typeof switchLearnPath === 'function') switchLearnPath('coach', target);
              } else {
                if (typeof switchLearnPath === 'function') switchLearnPath('general');
              }
              if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('learn');
            }
            break;
          case 'film':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('film');
            if (typeof target === 'number' && typeof selectFilmScenario === 'function') {
              selectFilmScenario(target);
            }
            break;
          case 'playbuilder':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('playbuilder');
            break;
          case 'playbook':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('playbook');
            break;
          case 'clock':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('lab');
            if (typeof switchLabMode === 'function') switchLabMode('clock');
            break;
          case 'coverage_lab':
          case 'call_lab':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('challenges');
            break;
          case 'stats':
            if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('stats');
            break;
          default:
            this.showToast(`Modul "${type}" ausgewählt`);
            break;
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // RENDERING ENGINE
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      render() {
        const container = document.getElementById('training-plan-container');
        if (!container) return;

        const role = TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[this.state.activeRole] || TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META.qb;
        const week = this.state.currentWeek;
        const stats = this.getWeekStats(week);
        const curriculum = TRAINING_PLAN_CURRICULUM[this.state.activeRole] || {};
        const weekInfo = curriculum[week] || { themeTitle: "Entwicklungswoche", themeFocus: "Fundamentals & Progression" };
        const sessions = this.getEffectiveSessionsForWeek(week);
        const weekData = this.state.weeksHistory[week] || { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, skippedSessionIds: {}, sessionNotes: {} };

        // Apply UI Day & Type filters
        let filteredSessions = sessions;
        if (this.state.filterDay !== 'all') {
          const targetDay = parseInt(this.state.filterDay, 10);
          filteredSessions = filteredSessions.filter(s => s.dayIndex === targetDay);
        }
        if (this.state.filterType !== 'all') {
          filteredSessions = filteredSessions.filter(s => s.type === this.state.filterType);
        }

        container.innerHTML = `
      <!-- TOP COMMAND CENTER PROFILE & PROGRESS HUD -->
      <div class="tp-hud-card">
        <div class="tp-hud-profile-row">
          <div class="tp-role-avatar">
            <span class="tp-role-icon">${role.icon}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tp-role-meta">
            <div class="tp-role-badge-line">
              <span class="tp-role-group-tag">${role.group === 'offense' ? 'OFFENSE' : role.group === 'defense' ? 'DEFENSE' : role.group === 'special_teams' ? 'SPECIAL TEAMS' : 'COACHING STAFF'}</span>
              <span class="tp-role-level-tag ${this.state.experienceLevel.toLowerCase()}">${this.state.experienceLevel}</span>
              <span class="tp-role-budget-tag">${this.state.timeBudget === 'light' ? '⚡ 2h / Smart' : this.state.timeBudget === 'standard' ? '⚖️ 4h / Standard' : '🔥 7h / Intensiv'}</span>
            </div>
            <h2 class="tp-role-name">${role.name} <span class="tp-badge-text">[${role.badge}]</span></h2>
            <p class="tp-role-desc">${role.desc}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="tp-hud-actions">
            <button class="tp-btn-secondary" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.openConfigModal()">
              ⚙️ Plan anpassen
            </button>
            <button class="tp-btn-ghost" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.resetWeek(${week})">
              🔄 Woche leeren
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- PROGRESS METRICS ROW -->
        <div class="tp-metrics-grid">
          <div class="tp-metric-box">
            <div class="tp-metric-header">
              <span class="tp-metric-label">WOCHENFORTSCHRITT</span>
              <span class="tp-metric-val">${stats.percent}%</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tp-progress-bar-bg">
              <div class="tp-progress-bar-fill" style="width: ${stats.percent}%;"></div>
            </div>
            <div class="tp-metric-sub">${stats.completedCount} von ${stats.totalSessions} Sessions abgeschlossen</div>
          </div>

          <div class="tp-metric-box">
            <div class="tp-metric-header">
              <span class="tp-metric-label">TRAININGSZEIT</span>
              <span class="tp-metric-val">${stats.completedHours}h <span class="tp-metric-muted">/ ${stats.totalHours}h</span></span>
            </div>
            <div class="tp-metric-sub">Geschätzter wöchentlicher Zeitaufwand</div>
          </div>

          <div class="tp-metric-box">
            <div class="tp-metric-header">
              <span class="tp-metric-label">TRAINING STREAK</span>
              <span class="tp-metric-val">🔥 ${this.state.streak} ${this.state.streak === 1 ? 'Tag' : 'Tage'}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tp-metric-sub">Kontinuierliche Trainingsdisziplin</div>
          </div>

          <div class="tp-metric-box">
            <div class="tp-metric-header">
              <span class="tp-metric-label">AKTUELLE PHASE</span>
              <span class="tp-metric-val">Woche ${week} / 4</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tp-metric-sub">${week < 4 ? 'Woche ' + (week + 1) + ' ab ' + stats.percent + '% empfohlen' : '🏆 Finale Meisterschaftswoche'}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- MULTI-WEEK PROGRESSION SELECTOR -->
      <div class="tp-week-nav-bar">
        <div class="tp-week-tabs">
          ${[1, 2, 3, 4].map(w => {
          const wStats = this.getWeekStats(w);
          const isActive = w === week;
          return `
              <button class="tp-week-tab ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setWeek(${w})">
                <span class="tp-week-tab-num">Woche ${w}</span>
                <span class="tp-week-tab-status">${wStats.percent === 100 ? '✅ 100%' : wStats.percent > 0 ? wStats.percent + '%' : 'Bereit'}</span>
              </button>
            `;
        }).join('')}
        </div>
        <div class="tp-week-quick-nav">
          <button class="tp-btn-nav" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.prevWeek()" ${week === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}>◀ Vorherige</button>
          <button class="tp-btn-nav tp-btn-nav-primary" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.nextWeek()">
            ${week < 4 ? 'Nächste Woche ▶' : '🏆 Meisterschaft'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- THEMATIC BANNER FOR CURRENT WEEK -->
      <div class="tp-theme-banner">
        <div class="tp-theme-icon">📌</div>
        <div class="tp-theme-content">
          <div class="tp-theme-tag">LEITTHEMA WOCHE ${week}</div>
          <h3 class="tp-theme-title">${weekInfo.themeTitle}</h3>
          <p class="tp-theme-focus"><strong>Fokus für ${role.name}:</strong> ${weekInfo.themeFocus}</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tp-theme-goals-summary">
          <span class="tp-goals-badge">🎯 ${this.state.selectedGoals.length} Lernziele aktiv</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- FILTER & DAY CONTROLS BAR -->
      <div class="tp-filter-bar">
        <div class="tp-day-pills">
          <button class="tp-day-pill ${this.state.filterDay === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setDayFilter('all')">Alle Tage (${sessions.length})</button>
          ${["Mo", "Di", "Mi", "Do", "Fr", "Sa", "So"].map((dayName, idx) => {
          const count = sessions.filter(s => s.dayIndex === idx).length;
          return `
              <button class="tp-day-pill ${this.state.filterDay === String(idx) ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setDayFilter('${idx}')">
                ${dayName} ${count > 0 ? `(${count})` : ''}
              </button>
            `;
        }).join('')}
        </div>

        <div class="tp-type-filters">
          <select class="tp-select-filter" onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.setTypeFilter(this.value)">
            <option value="all" ${this.state.filterType === 'all' ? 'selected' : ''}>Alle Trainingsarten</option>
            <option value="theorie" ${this.state.filterType === 'theorie' ? 'selected' : ''}>📖 Theorie & Fundament</option>
            <option value="film" ${this.state.filterType === 'film' ? 'selected' : ''}>🎥 Film Room & Tape</option>
            <option value="technik" ${this.state.filterType === 'technik' ? 'selected' : ''}>⚡ Technik & Feldübungen</option>
            <option value="quiz" ${this.state.filterType === 'quiz' ? 'selected' : ''}>🎯 Entscheidung & Quiz</option>
            <option value="rest" ${this.state.filterType === 'rest' ? 'selected' : ''}>🧘 Wochenabschluss / Review</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- SESSIONS GRID -->
      <div class="tp-sessions-grid">
        ${filteredSessions.length === 0 ? `
          <div class="tp-empty-state">
            <span class="tp-empty-icon">📅</span>
            <h4>Keine Einheiten für diesen Filter</h4>
            <p>Wähle einen anderen Tag oder filtere nach allen Trainingsarten.</p>
            <button class="tp-btn-secondary" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setDayFilter('all'); TrainingPlanEngine.setTypeFilter('all');">Filter zurücksetzen</button>
          </div>
        ` : filteredSessions.map(session => this.renderSessionCard(session, week, weekData)).join('')}
      </div>

      <!-- ROLE CURRICULUM FOOTER WITH DIRECT LAB SHORTCUTS -->
      <div class="tp-footer-tools">
        <h4 class="tp-footer-tools-title">🛠️ Verknüpfte Lab-Werkzeuge für ${role.name}</h4>
        <div class="tp-footer-tools-grid">
          ${role.relatedTools ? role.relatedTools.map(tool => `
            <button class="tp-tool-card-btn" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.jumpToTool('${tool.type}', ${typeof tool.target !== 'undefined' ? (typeof tool.target === 'string' ? `'${tool.target}'` : tool.target) : 'null' })">
              <span class="tp-tool-icon">🚀</span>
              <span class="tp-tool-name">${tool.name}</span>
              <span class="tp-tool-action">${tool.label} ▶</span>
            </button>
          `).join('') : ''}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      },

      renderSessionCard(session, week, weekData) {
        const isCompleted = weekData.completedSessionIds && weekData.completedSessionIds.includes(session.id);
        const isSkipped = weekData.skippedSessionIds && weekData.skippedSessionIds.includes(session.id);
        const currentNote = (weekData.sessionNotes && weekData.sessionNotes[session.id]) || '';

        // Safety badge rendering
        let safetyBadge = '';
        if (session.safetyLevel === 'partner_equipment') {
          safetyBadge = `
        <div class="tp-safety-alert warning">
          <span class="tp-safety-icon">⚠️</span>
          <div class="tp-safety-text">
            <strong>Partner / Schutzausrüstung empfohlen:</strong> Für echten Kontakt Helm & Schulterpolster erforderlich.<br>
            <span class="tp-safety-alt">💡 <strong>Sichere Alternative ohne Partner:</strong> Trockenübungen (Footwork & Hand-Placement) gegen Luft/Dummy oder Film-Study-Analyse!</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
        } else if (session.safetyLevel === 'cones_turf') {
          safetyBadge = `
        <div class="tp-safety-alert info">
          <span class="tp-safety-icon">🟡</span>
          <span class="tp-safety-text"><strong>Platzbedarf:</strong> Freie Rasenfläche oder ca. 5x5m Raum mit 4 Hütchen/Markierungen.</span>
        </div>
      `;
        } else if (session.safetyLevel === 'safe_solo') {
          safetyBadge = `
        <div class="tp-safety-alert safe">
          <span class="tp-safety-icon">🟢</span>
          <span class="tp-safety-text"><strong>Solo & Sicher:</strong> Überall durchführbar – keine Ausrüstung oder Partner erforderlich.</span>
        </div>
      `;
        }

        return `
      <div class="tp-session-card ${isCompleted ? 'completed' : ''} ${isSkipped ? 'skipped' : ''}" id="card-${session.id}">
        <!-- HEADER ROW -->
        <div class="tp-card-header">
          <div class="tp-card-badges">
            <span class="tp-day-badge">${session.day}</span>
            <span class="tp-type-badge ${session.type}">${session.typeLabel || session.type}</span>
            <span class="tp-meta-pill">⏱️ ${session.durationMin} Min</span>
            <span class="tp-diff-pill ${session.difficulty.toLowerCase()}">${session.difficulty}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="tp-card-status">
            ${isCompleted ? '<span class="tp-status-done">✅ Erledigt</span>' : isSkipped ? '<span class="tp-status-skipped">⏭️ Übersprungen</span>' : '<span class="tp-status-pending">⏳ Offen</span>'}
          </div>
        </div>

        <h3 class="tp-card-title">${session.title}</h3>

        ${safetyBadge}

        <!-- THE 3 MANDATORY DIDACTICAL PILLARS -->
        <div class="tp-didactic-boxes">
          <div class="tp-didactic-box was">
            <div class="tp-didactic-header">
              <span class="tp-didactic-icon">📌</span>
              <span class="tp-didactic-label">WAS WIRD TRAINIERT?</span>
            </div>
            <p class="tp-didactic-text">${session.was}</p>

          <div class="tp-didactic-box warum">
            <div class="tp-didactic-header">
              <span class="tp-didactic-icon">💡</span>
              <span class="tp-didactic-label">WARUM IST ES WICHTIG?</span>
            </div>
            <p class="tp-didactic-text">${session.warum}</p>
          </div>

          <div class="tp-didactic-box erfolg">
            <div class="tp-didactic-header">
              <span class="tp-didactic-icon">🎯</span>
              <span class="tp-didactic-label">WORAN ERKENNST DU DEN ERFOLG?</span>
            </div>
            <p class="tp-didactic-text">${session.erfolg}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- ACTIONABLE TASK CHECKLIST -->
        <div class="tp-task-checklist">
          <h4 class="tp-tasks-title">Aufgaben dieser Session:</h4>
          <div class="tp-tasks-list">
            ${session.tasks ? session.tasks.map((task, idx) => {
          const isChecked = !!(weekData.taskStates && weekData.taskStates[`${session.id}_t${idx}`]);
          return `
                <label class="tp-task-item ${isChecked ? 'done' : ''}">
                  <input type="checkbox" ${isChecked ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.toggleTask('${session.id}', ${idx})" />
                  <span class="tp-task-label">${task.text}</span>
                </label>
              `;
        }).join('') : ''}
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- INTEGRATED TOOL LINK (IF AVAILABLE) -->
        ${session.toolLink ? `
          <div class="tp-tool-link-row">
            <button class="tp-btn-tool" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.jumpToTool('${session.toolLink.type}', ${typeof session.toolLink.target === 'string' ? `'${session.toolLink.target}'` : session.toolLink.target})">
              ${session.toolLink.label}
            </button>
            <span class="tp-tool-hint">Direkter Absprung in das interaktive NFL Lab Modul</span>
          </div>
        ` : ''}

        <!-- SESSION NOTES & ACTIONS FOOTER -->
        <div class="tp-card-footer">
          <div class="tp-card-controls">
            <button class="tp-btn-toggle-done ${isCompleted ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.toggleSessionComplete('${session.id}')">
              ${isCompleted ? '↩️ Als offen markieren' : '✅ Session abschließen'}
            </button>
            
            <div class="tp-reschedule-group">
              <label for="reschedule-${session.id}" class="sr-only">Tag verschieben</label>
              <select id="reschedule-${session.id}" class="tp-select-day" onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.rescheduleSession('${session.id}', this.value)">
                <option value="" disabled selected>📅 Verschieben...</option>
                <option value="0">Montag</option>
                <option value="1">Dienstag</option>
                <option value="2">Mittwoch</option>
                <option value="3">Donnerstag</option>
                <option value="4">Freitag</option>
                <option value="5">Samstag</option>
                <option value="6">Sonntag</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <button class="tp-btn-skip ${isSkipped ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.skipSession('${session.id}')">
              ${isSkipped ? 'Wieder aufnehmen' : '⏭️ Überspringen'}
            </button>

            <button class="tp-btn-note-toggle" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.toggleNotes('${session.id}')">
              📝 Notiz ${currentNote ? '•' : ''}
            </button>
          </div>

          <!-- COLLAPSIBLE NOTES FIELD -->
          <div class="tp-notes-drawer" id="notes-${session.id}" style="${currentNote ? 'display: block;' : 'display: none;'}">
            <label class="tp-notes-label">Persönliche Erkenntnisse & Feedback zu dieser Einheit:</label>
            <div class="tp-notes-input-row">
              <input type="text" class="tp-notes-input" id="note-input-${session.id}" placeholder="z.B. Footwork war sauber, beim Release noch zu viel Oberkörper-Pendeln..." value="${currentNote.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}" />
              <button class="tp-btn-save-note" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.saveSessionNote('${session.id}', document.getElementById('note-input-${session.id}').value)">Speichern</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      },

      toggleNotes(sessionId) {
        const el = document.getElementById(`notes-${sessionId}`);
        if (el) {
          el.style.display = el.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
        }

                <div class="tp-role-col-title">DEFENSE</div>
                <div class="tp-role-chips">
                  ${['dl', 'lb', 'cb', 's'].map(id => {
          const r = TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[id];

                <div class="tp-role-chips">

                </button>
                <button class="tp-toggle-btn ${this.state.experienceLevel === 'All-Pro' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setModalLevel('All-Pro')">
                  <strong>All-Pro</strong><br><small>Meisterschaft / Elite</small>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="tp-modal-section">
              <label class="tp-form-label">3. Verfügbare Zeit pro Woche:</label>
              <div class="tp-toggle-buttons" id="tp-budget-toggles">

                <button class="tp-toggle-btn ${this.state.timeBudget === 'standard' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.setModalBudget('standard')">
                  <strong>Standard (~4h)</strong><br><small>5 Sessions / Woche</small>

          <div class="tp-modal-row-grid">

              <select class="tp-modal-select" id="tp-modal-env" onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.state.environment = this.value">
                <option value="solo" ${this.state.environment === 'solo' ? 'selected' : ''}>Solo auf Rasen / Hütchen (Kein Partner erforderlich)</option>
                <option value="theory" ${this.state.environment === 'theory' ? 'selected' : ''}>Digital / Theorie & Film Study (Schreibtisch / Sofa)</option>
                <option value="team" ${this.state.environment === 'team' ? 'selected' : ''}>Team / Ausrüstung & Partner vorhanden</option>
              </select>

              <select class="tp-modal-select" id="tp-modal-method" onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.state.learningMethod = this.value">
                <option value="balanced" ${this.state.learningMethod === 'balanced' ? 'selected' : ''}>Ausgewogen (Theorie, Film Room & Feldübungen)</option>
                <option value="practical" ${this.state.learningMethod === 'practical' ? 'selected' : ''}>Praxisorientiert (Fokus auf Drills & Mechanik)</option>
                <option value="analytical" ${this.state.learningMethod === 'analytical' ? 'selected' : ''}>Taktisch & Analytisch (Film Study & Playbook)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- STEP 4: GOALS CHECKLIST -->
          <div class="tp-modal-section">
            <label class="tp-form-label">6. Persönliche Lernziele für ${currentRole.name}:</label>
            <div class="tp-goals-checklist" id="tp-modal-goals-list">
              ${(currentRole.defaultGoals || []).map(goal => {
          const isSelected = this.state.selectedGoals.includes(goal);
          return `
                  <label class="tp-goal-item">
                    <input type="checkbox" ${isSelected ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="TrainingPlanEngine.toggleModalGoal('${goal.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" />

        }).join('')}
