        <div class="tp-modal-footer">
          <button class="tp-btn-secondary" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.closeConfigModal()">Abbrechen</button>
          <button class="tp-btn-primary" onclick="TrainingPlanEngine.saveModalConfig()">Einstellungen übernehmen</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;

        modal.style.display = 'flex';
      },

      selectModalRole(roleId) {
        this.state.activeRole = roleId;
        this.setDefaultGoalsForRole(roleId);
        this.openConfigModal();
      },

      setModalLevel(level) {
        this.state.experienceLevel = level;
        document.querySelectorAll('#tp-level-toggles .tp-toggle-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle('active', b.textContent.includes(level));
        });
      },

      setModalBudget(budget) {
        this.state.timeBudget = budget;
        document.querySelectorAll('#tp-budget-toggles .tp-toggle-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle('active', b.onclick.toString().includes(budget));
        });
      },

      toggleModalGoal(goal) {
        if (this.state.selectedGoals.includes(goal)) {
          this.state.selectedGoals = this.state.selectedGoals.filter(g => g !== goal);
        } else {
          this.state.selectedGoals.push(goal);
        }
      },

      saveModalConfig() {
        this.state.configured = true;
        this.saveState();
        this.closeConfigModal();
        this.render();
        this.showToast(`🎉 Trainingsplan für ${TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[this.state.activeRole].name} aktualisiert!`);
      },

      closeConfigModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('tp-config-modal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
      },

      showToast(msg) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast(msg);
        } else {
          let toast = document.getElementById('tp-toast');
          if (!toast) {
            toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.id = 'tp-toast';
            toast.className = 'tp-toast';
            document.body.appendChild(toast);
          }
          toast.textContent = msg;
          toast.classList.add('show');
          setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
        }
      }
    };


    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META = TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META;
      window.TRAINING_PLAN_CURRICULUM = TRAINING_PLAN_CURRICULUM;
      window.TrainingPlanEngine = TrainingPlanEngine;
    }



    // ========================================================================// ========================================================================// ========================================================================// ========================================================================// ==========================================================================
    // NFL FOOTBALL LAB: USER PROFILE & DATA MANAGEMENT ENGINE
    // Centralized Profile, Telemetry Dashboard, Data Backup & Granular Resets
    // 100% Client-Side, Zero Mandatory Account, GitHub Pages Compatible
    // ==========================================================================

    const UserProfileEngine = {
      storageKey: 'nfl_user_profile_v1',

      state: {
        displayName: 'Football Analyst',
        preferredLearnPath: 'general', // 'general', 'player', 'coach', 'training_plan'
        roleId: 'qb', // syncs with TrainingPlanEngine
        experienceLevel: 'Rookie', // 'Rookie', 'Varsity', 'All-Pro'
        learningGoals: [
          'Coverages vor dem Snap lesen',
          'Playbook-Konzepte & Schemes verstehen'
        ],
        customGoal: '',
        themePreference: 'system', // 'system', 'dark', 'light'
        favoriteTeam: 'KC', // Team ID from NFL_TEAMS_DATA
        avatarIcon: '🏈',
        notes: '',
        createdAt: null,
        updatedAt: null
      },

      allAppKeys: [
        'nfl',
        'nfl_trainer',
        'nfl_recents',
        'nfl_active_learn_path',
        'nfl_player_progress',
        'nfl_coach_progress',
        'nfl_film_room_stats',
        'nfl_vision_stats',
        'nfl_call_stats',
        'nfl_mastery_progress_v2',
        'nfl_my_plays',
        'nfl_madden_mode',
        'nfl_command_tierlist_v1',
        'nfl_team_builder_rosters_v2',
        'nfl_team_builder_active_v2',
        'nfl_theme',
        'nfl_training_plan_v1',
        'nfl_user_profile_v1'
      ],

      init() {
        this.loadState();
        this.applyTheme(this.state.themePreference, false);
        this.syncWithTrainingPlan();
        this.updateHeaderProfileBadge();
      },

      loadState() {
        try {
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(this.storageKey);
          if (saved) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
              this.state = Object.assign({}, this.state, parsed);
            }
          } else {
            this.state.createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
            this.state.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
            this.saveState();
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[UserProfile] Failed to load profile:', e);
        }
      },

      saveState() {
        try {
          this.state.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
          localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(this.state));
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[UserProfile] Failed to save profile:', e);
        }
        this.updateHeaderProfileBadge();
      },

      syncWithTrainingPlan() {
        if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined' && TrainingPlanEngine.state) {
          if (TrainingPlanEngine.state.activeRole) {
            this.state.roleId = TrainingPlanEngine.state.activeRole;
          }
          if (TrainingPlanEngine.state.experienceLevel) {
            this.state.experienceLevel = TrainingPlanEngine.state.experienceLevel;
          }
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // THEME MANAGEMENT (Dark, Light, System)
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      applyTheme(pref, save = true) {
        if (!['system', 'dark', 'light'].includes(pref)) pref = 'system';
        this.state.themePreference = pref;
        if (save) this.saveState();

        const root = document.documentElement;
        let effectiveTheme = 'dark';

        if (pref === 'dark') {
          effectiveTheme = 'dark';
        } else if (pref === 'light') {
          effectiveTheme = 'light';
        } else {
          // System mode: inspect OS preference
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia) {
            effectiveTheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
          }
        }

        root.dataset.theme = effectiveTheme;
        if (save) {
          try {
            localStorage.setItem('nfl_theme', effectiveTheme);
          } catch (e) { }
        }

        // Update toggle button text if present
        const thBtn = document.getElementById('th');
        if (thBtn) {
          thBtn.textContent = effectiveTheme === 'dark' ? '🌙' : '☀️';
          thBtn.title = `Theme: ${pref.toUpperCase()} (${effectiveTheme})`;
        }
      },

      setThemePreference(pref) {
        this.applyTheme(pref, true);
        this.showToast(`🎨 Theme auf "${pref === 'system' ? 'Systemeinstellung' : pref === 'dark' ? 'Dark Mode' : 'Light Mode'}" gesetzt.`);
        this.render();
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // REAL COMPUTED METRICS (100% calculated from actual storage)
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      getCalculatedStats() {
        // 1. Learning Paths progress
        const genDone = (typeof doneLessons !== 'undefined' && doneLessons) ? Object.keys(doneLessons).filter(k => doneLessons[k]).length : 0;
        const genTotal = (typeof L !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(L)) ? L.length : 19;
        const genPct = genTotal > 0 ? Math.round((genDone / genTotal) * 100) : 0;

        const playDone = (typeof donePlayerModules !== 'undefined' && donePlayerModules) ? Object.keys(donePlayerModules).filter(k => donePlayerModules[k]).length : 0;
        const playTotal = (typeof PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA)) ? PLAYER_LEARNING_DATA.length : 19;
        const playPct = playTotal > 0 ? Math.round((playDone / playTotal) * 100) : 0;

        const coachDone = (typeof doneCoachModules !== 'undefined' && doneCoachModules) ? Object.keys(doneCoachModules).filter(k => doneCoachModules[k]).length : 0;
        const coachTotal = (typeof COACH_LEARNING_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(COACH_LEARNING_DATA)) ? COACH_LEARNING_DATA.length : 12;
        const coachPct = coachTotal > 0 ? Math.round((coachDone / coachTotal) * 100) : 0;

        const totalDone = genDone + playDone + coachDone;
        const totalAll = genTotal + playTotal + coachTotal;
        const totalPct = totalAll > 0 ? Math.round((totalDone / totalAll) * 100) : 0;

        // Mastery Stage & Rank
        const mastery = typeof getMasteryData === 'function' ? getMasteryData() : { rank: 'Level 1: Rookie', stage: 1, desc: 'Grundlagen & Downs' };

        // 2. Training Plan Live Data
        let tpStats = {
          activeRole: this.state.roleId || 'qb',
          roleName: 'Quarterback',
          roleBadge: 'FIELD GENERAL',
          roleIcon: '🎯',
          currentWeek: 1,
          weekCompleted: 0,
          weekTotal: 0,
          weekPercent: 0,
          totalSessionsDone: 0,
          streak: 0,
          totalHours: '0.0'
        };

        if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined' && TrainingPlanEngine.state) {
          const rId = TrainingPlanEngine.state.activeRole || this.state.roleId || 'qb';
          const rMeta = (typeof TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META !== 'undefined' && TRAINING_PLAN_ROLES_META[rId]) || {};
          const wStats = TrainingPlanEngine.getWeekStats(TrainingPlanEngine.state.currentWeek);

          // Compute total completed sessions across all 4 weeks
          let allSessionsDone = 0;
          let allDurationMin = 0;
          for (let w = 1; w <= 4; w++) {
            const wData = TrainingPlanEngine.state.weeksHistory && TrainingPlanEngine.state.weeksHistory[w];
            if (wData && wData.completedSessionIds) {
              allSessionsDone += wData.completedSessionIds.length;
            }
          }

          tpStats = {
            activeRole: rId,
            roleName: rMeta.name || 'Quarterback',
            roleBadge: rMeta.badge || 'FIELD GENERAL',
            roleIcon: rMeta.icon || '🎯',
            currentWeek: TrainingPlanEngine.state.currentWeek,
            weekCompleted: wStats.completedCount,
            weekTotal: wStats.totalSessions,
            weekPercent: wStats.percent,
            totalSessionsDone: allSessionsDone,
            streak: TrainingPlanEngine.state.streak || 0,
            totalHours: wStats.completedHours
          };
        }

        // 3. Quiz & Practice Challenge Telemetry
        const quizScore = (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined' && typeof trainerState.score === 'number') ? trainerState.score : 0;
        const quizStreak = (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined' && typeof trainerState.streak === 'number') ? trainerState.streak : 0;
        const quizQuestionsAnswered = (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined' && typeof trainerState.curIndex === 'number') ? trainerState.curIndex : 0;

        // Tactical stats
        let filmCount = 0;
        try {
          const rawFilm = localStorage.getItem('nfl_film_room_stats');
          if (rawFilm) {
            const p = JSON.parse(rawFilm);
            filmCount = p.scenariosViewed ? Object.keys(p.scenariosViewed).length : 0;
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        let visionSuccess = 0;
        try {
          const rawVision = localStorage.getItem('nfl_vision_stats');
          if (rawVision) {
            const p = JSON.parse(rawVision);
            visionSuccess = p.correctCount || 0;
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        let callCalls = 0;
        try {
          const rawCalls = localStorage.getItem('nfl_call_stats');
          if (rawCalls) {
            const p = JSON.parse(rawCalls);
            callCalls = p.totalCalls || 0;
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        // 4. Creative Tools Data
        let myPlaysCount = 0;
        if (typeof pbState !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(pbState.myPlays) && pbState.myPlays.length > 0) {
          myPlaysCount = pbState.myPlays.length;
        } else {
          try {
            const rawPlays = localStorage.getItem('nfl_my_plays');
            if (rawPlays) myPlaysCount = JSON.parse(rawPlays).length;
          } catch (e) { }
        }

        let savedRostersCount = 0;
        if (typeof savedRostersList !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(savedRostersList) && savedRostersList.length > 0) {
          savedRostersCount = savedRostersList.length;
        } else {
          try {
            const rawRosters = localStorage.getItem('nfl_team_builder_rosters_v2');
            if (rawRosters) savedRostersCount = JSON.parse(rawRosters).length;
          } catch (e) { }
        }

        let tierlistTeamsPlaced = 0;
        try {
          const rawTier = localStorage.getItem('nfl_command_tierlist_v1');
          if (rawTier) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(rawTier);
            if (parsed && parsed.teams) {
              tierlistTeamsPlaced = Object.values(parsed.teams).filter(tier => tier !== 'unassigned').length;
            }
          }
        } catch (e) { }

        return {
          general: { done: genDone, total: genTotal, percent: genPct },
          player: { done: playDone, total: playTotal, percent: playPct },
          coach: { done: coachDone, total: coachTotal, percent: coachPct },
          mastery: { totalDone, totalAll, percent: totalPct, rank: mastery.rank, stage: mastery.stage, desc: mastery.desc },
          trainingPlan: tpStats,
          quizzes: { score: quizScore, streak: quizStreak, answered: quizQuestionsAnswered },
          tactical: { filmViewed: filmCount, visionScore: visionSuccess, playCalls: callCalls },
          creative: { playsCount: myPlaysCount, rostersCount: savedRostersCount, tierlistPlaced: tierlistTeamsPlaced }
        };
      },

      updateHeaderProfileBadge() {
        const badge = document.getElementById('mastery-badge');
        if (badge) {
          badge.innerHTML = `<span style="margin-right: 4px;">${this.state.avatarIcon || '🏈'}</span> ${this.state.displayName || 'Profil'}`;
          badge.title = `Profil: ${this.state.displayName} (${this.state.experienceLevel}) - Klicke für Details`;
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // USER PROFILE EDITING ACTIONS
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      saveProfileForm() {
        const nameInput = document.getElementById('prof-input-name');
        if (nameInput) {
          const name = nameInput.value.trim();
          if (name) this.state.displayName = name;
        }

        const pathSelect = document.getElementById('prof-select-path');
        if (pathSelect) this.state.preferredLearnPath = pathSelect.value;

        const roleSelect = document.getElementById('prof-select-role');
        if (roleSelect) {
          this.state.roleId = roleSelect.value;
          // Sync with TrainingPlanEngine
          if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined') {
            TrainingPlanEngine.selectRole(this.state.roleId);
          }
        }

        const teamSelect = document.getElementById('prof-select-team');
        if (teamSelect) this.state.favoriteTeam = teamSelect.value;

        const avatarSelect = document.getElementById('prof-select-avatar');
        if (avatarSelect) this.state.avatarIcon = avatarSelect.value;

        this.saveState();
        this.render();
        this.showToast('✅ Persönliche Einstellungen erfolgreich gespeichert!');
      },

      setExperienceLevel(lvl) {
        this.state.experienceLevel = lvl;
        if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined') {
          TrainingPlanEngine.state.experienceLevel = lvl;
          TrainingPlanEngine.saveState();
        }
        this.saveState();
        this.render();
        this.showToast(`🎯 Erfahrungsniveau auf "${lvl}" gesetzt.`);
      },

      toggleGoal(goalText) {
        if (this.state.learningGoals.includes(goalText)) {
          this.state.learningGoals = this.state.learningGoals.filter(g => g !== goalText);
        } else {
          this.state.learningGoals.push(goalText);
        }
        this.saveState();
        this.render();
      },

      addCustomGoal(text) {
        text = (text || '').trim();
        if (!text) return;
        if (!this.state.learningGoals.includes(text)) {
          this.state.learningGoals.push(text);
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
          this.showToast(`🎯 Neues Lernziel hinzugefügt: "${text}"`);
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // DATA MANAGEMENT: BACKUP EXPORT & IMPORT
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      exportAllUserData() {
        const backup = {
          app: 'NFL Football Lab',
          version: '2.0',
          exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          profile: this.state,
          data: {}
        };

        this.allAppKeys.forEach(k => {
          const val = localStorage.getItem(k);
          if (val !== null) {
            try {
              backup.data[k] = JSON.parse(val);
            } catch (e) {
              backup.data[k] = val;
            }
          }
        });

        const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(backup, null, 2);
        const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        const dateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        a.href = url;
        a.download = `nfl_football_lab_backup_${dateStr}.json`;
        document.body.appendChild(a);
        a.click();
        document.body.removeChild(a);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

        this.showToast('📥 Backup-Datei erfolgreich heruntergeladen!');
      },

      triggerImportModal() {
        let input = document.getElementById('prof-file-input');
        if (!input) {
          input = document.createElement('input');
          input.type = 'file';
          input.id = 'prof-file-input';
          input.accept = '.json,application/json';
          input.style.display = 'none';
          input.onchange = (e) => {
            const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
            if (file) {
              const reader = new FileReader();
              reader.onload = (evt) => {
                UserProfileEngine.processImportedData(evt.target.result);
              };
              reader.readAsText(file);
            }
          };
          document.body.appendChild(input);
        }
        input.value = '';
        input.click();
      },

      processImportedData(jsonText) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonText);
          if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') {
            alert('Ungültiges Datenformat: Die Datei enthält kein gültiges JSON-Objekt.');
            return;
          }

          if (!confirm('Möchtest du dieses Backup wirklich importieren? Alle aktuellen lokalen Daten werden mit dem Stand aus der Datei überschrieben.')) {
            return;
          }

          // Restore profile
          if (parsed.profile && typeof parsed.profile === 'object') {
            this.state = Object.assign({}, this.state, parsed.profile);
            localStorage.setItem(this.storageKey, JSON.stringify(this.state));
          }

          // Restore app keys
          if (parsed.data && typeof parsed.data === 'object') {
            Object.keys(parsed.data).forEach(k => {
              if (this.allAppKeys.includes(k)) {
                const v = parsed.data[k];
                localStorage.setItem(k, typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v));
              }
            });
          }

          // Re-initialize in-memory states
          if (typeof doneLessons !== 'undefined') {
            try { doneLessons = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nfl') || '{}'); } catch (e) { }
          }
          if (typeof donePlayerModules !== 'undefined') {
            try { donePlayerModules = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nfl_player_progress') || '{}'); } catch (e) { }
          }
          if (typeof doneCoachModules !== 'undefined') {
            try { doneCoachModules = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nfl_coach_progress') || '{}'); } catch (e) { }
          }
          if (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined') {
            try { Object.assign(trainerState, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nfl_trainer') || '{}')); } catch (e) { }
          }
          if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined') {
            TrainingPlanEngine.init();
          }

          this.init();
          this.render();
          if (typeof updateMasteryBadge === 'function') updateMasteryBadge();
          if (typeof updateLearnPathBadges === 'function') updateLearnPathBadges();

          this.showToast('📤 Backup erfolgreich importiert und aktiviert!');
        } catch (err) {
          alert(`Fehler beim Lesen der Backup-Datei: ${err.message}`);
        }
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // GRANULAR RESETS (Targeted scope without wiping everything)
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      resetTrainingPlanOnly() {
        if (!confirm('⚠️ Trainingsplan zurücksetzen?\n\nBetroffene Daten:\n• Alle 4 Wochenpläne und deren Aufgaben-Häkchen\n• Sämtliche Session-Notizen\n• Verschobene Tage und Streak\n\nDeine allgemeinen Lektionen, Quizzes und Entwürfe bleiben vollständig erhalten.')) {
          return;
        }

        localStorage.removeItem('nfl_training_plan_v1');
        if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined') {
          TrainingPlanEngine.state = {
            configured: false,
            activeRole: this.state.roleId || 'qb',
            experienceLevel: this.state.experienceLevel || 'Rookie',
            timeBudget: 'standard',
            environment: 'solo',
            learningMethod: 'balanced',
            selectedGoals: [],
            customGoal: '',
            currentWeek: 1,
            streak: 0,
            lastCompletedDate: null,
            filterDay: 'all',
            filterType: 'all',
            weeksHistory: {
              1: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              2: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              3: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              4: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} }
            }
          };
          TrainingPlanEngine.render();
        }

        this.render();
        this.showToast('🔄 Trainingsplan wurde vollständig auf Anfang zurückgesetzt.');
      },

      resetLearningProgressOnly() {
        if (!confirm('⚠️ Lernfortschritte & Quizzes zurücksetzen?\n\nBetroffene Daten:\n• Abgeschlossene Lektionen (Allgemeines Football-Wissen)\n• Abgeschlossene Spielerausbildungs-Module\n• Abgeschlossene Coachausbildungs-Module\n• Rules Trainer Punktestand & Streak\n• All-22 Film Room & Vision Challenge Telemetrie\n\nDein Trainingsplan, Roster und persönliche Spieleentwürfe bleiben erhalten.')) {
          return;
        }

        const learnKeys = [
          'nfl',
          'nfl_trainer',
          'nfl_player_progress',
          'nfl_coach_progress',
          'nfl_mastery_progress_v2',
          'nfl_film_room_stats',
          'nfl_vision_stats',
          'nfl_call_stats'
        ];

        learnKeys.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));

        if (typeof doneLessons !== 'undefined') doneLessons = {};
        if (typeof donePlayerModules !== 'undefined') donePlayerModules = {};
        if (typeof doneCoachModules !== 'undefined') doneCoachModules = {};
        if (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined') {
          trainerState = { curIndex: 0, score: 0, streak: 0, answered: false };
        }
        if (typeof progressEngine !== 'undefined') {
          progressEngine.state.topicStates = {};
          progressEngine.state.recentActivities = [];
          progressEngine.calculateSkillRatings();
          progressEngine.saveState();
        }

        if (typeof updateMasteryBadge === 'function') updateMasteryBadge();
        if (typeof updateLearnPathBadges === 'function') updateLearnPathBadges();

        this.render();
        this.showToast('🔄 Lernfortschritte & Quiz-Ergebnisse wurden zurückgesetzt.');
      },

      resetCreativeToolsOnly() {
        if (!confirm('⚠️ Eigene Entwürfe & Werkzeuge zurücksetzen?\n\nBetroffene Daten:\n• Gespeicherte Spielzüge im Play Builder\n• Erstellte Roster im Team Builder\n• Deine individuelle 32-Teams-Tierlist\n\nDein Profil und sämtliche Lernfortschritte bleiben erhalten.')) {
          return;
        }

        const toolKeys = [
          'nfl_my_plays',
          'nfl_command_tierlist_v1',
          'nfl_team_builder_rosters_v2',
          'nfl_team_builder_active_v2'
        ];

        toolKeys.forEach(k => localStorage.removeItem(k));

        if (typeof pbState !== 'undefined') pbState.myPlays = [];
        if (typeof userTierlistState !== 'undefined' && typeof NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS !== 'undefined') {
          userTierlistState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS));
          userTierlistState.unranked = [];
        }
        if (typeof renderTierlistCanvas === 'function') renderTierlistCanvas();
        if (typeof savedRostersList !== 'undefined') savedRostersList = [];

        this.render();
        this.showToast('🔄 Spielzüge, Roster und Tierlist wurden zurückgesetzt.');
      },

        modal.innerHTML = `

          <button class="prof-btn-secondary" onclick="UserProfileEngine.closeFullResetModal()">Abbrechen</button>

    `;

        modal.style.display = 'flex';
      },

      closeFullResetModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('prof-full-reset-modal');
        if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
      },

      checkResetKeyword(val) {
        const btn = document.getElementById('prof-btn-do-full-reset');
        if (btn) {
          const match = (val || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'LÖSCHEN' || (val || '').trim().toUpperCase() === 'RESET';
          btn.disabled = !match;
        }
      },

      executeFullReset() {
        // 1. Strictly remove all app-specific keys
        this.allAppKeys.forEach(k => {
          try { localStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) { }
        });
        try { sessionStorage.removeItem('nfl_portal_entered_v1'); } catch (e) { }

        // 2. Re-initialize in-memory states to clean defaults
        if (typeof doneLessons !== 'undefined') doneLessons = {};
        if (typeof donePlayerModules !== 'undefined') donePlayerModules = {};
        if (typeof doneCoachModules !== 'undefined') doneCoachModules = {};
        if (typeof trainerState !== 'undefined') {
          trainerState = { curIndex: 0, score: 0, streak: 0, answered: false };
        }
        if (typeof pbState !== 'undefined') pbState.myPlays = [];
        if (typeof userTierlistState !== 'undefined' && typeof NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS !== 'undefined') {
          userTierlistState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(NFL_DEFAULT_TIERS));
          userTierlistState.unranked = [];
        }
        if (typeof renderTierlistCanvas === 'function') renderTierlistCanvas();
        if (typeof savedRostersList !== 'undefined') savedRostersList = [];
        if (typeof currentRoster !== 'undefined') currentRoster = {};

        if (typeof progressEngine !== 'undefined') {
          progressEngine.state.topicStates = {};
          progressEngine.state.recentActivities = [];
          progressEngine.calculateSkillRatings();
        }

        if (typeof TrainingPlanEngine !== 'undefined') {
          TrainingPlanEngine.state = {
            configured: false,
            activeRole: 'qb',
            experienceLevel: 'Rookie',
            timeBudget: 'standard',
            environment: 'solo',
            learningMethod: 'balanced',
            selectedGoals: [],
            customGoal: '',
            currentWeek: 1,
            streak: 0,
            lastCompletedDate: null,
            filterDay: 'all',
            filterType: 'all',
            weeksHistory: {
              1: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              2: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              3: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} },
              4: { completedSessionIds: [], taskStates: {}, sessionDayOverrides: {}, skippedSessionIds: [], sessionNotes: {} }
            }
          };
        }

        // Reset profile state in memory
        this.state = {
          displayName: 'Football Analyst',
          preferredLearnPath: 'general',
          roleId: 'qb',
          experienceLevel: 'Rookie',
          learningGoals: [
            'Coverages vor dem Snap lesen',
            'Playbook-Konzepte & Schemes verstehen'
          ],
          customGoal: '',
          themePreference: 'system',
          favoriteTeam: 'KC',
          avatarIcon: '🏈',
          notes: '',
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()
        };
        this.updateHeaderProfileBadge();

        // 3. Close modal & update all badges
        this.closeFullResetModal();
        this.applyTheme('system', false);
        if (typeof updateMasteryBadge === 'function') updateMasteryBadge();
        if (typeof updateLearnPathBadges === 'function') updateLearnPathBadges();

        // 4. Return to home view
        if (typeof setView === 'function') setView('home');

        this.showToast('🧹 Alle lokalen Daten wurden vollständig auf Werkseinstellung zurückgesetzt.');
      },

            <p class="prof-section-sub">Präzise aufgeschlüsselt nach den drei Akademie-Pfaden, Quizzes und praktischen Lab-Simulationen.</p>
          </div>
          <button class="prof-btn-link" onclick="setView('progress')">Mastery-Radar öffnen ➔</button>
        </div>

        <div class="prof-paths-grid">
          <!-- GENERAL PATH -->
          <div class="prof-path-card">
            <div class="prof-path-header">
              <span class="prof-path-icon">📖</span>
              <div>
                <h3 class="prof-path-name">Allgemeines Football-Wissen</h3>
                <span class="prof-path-meta">Regeln, Downs, Taktik, Coverages & Statistik</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-stats">
              <div class="prof-path-num-row">
                <span class="prof-num">${stats.general.done} <small>/ ${stats.general.total}</small></span>
                <span class="prof-pct">${stats.general.percent}%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="prof-tele-bar"><div class="prof-tele-bar-fill" style="width: ${stats.general.percent}%;"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-footer">
              <button class="prof-btn-action" onclick="switchLearnPath('general'); setView('learn');">
                ${stats.general.done > 0 ? 'Lernen fortsetzen ➔' : 'Kapitel 1 starten ➔'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- PLAYER PATH -->
          <div class="prof-path-card">
            <div class="prof-path-header">
              <span class="prof-path-icon">🏈</span>
              <div>
                <h3 class="prof-path-name">Spielerausbildung</h3>
                <span class="prof-path-meta">Footwork, Reads, Technik & Hawk Tackling</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-stats">
              <div class="prof-path-num-row">
                <span class="prof-num">${stats.player.done} <small>/ ${stats.player.total}</small></span>
                <span class="prof-pct">${stats.player.percent}%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="prof-tele-bar"><div class="prof-tele-bar-fill green" style="width: ${stats.player.percent}%;"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-footer">
              <button class="prof-btn-action" onclick="switchLearnPath('player'); setView('learn');">
                Spieler-Module öffnen ➔
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- COACH PATH -->
          <div class="prof-path-card">
            <div class="prof-path-header">
              <span class="prof-path-icon">🧠</span>
              <div>
                <h3 class="prof-path-name">Coachausbildung</h3>
                <span class="prof-path-meta">Schemes, Playcalling, Gameplan & Führung</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-stats">
              <div class="prof-path-num-row">
                <span class="prof-num">${stats.coach.done} <small>/ ${stats.coach.total}</small></span>
                <span class="prof-pct">${stats.coach.percent}%</span>
              </div>
              <div class="prof-tele-bar"><div class="prof-tele-bar-fill purple" style="width: ${stats.coach.percent}%;"></div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="prof-path-footer">
              <button class="prof-btn-action" onclick="switchLearnPath('coach'); setView('learn');">
                Coach-Module öffnen ➔
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- SECONDARY TELEMETRY CARDS -->
        <div class="prof-secondary-grid">
          <div class="prof-sec-card">
            <div class="prof-sec-header">
              <span class="prof-sec-icon">📅</span>
              <h4>Trainingsplan-Status</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-sec-body">
              Rolle: <strong>${stats.trainingPlan.roleName}</strong> • Aktuelle Phase: <strong>Woche ${stats.trainingPlan.currentWeek}</strong><br>
              ${stats.trainingPlan.weekCompleted} von ${stats.trainingPlan.weekTotal} Einheiten diese Woche abgeschlossen (${stats.trainingPlan.weekPercent}%).
            </p>
            <button class="prof-sec-btn" onclick="switchLearnPath('training_plan'); setView('learn');">
              Wochenplan öffnen & bearbeiten ➔
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="prof-sec-card">
            <div class="prof-sec-header">
              <span class="prof-sec-icon">🎯</span>
              <h4>Praxis-Challenges & Quizzes</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-sec-body">
              Rules Trainer: <strong>${stats.quizzes.score} Punkte</strong> (${stats.quizzes.answered} Fragen gelöst)<br>
              Film Room Breakdowns: <strong>${stats.tactical.filmViewed} Tape-Scenarios</strong> analysiert.
            </p>
            <button class="prof-sec-btn" onclick="setView('challenges');">
              Challenges & Quizzes starten ➔
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="prof-sec-card">
            <div class="prof-sec-header">
              <span class="prof-sec-icon">⚡</span>
              <h4>Taktische Werkzeuge</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-sec-body">
              Play Builder: <strong>${stats.creative.playsCount} eigene Plays</strong> gespeichert.<br>
              Team Builder: <strong>${stats.creative.rostersCount} Roster</strong> angelegt • Tierlist: <strong>${stats.creative.tierlistPlaced} Teams</strong> platziert.
            </p>
            <button class="prof-sec-btn" onclick="setView('playbuilder');">
              Zum Play Builder wechseln ➔
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- 3. PERSONAL SETTINGS & PROFILE CONFIGURATION -->
      <div class="prof-section-card" id="prof-settings-section">
        <div class="prof-section-header">
          <div>
            <h2 class="prof-section-title">Persönliche Einstellungen & Präferenzen</h2>
            <p class="prof-section-sub">Passe deinen Auftritt, deine Football-Rolle und deine bevorzugte Darstellung an. Keine Pflichtregistrierung, alles bleibt lokal.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="prof-form-grid">
          <!-- COLUMN 1: IDENTITY & ROLE -->
          <div class="prof-form-col">
            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label" for="prof-input-name">Anzeigename / Nickname:</label>
              <input type="text" id="prof-input-name" class="prof-input" value="${this.escapeHtml(this.state.displayName)}" placeholder="z. B. Coach Miller, Field General" />
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label" for="prof-select-path">Bevorzugter Lernpfad:</label>
              <select id="prof-select-path" class="prof-select">
                <option value="general" ${this.state.preferredLearnPath === 'general' ? 'selected' : ''}>📖 Allgemeines Football-Wissen</option>
                <option value="player" ${this.state.preferredLearnPath === 'player' ? 'selected' : ''}>🏈 Spielerausbildung (Positionsspezifisch)</option>
                <option value="coach" ${this.state.preferredLearnPath === 'coach' ? 'selected' : ''}>🧠 Coachausbildung (Schemes & Playcalling)</option>
                <option value="training_plan" ${this.state.preferredLearnPath === 'training_plan' ? 'selected' : ''}>📅 Mein persönlicher Trainingsplan</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label" for="prof-select-role">Football-Rolle & Position (14 Rollen):</label>
              <select id="prof-select-role" class="prof-select">
                <optgroup label="Offense">
                  <option value="qb" ${this.state.roleId === 'qb' ? 'selected' : ''}>Quarterback (QB)</option>
                  <option value="rb" ${this.state.roleId === 'rb' ? 'selected' : ''}>Running Back (RB)</option>
                  <option value="wr" ${this.state.roleId === 'wr' ? 'selected' : ''}>Wide Receiver (WR)</option>
                  <option value="te" ${this.state.roleId === 'te' ? 'selected' : ''}>Tight End (TE)</option>
                  <option value="ol" ${this.state.roleId === 'ol' ? 'selected' : ''}>Offensive Line (OL)</option>
                </optgroup>
                <optgroup label="Defense">
                  <option value="dl" ${this.state.roleId === 'dl' ? 'selected' : ''}>Defensive Line (DL)</option>
                  <option value="lb" ${this.state.roleId === 'lb' ? 'selected' : ''}>Linebacker (LB)</option>
                  <option value="cb" ${this.state.roleId === 'cb' ? 'selected' : ''}>Cornerback (CB)</option>
                  <option value="s" ${this.state.roleId === 's' ? 'selected' : ''}>Safety (S)</option>
                </optgroup>
                <optgroup label="Special Teams">
                  <option value="st" ${this.state.roleId === 'st' ? 'selected' : ''}>Special Teams Unit (ST)</option>
                </optgroup>
                <optgroup label="Coaching Staff">
                  <option value="position_coach" ${this.state.roleId === 'position_coach' ? 'selected' : ''}>Position Coach</option>
                  <option value="oc" ${this.state.roleId === 'oc' ? 'selected' : ''}>Offensive Coordinator (OC)</option>
                  <option value="dc" ${this.state.roleId === 'dc' ? 'selected' : ''}>Defensive Coordinator (DC)</option>
                  <option value="hc" ${this.state.roleId === 'hc' ? 'selected' : ''}>Head Coach (HC)</option>
                </optgroup>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label">Erfahrungsniveau:</label>
              <div class="prof-toggle-row">
                ${['Rookie', 'Varsity', 'All-Pro'].map(lvl => `
                  <button type="button" class="prof-toggle-btn ${this.state.experienceLevel === lvl ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="UserProfileEngine.setExperienceLevel('${lvl}')">
                    <strong>${lvl}</strong>
                  </button>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <!-- COLUMN 2: APPEARANCE & TEAM -->
          <div class="prof-form-col">
            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label">Bevorzugte Darstellung (Theme):</label>
              <div class="prof-toggle-row">
                <button type="button" class="prof-toggle-btn ${this.state.themePreference === 'dark' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="UserProfileEngine.setThemePreference('dark')">
                  🌙 Dark Mode
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="prof-toggle-btn ${this.state.themePreference === 'light' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="UserProfileEngine.setThemePreference('light')">
                  ☀️ Light Mode
                </button>
                <button type="button" class="prof-toggle-btn ${this.state.themePreference === 'system' ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="UserProfileEngine.setThemePreference('system')">
                  💻 System
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label" for="prof-select-team">Lieblings-NFL-Team (32 Franchises):</label>
              <select id="prof-select-team" class="prof-select">
                <option value="none" ${this.state.favoriteTeam === 'none' ? 'selected' : ''}>Kein Lieblingsteam (Neutraler Analyst)</option>
                ${(typeof NFL_TEAMS_DATA !== 'undefined' && Array.isArray(NFL_TEAMS_DATA)) ? NFL_TEAMS_DATA.map(t => `
                  <option value="${t.id}" ${this.state.favoriteTeam === t.id ? 'selected' : ''}>
                    ${t.name} (${t.conf} ${t.division})
                  </option>
                `).join('') : ''}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label" for="prof-select-avatar">Avatar-Symbol:</label>
              <select id="prof-select-avatar" class="prof-select">
                ${['🏈', '🎯', '🧠', '🛡️', '⚡', '🏛️', '🔥', '👑', '📋', '⭐'].map(ic => `
                  <option value="${ic}" ${this.state.avatarIcon === ic ? 'selected' : ''}>${ic} Symbol</option>
                `).join('')}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="prof-form-group">
              <label class="prof-form-label">Persönliche Lernziele:</label>
              <div class="prof-goals-cloud">
                ${this.state.learningGoals.map(g => `
                  <span class="prof-goal-pill">
                    ${g}
                    <button type="button" class="prof-goal-rm" onclick="UserProfileEngine.toggleGoal('${this.escapeHtml(g)}')" title="Entfernen">✕</button>
                  </span>
                `).join('')}
              </div>
              <div class="prof-add-goal-row">
                <input type="text" id="prof-new-goal-input" class="prof-input" placeholder="Neues Ziel (z. B. Match Quarters entschlüsseln)" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'){UserProfileEngine.addCustomGoal(this.value); this.value='';}" />
                <button type="button" class="prof-btn-small" onclick="const el=document.getElementById('prof-new-goal-input'); UserProfileEngine.addCustomGoal(el.value); el.value='';">Hinzufügen</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="prof-form-footer">
          <button class="prof-btn-save" onclick="UserProfileEngine.saveProfileForm()">
            💾 Einstellungen speichern
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- 4. DATA MANAGEMENT, BACKUP & GRANULAR RESETS SECTION -->
      <div class="prof-section-card" id="prof-data-section">
        <div class="prof-section-header">
          <div>
            <h2 class="prof-section-title">Datenverwaltung, Backup & Resets</h2>
            <p class="prof-section-sub">Volle Kontrolle über deinen lokalen Browserspeicher. Erstelle Backups oder setze gezielt einzelne Bereiche zurück.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- BACKUP EXPORT & IMPORT ROW -->
        <div class="prof-backup-card">
          <div class="prof-backup-info">
            <span class="prof-backup-icon">📦</span>
            <div>
              <h3 class="prof-backup-title">Lokales Daten-Backup (JSON Export / Import)</h3>
              <p class="prof-backup-desc">
                Da alle deine Fortschritte im lokalen Browserspeicher (localStorage) gesichert sind, kannst du hier jederzeit ein vollständiges Backup herunterladen oder auf ein anderes Gerät übertragen.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="prof-backup-btns">
            <button class="prof-btn-export" onclick="UserProfileEngine.exportAllUserData()">
              📥 Backup exportieren (JSON)
            </button>
            <button class="prof-btn-import" onclick="UserProfileEngine.triggerImportModal()">
              📤 Backup wiederherstellen
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- GRANULAR RESETS GRID -->
        <h3 class="prof-sub-heading">Gezieltes Zurücksetzen einzelner Bereiche</h3>
        <p class="prof-sub-desc">Lösche nur spezifische Teildaten, ohne dein gesamtes Profil oder andere Module zu beeinträchtigen:</p>

        <div class="prof-granular-grid">
          <div class="prof-gran-box">
            <div class="prof-gran-header">
              <span class="prof-gran-icon">📅</span>
              <h4>Trainingsplan leeren</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-gran-text">
              Setzt die Wochenpläne, Session-Häkchen, Notizen und Tage-Verschiebungen zurück.
            </p>
            <button class="prof-btn-gran" onclick="UserProfileEngine.resetTrainingPlanOnly()">
              🔄 Nur Trainingsplan zurücksetzen
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="prof-gran-box">
            <div class="prof-gran-header">
              <span class="prof-gran-icon">📚</span>
              <h4>Lernfortschritte & Quizzes</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-gran-text">
              Setzt alle 50 erledigten Akademie-Module sowie Punktestände im Rules Trainer & Quizzes zurück.
            </p>
            <button class="prof-btn-gran" onclick="UserProfileEngine.resetLearningProgressOnly()">
              🔄 Nur Lernfortschritte zurücksetzen
            </button>
          </div>

          <div class="prof-gran-box">
            <div class="prof-gran-header">
              <span class="prof-gran-icon">⚡</span>
              <h4>Eigene Entwürfe & Werkzeuge</h4>
            </div>
            <p class="prof-gran-text">
              Löscht alle selbst gebauten Spielzüge im Play Builder, Team-Roster und deine NFL Tierlist.
            </p>
            <button class="prof-btn-gran" onclick="UserProfileEngine.resetCreativeToolsOnly()">
              🔄 Nur Entwürfe zurücksetzen
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- DANGER ZONE: FULL FACTORY RESET -->
        <div class="prof-danger-zone">
          <div class="prof-danger-header">
            <span class="prof-danger-icon">⚠️</span>
            <div>
              <h3 class="prof-danger-title">Gefahrenzone: Vollständiger Reset (Werkseinstellung)</h3>
              <p class="prof-danger-desc">
                Löscht sämtliche lokalen Daten (Profil, Lernfortschritte, Trainingspläne, Quizzes und eigene Spielzüge) und versetzt die Anwendung in den absoluten Ausgangszustand.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="prof-btn-danger-large" onclick="UserProfileEngine.openFullResetModal()">
            ⚠️ Alle lokalen Daten unwiderruflich löschen...
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
      },

      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------
      // HELPERS & UTILITIES
      // --------------------------------------------------------------------------

      getPathLabel(pathKey) {
        switch (pathKey) {
          case 'player': return '🏈 Spielerausbildung';
          case 'coach': return '🧠 Coachausbildung';
          case 'training_plan': return '📅 Trainingsplan-System';
          default: return '📖 Allgemeines Football-Wissen';
        }
      },

      escapeHtml(str) {
        if (typeof str !== 'string') return '';
        return str
          .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
          .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
          .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
          .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
          .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
      },

      scrollToSettings() {
        const el = document.getElementById('prof-settings-section');
        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      },

      scrollToDataManagement() {
        const el = document.getElementById('prof-data-section');
        if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      },

      openAvatarPicker() {
        const icons = ['🏈', '🎯', '🧠', '🛡️', '⚡', '🏛️', '🔥', '👑', '📋', '⭐', '🏟️', '🦾'];
        const choice = prompt(`Wähle ein Avatar-Symbol aus:\n${icons.join('  ')}`, this.state.avatarIcon || '🏈');
        if (choice && icons.includes(choice.trim())) {
          this.state.avatarIcon = choice.trim();
          this.saveState();
          this.render();
          this.showToast(`Avatar auf "${choice}" aktualisiert!`);
        }
      },

      showToast(msg) {
        if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
          showToast(msg);
        } else {
          let toast = document.getElementById('tp-toast');
          if (!toast) {
            toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.id = 'tp-toast';
            toast.className = 'tp-toast';
            document.body.appendChild(toast);
          }
          toast.textContent = msg;
          toast.classList.add('show');
          setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('show'), 3400);
        }
      }
    };

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      window.UserProfileEngine = UserProfileEngine;
    }





  </script>


  <!-- ==================== MADDEN COMPANION GUIDE MODAL ==================== -->
  <div id="modal-madden-guide" class="madden-modal-overlay" style="display: none;">
    <div class="madden-modal-content">

      <!-- Modal Header -->
      <div
        style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(56,189,248,0.3); padding-bottom: 14px;">
        <div>
          <h2
            style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; color: #fff; margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;">
            <span>🎮</span> Madden Playbook Companion & Controller Guide
          </h2>
          <span style="font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent-cyan); font-weight: 700;">
            Football-Wissen in Madden-Gameplay übersetzen – mit klarer Trennung von realer NFL-Taktik und
            Videospielmechanik.
          </span>
        </div>
        <button class="pb-modal-close" onclick="closeMaddenGuideModal()">✕</button>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab Bar -->
      <div class="madden-guide-tabs">
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn active" data-madden-tab="passing"
          onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('passing')">🎯 Passing & Mechanics</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="running" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('running')">🏃
          Laufspiel & Sprint-Falle</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="protections"
          onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('protections')">🛡️ Protections & O-Line</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="personnel" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('personnel')">👥
          Formations & Personnel</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="routes" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('routes')">📈 Routen
          & Thresholds</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="defense" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('defense')">🔒
          Defense & Usering</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="matrix" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('matrix')">⚖️ NFL
          vs. Madden Matrix</button>
        <button class="madden-guide-tab-btn" data-madden-tab="mistakes" onclick="switchMaddenGuideTab('mistakes')">⚠️ 5
          Anfängerfehler</button>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 1: PASSING -->
      <div id="madden-tab-passing" class="madden-guide-tab-pane">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🎯</span> Die 4 Wurfarten</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>1. Bullet Pass (Taste gedrückt halten):</strong> Maximales Balltempo mit flacher Flugbahn.
                Unerlässlich für Quick Slants, Out-Routen und Hitch-Pässe in enge Fenster.</p>
              <p><strong>2. Touch Pass (Taste mittellang antippen):</strong> Perfekter Bogen über absinkende Linebacker
                vor die heraneilenden Safeties (z.B. für Dagger Digs oder Seams).</p>
              <p><strong>3. Lob Pass (Taste nur ganz kurz antippen):</strong> Hohe Flugparabel für tiefe Go- und
                Fade-Routen an die Auslinie.</p>
              <p><strong>4. High Point (L1 / LB + Wurfknopf):</strong> Jump-Ball für großgewachsene Tight Ends und
                Redzone-Fade-Routen.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🕹️</span> Pass Lead & Free-Form Passing</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Pass Lead (Linker Stick während des Wurfs):</strong> Leitet den Receiver in den freien Raum weg
                vom Cornerback. Bei Out-Routen Stick hart nach außen halten; bei Slants nach vorne in den Lauf führen.
              </p>
              <p><strong>Low Pass (L2 / LT + Wurf):</strong> Zwingt den Receiver zu einem tiefen Catch und minimiert
                Interceptions über der Spielfeldmitte.</p>
              <p><strong>Catch Mechanics:</strong></p>
              • <strong>Possession Catch (A / X):</strong> Sichert den First Down, schützt vor Fumbles und
              Hit-Sticks.<br>
              • <strong>RAC Catch (X / Square):</strong> Nimmt maximalen Schwung für Yards After Catch mit.<br>
              • <strong>Aggressive Catch (Y / Triangle):</strong> Springt hoch für umkämpfte 50/50-Bälle.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 2: RUNNING -->
      <div id="madden-tab-running" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card"
            style="border-color: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.4); background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.06);">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title" style="color: #fca5a5;"><span>⚠️</span> Die goldene Regel: Die
              Sprint-Falle (R2 / RT)</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Warum du NIEMALS vor der Line of Scrimmage sprinten darfst:</strong></p>
              <p>Die Madden-Spiel-Engine besitzt einen fest programmierten 'Block Shed'-Code: Sobald der Spieler den
                Sprint-Knopf (R2 / RT) drückt, erhalten alle gegnerischen Defensive Linemen sofort eine erhöhte Chance,
                sich blitzartig von ihren O-Line Blöcken zu lösen!</p>
              <p><strong>Die richtige Ausführung:</strong> Steuere den Running Back im Backfield mit sanften Berührungen
                des linken Sticks. Lass Guards und Center ihre Doppelblocks ansetzen. Zünde den Sprint-Booster erst,
                wenn du das freie Gap durchquert hast!</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🏃</span> Gap-Geduld & One-Cut Mechanik</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Inside Zone vs. Outside Zone:</strong></p>
              • <strong>Inside Zone:</strong> Bleibe geduldig hinter Center und Guard. Suche das Backside Cutback A-Gap,
              wenn der D-Tackle nach außen schiebt.<br>
              • <strong>Outside Zone / Stretch:</strong> Halte den Stick schräg nach außen. Wenn der Edge Rusher die
              Außenbahn blockiert, drücke den Stick hart nach vorne oben für den 'One-Cut' Beschleunigungsboost ins
              Feld.<br>
              • <strong>Duo & Power:</strong> Folge blind den Vorblockern (Puller / Fullback). Überhole niemals deinen
              Lead-Blocker!
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 3: PROTECTIONS -->
      <div id="madden-tab-protections" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🛡️</span> Das Pre-Snap L1 / LB Schutzmenü</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>1. Slide Left / Right (Linker Stick nach links/rechts):</strong> Schiebt die Schutzlinie der
                Offensive Line zu einer Seite, um Overload-Blitzes und Cornerback-Blitze abzufangen.</p>
              <p><strong>2. Pinch (Linker Stick nach unten):</strong> Zieht Guards und Tackles eng zusammen, um
                gefährliche A-Gap Blitzes (wie Mid Blitz) zu neutralisieren.</p>
              <p><strong>3. Max Protect (R2 / RT):</strong> Hält Tight End und Running Back im Block, sodass 7 Spieler
                den Quarterback gegen 6- und 7-Mann Heavy Pressures absichern.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🎯</span> 'ID the Mike' & Double Team</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>ID the Mike (L1 / LB $\rightarrow$ X / Square):</strong></p>
              <p>Wähle vor dem Snap den gegnerischen Linebacker oder Safety aus, der am gefährlichsten aussieht. Der
                Center und Running Back richten ihre Block-Priorität sofort auf diesen Spieler aus. Verhindert unblockte
                Free Rusher!</p>
              <p><strong>Double Team (L1 / LB $\rightarrow$ Rechter Stick nach unten):</strong></p>
              <p>Platziert zwei Offensive Linemen gegen einen dominanten Superstar Pass Rusher (z.B. Micah Parsons oder
                Myles Garrett), um dessen Pass-Rush-Abilitys zu neutralisieren.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 4: PERSONNEL -->
      <div id="madden-tab-personnel" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>👥</span> Match Personnel Regel</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Wie Defense-Play-Calling funktioniert:</strong></p>
              • <strong>3 Wide Receiver (11 Personnel):</strong> Verteidige IMMER mit Nickel (5 DBs), um keinen
              langsamen Linebacker gegen einen flinken Slot-Receiver isoliert zu haben.<br>
              • <strong>4 Wide Receiver (10 Personnel):</strong> Wechsle auf Dime oder Dollar (6 DBs).<br>
              • <strong>2 TEs / 2 RBs (12 oder 21 Personnel):</strong> Wähle Base Defense (4-3 oder 3-4), um physisch
              gegen Power- und Duo-Läufe gegenzuhalten.
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>⚡</span> Sub-LB Meta (Safety als Linebacker)</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Die wichtigste defensive Einstellung in Madden:</strong></p>
              <p>Normale Linebacker haben in Madden oft zu niedrige Agility- und Speed-Werte, um moderne Crossing-Routen
                über das Feld zu verteidigen. Setze daher im Depth Chart unter 'Sub-LB' schnelle Strong Safeties ein.
                Dies verleiht deiner Defense explosive Wendigkeit und verhindert Jumping-Penalty-Nachteile.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 5: ROUTES -->
      <div id="madden-tab-routes" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>📈</span> Route Running Thresholds (90 RR)</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Die magische 90er-Grenze in Madden:</strong></p>
              <p>Receiver mit Short (SRR), Medium (MRR) oder Deep Route Running (DRR) über 90 schalten völlig neue
                Cut-Animationen frei! Sie stoppen auf der Stelle ab ('Snappy Cuts') und erzeugen 2 bis 3 Yards
                Separation gegen Man Coverage.</p>
              <p><strong>Smart Routes (R1 / RB im Hot-Route-Menü):</strong> Passt Out-, In- und Curl-Routen automatisch
                exakt an die First-Down-Marker-Linie an!</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🚀</span> Clearout Streaks & High-Low Reads</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Clearout-Routen:</strong> Stelle outside Receiver auf 'Fade/Streak', um Deep Thirds und Deep
                Quarters der gegnerischen Zonen nach hinten zu ziehen. Dadurch wird die darunterliegende 12-Yard
                Out-Route (Flood) oder Dig (Dagger) sperrangelweit frei!</p>
              <p><strong>High-Low Stress:</strong> Zwingt den Zonen-Verteidiger zur Wahl: Springt er nach vorne, wirf
                tief; bleibt er tief, nimm den einfachen First Down darunter.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 6: DEFENSE USERING -->
      <div id="madden-tab-defense" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div class="madden-guide-grid">
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>🎮</span> User-Control: No D-Line Usering!</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Der größte Sprung vom Anfänger zum Profi:</strong></p>
              <p>Steuere NIEMALS einen Defensive Lineman! Die KI kann Pass Rush automatisch abwickeln. Übernimm
                stattdessen den Middle Linebacker oder Sub-LB als 'User Defender'.</p>
              <p><strong>Lurken über der Mitte:</strong> Lese die QB-Augen, täusche vor, den ersten Crosser zu decken
                ('Baiting'), und sprinte im richtigen Moment in die Passbahn des zweiten Crossers!</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="madden-guide-card">
            <span class="madden-guide-card-title"><span>⚙️</span> Zone Drops & Shade Technique</span>
            <div class="madden-guide-card-body">
              <p><strong>Coaching Adjustments $\rightarrow$ Zone Drops:</strong></p>
              • <strong>Flats auf 20 bis 25 Yards:</strong> Verteidigt automatisch gegnerische Corner-Routen aus Gun
              Bunch.<br>
              • <strong>Curl Flats auf 10 Yards:</strong> Fängt Intermediate Digs und In-Routen ab.<br>
              <p><strong>Coverage Shades (Dreieck / Y vor dem Snap):</strong></p>
              • <strong>Shade Over the Top (Rechter Stick nach oben):</strong> Verhindert tiefe Burner über die
              Außenlinie.<br>
              • <strong>Shade Underneath (Rechter Stick nach unten):</strong> Verwandelt Soft Flats in aggressive Hard
              Flats gegen Checkdowns.
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 7: MATRIX -->
      <div id="madden-tab-matrix" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div
          style="background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow-x: auto;">
          <table class="madden-diff-table">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th style="width: 22%;">Football-Konzept</th>
                <th style="width: 39%; color: #6ee7b7;">🏈 Reale NFL-Wissenschaft & Regelwerk</th>
                <th style="width: 39%; color: #7dd3fc;">🎮 Madden-Videospielmechanik</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr>
                <td><strong>Laufspiel & Blocken</strong></td>
                <td>O-Line liest Fronts, verschiebt Gewicht dynamisch, Block-Shedding erfolgt durch physische Leverage
                  und Technik.</td>
                <td>Sprint-Taste (R2/RT) aktiviert programmierbaren 'Block Shed'-Code der CPU. Geduld am Stick ist
                  wichtiger als echte Leverage.</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td><strong>Cover 2 Schwachstelle</strong></td>
                <td>'Turkey Hole' an der Seitenlinie erfordert perfekten NFL-Arm mit Touchdown-Pass zwischen Flat-CB und
                  tiefem Safety.</td>
                <td>Tiefe Seam-Routen in Four Verts reißen Cover 2 ohne Tampa-2-Audible komplett auseinander;
                  DB-Abilities wie 'Deep Out Zone KO' greifen spektakulär.</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td><strong>Pass Protection</strong></td>
                <td>Komplexe Half-Slide- und Dual-Read-Konzepte des Centers basierend auf Filmstudium und Blitzer-Look.
                </td>
                <td>Einfaches L1/LB Menü: Slide Left/Right, Max Protect und 'ID the Mike' garantieren feste Zuweisungen.
                </td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td><strong>Defensive Reaction</strong></td>
                <td>Linebacker lesen Guard-Keys und Mesh-Points diszipliniert; Fehltritte werden sofort bestraft.</td>
                <td>Menschlicher 'User Defender' mit 'Lurker'-Ability kann unphysikalisch hoch in die Luft springen und
                  Pässe 10 Yards entfernt abfangen.</td>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <td><strong>RPO Timing</strong></td>
                <td>O-Linemen dürfen maximal 1 Yard nach vorne treten, bevor der Ball geworfen wird (Ineligible
                  Downfield).</td>
                <td>Madden-Schiedsrichter pfeift nach ca. 1.2 Sekunden gnadenlos ab, wenn der Wurfbutton nicht sofort
                  betätigt wurde.</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- TAB 8: MISTAKES -->
      <div id="madden-tab-mistakes" class="madden-guide-tab-pane" style="display: none;">
        <div
          style="background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.35); border-radius: var(--radius-md); padding: 18px;">
          <span
            style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; color: #fca5a5; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;">
            <span>⚠️</span> Die 5 fatalsten Anfängerfehler in Madden (und ihre Lösung)
          </span>
          <ol style="margin: 0; padding-left: 22px; font-size: 13px; color: #fecdd3; line-height: 1.8;">
            <li><strong>Sofort sprinten im Backfield:</strong> Zerstört die eigenen Blocks der Offensive Line.
              $\rightarrow$ <em>Lösung:</em> Erst sprinten, wenn das Loch frei ist!</li>
            <li><strong>Panik-Scrambling nach hinten:</strong> Rückwärts rennen aktiviert den automatischen
              Disengage-Speedboost der Edge Rusher $\rightarrow$ 15-Yard-Sack! $\rightarrow$ <em>Lösung:</em> 'Step Up'
              in the Pocket!</li>
            <li><strong>Stures Bullet-Pass Werfen:</strong> Führt zu 90% der Interceptions gegen Zonen-Linebacker mit
              der 'Lurker'-Ability. $\rightarrow$ <em>Lösung:</em> Nutze Touch Pässe für Raum hinter LBs.</li>
            <li><strong>Tunnel Vision auf den 1. Read:</strong> Den Ball in Double Coverage forcieren, statt den freien
              Checkdown-Running Back zu bedienen. $\rightarrow$ <em>Lösung:</em> Checkdowns nehmen! 4 Yards sind ein
              Gewinn!</li>
            <li><strong>Blindes All-Out Blitzing:</strong> Ohne Pre-Snap Safety-Absicherung wird Cover 0 von schnellen
              Slants und RPOs sofort für 75-Yard-TDs bestraft. $\rightarrow$ <em>Lösung:</em> Sim Pressure oder Cover 3
              Match spielen.</li>
          </ol>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Modal Footer -->
      <div
        style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.15); padding-top: 14px;">
        <button class="pb-action-btn primary" onclick="closeMaddenGuideModal()">
          Verstanden & Schließen
        </button>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

</body>

</html>
